Headquartered in Boca Raton, FL, we offer a professional, fast\-paced environment that is collaborative, innovative, and never overly corporate. We recruit, credential, license and place physicians and advanced practice providers with hospitals and health systems in every state, an we support the full lifecycle of that relationship. As a Sun\-Sentinel Top Places to Work recipient, we invest in our people—their personal, professional, and financial goals—while fostering a culture built on teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement. If you're looking for the opportunity to influence executive strategy, lead transformational initiatives, and help shape the future of a growing organization, All Star is the place to build your career. **What You Will Do** All Star Healthcare Solutions is seeking an experienced **AI Engineer** to design, build, and deploy AI capabilities across the enterprise. This position reports to the Chief Information Officer and works alongside the Salesforce Architect and Platform Owner, Salesforce Engineers, Salesforce Administrator, Analytics Engineer, and the Project Manager/Business Analyst on a single flat technology team. This position builds production AI solutions — agents, automations, and model\-backed features — on the Salesforce Platform, on Microsoft 365, and against the enterprise data warehouse, This role also defines the guardrails those solutions operate within. This position combines hands\-on engineering with the judgment to say when a use case is not ready to automate. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** **You Will Own the Following:** * Design, build, test, and deploy AI solutions end to end — agents, assistants, retrieval pipelines, classification and extraction services, and model\-backed automations * Build Agentforce agents on the Salesforce Platform — topic and action design, grounding, prompt templates, testing, and release * Build and support AI capabilities on Microsoft 365 and Claude Enterprise, including custom integrations, MCP servers, and internal tooling * Engineer the retrieval and grounding layer against enterprise data — source selection, chunking, embedding, indexing, and relevance evaluation * Define and implement AI guardrails — data access scoping, encryption, PII and PHI handling, prompt injection defense, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and audit logging * Build evaluation harnesses and regression suites for AI features; measure accuracy, latency, cost per task, and failure modes before and after release * Instrument deployed AI in production — usage, cost, error, and quality monitoring — and act on what * 6\+ years of software or data engineering experience, including 2\+ years building and shipping production AI or LLM\-backed applications * Hands\-on experience with LLM application patterns — retrieval\-augmented generation, tool and function calling, agent orchestration, structured output, and prompt engineering * Proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, and fluency with REST APIs, webhooks, and event\-driven integration * Experience building on at least one major model platform (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Google) and familiarity with the Model Context Protocol * Experience deploying AI capability inside an enterprise SaaS platform — Agentforce, Einstein, Copilot, or equivalent * Strong data engineering fundamentals — SQL, data modeling, ELT pipelines, and working with a cloud data warehouse * Demonstrated ownership of AI evaluation and testing — defining success criteria, building eval sets, and measuring accuracy and regression * Working knowledge of AI security and governance — access scoping, data residency, PII and PHI handling, and auditability * Advanced understanding of CI/CD concepts, source control, unit testing principles, and release management * Advanced understanding of Agile software development methodologies, values, and procedures (Scrum, Kanban) * Strong presentation and documentation/technical writing skills Experience in owning end\-to\-end engineering initiatives **Why You'll Love Working Here** At All Star Healthcare Solutions, we believe our employees are our greatest investment. We offer a competitive total rewards package designed to support your career growth, well\-being, and work\-life balance. **Perks \& Benefits** * Competitive base salary with an annual discretionary bonus opportunity * Remote work model that supports flexibility while fostering collaboration and connection * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future * Three weeks of paid time off, plus 10 paid holidays * Paid parental leave * Ongoing professional development and leadership growth opportunities * Opportunity to help shape the financial strategy of one of the nation's fastest\-growing healthcare staffing organizations * A collaborative, people\-first culture where your ideas are valued and innovation is encouraged **Location** This position offers the flexibility to work remotely, allowing you to contribute, collaborate, and stay connected with the team from your home workspace. We’re looking for someone who thrives in a remote environment and can communicate and collaborate effectively across teams. jobs.title: AI Engineer II
jobs.description: **Salary Grade: 20** **SUMMARY:** The AI Engineer II is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting AI enabled applications, agentic workflows, and enterprise integrations that drive innovation and operational efficiency across Mutual Bancorp. This hands on engineering role partners with Information Technology and business teams to translate business needs into secure, scalable, and reliable AI solutions. Key responsibilities include developing AI applications and agents, integrating AI capabilities with enterprise systems and data platforms, implementing technical governance and security controls, and establishing testing, monitoring, and operational support practices. The AI Engineer II leads assigned technical workstreams, promotes reusable engineering standards, and contributes to the continued development and adoption of AI capabilities across the organization. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** * **AI Solution Implementation:** Design and deliver approved AI applications, implementing AI enabled tools, workflows, and agents that solve business problems. Create workflows and automations from requirements through production support including AI Governance, Internal Models, and Model Harnesses, and AI related projects from other lines of business. * **Enterprise Integration:** Build secure API and data integrations with Snowflake, business applications, and approved AI services. Partner with Data Engineering on source quality, access, and lineage. Build integrations between Snowflake, ChatGPT Enterprise, and other approved tools using A2A, ACP, MCP, ANP, APIs, and other AI protocols. * **AI Development:** Write and maintain dashboards that support data visibility, agentic workflows, document handling, data preparation, workflow routing, and operational processes. Use version control, automated testing, peer review, and change management practices. Improve documentation and reusable patterns across solutions. * **LLM Integration:** Integrate applications with approved large language models, including enterprise hosted, privately deployed, and third\-party services. Understand model capabilities, context windows, token usage, inference parameters, and limitations. * **Internal AI Models:** Support deployment and integration of internally hosted or privately managed models when required by security, privacy, performance, or business requirements. * **Testing:** Define acceptance criteria and repeatable tests for output quality, accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost. Record results and resolve defects before releases. Ensure model consistency is observable, measured, and tested. * **Agentic AI Development:** Develop AI agents capable of completing multistep tasks, retrieving information, using tools, and interacting with approved systems. Configure agent instructions, execution logic, permissions, state management, and appropriate human intervention points. * **Security \& Privacy:** Apply authentication, role based access, logging, and secure development practices. Protect customer and bank information under established policies and approved data flows. * **Operations:** Implement application monitoring, alerts, recovery procedures, and runbooks. Troubleshoot production issues and coordinate fixes with system owners and support teams. Manage high risk migrations as they arise. * **User Experience:** Develop or integrate user interfaces that allow employees to interact with AI applications. Support conversational interfaces, internal applications, and workflow based experiences using approved development platforms. * **Responsible AI Governance:** Monitor AI and Agentic AI performance**,** provide testing results, data flow documentation, and evidence for AI Working Group reviews and risk partners. Support approved monitoring controls in AI governance applications. * **Use Case Outcomes:** Partner with AI Analysts and business teams to measure quality improvements, processing time, adoption, and other agreed outcomes; improve solutions using those findings. * **Collaboration:** Work with Lending, Operations, Finance, IT, and other areas to translate needs into technical designs. Provide guidance as needed to AI colleagues. * **Other Duties:** Perform other duties as assigned. **QUALIFICATIONS:** **EDUCATION \& CERTIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES:** * 5 years of professional experience in AI engineering, software engineering, data science, data engineering, systems integration, technical process excellence/automation, or a closely related field. * Proficiency in Python and other coding language skills, with a history of improving deployment reliability and reducing manual work * Experience leading critical migrations, ensuring key system reliability and a seamless migration experience for users. * Experience with version control such as Git, CI/CD workflows, code review, documentation, and Agile or Jira based delivery. * Experience delivering production software, automated workflows, or data integrations with monitoring and support procedures. * History of cross functional collaboration between subject matter experts, project management, banking lines of business, nontechnical users. * Working knowledge of generative AI applications, including retrieval, model evaluation, and reliable handling of AI outputs. * Experience working with process excellence teams to develop automated workflows for regulated financial institutions is preferred. * Experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform preferred; familiarity with ChatGPT Enterprise or approved enterprise AI services preferred. * Understanding of application security, data access controls, and secure handling of confidential information. * Familiarity with core banking systems (Jack Henry, FIS, Fiserv, AS400/DB2 systems) preferred. * Prior experience in banking, credit unions, or financial services, with exposure to core banking platforms or shared services across multiple entities. * Familiarity with regulatory and financial reporting concepts such as Call Reports, SOX, CCPA, CECL, or related bank reporting requirements. * Ability to lead technical workstreams, coordinate priorities, and manage delivery details. * Ability to translate business requirements into technical designs, acceptance criteria, data models, and quality controls. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to Finance, business, and technical and non technical stakeholders. * Ability to mentor other engineers, conduct constructive code reviews, and promote reusable patterns and documentation standards. * Strong problem solving, systems thinking, and incident troubleshooting skills. * Sound judgment when working with sensitive data, third\-party services, and production systems. * Cybersecurity awareness and a commitment to responsible, controlled use of AI in banking. * Familiarity with Jira/Agile methodology for project and task management. * Relevant certifications are a plus. Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview** As an AI/ML Engineer, you’ll turn data into practical, reliable solutions. You’ll build and deploy machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI) models, collaborate with research and product teams, and help ensure systems are useful, scalable, and ready for real\-world needs. **Duties** * Prepare data through extract, transform, and load (ETL) workflows, data mining, and database design; work with SQL databases, linked data, and big data systems. * Develop, train, and evaluate machine learning models, including predictive modeling, statistical modeling, unsupervised learning, natural language processing, and generative AI. * Implement AI solutions and scalable model deployment using machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and machine learning cloud services, including AWS. * Apply statistical analysis, statistical analysis for research, and data analytics; communicate findings with analytics tools such as Looker. * Your impact: By delivering well\-evaluated, scalable models, you help teams make informed decisions and provide users with more relevant, dependable solutions. **Experience** * **Essential:** Practical experience with machine learning, model training and evaluation, AI implementation, Python, and SQL; familiarity with statistical analysis tools and model deployment. * **Preferred:** Experience with Spark implementation, Hadoop, big data, and Talend; knowledge of Java, C, R, SAS, VBA, and Bash (Unix shell). * Familiarity with machine learning/AI\-based analysis, Spark, scalability, and machine learning cloud services is valuable. * Quantum engineering experience or knowledge is a plus. Pay: $67,700\.00 \- $98,600\.00 per year Benefits: * Relocation assistance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AWS DevOps & Full Stack Technical Lead
jobs.description: **Pivot Point Solutions** ========================= Pivot Point Solutions is a California\-based technology consulting firm that specializes in delivering IT solutions and support for the construction and utility industries. We partner with organizations across the state to provide reliable technology services that improve operational efficiency, enhance project delivery, and support critical business systems. Our team understands the unique technology challenges facing construction and utility organizations, from field operations and infrastructure projects to enterprise applications and cybersecurity. By combining industry expertise with responsive service, we help clients modernize their technology environments, streamline workflows, and maintain secure, reliable IT systems that support long\-term growth. **Job Overview** ---------------- **Title:** AWS DevOps \& Full Stack Technical Lead **Sector:** Information Technology / Cloud Engineering \& Software Development **Seniority:** Expert Level **Location:** Oakland, CA **Job Type:** Remote Eligible – Potential Quarterly Onsite Planning Sessions **Contract Length:** 12 months \+ **Compensation:** $65 \- $80/hr **Role Overview** ----------------- Pivot Point Solutions is seeking an experienced AWS DevOps \& Full Stack Technical Lead to oversee the architecture, development, automation, deployment and production support of enterprise cloud applications supporting customer\-facing digital services. The ideal candidate combines hands\-on software development experience with advanced AWS cloud engineering, Infrastructure as Code and DevOps capabilities. This individual will lead technical design decisions, contribute production\-quality code, establish engineering standards, mentor developers and ensure applications and infrastructure meet enterprise security, scalability, reliability and performance requirements. **Your Day\-to\-Day Activities** -------------------------------- * Lead the architecture, development, deployment and production support of enterprise applications hosted in AWS. * Design scalable, secure and highly available AWS cloud solutions supporting customer\-facing applications. * Develop full\-stack applications, backend services, REST APIs, microservices and automation solutions using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js. * Develop reusable Terraform modules and Infrastructure as Code solutions to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning and environment management. * Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting automated builds, testing, security validation, deployments and rollbacks. * Establish Git\-based development standards, including branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews and release management. * Provide hands\-on technical leadership through software development, architecture reviews, infrastructure code reviews and developer mentorship. * Develop Python and Node.js automation solutions to improve deployment efficiency, infrastructure management and operational support. * Implement AWS services supporting compute, storage, networking, APIs, serverless workloads and identity management. * Establish monitoring, logging, alerting and observability capabilities across applications and cloud infrastructure. * Lead technical incident response, root\-cause analysis, production recovery and corrective actions. * Implement cloud and application security practices, including IAM, least\-privilege access, encryption, secrets management and vulnerability remediation. * Establish engineering standards for automated testing, scalability, resiliency, security and production readiness. * Coordinate technical delivery across development, architecture, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, quality engineering and product teams. * Maintain architecture diagrams, infrastructure configurations, operational runbooks, deployment procedures and recovery plans. * Identify and implement modernization opportunities across cloud infrastructure, application frameworks and DevOps tooling. **The Job Requirements** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 7\+ years of software development, cloud engineering, DevOps or related technology experience supporting production applications. * Hands\-on experience designing, deploying and supporting enterprise solutions within AWS cloud environments. * Hands\-on development experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js, including backend services, automation or full\-stack applications. * Experience provisioning and managing cloud infrastructure using Terraform or equivalent Infrastructure as Code technologies. * Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, automated build and deployment processes, Git\-based source control and code reviews. * Experience developing REST APIs, enterprise integrations and supporting business\-critical production systems through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response and recovery. * Experience providing hands\-on technical leadership across application development, cloud architecture, DevOps and production support. **You'll Stand Out If You Have** -------------------------------- * Advanced experience with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, serverless architectures and event\-driven integrations. * Experience developing reusable Terraform modules, managing infrastructure state and integrating Infrastructure as Code with CI/CD pipelines. * Experience with Docker, AWS container services, automated testing, distributed observability and cloud security frameworks. * Experience supporting high\-volume customer\-facing digital applications with complex availability, scalability, disaster recovery and performance requirements. **About Pivot Point Solutions** ------------------------------- Pivot Point Solutions is committed to delivering technology solutions that help construction and utility organizations operate more efficiently, securely, and effectively. We work closely with our clients to provide experienced IT professionals who can support enterprise systems, modernize technology environments, and deliver reliable solutions to complex business challenges. Our team values technical expertise, collaboration, and practical problem\-solving. By connecting skilled technology professionals with meaningful projects, we help organizations strengthen their technology capabilities while providing opportunities for professionals to contribute to impactful initiatives.

experience with Databricks, Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, and lakehouse architecture. * Experience analyzing and modernizing batch ingestion pipelines. * Ability to assess undocumented or jobs.title: Cybersecurity/Bootloader Expert
jobs.description: **Position Summary** ==================== The Cybersecurity/Bootloader Expert is the technical lead for embedded cybersecurity and bootloader development on electronic control units (ECUs) for BWI's Suspension or Brakes product lines. This role defines and implements secure boot, secure flashing and on\-board communication security, leads threat analysis and risk assessment (TARA) activities, and ensures products meet ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE R155/R156 and customer cybersecurity requirements. The Cybersecurity/Bootloader Expert works closely with software, systems, hardware, functional safety and validation teams, and serves as BWI's technical point of contact with customers and suppliers on cybersecurity and bootloader topics. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ========================================= * Design, develop, integrate and maintain bootloader software for brake or suspension ECUs, including secure boot, secure flashing and reprogramming over UDS (ISO 14229\) via CAN, CAN FD and Automotive Ethernet. * Define and implement ECU cybersecurity features such as secure on\-board communication (AUTOSAR SecOC), secure diagnostics and authentication, key and certificate management, and secure debug access. * Configure and integrate hardware security modules (HSM) and cryptographic libraries on automotive microcontrollers. * Lead threat analysis and risk assessment (TARA) activities and derive cybersecurity goals, concepts and technical requirements in line with ISO/SAE 21434\. * Create and maintain cybersecurity work products, including the cybersecurity plan, cybersecurity case and related documentation required for customer and audit review. * Support compliance with UNECE R155 (cybersecurity management) and R156 (software update management), including software over\-the\-air (OTA) update readiness. * Plan and support cybersecurity verification and validation, including fuzz testing, penetration testing and vulnerability scanning, and drive resolution of findings. * Monitor and assess cybersecurity vulnerabilities affecting products in development and in the field, and lead incident response and remediation activities. * Work with functional safety (ISO 26262\) engineers to align cybersecurity and safety requirements and resolve conflicts. * Serve as the technical point of contact for customers and suppliers on cybersecurity and bootloader requirements, reviews and audits. * Review customer cybersecurity and flashing specifications, support RFQ technical responses, and estimate effort for new programs. * Mentor software engineers on secure coding practices and bootloader architecture, and help develop internal cybersecurity processes and guidelines. * Collaborate with global BWI engineering teams to share best practices and reusable cybersecurity and bootloader components. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. * 5\+ years of embedded software development experience in the automotive industry, including at least 3 years focused on bootloaders and/or automotive cybersecurity. * Hands\-on experience with secure boot, secure flashing and UDS (ISO 14229\) diagnostic and reprogramming services. * Working knowledge of ISO/SAE 21434 and UNECE R155/R156\. * Experience with cryptographic fundamentals (symmetric and asymmetric encryption, hashing, digital signatures, MAC) and key management. * Proficiency in embedded C on automotive microcontrollers. * Experience with vehicle networks (CAN, CAN FD; Automotive Ethernet a plus) and tools such as Vector CANoe/CANalyzer. * Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical risks to engineering teams, management and customers. **Preferred** * Master's degree in a related engineering or computer science field. * Experience with AUTOSAR Classic, including the crypto stack, SecOC and bootloader/flash driver integration. * Experience with hardware security modules on automotive MCUs (such as Infineon AURIX HSM or NXP HSE). * Experience with brake (electronic stability control, brake\-by\-wire) or suspension (semi\-active damping) ECUs. * Knowledge of ISO 26262 functional safety and how it interacts with cybersecurity. * Experience with penetration testing, fuzz testing or vulnerability management tools. * Experience with public key infrastructure (PKI) and software OTA update solutions. * Automotive cybersecurity certification (such as ISO/SAE 21434 practitioner) or equivalent industry certification. **Key Competencies** ==================== * **Technical Expertise:** Applies deep knowledge of embedded security and bootloaders to solve complex problems and set technical direction. * **Security Mindset:** Thinks like an attacker to anticipate threats and builds protection in from the start. * **Attention to Detail:** Produces precise, well\-documented work that holds up under customer and audit review. * **Problem Solving:** Breaks down complex issues, identifies root causes and develops practical, timely solutions. * **Collaboration:** Works effectively across software, hardware, safety, validation and global teams. * **Communication:** Explains technical risks and requirements clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * **Continuous Learning:** Keeps current on evolving threats, standards and regulations and shares that knowledge with others. **Travel** ========== Travel is needed based on project and product development demands, including technical exchanges, on\-site work at customer sites, regional technical centers, supplier facilities and including occasional international travel. **Work Environment and Physical Requirements** ============================================== * Primarily an office and engineering lab environment, with occasional time on the manufacturing floor, in test vehicles and at customer or supplier facilities. * Must wear required personal protective jobs.title: Electrical & Electronics Engineer AI Evaluator
jobs.description: About the RoleWe are looking for experienced, hands\-on electrical and electronics engineers to help evaluate and train frontier AI models on real\-world hardware and circuit engineering work. While modern AI models can talk fluently about electronics, they still struggle to reliably execute actual engineering tasks—such as specifying a circuit, stabilizing a control loop, closing a link budget, sizing a power stage, or debugging a signal chain. In this role, you will bring the practical judgment you have built designing, simulating, bringing up, and debugging real hardware. You will design challenging, open\-ended engineering tasks drawn from your own day\-to\-day practice, run them through frontier AI models, and grade the results against a professional standard. Tasks range from compact scenarios built around a handful of files to larger, multi\-day engineering problems. In every case, the goal is the same: create a realistic problem that a competent practitioner would solve correctly, but that a frontier model currently gets wrong. This is not a traditional hardware engineering position. There is no shift work or production floor support; instead, it is a flexible, long\-form, self\-directed remote contract where clear written reasoning and physical intuition matter just as much as technical depth. **Responsibilities** * **Design Realistic Engineering Tasks:** Craft challenging circuit\- and system\-level scenarios drawn from your own expertise—complete with realistic supporting files you author yourself (schematics, simulation setups, datasheets, board files, and measurement data). * **Evaluate AI Deliverables:** Run your tasks through frontier AI models and grade their outputs (derivations, schematics, component selections, simulation setups, and design calculations) against the bar you would hold a colleague to. * **Compare \& Benchmark Models:** Evaluate side\-by\-side model responses on identical prompts and supporting files, decide which performed better, and document precisely where each fell short. * **Author Grading Rubrics:** Write detailed grading rubrics and the technical rationale behind your judgments to define what a physically sound, complete deliverable requires. * **Flag Model Failures with Evidence:** Identify and document concrete errors including unstated or incorrect assumptions, sign and unit errors, unphysical results, invalid component or topology choices, misapplied approximations, fabricated datasheet values, misread schematics/plots, and off\-brief interpretations. * **Cross\-Domain Contribution \& Peer Review:** Contribute across analog, RF/mixed\-signal, power electronics, embedded/controls, signal processing, electromagnetics, photonics, and energy systems, while reviewing and refining tasks built by fellow engineers. **Representative Task Types** * Specifying a circuit or sizing a power stage with defensible component tradeoffs. * Stabilizing a feedback control loop. * Closing an RF or optical link budget. * Debugging a noisy or failing mixed\-signal chain from measurement data. * Conducting a mixed\-signal or embedded telemetry PCB power and thermal design review. * Creating a photonic test\-circuit layout and verification setup. **Domain Qualifications** * **Hands\-On Industry Experience:** 2\+ years of industry experience in circuit or electronics engineering (5\+ years is a plus), currently or very recently performing technical design, simulation, and debug work at an individual\-contributor level. * **Specialty Depth:** Practical hardware experience in at least one core discipline: * Analog, RF, and mixed\-signal circuits * Power electronics and electric power/energy systems * Embedded systems, firmware/hardware, and controls * PCB and board\-level hardware design * Signal processing, electromagnetics, antennas, and microwaves * Electronic devices, materials, photonics, and optoelectronics * **Circuit \& System Mastery:** Strong command of circuit analysis and design tradeoffs, with the ability to defend both component\-level and system\-level engineering decisions. * **Tooling Fluency:** Hands\-on proficiency in standard industry tools—including circuit simulation (SPICE or similar), schematic capture and PCB layout tools, lab instrumentation, and MATLAB or Python for engineering analysis. * **Education:** An in\-progress or completed Bachelor’s degree or higher in electrical engineering, electronics engineering, or a closely related field is preferred, though verifiable hands\-on circuit and hardware experience outweighs formal degrees or PE licensure. **General Requirements** * **Analytical Rigor \& Communication:** Full professional or native\-level written and spoken English. You are meticulous, verify claims against underlying numbers and datasheets, and can clearly articulate *why* an engineering solution is wrong, not just *that* it is wrong. * **Autonomy:** Comfortable working independently in ambiguous, open\-ended scenarios and applying reviewer feedback without hand\-holding. * **AI \& Tech Literacy:** General user\-level familiarity with LLM tools (such as Claude or ChatGPT) to distinguish a well\-reasoned technical derivation from a plausible\-sounding hallucination (or the ability to pick these tools up quickly). Comfortable with cloud file tools (Google Workspace), browser profiles, desktop apps, and standard file handling (Excel/Google Sheets conversions, zip files). * **Weekly Availability:** Minimum of 10 hours per week with no weekly cap; **30–40\+ hours/week is prioritized** and full\-time capacity is available. **Compensation \& Terms** * **Pay Rate:** $40–$125/hr USD (with bonus rates available on select projects). * **Schedule:** Contract position, fully remote, with flexible scheduling. Multi\-day task timers allow you to spread work across your week. * **Location:** Must be based in the **United States, Canada, the UK, Australia, Ireland, or New Zealand**. * **Tools Provided:** Access to frontier models (including Claude and ChatGPT) is provided through the platform; no personal subscription is required. Pay: $40\.00 \- $125\.00 per hour Expected hours: No less than 10\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Commercial Aviation
jobs.description: Navi captures everything a pilot sees and hears and turns it into automated debrief intelligence, sortie\-level awareness that has never existed before. You're building the platform that makes that happen. Navi is live at the U.S. Air Force Test Pilot School, Embry\-Riddle, United Aviate, Sling Pilot Academy and Delta State University. You'll bring it to the next school, and make the one after that faster. **On site with customers 25 to 40% of the time** **About the role** ================== At a flight school, Navi is a device in every aircraft, a debrief after every lesson, and the picture the chief instructor, director of operations and safety officer run the school on. Forward deployed engineers make that work at each customer. You'll spend time at flight schools, universities and airline pathway programs: on the ramp, in dispatch and in the briefing room. Then you'll write the production code that turns what you saw into product, in the same codebase every customer runs. You'll own a set of customers end to end, from the devices in their aircraft to the instructors and staff who use what comes out. **Problems you'll own** ======================= **Bring a school online.** Install recording devices across a fleet. Connect avionics (Garmin G1000 and G3X, piston and turbine engines) and the school's scheduling and maintenance systems. Map roles and permissions to how the school actually runs: chief instructors, stage check pilots, dispatchers, maintenance and students. **Keep every flight recorded.** Devices live in hot cockpits on vibrating panels, with SD cards and cables that fail. When a student says their flight never showed up, you'll trace it from the aircraft through the ingest pipeline to storage, recover it, and fix the reason it went missing. Then you'll build the alerts and troubleshooting guides that catch the next failing device before a week of flights goes unrecorded. **Make the debrief right for their aircraft and procedures.** A turbine logs torque and percent power; a piston logs manifold pressure. One school's stabilized approach criteria aren't another's. You'll tune exceedances, SOP adherence and maneuver detection to each fleet and each operation, as configuration where you can and code where you must. **Build what leaders run the school on.** Student progress and completion forecasts, stalled students, upcoming stage checks and checkrides, aircraft hours to the next inspection, open squawks. You'll find the question a chief instructor or director of operations asks every Monday morning and make Navi answer it. **Make safety proactive.** Every exceedance, unstable approach and trend across every flight, not only the ones someone reported. You'll turn flight data and safety reports into the picture a safety officer runs their SMS on. **Know whether it worked.** Every feature ships with product analytics, so you can tell which schools and which roles use it and where people drop off. Adoption is the scoreboard. **Earn trust with student data.** Students see their own progress without comparisons to classmates, and names stay blurred on shared screens. You'll make the careful calls on how data about people is shown. **About you** ============= * 3\+ years shipping production software, in any programming language. You've owned a system in production end to end. * You debug across the whole stack: a device in an aircraft, a queue, a database, a web page. * Comfortable with flight data or other real\-world time series: sampling rates, units, gaps and bad sensors. * You can run a meeting with a chief instructor and a director of operations and come back with the right problem, not just the one they named. * You build with AI coding agents every day, and you know how to check their work: tests, measurements and a second look before anything ships. * You're comfortable owning outcomes when the roadmap isn't written yet. * Able to travel to customer sites regularly. **Nice to have** ================ * A pilot certificate, and a CFI or CFII even more * Flight school operations: Part 141 and Part 61 training, stage checks, scheduling and maintenance software * Avionics and engine data: Garmin G1000 and G3X logs, ADS\-B * Airline training and safety programs: AQP, FOQA/FDM, SMS * Devices in the field: embedded Linux, IoT fleets, cellular connectivity * Hands\-on aviation work: an A\&P certificate, a dispatcher certificate or line service **What this role is not** ========================= Not a sales engineer running demos. Not support working a ticket queue. Not a consultant handing over a report. You write production code that ships to every customer, and you're the reason it works where it lands. **Why this role matters** ========================= Most of what happens on a training flight is never reviewed. An instructor has minutes between lessons, and a chief instructor can learn that a student was struggling weeks after it started. Navi turns every flight into something a student can learn from and a school can act on. Getting it right at each school is how flight training gets safer and faster for everyone who comes after. **What you'll get** =================== * Early\-stage equity: real ownership in a category\-defining company * Flight training: earn your pilot's license and build with true domain expertise * Time on the ramp with the people who use what you build * A role that grows into leading Navi's commercial deployments as we scale **How we work** =============== * **Find a way.** We don't wait for permission or perfect information. Ideas come from anywhere regardless of title. Figure it out, ship it, iterate. * **Creativity over control.** First principles over process. We'd rather have a creative solution that's 80% right today than a perfect one next quarter. * **Update fast.** Come in with a hypothesis, throw it away when the data says otherwise. Ego has no place here. * **Intensity with focus.** We work hard because the mission demands it. Clarity on what matters is how we make that sustainable.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise Inference
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Mount Thor makes Apple hardware (macOS and Apple silicon) available and performant at datacenter scale for AI workloads. We take consumer hardware and build the infrastructure platform around it to enable consumption as elastic compute exposed through developer\-friendly interfaces. Our customers use us to develop computer\-use model capabilities, deploy long\-running agents, and accelerate agentic engineering. **The Opportunity** ------------------- The future of enterprise inference is a constellation of small, specialized models. The work a company does every day may occupy only a tiny fraction of a general model’s training. The company knows which details change the outcome, has developed methods for handling them, and sees firsthand what works for its customers. Specialized models put more expertise in people’s hands while preserving the distinct ways companies think and work. Much of that inference will happen in the background. People delegate tasks hours or days before they need the results to make a decision. Apple silicon will power this shift. At rack scale, it pairs the memory capacity that long contexts demand with the power efficiency to deliver more work per dollar. You’ll help enterprise teams run more of their highest\-value workloads on the same inference budget, at the quality their users expect. Their models, evaluations, and traffic patterns will guide how you and Mount Thor’s inference engineers design and tune the rack\-scale serving system, from model execution and context management to request scheduling. Once it’s live, you’ll own reliability and performance against the targets you set with the customer. Requirements that recur across deployments will shape the model support, serving interfaces, and release tools you build so customers and partners can launch new workloads themselves. **What you’ll build** --------------------- * **Choose the workloads Mount Thor takes into production.** Lead discovery with the customer’s engineers and the people who use the model’s output. Decide which workload warrants the investment, build a working prototype on Apple silicon, and show what it costs to deliver the required quality at production volume compared with the customer’s current approach. * **Decide how the customer’s model runs across a rack of Apple silicon.** Select and adapt the inference engine for the model architecture and traffic. Bring new architectures into the runtime with Mount Thor’s inference engineers. Write the performance\-critical code, whether that means fusing GPU operations, changing how the engine manages the KV cache, or overlapping computation with communication between devices. * **Build deadline\-aware scheduling into the fleet runtime.** Decide when a long\-context request should wait for a rack that holds its cache and when its deadline makes another rack the better choice. Design placement, routing, and admission control together so the fleet can take on new work and still meet the deadlines of jobs already queued. * **Build the evaluations that govern a release.** Compare model and runtime versions on representative tasks, context lengths, and traffic. Work with model authors to catch changes in output quality introduced by quantization or a new kernel. Use those results to choose a serving configuration and build the regression checks for future releases. * **Own the workload under live traffic.** Lead the rollout with the customer and own capacity, performance, and recovery after launch. Instrument the serving path so you can trace a missed deadline through queueing, model execution, and communication across the rack. Prioritize fixes by how much they improve completion time, reliability, or cost for the customer. * **Build the platform customers and partners use to launch models on their own.** Lead deployments alongside partner engineers. Build the APIs they need to submit and track background workloads, and the release tools they need to qualify a new model version and diagnose regressions. Use what still requires custom engineering to decide what the platform should support next. **What you bring** ------------------ * You’ve worked directly with an enterprise customer to decide what to build, designed the system with their engineers, and written code they rely on in production. You can make the technical case to the team that will operate it and the business case to the person funding it. * A record of improving throughput, latency, or memory efficiency in a production inference engine, GPU runtime, or distributed serving system. You can use hardware limits and workload traces to explain the gap between the performance you measure and the performance you expect. * Strong systems programming skills in a language such as C\+\+ or Rust and experience working inside a runtime or performance\-critical library. You can build a reproducible benchmark and evaluate the numerical and model\-quality effects of an optimization. * Direct responsibility for a distributed system under load, including capacity planning, production releases, and incident response. **Bonus Skills** ---------------- * Experience optimizing inference on Apple silicon with Metal or MLX, or porting an inference engine to a new accelerator. * Contributions to an inference engine, compiler, GPU kernel library, or distributed communication library. * Experience developing model evaluations with domain experts or building deployment tools adopted by engineers outside your own team.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Engineering
jobs.description: **About Parameter** ------------------- Security testing still mostly means scanners that miss the real bugs, or human pentesters who show up once a year. Parameter is building AI agents that do the work of a skilled attacker. They break into live applications, APIs and cloud environments, find the access control, auth and business logic flaws that matter, and prove each one before it's reported. We're a Y Combinator company in San Francisco. The team is small and the engineers own large parts of the product. Some of the problems in front of us right now are below. **Problems you might own** -------------------------- * Keeping an agent on task and correct through a multi\-hour engagement against a system it has never seen, and measuring whether a change made it better or worse * Cutting false positives to near zero by building validation that proves a vulnerability is real before it is reported * Running many long agent runs in parallel against customer infrastructure with strict isolation between customers, and making failures loud and cheap * Turning what a skilled attacker does by hand into reliable agent capability * Building the product customers use to review, verify and act on findings **What the work looks like** ---------------------------- The role is broad on purpose. You will usually have a primary area (product, infrastructure, AI and agents, or offensive security) and you will work outside it whenever the company needs it. Day to day that means TypeScript, React and Next.js, GCP, Terraform, Temporal, LangGraph, Docker, Linear and Graphite. You work directly with the founders, talk to customers when it helps, and ship to production within days. **You might be a fit if** ------------------------- * You have built something real that people used, and can say exactly which parts were yours * You have started something, whether a company, an open\-source project, a product, or a research effort, and kept going when it was hard * You have gone deep on something difficult without being asked: CTFs, bug bounty, CVEs, systems work, or competitive programming * You learn quickly and are strong across more than one layer of the stack * You decide things yourself, tell us what you decided and why, and see your work through after it ships * Experience as a founder or founding engineer is a strong signal. Years at a large company and a long title are not what we are looking for **How we work** --------------- * In person in San Francisco, with long hours that we expect to continue at this stage. Most of the team works well beyond a normal week. If you want a balanced 9 to 5, this is not the right job * A small team with high expectations and little process. You will have real scope, direct access to the founders, and fast decisions * We hire slowly. Every engineer we add is a large share of the team **Interview process** --------------------- Intro call with a founder (30 min), technical deep dive on something you built (60 min), a paid work trial of about one day, onsite with the team, then references and an offer. We aim to make an offer within two weeks of first contact. **Compensation** ---------------- $200K to $300K base salary depending on experience, plus 0\.2% to 0\.4% equity. **Logistics** ------------- Full time, onsite in San Francisco. You must be authorized to work in the US. We are not able to sponsor visas at this time. **Application question** ------------------------ Link to something you built or started and tell us which part was yours, and what broke. Please write this yourself. We read every answer. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Performance Engineer, Inference
jobs.description: **Who we are:** --------------- Today, AI is something you rent. Alpaca is building the full stack of hardware, software, models, and applications together to make it something you own. We are developing a new computer architecture that breaks the economics keeping frontier models trapped in datacenters. On top of that, we’re building a platform of models, applications, and services that give that hardware meaning. Personal AI is moving from the datacenter to the desk, and we are driving that change. Our team is based in Cambridge, MA. **What you’ll do:** ------------------- * **Optimize inference:** Profile inference process in realistic environments and resolve inefficiencies found – in both high\- and low\-level parts of the inference stack. * **Model implementation:** Support state\-of\-the\-art model architectures and their modifications on our hardware. * **Co\-design software and hardware:** Integrate closely with hardware and low\-level teams, informing them about inference needs and existing bottlenecks. * **Own your work:** Inference stack is very heterogeneous, spanning from kernel optimization to reducing communication latency, and you will take full ownership of the parts you find interesting. **Who you are:** ---------------- * **Performance\-conscious developer:** Care deeply about the performance of the programs you write and strive to improve it across all layers you own. * **Deep software expertise:** Understand how the code you write gets turned into the instructions that are running on the hardware, as well as the corresponding trade\-offs. * **Independent researcher:** Propose and evaluate new optimizations in addition to being able to reproduce the existing approaches. * **Excellent communicator:** Provide reasonable feedback on others’ work and ideas, and clearly explain the needs you have and the constraints you face. **Who we’re looking for:** -------------------------- * **Low\-level programming:** Deep experience with C, C\+\+, or Rust, and ability to read the assembly your compiler produces. * **Model architecture:** You understand transformers and the most recent LLM architectures well enough to know where time and bytes go. * **Performance intuition:** Understanding of memory hierarchies, caches, SIMD versus SIMT, and memory\-bound versus compute\-bound work. * **Inference knowledge:** Familiarity with how LLMs run in practice: prefill and decode, KV caches, batching, quantization, speculative decoding, and mixture\-of\-experts. * **Kernel experience:** You've written or optimized CUDA, Triton, Metal, or SIMD code, or contributed to inference engines like llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT\-LLM. * **Software architecture:** You have good architectural judgement regarding large software projects and can balance between overspecialized and overgeneralized code. * **Tensor frameworks:** You know how tensor frameworks like PyTorch, JAX, or GGML work under the hood. **How to apply:** ----------------- Send us your resume and examples of projects you've designed or built, along with a short note about why Alpaca interests you. More than credentials, we want to see what you've made, researched, designed, or shipped. If the role sounds like you but your background is unconventional, apply anyway. Compensation Range: $140K \- $170K

jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Evaluator
jobs.description: We are looking for experienced, hands\-on software engineers to help train and evaluate the next generation of AI coding agents. While modern AI coding agents are capable in many areas, they frequently miss edge cases, introduce brittle changes, write tests that pass for the wrong reasons, and require close supervision from an experienced engineer. In this role, you will bring the engineering judgment you have built shipping production systems to evaluate how AI coding agents handle real\-world software engineering work inside realistic codebases. You will design challenging, realistic tasks drawn from your own day\-to\-day experience—ranging from compact bug fixes to multi\-day engineering scenarios—run them through frontier AI models, and grade the results against a professional standard. This is not a traditional software engineering position. There is no production on\-call or rigid shift work; instead, it is a flexible, self\-directed, fully remote contract where clear written reasoning matters just as much as technical depth. **Responsibilities** * **Design Realistic Engineering Tasks:** Create challenging scenarios drawn from your own practice—including specs phrased as you would brief a trusted teammate, alongside repositories, tests, logs, API contracts, and design notes that you construct or adapt yourself. * **Evaluate AI Coding Agents:** Run your tasks through frontier AI models and grade their deliverables (diffs, tests, designs, and pull request reviews) against the bar you would hold a teammate to. * **Compare \& Benchmark Outputs:** Evaluate side\-by\-side agent outputs on identical specs and codebases, determine which performed better, and document where each fell short. * **Define Success Criteria:** Author unit/regression tests and detailed grading rubrics specifying required behaviors, edge cases, and codebase conventions, explaining in writing why a submission passes or fails each criterion. * **Flag Model Failures with Evidence:** Identify and document concrete issues such as brittle changes, missed edge cases, false\-positive tests, trace thrashing, fabricated/ignored files, and off\-spec interpretations. * **Peer Review \& Collaboration:** Contribute across your primary tech stack (and adjacent ones) while reviewing and refining tasks built by fellow engineers. **Representative Task Types** * Implementing a new feature to spec, complete with comprehensive tests. * Fixing a complex bug accompanied by a regression test that proves the fix. * Refactoring existing code while strictly preserving behavior. * Conducting a thorough pull request review. * Writing a root\-cause debugging analysis from system logs and traces. * Designing an API contract with concrete examples. **Qualifications** * **Hands\-On Practitioner:** You currently write and ship production code—or have done so very recently—at an individual\-contributor level (engineers who only manage, architect, or review without coding day\-to\-day will not be a fit). * **Experience:** 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience shipping and maintaining production code as part of a team (strong mid\-level to senior individual contributors are ideal). * **Technical Stack:** Deep expertise in at least one common language/stack (e.g., TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java, Go, Rust, C\+\+, C\#, Ruby, PHP, Swift, or Kotlin). Frontend, backend, full\-stack, mobile, infrastructure, and systems specialists are all welcome. * **Tooling Fluency:** Comfortable working in a terminal with git, test runners, and debuggers, with the ability to orient yourself quickly in an unfamiliar codebase (Docker and CI experience is a plus). * **Communication \& Judgment:** Full professional or native\-level written and spoken English, with the ability to clearly articulate *why* a technical solution is flawed, not just *that* it is wrong. * **AI Familiarity:** General user\-level familiarity with LLM tools (such as Claude or ChatGPT) to distinguish a well\-reasoned technical answer from a plausible\-sounding hallucination. No prior AI/ML engineering experience is required. * **Education \& Tech Literacy:** An in\-progress Bachelor’s degree or higher (a CS degree is a plus, though verifiable shipped production work outweighs credentials). Comfortable with standard cloud tools (Google Workspace), file handling, and desktop applications. **Compensation \& Terms** * **Pay Rate:** $40–$125/hr USD. * **Schedule:** Minimum commitment of 10 hours per week with no weekly cap; full\-time hours (40\+ hrs/week) are available. Multi\-day task timers allow you to spread work flexibly across your week. * **Location:** Must be based in the **United States, Canada, or the UK**. * **Tools Provided:** Access to frontier models (including Claude and ChatGPT) is provided through the platform; no personal subscriptions are required. Pay: $40\.00 \- $125\.00 per hour Expected hours: No less than 10\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

Nginx, etc., * Experience in large\-scale online service design, development and operation and maintenance is preferred * Good understanding of Linux/Unix, with excellent data structure and algorithm foundation * Proficiency in C/C\+\+ or Golang and network programming. * Experience with large system software design and development. * Experience with distributed systems and mission\-critical systems is preferred. * Demonstrated expertise in problem solving and technical innovation. * Strong passion with learning/practicing new technics. * Knowledgeable about SDLC, Agile and Software Engineering Methodology. * Team working skills, Good communication skills, Willingness to work under pressure. * Have strong ability and persistency on technical support. * Have ability to work close with global teams and accept additional working time besides normal working hours to have meeting or co\-working with global teams. * Advertising industry experience is a plus. **Education** joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers. * Drive results and growth. * Respect and promote inclusion \& diversity. * Do what's right for jobs.title: Full Stack Web & eCommerce Engineer
jobs.description: **Join the ACI Learning Adventure!** ------------------------------------ ### **Our Mission** Welcome to a new era of learning, where individuals and organizations come to transform goals into measurable success. At ACI Learning, we believe that anything worth doing is worth leading the way—with innovation, exceptional experiences, and impactful results. We provide a full ecosystem of learning and development solutions that empower people and businesses to lead with confidence, learn with purpose, and achieve outcomes that matter. Join us, and together, we'll shape the future of skill\-building and professional growth. ### **The ACI Team** Imagine collaborating with over 200 of the brightest minds who are passionate, grounded, and dedicated to shaping the future of eLearning. Together, we're not just a team; we're a movement in one of the most exciting times in tech. ### **Purpose\-Driven Culture** At ACI Learning, work isn't just a job. It's a passion we pour into every project, every day. We celebrate creativity, innovation, and the joy of doing what we love. ### **Your Opportunity** Are you ready to be part of something transformative? Dive into a world of collaboration, growth, and endless potential. Apply now and help lead the change! **Who We Are** -------------- ACI Learning is a leading provider of audit, cybersecurity and IT training solutions, empowering individuals and organizations worldwide to improve their technical capabilities and their cybersecurity with compelling and comprehensive training. Our leadership position extends even further to our new SaaS Learning Platform myACI that goes beyond audit, cyber and IT training to provide organizational and individual knowledge assessment, analytics and training delivery with integrated AI to understand capabilities and skill gaps for organizations. **Full Stack Web \& eCommerce Engineer** ---------------------------------------- ##### ***Remote (US) \| Full\-Time \| Exempt*** From the first click through checkout, our websites shape how learners and businesses find, evaluate, and buy from ACI Learning. You'll improve and extend every step of that buyer journey. You'll work directly with the Director of Web on a small team, and your work ties straight to revenue and to organic and AI\-search visibility. ### **What you'll do** You'll be the hands\-on engineer behind everything a buyer touches on our sites, from the first search result to the order confirmation. Day to day, that means shipping new features, keeping a growing stack healthy, and building the systems that let a small team do more. The Director of Web sets direction and priorities. You own the technical decisions and the quality of what ships, from Figma through production, across acilearning.com, acitechacademy.com, and our headless BigCommerce store. **Storefront and checkout** * Lead day\-to\-day development of our headless ecommerce storefront (Next.js / React on Vercel), including cart and checkout, and contribute to product experiences for Commercial, Consumer, and Academic buyers * Build a new Academic checkout channel for ACI Skill Labs with the Director of Web, from design through launch * Instrument and test ecommerce analytics, user insights, and conversion improvements **Marketing sites and SEO** * Develop and maintain our marketing sites (React / Gatsby with a headless CMS), including a new /learn/ knowledge base * Implement technical SEO and AI\-search readiness: structured data, crawlability, and fixes for errors that hurt rankings **Content automation** * Build AI\-assisted pipelines with the team that pull news and course content, draft into our headless CMS (Strapi v5\) for human review, and publish to the site and search * Set up on\-demand or incremental builds so time\-sensitive pages go live without a full site rebuild **Integrations** * Maintain the Node middleware and APIs that send order, customer, and product data from our storefront to HubSpot, Stripe, and our CRM, and understand what happens downstream in our ERP, provisioning, and learning platform * Partner with Product on integrations such as SSO, catalog sync, and provisioning **Platform health and design system** * Keep the stack current, secure, and lean: framework and dependency upgrades, patching, Core Web Vitals, and tech debt (refactoring legacy code, consolidating duplicate components, removing unused dependencies, and improving build times and bundle size) * Design and build UI from concept to Figma to production, and build our design system: design tokens, a shared React component library that matches our Figma components, and documented patterns that keep every site consistent * Document what you build so the team isn't dependent on any one person **How you'll work** * Scope and ship work independently, with a weekly check\-in with the Director of Web * Pair with teammates and take on work outside your lane when the team needs it, from a copy fix to a checkout bug * Explain technical trade\-offs rketing, Product, and leadership, in writing and in meetings * Track how your work affects conversion, traffic, and checkout completion **How we use AI** We use AI tools like Claude and Cursor every day to build skills and move faster, not to stand in for your own understanding or judgment. In practice, that means you: * Can explain every line you ship, whether you wrote it or an AI tool drafted it * Review, test, and debug AI\-generated code with the same rigor as your own * Know when to use an AI tool and when it's faster or safer to work it through yourself * Use AI to learn unfamiliar code and systems and to raise the bar on documentation, testing, and code quality, and help shape how the team uses it ### **What you'll need** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Human\-Computer Interaction, Design, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, such as a coding bootcamp, relevant certifications, or shipped work you can show us * 5\+ years of professional full stack web development, with production sites you can walk us through * React and TypeScript code you've shipped to production, including at least one Next.js site and one other React framework or static site generator (Gatsby or similar) * js APIs and third\-party integrations you've built and run in production (REST / GraphQL, webhooks, auth) * Experience integrating a storefront or web app with CRM, ERP, or payment systems (HubSpot, Stripe, or similar) * At least one ecommerce cart or checkout flow you've shipped, including payments and the edge cases that come with them * At least one production site on a headless architecture: headless commerce or a headless CMS (Strapi preferred, Contentful, Sanity or similar), including content models you designed ### **What we'd like you to have** **Design and front end** * A portfolio of interfaces you designed in Figma and then built in code * A design system you've built or extended: tokens, a coded component library (Storybook or similar), and documentation that designers and developers both use * Technical SEO fixes you've shipped: semantic HTML, structured data / schema.org, page speed, or crawlability **Commerce, data, and platforms** * BigCommerce Catalyst: building on BigCommerce's headless Next.js storefront and its APIs * HubSpot work you've shipped: custom objects or properties, forms, workflows, or HubSpot API integrations, such as syncing ecommerce or website data into HubSpot * GA4 and Google Tag Manager, ecommerce event tracking, and A/B tests or behavior analysis (such as Microsoft Clarity) that changed what you shipped * Owned deployments and environments on modern hosting (Vercel, Netlify, Render, or similar) and Git\-based workflows * A refactor or cleanup you've led in an existing codebase, and what it improved **AI, search, and media** * A project or experiment where you applied AI to how software gets built or how people find information (AI search, LLM citations) * Scheduled jobs or workflows that call LLM APIs (such as the Claude API), with human review built in * Algolia or a similar search platform you've implemented or tuned * Work with video platforms (such as JW Player) and their APIs for clips, captions, and transcripts **Background** * Time on a marketing\-site or growth team, not only application development **Why ACI Learning is Your Next Big Move** ------------------------------------------ *For Full\-Time, Benefits Eligible Positions* **Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage—starting the 1st of the month after your hire date.** **Four weeks of paid parental or medical leave, so you can focus on what matters most.** **Flexible PTO policy, sick time, and eight paid holidays — because we believe in balance.** **401(k) retirement plan so you can invest in your future from day one.** **One free course each year after 90 days — advancing your skills is part of the job.** **Tuition assistance to support your continued education and professional growth.**

jobs.title: Lead Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. **Job Description** The **AECOM\-Hill Joint Venture (AHJV)**, **Program Manager for the NYC Department of Design and Construction,** is seeking an **Engineering Lead** for the **New York City Borough\-Based Jails Program** whose goal is to deliver 4 high\-rise, design\-build jails, one each in the boroughs of Brooklyn, The Bronx, Queens, and Manhattan. This position will be on site in New York, NY. The **Lead Engineer** will work with our pool of subject matter experts to respond to and address engineering topics that require the AHJV to support DDC in communicating with the Sponsor Agencies and the Design\-Builders. The Lead Engineer is a full\-time, program\-wide position to be fulfilled by someone who understands the overall program goals in addition to the specific project requirements and will assure that program goals are being met on each project. **Responsibilities include:** * Identify and address engineering\-related topics that come up from the NYC Department of Correction (DOC), Department of Design and Construction (DDC), site conditions and AECOM\-Hill Joint Venture (AHJV) input. * Assure that the proper resources are focusing on the topics and manage moving issues toward resolution. * Participate in preparation for and attend Design Builder work sessions. * Oversee AHJV engineering team responses during the Design Builder implementation of the projects. * Attend engineering\-specific meetings, including asset management, radio, and communications, and be responsible for capturing action items and disseminating that information back to the team and the client. * Guide the engineering specialists and keep them up to date with changes to the program, including weekly AHJV engineering\-specific meetings. * Review design review comments made on the progress design submittals from the Design Builder and coordinate with engineering specialists. * Follow up with engineers on RFI and Submittals responses and review content for compliance with the project requirements. * Manage the budget assigned to the engineering specialists. **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications**: * BA/BS plus ten years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education. * Experience with Design\-Build project delivery and other forms of alternative project delivery for large scale projects/programs. **Preferred Qualifications**: * 12\+ years of progressive roles in engineering, management, and leadership. * Experience in multi\-story/high\-rise projects, New York City agencies and conditions, and the program management role in a government design\-build project are desirable Software skills expected include MS Office Suite and Bluebeam Studio. * Experience with coordinating MEP, low voltage, and other engineering specialties. * Client\-focus – Work within the program communication structures, make recommendations that are appropriate to the program and project frameworks **Additional Information** * Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position. * Relocation is not available for this position. * **THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION NO SOONER THAN April 27th 2027\.** At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.*** **About AECOM** AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com. **What makes AECOM a great place to work** You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Server Analyst (no relo) (on-site)
jobs.description: Overview: **POSITION SUMMARY** The Systems Analyst, reporting to the Senior Director of Information Technology, is responsible for delivering comprehensive technical and operational support across complex server infrastructure, operating systems, and enterprise application ecosystems. This role implements, optimizes, and monitors core infrastructure workflows, ensures high system availability, and addresses implementation or integration challenges. Serves as operational backup to the Server Engineer and actively evaluates emerging tech stack innovations to drive continuous infrastructure modernization. This is an on\-site position based at the AHMC Healthcare Corporate Office; relocation assistance and reimbursement are not available for this role. Responsibilities: **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**  Maintain strict data privacy standards, ensuring HIPAA compliance and adherence to cybersecurity frameworks at all times.  Evaluate, architect, deploy, and maintain robust server and compute infrastructure solutions.  Author and maintain comprehensive system topology, operational runbooks, and server documentation.  Utilize monitoring and observability tools to perform system telemetry analysis and deliver status dashboards to Senior Systems Administrators.  Manage end\-to\-end backup orchestration, disaster recovery workflows, and automated restoration validation checks.  Take ownership of Tier 2/3 system incidents with a proactive approach to root\-cause analysis and problem resolution.  Conduct regression testing and staging deployment of OS updates, patches, and endpoint security software prior to production release.  Triage and escalate complex incidents to designated IT engineering leads or third\-party technology partners.  Collaborate with Systems Administrators to resolve escalated customer and vendor system issues.  Serve as operational backup to Systems Administrators for core infrastructure maintenance.  Support enterprise application hosting and line\-of\-business software platforms within server environments.  Demonstrate exceptional time management and organizational capabilities to
