What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada's mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world. **About the role** Armada is seeking a Senior AI Forward Deployment Engineer to work directly with customers to design, build, and operate production AI systems at the edge of the physical world. You will serve as the hands\-on technical lead for customer AI deployments, working alongside operators, domain experts, and engineering teams to understand their workflows, identify valuable use cases, and turn ambiguous requirements into working systems. You will own technical delivery from discovery and architecture through implementation, evaluation, deployment, and operational adoption. Your work may support offshore energy platforms, remote mines, defense installations, transportation networks, industrial facilities, autonomous systems, and distributed camera and sensor networks. These environments demand AI that performs under intermittent connectivity, strict latency requirements, constrained compute and power, noisy data, changing conditions, and rigorous security and data sovereignty requirements. Depending on your expertise and the customer's needs, you will build solutions involving computer vision, language and vision\-language models, multimodal AI, agents, time\-series analysis, anomaly detection, robotics, or distributed inference. You will make practical decisions about when to use existing models, adapt or train models, combine AI with conventional software, and place workloads across cloud, on\-premises, and edge infrastructure. This is a senior individual contributor role with substantial customer responsibility. You will write production code, lead architectural decisions, resolve difficult technical issues, and communicate clearly with both engineers and business leaders. Your success will be measured by customer outcomes, reliable production operation, and the reusable capabilities you contribute to Armada's platform. **Location.** This role is office\-based at our Bellevue, Washington office. **What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)** * **Lead customer discovery and technical scoping.** Work directly with customers to understand operational workflows, data availability, infrastructure, and constraints. Define the problem, establish baselines, agree on measurable success criteria, and develop an achievable delivery plan. * **Own delivery from concept through production.** Lead architecture and implementation, manage technical dependencies and risks, and guide deployments through validation, acceptance, and adoption. Keep customers and internal teams aligned on progress, tradeoffs, and next steps. * **Build complete AI solutions.** Develop the data pipelines, models, inference services, APIs, and application integrations needed to embed AI into customer operations. Select, train, fine\-tune, or adapt models according to the use case and deployment constraints. * **Engineer for edge and sovereign environments.** Deploy containerized AI workloads across GPUs, Kubernetes, cloud, on\-premises infrastructure, and disconnected environments. Design for local operation, connectivity loss, resource limits, secure updates, and recovery. * **Establish rigorous evaluation.** Build representative datasets and reproducible tests that measure task performance, latency, throughput, robustness, safety, and resource efficiency. Evaluate failure modes and validate improvements against real operating conditions. * **Optimize models and inference.** Profile workloads and apply techniques such as quantization, distillation, batching, caching, and hardware\-aware acceleration to meet customer requirements for performance, memory, power, and cost. * **Own production readiness and reliability.** Implement testing, deployment automation, model and data versioning, observability, and rollback procedures. Establish monitoring for data quality, model performance, and drift, with controlled processes for updates and retraining. * **Resolve issues to travel to customer sites and work alongside customer teams during discovery, implementation, and deployment. **Preferred Experience and Skills** * Production AI deployments in edge, disconnected, air\-gapped, sovereign, or other constrained computing environments. * GPU inference optimization using technologies such as TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, ONNX Runtime, vLLM, or CUDA. * Adaptation of open\-weight models through fine\-tuning, LoRA, distillation, quantization, or related techniques. * Production LLM and agent systems, including retrieval, tool integration, evaluation, observability, and controls for reliable execution. * Multimodal applications combining video, images, language, audio, telemetry, geospatial information, or other sensor data. * Experience in energy, mining, defense, manufacturing, transportation, robotics, or other operationally demanding industries. * Integration with industrial systems, streaming data platforms, camera networks, enterprise applications, or operational technology. * Synthetic data, simulation, active learning, weak supervision, reinforcement learning, or human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. * Experience as a forward deployed engineer, technical founder, customer\-facing engineering lead, or applied AI technical lead. * An MS or Ph.D. in a relevant technical, science, or statistics discipline, or equivalent depth gained through industry experience. You do not need experience in every area listed above. We value technical depth, sound judgment, and a demonstrated ability to deliver AI/SI systems that customers can depend on. **Compensation** For U.S. Based candidates: To ensure fairness and transparency, the starting base salary range for this role for candidates in the U.S. are listed below, varying based on location experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, ***this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits***(details available upon request). **Benefits** * Competitive base salary and equity * Medical, dental, and vision (subsidized cost) * Health savings accounts (HSA), flexible spending accounts (FSA), and dependent care FSAs (DCFSA) * Retirement plan options, including 401(k) and Roth 401(k) * Unlimited paid time off (PTO) * 14 paid company holidays per year \#LI\-SM2 \#LI\-Onsite **You're a Great Fit if You're** * A go\-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge * A detail\-oriented problem\-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get\-it\-done" attitude * Thrive in a fast\-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company * A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda * Highly organized and results\-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you **Equal Opportunity Statement** At Armada, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone is given equal opportunities to thrive. Alliance North America was established in 2017 and is proud to be the sole North American supplier of AIRMAN Power Generators, AIRMAN Air Compressors, and ANA’s patented EBOSS® Hybrid Energy System and Smart load bank system. Our commitment to our customers is to Make their World Easier, by answering the phone, understanding their needs, and taking ownership to provide them solutions. With a large parts inventory and more than 90% of all orders shipping within 24 hours, you never have to worry about spare parts. We help keep your fleet in top condition with our world class Support Department, who are always ready to help and be a resource by providing training on our equipment. ANA is headquartered in Henderson, Nevada with locations in Cypress, California and Spartanburg, South Carolina. ANA is growing and scaling and we are seeking an Senior DevOps Engineer in an onsite position in Henderson, Nevada. In this role, you will own the build, release, and test infrastructure behind the energy systems we build and the software that runs them. Half of the role focuses on edge and IoT: building, releasing, and testing the software that runs on our controllers, gateways, and edge devices, including the hardware\-in\-the\-loop lab. The other half focuses on cloud test infrastructure: the environments, pipelines, and automation that verify our AWS IoT platform before every release. You will work closely with the Senior Test Engineer, QA, the development team, and IT so that every release is repeatable, verifiable, and secure. The position is fully onsite, and the work schedule is weekdays from 8:00 AM\-5:00 PM. This role reports to the Director of Software Engineering. ### **Role \& Responsibilities:** **Edge \& IoT Build, Release, and Test Infrastructure:** * Own the build and release pipeline for edge and gateway software and embedded Linux images: reproducible builds, cross\-compilation, versioning, and artifact signing. * Package and deploy edge software (e.g., Docker/Podman containers) with staged over\-the\-air (OTA) rollouts and safe rollback to fielded equipment. * Build and operate the hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) lab infrastructure with the Senior Test Engineer: self\-hosted CI runners connected to controllers, gateways, load banks, and bench equipment, so HIL tests run automatically on every release candidate. * Automate control of units under test — flashing, provisioning, power cycling, configuration, and device certificates — so the lab is in a known, documented state before every run. * Build and maintain simulators and emulators for Modbus TCP/RTU, CANbus/J1939, and MQTT traffic so edge software can be tested against realistic site and load conditions without full hardware. * Capture device logs, telemetry, and bench instrument data from every test run so failures can be diagnosed from the run record. * Support fleet update and remote diagnostics tooling (IoT Secure Tunneling, device shadows) for equipment at customer sites. **Cloud Test Infrastructure:** * Build on\-demand, ephemeral test environments for the AWS IoT platform with infrastructure as code (Terraform and/or AWS CDK), so every branch or release candidate can be tested in isolation. * Build cloud\-side test harnesses: simulated device fleets publishing MQTT telemetry at scale, test data seeding, and fixtures for RESTful and event\-driven APIs. * Integrate automated suites (pytest, API, integration, end\-to\-end edge\-to\-cloud, and performance/load) into GitHub Actions as quality gates, publishing results in a form that supports requirements\-to\-test traceability. * Enable end\-to\-end data integrity checks confirming that values, units, timestamps, and alarm states in dashboards, reports, and notifications match what the equipment actually did. Own CI/CD pipelines and environment promotion (dev test staging* production) for cloud services, with release gates agreed with QA. * Keep test environments cost\-efficient through automatic teardown, right\-sizing, and usage reporting. **Security \& Compliance:** * Build security into cloud and edge pipelines: static analysis, dependency and container image scanning, SBOM generation, secrets management, and signed artifacts. * Maintain least\-privilege access for pipelines, test environments, and lab devices, and produce the pipeline evidence that supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, and IEC 62443\. **Operations (Secondary):** * Support releases and serve as escalation for build, deployment, and pipeline issues; day\-to\-day production monitoring and on\-call are shared with the development team. * Maintain observability for pipelines, test environments, and the lab: run health, flaky tests, and runner and device availability. **Team and Stakeholder Co ve developers fast feedback through self\-service test environments, simulators, and clear pipeline tooling; participate in design reviews so systems are testable and deployable from day one. * IT: Coordinate on lab network segmentation, networking for runners and devices, identity and access, and remote or vendor access to the lab. * Provide regular updates on release readiness, test infrastructure status, and risks to engineering leadership and product stakeholders. * Document architecture, lab setup, and runbooks so the platform does not depend on any one person. * Mentor and guide other engineers on build, release, and test automation practices. **Other duties as assigned** ### **Qualifications:** **Required Qualifications:** * Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * 8–12 years of experience in DevOps, build and release, or test infrastructure engineering, including 3\+ years in a senior or lead role. * Hands\-on experience building CI/CD and test infrastructure for embedded Linux or IoT products, including devices deployed in the field. * Proficient using Embedded Linux, Docker, Python, and Bash. * Proficient with SCM tools and methodologies including Git, GitHub, and GitHub Actions, including self\-hosted runners. * Experience building HIL or lab automation connected to physical devices and test equipment. * Working knowledge of Modbus TCP/RTU, CANbus, and MQTT. * Hands\-on AWS experience and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, and/or AWS CDK). * Proficient testing RESTful and/or event\-driven APIs using Python and pytest. * Solid networking and security fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, TLS, and X.509/PKI. * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail, including reading behavior from device logs, telemetry, and bench instrumentation rather than application output alone. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with AWS IoT Core, Greengrass v2, fleet provisioning, and IoT Secure Tunneling. * Experience with embedded Linux build systems (Yocto, Buildroot), OTA update frameworks, and secure boot or code signing. * Familiar with hardware/software integration such as J1939, CANopen, and RS\-485\. * Experience simulating device fleets or running load and performance tests against IoT backends. * Familiar with inverters, BMS systems, batteries, power generation systems, or microgrids. * Experience producing evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, or IEC 62443\. * Experience collaborating with external development partners or outsourced engineering teams on shared codebases. ### **ANA’s Core Values:** * Root Cause Problem Solving * Be Creative with Solutions * Build open and honest relationships * Build a positive team and family spirit * Be inclusive * Look for better ways * Be humble * Urgency ### **Benefits \& Perks:** * Competitive pay * 401k with company contribution * Medical, Dental, \& Vision * Life Insurance * Voluntary Accident Insurance * Voluntary Critical Illness Insurance * Employee Assistance Program * Employee Appreciation Programs The salary range for this role is $145,000 – $185,000 per year, which serves as a guide for pay decisions. Final compensation will be determined by a of factors, such as candidate's qualifications, experience, and skills, as well as pay equity considerations. You must be based in the United States and authorized to work in the U.S. without employer sponsorship. Please be advised that ANA does not provide employment\-based visa sponsorship for this position at this time. ANA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Senior Deployment and Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a **Senior Deployment and Site Reliability Engineer** to deploy, commission, and support our software in some of the most demanding customer environments, including cloud, on\-premises, hybrid, and air\-gapped installations. You will be the bridge between our product teams and our customers: ensuring installations go smoothly, upgrades are predictable, and issues are resolved quickly and permanently. This role suits an engineer who is equally comfortable working hands\-on at a customer site during a tight maintenance window and designing the monitoring, automation, and documentation that make those deployments repeatable and reliable. This is a **field\-facing SRE / deployment** role. **Location:** Salt Lake City (Utah) or Houston (Texas) \- US **Work Mode:** Hybrid **Travel:** Approximately 30% to customer sites **Level:** Senior ### **Key Responsibilities** **Deployment and Commissioning** * Deploy, commission, and upgrade software at customer sites and remotely across cloud, on\-premises, hybrid, and air\-gapped environments, often within a fixed maintenance window. * Develop and maintain deployment automation, verification, and diagnostic tooling. **Incident Management and Escalation** * Serve as the technical escalation point for critical production issues: restore service first, then perform root cause analysis. * Drive permanent fixes in partnership with product and engineering teams. **Environment Ownership** * Own staging and pre\-production environments that mirror real customer installations. * Validate releases and upgrade paths before they reach customers. **Monitoring and Reliability** * Design and implement monitoring and alerting so issues are detected before customers report them. * Continuously improve observability, resilience, and operational readiness. **Documentation and Enablement** * Write installation guides, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides. * Train Regional Operations teams and customer staff. ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * 5–8\+ years of experience deploying, commissioning, and supporting complex software solutions in production and customer environments. * Proven experience managing critical production incidents under time pressure, including troubleshooting, service restoration, root cause analysis, and corrective actions. * Strong hands\-on experience with Kubernetes operations, including Helm, RBAC, storage, networking, and production troubleshooting. * Experience with Docker and container management, including image building, inspection, and runtime troubleshooting. * Strong Linux administration skills (Debian, Ubuntu, or Red Hat), including networking, storage, log analysis, and command\-line troubleshooting. * Experience with both on\-premises and cloud deployments (Azure or AWS). * Production experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases, including backup, recovery, migrations, and basic performance troubleshooting. * Strong understanding of networking and security concepts, including TLS/certificates, firewalls, proxies, DNS, routing, load balancing, and VPN/remote access. * Experience using Prometheus and Grafana for production monitoring and incident troubleshooting. * Scripting skills in Python and/or Bash for deployment automation, verification, and diagnostics. * Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps) and artifact repositories such as Artifactory. * Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and distributed development teams. * Strong customer\-facing communication skills, particularly when handling technical incidents under pressure. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience deploying and supporting software in substation, utility, industrial, or other Operational Technology (OT) environments. * Knowledge of IT/OT integration, including network segmentation, restricted remote access, hardened infrastructure, and air\-gapped environments. * Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity standards, particularly IEC 62443, as well as security patching and vulnerability remediation. * Experience with High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR), including database clustering and connection pooling (e.g., pgpool). * Familiarity with GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux, and service mesh technologies such as Istio. * Experience with structured incident and problem management processes (ITIL), using tools such as Jira or ServiceNow. * Familiarity with test automation and management tools such as Cypress, Playwright, and Jira/Xray. * Additional language skills relevant to the regions supported. ### **Why choose us** * An international community bringing together more than 110 different nationalities * An environment where trust is central: 70% of our leaders started their careers at the entry level * A strong training system with our internal Academy and more than 250 modules available * A dynamic work environment that frequently comes together for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.) *Amaris Consulting promotes equal opportunities. We are committed to bringing together people from diverse backgrounds and creating an inclusive work environment. In this regard, we welcome applications from all qu**alified individuals, regardless of sex, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.* *\#LI\-AS2* **Who are we?** --------------- **Amaris Consulting** is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System \& Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success. At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like: **Brief Call**: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you! **Interviews** (the average number of interviews is 3 \- the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities! **Case study**: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem\-solving scenario, etc. As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience. We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.title: Applied Scientist, AWS Insights & Optimization
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Insights \& Optimization is looking for an Applied Scientist to help develop sophisticated algorithms and models that involve analyzing and learning from over 540 billion customer cost, usage, and utilization events daily. We use this data to power cost anomaly detection, cost forecasting, rightsizing recommendations across seven compute services, Savings Plans optimization, and AI\-powered conversational experiences that help customers understand and optimize their AWS spend. Our team's vision is to be the world's provider of intelligent AWS cloud financial management, where customers can understand, control, and optimize usage of AWS products. We sit at the nexus of all AWS services and interact directly with end\-customers, building relationships with teams across AWS to ensure we offer a secure and reliable experience that builds trust and provides intelligent insights. As a successful Applied Scientist in AWS Insights \& Optimization, you will own models end\-to\-end — from problem formulation through experimentation to production deployment. Your work may span cost anomaly detection (decomposition, detection, and root cause attribution), time\-series forecasting with a focus on accuracy and consistency, rightsizing engines for EC2, EBS, Lambda, ECS, RDS, and Aurora, LLM evaluation science for AI\-powered agent experiences, or agent memory architectures that enable persistent, adaptive behavior across sessions. You will work closely with applied scientists, software engineers, and product teams to enhance existing models and build new ones that solve challenging customer problems. You will drive implementation of proposed models, establish testing strategies to validate them before and after production, and define evaluation metrics that determine whether capabilities meet the quality bar. We value accuracy over speed, measurability over intuition, and simplicity over complexity — the simplest model that meets the bar wins. jobs.title: Cloud Hardware Development Manager, AWS Gen AI & ML Servers
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS operates the world's largest fleet of GPU\-accelerated servers powering AI/ML training and inference at cloud scale. Our team defines the server architectures, drives the hardware designs, and owns the fleet quality for these platforms — from component selection through datacenter operations. If you want to shape the physical hardware that frontier models train on, this is the role. We are seeking a Cloud Hardware Development Manager to lead a team of hardware, systems development engineers, and technical program managers responsible for the design, validation, manufacturing, and fleet operations of GPU\-accelerated server platforms. You will set technical direction for your team, manage ODM and silicon supplier partnerships, drive hardware programs from concept through production ramp, and own fleet reliability metrics. This role requires deep hardware expertise to guide technical decisions, combined with people leadership to hire, develop, and retain a high\-performing engineering team. What You Will Do You will lead hardware engineers who define the platforms running the world's largest AI workloads. You will set technical strategy for your team's hardware portfolio working alongside product and leadership teams, making trade\-offs between schedule, cost, reliability, and performance. You will guide your engineers through ambiguous design problems while removing blockers and ensuring delivery. You will own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of your team's hardware, from architecture definition through fleet operations, and be accountable for fleet quality metrics including annualized failure rates and system availability. Why You Will Love It The world's most advanced frontier models train on the hardware your team designs. You will build and lead the engineers who define GPU server platforms at unprecedented scale. Your decisions on architecture, components, and quality directly impact fleet reliability for customers within weeks of deployment. The team is deeply technical and high\-trust, with direct access to senior leadership and the freedom to set technical direction. The Ideal Candidate You combine deep hardware expertise with strong people leadership. You have designed or led teams that delivered server hardware at scale, and you can still dive into a schematic review or signal integrity issue when needed. You set high standards for your team and your partners, make data\-driven decisions, and communicate clearly to both engineers and executives. You build teams that are stronger because of your presence but don't require it to be successful. Key job responsibilities Technical Leadership \& Strategy * Set technical direction for your team's hardware portfolio across GPU\-accelerated server platforms, making architecture and component trade\-offs aligned with customer requirements and business goals * Guide system\-level design decisions across thermal, mechanical, power delivery, signal integrity, and accelerator subsystems — technical judgment * Own fleet reliability and availability for your team's hardware; drive continuous improvement to reduce failure rates People Leadership \& Development * Hire, develop, and retain Own operational metrics for your team's server platforms: annualized failure rates, system availability, manufacturing escape rates * Drive root cause analysis of fleet\-wide failures and ensure manufacturing improvements Cross\-Functional Alignment * Align with EC2 architecture teams on instance requirements, workload characterization, and platform roadmaps * Partner with firmware, software, jobs.title: Front-End Engineer – 2027 (US)
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Are you excited to build products that are used by Amazon customers all over the world? As a Front\-End Engineer, you’ll have the opportunity to work closely with experienced developers to create the user\-facing side of software. You’ll collaborate with team members and stakeholders on UX and the full software development lifecycle, including scoping, software design, code, testing, documentation, deployment, and maintenance. NOTE: By applying to this position, your application will be considered for all Front End Engineer roles at all locations we hire for in the United States including but not limited to: Greater Seattle Area (Seattle, Bellevue, Redmond), Greater Bay Area (San Francisco, Sunnyvale, Santa Clara, Palo Alto), Greater DMV (DC, MD, VA), Austin (TX), New York City (NY), Minneapolis (MN),Annapolis Jct, (MD), Arlington (VA) . Key job responsibilities As a Front\-End Engineer, you will/may: * Deliver software components and improvements to software features with your team’s software. * Work with stakeholders and product partners to deliver high\-quality UX. * Take feature specifications and deliver working code that is maintainable and extendable. * Help provide operational support for your team and work to ensure that root causes are identified and resolved. * Participate in code reviews and daily stand\-ups. * Collaborate with your team to positively impact the software quality, customer experience, and maintainability of your team’s products. jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Validation Tools and Infrastructure - Annapurna Labs
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Annapurna Labs builds custom silicon and software for AWS customers. The Post\-Silicon Validation team's domain engineers write hardware tests for memory, interconnect, PCIe, compute, power, and thermal on AWS's ML training accelerators. This senior role owns everything those tests stand on: the on\-device test framework, the build\-and\-release pipeline that ships one content stack from emulation through production, the lab access tooling, and the data pipeline that turns millions of results into coverage metrics, dashboards, tickets, and automated triage. A silicon or systems\-validation background is required. You will define the data model that makes every failure attributable to a specific device without re\-running the test, and you will set the technical direction of a platform that other engineers build on. A defect in this role's tooling can misattribute dozens of tickets or pause a fleet mechanism, so the blast radius exceeds that of any single test. Key job responsibilities * Test framework: own the on\-device scripting runtime, native bindings, result and failure reporting, failure\-to\-repair mapping, and automated post\-failure investigation; own the developer experience (build speed, unit testing, lint, documentation, AI\-agent integration) * Build and release: own cross\-compilation, packaging, signing, and release of test content to emulation, bring\-up, manufacturing, burn\-in, and production, with staged rollout, automatic rollback, and a committed cadence * Lab and device access: own the tooling that lets engineers and agents run tests, pull logs, and sync files to devices behind lab networks, including access controls, audit posture, and inner\-loop latency * Fleet data and coverage: own the pipeline that ingests results across manufacturing, burn\-in, and production and the dashboards on it; own coverage as a first\-class metric and the gap list that becomes test work * Result data model: define and enforce the fields every test must emit for attribution (device, die, link, lane, port, address, counters, versions) and lead schema adoption across hundreds of existing tests * Triage and rule governance: own automated failure classification (deterministic plus LLM\-assisted), automatic re\-run and reproduction, ticket creation with attribution, and routing to repair or a human, with a measured false\-ticket rate; own the lifecycle of every automated fleet rule * Through others: lead migrations domain engineers must participate in (schema adoption, framework upgrades, release gates); review infrastructure changes, drive engineering best practices, and mentor engineers on infrastructure design A day in the life You start by checking the triage service's overnight classifications and find a new failure signature it labeled "unknown" 40 times. You read the logs, recognize a link\-training timeout, add the rule and repair mapping. Before lunch you land a build change that cuts test build time by 30% and update the release tool. In the afternoon a payload names the wrong card; you pause the affected runs, write the check, and script the cleanup of open tickets. You end the day reviewing a domain engineer's test to ensure its result record carries the DMA engine fields the dashboards expect. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Every token a large language model generates depends on data reaching the right accelerator at the right moment. That network layer is what our team builds. We're in search of an engineer to work at the frontier of disaggregated inference: splitting LLM serving into separate prefill and decode pools and moving the model's KV cache between them at the absolute limit of what the hardware allows. Get it right and users get answers in milliseconds; get it wrong and the fastest accelerators in the world sit idle waiting on data. You'll own pieces of the high\-speed transfer path that make the difference, and you'll measure your success in how close you run to the theoretical peak of the machine. What we're looking for: Strong C/C\+\+ and a love for low\-level, performance\-critical systems — solid command of Linux, kernels, memory, and writing fast code. Prior AI/ML experience is welcome but not required — if you're a great systems engineer, we'll teach you the ML side. If you like solving genuinely hard problems, working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with HPC and ML customers, iterating fast, and shipping at a scale few places can offer, come join us. jobs.title: Applied Scientist II, Brand Optimization
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing businesses, responsible for defining and delivering a collection of advertising products that drive discovery and sales. Brand advertising is at the center of that growth, and brand marketers are pushing the industry toward a fundamental shift: they no longer want to optimize toward proxy metrics like reach and frequency alone. They want their investment across Streaming TV, online video, and display to drive measurable business outcomes, from consideration through to purchase and long\-term loyalty. The core scientific challenge is connecting a brand ad exposure today to an outcome that may happen days or weeks later, and then optimizing for it in real time. The Brand Outcomes Optimization team exists to solve that challenge. We build machine\-learned models that predict how likely a customer is to move along the full funnel, from awareness through conversion, and we integrate those predictions into real\-time bidding so that every brand bid is placed on the opportunity most likely to produce the outcome the advertiser cares about. These systems operate at large scale, and even small improvements to how we predict and optimize for outcomes have meaningful and immediate impact on advertiser results. As an Applied Scientist II, you will help drive this outcome\-optimization. You will take on increasingly ambiguous problems, from predicting what a brand outcome will be, to building the bidding and control algorithms that optimize for it, to proving the lift through experimentation. You will work alongside senior scientists and engineers, applying advances in machine learning, online optimization, optimal control, forecasting, and causal inference. You will also join the Amazon science community, with opportunities to publish papers, attend workshops and conferences, and gain early access to Amazon ML technologies. Key job responsibilities In this role, you will work with a highly motivated team of ML scientists and engineers focused on making brand advertising measurable and optimizable against real outcomes. As an Applied Scientist II, you will: * Contribute to outcome\-driven brand optimization, helping define, predict, and bid toward brand outcomes across channels. * Build prediction models that estimate a customer's likelihood to progress through the funnel, and integrate them into bidding systems. * Develop the optimization and control algorithms that turn outcome predictions into bids. * Own projects end to end: frame the problem and success metrics, build and validate prototypes, partner with engineers to productionize, and prove impact through offline analysis and online A/B experimentation. * Help establish scalable, automated processes for training, monitoring, and feedback so outcome optimization stays reliable and performant at scale. * Contribute to the science bar on the team through design and model reviews. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of building models for business application experience * PhD, or Master's degree and 4\+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience * Experience programming in Java, C\+\+, Python or related language * Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience in state\-of\-the\-art deep learning models architecture design and deep learning training and optimization and model pruning Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/ About Us Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day. We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process. About the Role We're looking for a data scientist with strong statistics and modeling skills to be the science partner for the machine learning and recommendation systems behind Twitch's discovery products. You will work with product managers, ML engineers and applied scientists to help build what our recommendation systems should optimize for. That means balancing what a viewer does today (a click, a play, minutes watched) against what keeps them coming back: return visits, daily habits, and lasting connections with creators. It also means weighing short\-form clips against long\-form live content, and each surface against the others. This role will draw from a variety of statistical learning techniques, causal inference, optimization and recommender systems evaluation, and it still owns the full path from question to decision. Reporting to the Director of Data Science, you will work from our San Francisco, CA office. You Will * Help define the objective functions and success metrics for ranking and recommendations across feeds, search and notifications. Make the trade\-offs explicit between short\-term engagement (clicks, plays, watch time) and long\-term outcomes (return visits, retention, new creator connections), including how short\-form clips and live content add to or take away from each other. * Evaluate ranking, recommendation and feed changes with ML engineers and applied scientists. This covers A/B tests and long\-running holdouts, offline metrics that predict online results, and the cost and value of exploration and cold start. Handle the hard cases: novelty effects, interference between experiments, two\-sided marketplace effects involving creators and viewers, and feedback loops in recommendation data. * Build statistical and ML models that explain viewer behavior and size opportunities, such as propensity, uplift, survival and retention models. Include proxy metrics that predict long\-term retention, so teams can decide in days rather than months. * Turn ambiguous product questions into clear analyses. Quantify the uncertainty, and make recommendations that inform the machine learning and discovery roadmap. * Define the logging and data needed to measure discovery surfaces, and check its quality. * Contribute to the team's standards for experimentation, causal inference and model evaluation, and share what you learn with other data scientists. Perks * Medical, Dental, Vision \& Disability Insurance * 401(k) * Maternity \& Parental Leave * Flexible PTO * Amazon Employee Discount About the team Twitch is all about community, and our Community team is a core pillar of what makes Twitch, Twitch. Community Discovery \& ML (CDML) helps millions of viewers find the creators and communities they'll love. That covers search, browse, the mobile live and clips feeds, recommended notifications, and the recommendation systems behind them. When a viewer finds a new creator through one of these, it's often the start of a lasting connection. That connection is what keeps viewers, and the creators they watch, coming back.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of data scientist experience * A BA/BS in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent industry experience. * 3\+ years as a data scientist in a high\-velocity, data\-driven environment, with hands\-on experience applying statistical modeling and machine learning (regression, classification, causal inference, time series), including the assumptions behind each method and when it fails. * Experience designing and analyzing online experiments, including variance reduction, power analysis and the pitfalls of interpreting results. * Expert SQL and proficiency in Python or R. * A track record of using data and models to influence product decisions and leadership. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * An MS or PhD in a quantitative field. * Experience with recommender systems, search ranking or feed ranking, such as offline evaluation (precision and recall, NDCG), exploration versus exploitation, or cold\-start problems. * Experience with multi\-objective optimization or with defining objective functions for ranking systems, including choosing weights between competing goals. * Experience building proxy metrics for long\-term outcomes, or estimating long\-term effects from long\-running holdouts or observational data (e.g., difference\-in\-differences, synthetic control, uplift modeling). * Experience with two\-sided platforms or marketplaces, where changes for viewers also affect creators or supply. * Experience on a consumer content platform: streaming, short\-form video, social or marketplaces. * Familiarity with Twitch, as a viewer or a creator (or both!). We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use. Lead our pioneering AI initiative at AWS and define the future of AI agents. Shape how businesses leverage artificial intelligence by creating foundational building blocks used across AWS business applications. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Applied Science, Battery Data and Machine Learning, Project Jewel
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Do you want to put machine learning to work on a fleet of batteries powering advanced technologies? As the leader of our data and ML organization, you will set its multi\-year technical direction and take battery health and life prediction from prototype to deployed, monitored production across the fleet. Your models will tell us how the fleet is aging, when a battery needs attention, and how hard it can safely be pushed. You will work closely with algorithm, software, and cell teams, and as an early leader you will define how data shapes the product. This role can be based in Boston, Irvine, Sunnyvale, or Seattle, and involves occasional domestic travel, up to 15% of the time. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Security Lake
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Security Lake is a fully managed security data lake service that automatically centralizes security data from AWS environments, SaaS providers, on\-premises sources, and third\-party products into a purpose\-built data lake, normalizing it to the Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework (OCSF) so customers get a single, analytics\-ready view of their security posture across their entire organization. Amazon Security Lake operates across AWS commercial and GovCloud Regions and is trusted by many of the world's largest enterprises with their most sensitive data. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to serve as a technical leader for Amazon Security Lake and across the broader AWS Security Services organization. This role is unusual in its breadth: beyond owning the architecture and operational excellence of a security\-critical, customer\-facing data service, you will lead critical\-path initiatives across our portfolio — including Amazon Security Hub and Amazon Inspector services. You will regularly be the engineer who lands in an unfamiliar codebase, earns the trust of another team's engineers, and converts an ambiguous business problem into a shipped, production system. If you want the reach of a platform role combined with the hands\-on depth of a service team, this is that job. Key job responsibilities * Lead the design of major deliverables end\-to\-end — from working backwards on ambiguous requirements, through design documents and security reviews (threat models, AppSec, operational readiness), to implementation, launch, and production operation * Own and raise the operational bar for Security Lake: root\-cause high\-severity issues to resolution, harden APIs and canaries, drive down recurring alarms, and keep a security\-critical service healthy and efficient * Influence and own technical direction: promote re\-use and extension over new components, pay down architectural debt, and turn one\-off solutions into durable practices the whole team adopts * Drive decisions across team boundaries — when a dependency has no fix, propose the options, build consensus among stakeholders, and unblock the launch * Mentor and grow engineers through thorough (but kind) code and design reviews, onboarding of new team members, and raising the performance bar with every review A day in the life Most of your time is spent doing hands\-on engineering: designing, writing, and reviewing code for distributed data\-processing and control\-plane systems (primarily Java services with TypeScript/CDK infrastructure). In a typical week you might author a design for a new cross\-service security capability and drive it through review with senior engineers from two other teams, ship code into a partner team's codebase, dig into a production alarm and turn the root cause into a fix plus a runbook, and give design feedback that changes the direction of a teammate's approach. You will share the team's on\-call rotation and own customer issues to resolution — customers trust this service with their security data, and operational excellence is everyone's job, with senior engineers setting the example. jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Resilience Infrastruction and Solutions: Incident Mitigation
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion At AWS, resilience is a promise to our customers: that their workloads keep running even when part of the cloud doesn't. The Resilience Infrastructure and Solutions (RIS) organization makes good on that promise, driving higher availability for AWS customers through fewer and shorter operational events. We build the services and programs that detect, mitigate, and recover from failures, from a single impaired Availability Zone to a full Region. When something goes wrong at cloud scale, our systems are what move customer traffic out of harm's way, often in under a minute, before most people notice anything happened. You'll join a team of software engineers, product and program managers, and resilience specialists who work across AWS to raise the bar on availability. You'll partner with foundational services that depend on us as their default mitigation path, and you'll help customers protect workloads they can't afford to have go down. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. The Incident Mitigation team is looking for an experienced software engineer excited about building large\-scale distributed systems that protect hundreds of thousands of customer resources across every AWS Region. You'll own the design and development of significant components of our mission\-critical control and data planes, where correctness, speed, and scale are non\-negotiable, since the moment they're needed most is during an active event. The work spans cross\-service integrations with Route53, ELB, S3, EKS, DynamoDB, EC2, and other foundational services, and demands strong judgment in fault\-tolerant and distributed systems design. In this hands\-on role you'll do everything from building rock\-solid components to anticipating failure modes in design reviews to mentoring other engineers. You need to be not only a strong software developer with a track record of delivering, but someone who excels in communication, technical leadership, and customer focus. You'll help shape the technology and the direction of a growing, high\-impact space inside AWS, writing high\-quality code that measurably improves availability for every AWS customer. Key job responsibilities * Lead the end\-to\-end design, implementation, and delivery of software systems spanning multiple features across the full development lifecycle, ensuring solutions are well\-architected, extensible, and maintainable. * Own your team's architectural direction by evaluating trade\-offs across scalability, performance, security, and maintainability, and guide future technology choices that align with business goals. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including product managers, technical program managers, and partner engineering teams to define requirements, align on system design, and deliver integrated solutions. * Coach and mentor engineers on your team and across related teams, driving adoption of engineering best practices and raising the quality bar for code organization, clarity, and documentation. * Identify opportunities to simplify existing systems and reduce technical debt, leveraging generative AI tools and industry innovations where appropriate to improve team productivity and solution quality. A day in the life You will start your day reviewing design documents and code reviews, providing guidance that helps your teammates ship high\-quality software. You might then dive into a complex system design challenge, weighing trade\-offs with partner teams before writing code for a critical component. Afternoons could include mentoring a fellow engineer, prototyping a new approach using generative AI tools, or leading a discussion on operational improvements. Your work will balance hands\-on coding with architectural leadership, giving you the chance to shape both the technical direction and the culture of your team. About the team Our team is focused on building software that customers rely on every day. We value collaboration, pragmatism, and a commitment to quality that shows up in everything we build. You will work alongside talented engineers who are eager to learn from each other and solve meaningful problems together. We are investing in new capabilities and looking for someone who will help define our technical roadmap for the years ahead. If you are excited about working in an inclusive environment where your ideas shape the future of our products, we would love to hear from you.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 5\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience * 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Vice President, Principal Engineer (AI SDLC & Engineering Transformation)
jobs.description: American Express is accelerating the adoption of Generative AI and Agentic AI across the software development lifecycle. We are looking for a **VP – Principal Engineer (AI Dev Tools Platforms)** to provide enterprise technical leadership for the strategy, architecture, engineering, and scale\-out of AI\-powered developer capabilities. This role will shape how AI is integrated into the broader developer ecosystem, partnering across **Engineering, AI, GenAI Engineering, TRIS, Developer Platforms, Security, Operations, and Developer Analytics** to enable these capabilities securely and at enterprise scale. The role requires **deep software engineering expertise, developer\-platform experience, Agentic AI knowledge, architectural leadership, and the ability to drive execution across a complex global organization** . AI agents now write, test and review a growing share of our code. jobs.title: Senior Autonomy Software Engineer
jobs.description: Apptronik is a human\-centered robotics company developing AI\-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond. We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better. ### **JOB SUMMARY** The Senior Autonomy Software Engineer is a key, hands\-on role. You will build the on\-robot autonomy that lets Apollo complete full shifts of real work at customer sites. You will build the mission and behavior framework that turns a job from fleet software into robot actions. You will also build the runtime that runs learned policies safely on the robot, together with navigation, perception, and control. The main focus of this role is to move learned behaviors, including learned and language\-conditioned navigation, from simulation to reliable use on physical robots. As a senior member of the team, you will also mentor engineers and raise the team's engineering standards. ### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES** * Design, build, and own the on\-robot mission and behavior framework. This framework coordinates navigation, perception, manipulation, and control to complete customer missions. * Integrate learned policies on the robot: imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and large multimodal robot models. Make sure that on\-device inference meets real\-time latency and compute budgets. * Develop supervisors, safety wrappers, and fallback behaviors for learned autonomy. Work with the safety team to keep learned behaviors within safe limits near people. * Build failure detection and recovery. The robot must retry, re\-plan, or resume a mission at the failed step before it asks a person for help. * Extend the autonomy stack to learned navigation, including language\-conditioned navigation policies. Keep the classical planner as the safe fallback. * Build tools for telemetry, logging, replay, and evaluation. Run regression tests in simulation (for example Isaac Sim) and on hardware to measure and improve mission success and intervention rates. * Work closely with the navigation, perception, controls, reinforcement learning, and platform teams. Define clear interfaces, and find the root cause of system\-level problems on physical robots. * Mentor engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and code reviews. Improve code quality, testing, and CI/CD practices. ### **SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS** * Strong modern C\+\+ for fast, real\-time robot software, and strong Python for prototypes, tools, and ML workflows, on Linux. * Hands\-on experience with learned policies (imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or robot foundation models) in real robot systems. You integrated these policies and ran them closed loop on hardware. * Experience with mission or task execution that uses behavior trees or state machines, including failure handling and recovery. * Good knowledge of robotics systems: state estimation interfaces, and how autonomy, perception, navigation, and control work together. * Experience with ROS 2 or a similar message\-passing framework, and with real\-time, multi\-threaded, or distributed software. * Strong plus: you deployed neural networks on embedded GPUs, with model optimization, quantization, and latency profiling. * Strong plus: knowledge of learned navigation, vision\-language models that direct robot tasks, or runtime safety for learned systems (safety filters, monitors, fallback). * A results\-oriented mindset. You want to see autonomy work reliably on real hardware. ### **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE** * A BS in Computer Science, Robotics, Computer Engineering, or a related field and 5\+ years of industry experience, or an MS or PhD and 3\+ years. * A proven record of deploying autonomy, behavior, or navigation software on physical robots. Experience with humanoid, legged, or mobile manipulation robots is a plus. * Experience as a mentor or technical guide to other engineers on a team. * Plus: publications at relevant conferences (for example CoRL, RSS, ICRA, or IROS) or contributions to open\-source robotics software. ### **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times * Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen * Hearing and speech to communicate * This is a direct hire. Please, no outside Agency solicitations. Apptronik provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.description: **Summary**: Working under the direction of an Engineering Manager and with guidance from experienced engineers, this position supports the development, integration, testing, and evaluation of advanced vehicle control functions utilizing cross\-domain systems. Ability to support the construction, configuration, and troubleshooting of development and test vehicles. * Fundamental knowledge of embedded control systems and the ability to support the design, implementation, integration, and evaluation of ECU, actuator, and sensing algorithms. * Programming experience in C and MATLAB/Simulink, gained through academic coursework, internships, research, or professional experience. * Working knowledge of sensing technologies such as GPS/GNSS, IMU, cameras, LiDAR, and other vehicle sensors, including basic understanding of sensor data acquisition and processing. * Fundamental understanding of vehicle dynamics, chassis systems, and/or powertrain systems, including their relationship to vehicle motion control. * Working knowledge of in\-vehicle communication protocols, such as CAN, and familiarity with automotive Ethernet or other vehicle communication technologies. * Ability to support system\-level hardware and software integration, including basic troubleshooting and verification of integrated vehicle systems. * Ability to develop and execute engineering test procedures, collect and analyze test data, identify issues and trends, and summarize results. * Experience with Model\-Based Development tools, particularly MATLAB/Simulink, through academic, research, internship, or professional projects. * Familiarity with simulation, rapid\-prototyping, or hardware\-in\-the\-loop environments used for control\-system development and testing. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to apply engineering principles to vehicle system development and testing. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly document technical work, test results, and engineering findings. * Ability to work effectively both independently on assigned tasks and collaboratively within cross\-functional engineering teams, with appropriate technical guidance. Preferred: * Programming experience in C\+\+ and/or Python. * Knowledge of vehicle dynamics control, including stability control, traction control, braking, steering, suspension, or other vehicle motion\-control functions. * Knowledge of ADAS functions, sensors, or control concepts. * Familiarity with advanced control methods, such as Model Predictive Control (MPC). * Exposure to real\-time embedded algorithm development for automotive systems, chassis systems, or electromechanical actuators. * Experience or familiarity with vehicle dynamics simulation tools, such as CarSim. * Familiarity with rapid\-prototyping and HIL/SIL development platforms, such as dSPACE. * Familiarity with Linux\-based development environments, including Ubuntu. * Familiarity with cloud development platforms, such as AWS, is a plus. **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in electrical/ electronics/ mechanical engineering or related area required. Master's degree preferred. **Experience:** 1\~3\+ years of related experience for Eng I level. * Exposure to Automotive engineering is required, including the following + An understanding of automotive components and embedded systems. + Knowledge of ADAS sensor and ADAS control function is plus. + An understanding of chassis systems and electrical powertrain systems. + An understanding of vehicle control and vehicle dynamics. **Working Conditions:** **Physical Demands:** Required to sit or stand for long periods of time. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. **Travel:** Domestic and international may be required as needed. **Work Environment:** Primarily in a professional business office with exposure to testing areas and periodic exposure to manufacturing environments.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Robot Applications & Behavior)
jobs.description: Burro is the leading robotics company in the world by number of robots working outdoors in the field with real customers. Our mission is to free people from tedious work and solve the critical labor shortages faced by farmers and others that work outdoors. To accomplish our mission, we need a world\-class, diverse team where everyone feels comfortable sharing their ideas. With this in mind, we strive to create a work environment where every employee can be themselves and express their perspective – this enables us to deliver the most creative and innovative solutions to problems our customers face. Headquartered in Philadelphia with an office in central California, and backed by top Agtech and autonomy investors, including S2G, Catalyst, Translink, Cibus, FPrime, Toyota Ventures, FFVC, Xplorer, and Radicle, Burro was created to solve the labor shortages facing farmers using robotics. Burros can be described as Disney's Wall\-E for agriculture and work outdoors, in a 1\.0 format. They function, today, as computer vision based autonomous ground vehicles for carrying, towing, and scouting, and are designed to lay the base for the fully autonomous future of work outdoors. We have 700\+ robots in our growing fleet deployed in paid commercial use within vineyards, nurseries, berries, and beyond, and demand for our product is accelerating, so we are growing our team. **The Role** We are hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** for the Robot Applications and Behavior team. This team owns what the robot does once it's working at a customer site. This is a fully hands\-on individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll spend your time designing and writing the code that runs missions, handles faults and recovery, and turns new robot capabilities into features customers use. You'll join a team of engineers who design, ship, and support the robot's behavior stack in the field. You'll drive features end to end with your teammates, from design through field validation, and share design and code review with the rest of the team. The ideal candidate has shipped software on deployed robots or comparable physical systems and is happy to follow a feature wherever it leads in the stack. ### **Responsibilities:** * Build and extend the robot's mission and task logic: state machines, task sequencing, and fault handling and recovery * Take robot features from design to field deployment, such as autonomous docking and scheduled missions * Ensure mission execution holds up in the field: power cycles, dropped connectivity, and missions that only partly complete * Build the robot behavior behind remote operator commands, such as clearing a stop, manual moves, and resolving conflicts between robots * Instrument behaviors with events and telemetry that support alerts, fleet metrics, and field debugging * Triage field\-reported issues: reproduce them from logs and fleet data, fix them, and verify on hardware * Write design docs for your work, take part in design reviews, and review teammates' code * Work with Autonomy, Perception, and SLAM to turn their capabilities into behavior customers can see and use * Work with DevOps and QA on the test and release workflows the team depends on ### **Requirements:** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field * 5\+ years of professional experience building production software, including time on robots, autonomous vehicles, drones, or comparable physical systems * Strong proficiency in C\+\+ and Python * Able to pick up backend services, web front ends, and messaging such as MQTT when a feature calls for it * Shipped software on commercially deployed robots, vehicles, or comparable physical systems, and debugged it under real\-world conditions: partial observability, unreliable state, and failures that only reproduce on hardware * A safety\-first approach to design, with an understanding of how stop states, motion, and localization confidence limit what a robot is allowed to do * Ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Willingness to travel occasionally to Burro's test farm and customer sites to see the robots working in the field ### **Nice\-To\-Haves:** * Shipped behavior, planning, or mission\-level software on commercially deployed robots or vehicles * Experience designing systems and interfaces that other engineers build on top of * Built or maintained a behavior framework, task planner, or mission executive running across a fleet * Simulation for testing robot behavior * Multi\-robot coordination or fleet traffic management * Fleet observability or robot log tooling, such as Foxglove * Proficiency in ROS * Experience with middleware such as Zenoh or DDS * Experience with outdoor or unstructured environments such as agriculture, logistics, or construction * Prior startup experience, especially in robotics ### **Perks:** * Competitive salary and benefits package (medical/dental/vision) * Early\-Stage Equity * 401K Plan * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave $130,000 \- $150,000 a year **RECRUITERS**: We are **not** accepting agency resumes for this position. Please do not forward or submit resumes through our website or to any of our employees directly. Burro is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: AI Engineer - Scientific Intelligence and LLM Systems
jobs.description: **Company Description** Avery Dennison Corporation (NYSE: AVY) is a global materials science and digital identification solutions company. We are Making Possible™ products and solutions that help advance the industries we serve, providing branding and information solutions that optimize labor and supply chain efficiency, reduce waste and mitigate loss, advance sustainability, circularity and transparency and better connect brands and consumers. We design and develop labeling and functional materials, radio\-frequency identification (RFID) inlays and tags, software applications that connect the physical and digital and offerings that enhance branded packaging and carry or display information that improves the customer experience. Serving industries worldwide — including home and personal care, apparel, general retail, e\-commerce, logistics, food and grocery, pharmaceuticals and automotive — we employ approximately 35,000 employees in more than 50 countries. Our reported sales in 2025 were $8\.9 billion. Learn more at www.averydennison.com. At Avery Dennison, some of the great benefits we provide are: * Health \& Wellness benefits starting on day 1 of employment * Paid parental leave * 401K eligibility * Tuition reimbursement * Employee Assistance Program eligibility / Health Advocate * Paid vacation and Paid holidays **Job Description** We are seeking an exceptionally talented and entrepreneurial AI engineer to build next\-generation Artificial Intelligence capabilities that transform how scientific knowledge is accessed, interpreted, synthesized, and applied across global R\&D. This is a fast\-moving, highly exploratory role within the Materials Science \& Characterization (MSC) organization, operating as an AI skunk works focused on developing custom AI systems and intelligent applications for scientific and engineering challenges. The successful candidate will work at the intersection of advanced AI architectures, large language models (LLMs), information retrieval, knowledge engineering, and scientific computing. A central part of the mission will be to develop sophisticated Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures that connect LLMs to proprietary scientific databases, experimental datasets, technical literature, patents, and internal knowledge repositories. Beyond conventional LLM applications, the candidate will explore and build custom solutions using LLMs, multimodal language models, and small language models (SLMs), along with agentic architectures capable of reasoning, retrieving information, orchestrating computational tools, and executing complex scientific workflows. We are looking for someone who thrives on experimentation, moves rapidly from concepts to working prototypes, and has the technical depth to build custom AI solutions rather than simply assemble existing tools. The opportunity is to establish entirely new ways of leveraging scientific knowledge and computational intelligence to accelerate innovation. Key Responsibilities Advanced LLM and RAG Architectures * Design, develop, and implement advanced RAG architectures connecting LLMs to complex scientific and engineering databases. * Explore and develop hybrid, graph\-based, hierarchical, multimodal, and agentic RAG approaches. * Build sophisticated retrieval, reranking, embedding, and context\-engineering pipelines to improve accuracy, relevance, and scientific grounding. * Develop mechanisms for source attribution, traceability, provenance, and reliable retrieval of scientific information. * Integrate structured and unstructured data sources, including scientific databases, technical reports, patents, publications, experimental datasets, and engineering documentation. Custom AI Models and Intelligent Agents * Develop, fine\-tune, adapt, and deploy custom LLMs, multimodal models, and SLMs for specialized scientific and engineering applications. * Build agentic AI systems capable of multi\-step reasoning, information retrieval, data analysis, and computational task execution. * Develop multi\-agent architectures that coordinate specialized tools, models, and scientific workflows. * Explore emerging model architectures, orchestration frameworks, and AI development paradigms to identify opportunities for competitive differentiation. * Evaluate open\-source and commercial foundation models and determine optimal architectures for specific scientific applications. Scientific Knowledge Engineering * Develop intelligent interfaces and knowledge systems that make complex scientific databases accessible through natural language and semantic search. * Build knowledge graphs, scientific ontologies, and semantic representations connecting materials, formulations, processes, structures, properties, and performance. * Develop pipelines for extracting and structuring scientific information from heterogeneous sources, including complex documents, tables, figures, and experimental records. * Establish robust approaches for data preparation,  odern software engineering, model orchestration, and deployment frameworks. * Integrate LLMs with scientific databases, Python\-based computational tools, simulation platforms, and analytical workflows. * Explore emerging technologies and translate promising concepts into practical, working applications. * Establish evaluation frameworks to assess model accuracy, retrieval quality, hallucination rates, reliability, security, and practical utility. Collaboration and Innovation Across R\&D * Work closely with materials scientists, computational scientists, experimentalists, and engineers to identify opportunities for AI\-enabled scientific discovery. * Translate complex scientific problems into computational architectures and working AI solutions. * Help establish new capabilities and technical standards for the responsible deployment
