jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Fullstack and Applied AI
jobs.description: Awayday is looking for a Staff Engineer, Fullstack and Applied AI to join our IT Team! The Staff Engineer, Fullstack and Applied AI is the senior technical individual contributor in Awayday’s AI and application engineering function. The role owns the hardest technical problems across the custom application estate and the agentic capabilities built on the governed data platform: the designs others build against, the systems that must not fail, and the standards that keep a blended team of full\-time and contracted engineers producing consistent work. This is a build role with leverage. You will spend most of your time designing and writing production code across the stack, and the remainder raising the capability of everyone around you through design review, code review, and mentoring. You carry no direct reports and no budget; influence comes from the quality of your designs and the technical judgment others defer to. The ideal candidate is a full\-stack engineer with genuine production depth in applied AI: someone who can take an ambiguous business problem, decide whether it calls for an agent, a model call, or conventional software, build it, and prove that it works before it reaches a user. The role calls for an engineer who sets the technical standard by example and raises others rather than absorbing their work, who takes ownership of outcomes across the whole system rather than only the component assigned, who is pragmatic about where sophistication is warranted and skeptical of unproven AI capability, and who stays calm under pressure and communicates tradeoffs so any audience can act on them. **Key Responsibilities:** **Technical Design and Hands\-On Delivery** * Own the design of significant systems end to end: application services and APIs, integration with systems of record, data access patterns, and the user\-facing layer. * Translate ambiguous business problems into technical designs, including the judgment of when an agentic or model\-based approach is warranted and when conventional software is the better answer. * Write and maintain the design documents, interface contracts, and reference implementations other engineers build against. * Build and ship production software across the full stack, taking the most complex and highest\-risk components personally, including work that crosses pod and system boundaries where no single team has the full picture. * Build and maintain the shared libraries, services, and internal tooling that remove repeated effort across the team, and operate what you build: instrumentation, alerting, performance and cost tuning, and incident response. * Identify and retire architectural risk and technical debt before it constrains the roadmap, and make the case for the investment required. **Applied AI Engineering** * Design and build agentic capabilities in production: orchestration, tool and function design, retrieval, context and memory management, and the integration layer between models and systems of record. * Build the evaluation harness that proves a capability works: test sets, regression evaluation, grounding and accuracy measurement, and the thresholds a capability meets before release. * Implement guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and failure handling so that model behavior stays within defined bounds. * Engineer the security controls specific to agentic systems: scoped and least\-privilege tool permissions, prompt\-injection and data\-exfiltration defenses, input and output filtering, rate and cost limits, and complete logging and tracing of model and agent activity for audit. * Partner with Data Services on the governed metrics, semantic definitions, and retrieval foundations the agentic assistant depends on, and surface gaps early. * Track the model and tooling landscape, run focused proofs of concept, and give the Director a clear recommendation with evidence. * Lead the technical side of build\-versus\-buy evaluations: define the evaluation criteria and test sets, benchmark candidate models, platforms and vendor products against them, estimate engineering effort and inference and platform cost, and document the recommendation with evidence. **Quality, Standards, and Delivery** * Set and enforce the engineering standard through design and code review across the work of full\-time and contracted engineers, including the testing, documentation, and observability expected of every change. * Strengthen the development pipeline: CI/CD, environment management, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and release practice. * Build security and privacy into designs from the start, in partnership with IT Security, including the handling of employee, guest, and owner data. * Meet the AI governance requirements set by the Director: evaluation records and release evidence for each capability, documented risk tier and approval, model and prompt version control with change history, and participation in security reviews and threat modeling before release pability of the engineers around you through mentoring, pairing, and substantive code review with full\-time and contracted peers, and serve as technical escalation when they are blocked. * Support hiring as a technical interviewer, and contribute to leveling and interview standards for engineering roles. * Lead by demonstration on AI\-assisted development practice, including how such output is reviewed before it is merged. **Qualifications:** * 8\+ years building and operating production software, with a track record of owning systems of significant scope end to end. * Demonstrated full\-stack depth: services and APIs, data access and persistence, and modern front\-end development, with the judgment to work credibly at every layer. * Production experience delivering LLM\-based capability, including retrieval\-augmented generation, tool and function calling, agent orchestration, context and memory design, and prompt engineering grounded on trusted data. * Demonstrated ownership of evaluation for AI systems: test sets, regression evaluation, accuracy and grounding measurement, and the discipline to hold a release until the evidence supports it. * Deep experience with a major cloud platform in production, AWS strongly preferred, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, and cost and performance tuning. * Demonstrated technical leadership without formal authority: design and code review across a team, mentoring, and standards adopted because they were persuasive, including with contracted engineers. * Hands\-on participation in an agile practice: elaboration into stories with acceptance criteria, estimation, sprint planning, review, and retrospectives. * Strong oral and written communication, including the ability to document a design clearly and explain technical tradeoffs to a business audience. * Sound security and privacy judgment in system design, and openness to an evolving model, agent, and application stack. * Experience implementing guardrails and security controls for AI systems in production, including tool permission scoping, prompt\-injection defenses, audit logging, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with AI, Agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool\-integration standards, and vector or hybrid retrieval. * Experience running model observability in production, including logging, tracing, drift detection, and inference cost management. * Hospitality, vacation\-rental, or property\-management domain experience, including integration with those operational platforms and technical onboarding of acquired systems. * Experience with Terraform, AWS application and AI services, and cloud identity and RBAC design. * Prior staff, principal, or technical lead designation at a comparable organization. **Why Join Awayday?** * Be part of a **fast\-growing** company with opportunities for advancement. * Full\-time employees receive **PTO, 401K participation, health insurance, and life insurance**. * Work in a **dynamic, team\-oriented environment** where your contributions make a direct impact. * A collaborative, energized team that’s passionate about hospitality and performance marketing. Ready to make an impact? Apply today and help us shape the future of vacation rentals! Awayday, LLC, is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Awayday, LLC makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

jobs.title: Head of Private Equity
jobs.description: **Our Mission** =============== Rebuild the global economy for the AI era. **About Brain Co.** =================== Most of the economy was built before AI. Brain Co. builds AI\-first organizations so the institutions everyone depends on can serve more people, take on bigger challenges and pursue ideas that have been out of reach. Our engineers, operators and domain experts work alongside the people inside them to rethink how work gets done, with the first workflows live in weeks. Already deployed inside governments and Fortune 2000 companies, Brain Co. is driving hundreds of millions in annual impact. **Why Now** =========== Brain Co. is expanding its products, platform and teams across San Francisco, New York, London, Abu Dhabi and Doha. You’ll join 200\+ people from Palantir, Meta, Harvey, Ramp and Anduril, including many former founders. Everyone here ships. No one is too senior to own the strategy and the work, start to finish. We learn the work from the inside and build for how it really runs. The institutions everyone depends on deserve the best people in AI. **The Role** ============ The Head of Private Equity leads Brain Co.'s PE channel, building partnerships with sponsors, and using them to reach and serve their portfolio companies. You will own sponsor relationships end to end, from fund\-level partnerships and AI due diligence engagements, through deployments at portfolio companies. This role is for a commercial leader with deep relationships across private equity who wants to build a repeatable channel into large enterprises through the firms that own them. The Head of Private Equity will build a repeatable source of revenue through sponsors, working with some of the largest PE firms, their portfolio companies, and investors from our San Francisco office. Reporting to our COO, this role partners closely with our GTM team and leadership to deliver AI value creation engagements that turn sponsor relationships into long\-term customers. **Who Will Thrive in This Role** ================================ * 10\+ years of experience across private equity, PE\-focused consulting or advisory, or enterprise sales to sponsors and their portfolio companies. * Existing relationships with operating partners and value creation leaders at large\-cap private equity firms. * A track record of originating and closing complex, multi\-million\-dollar enterprise engagements with portfolio companies. * You understand how sponsors underwrite and create value, including diligence, the 100\-day plan, and EBITDA initiatives across the hold period. * You have built and led a channel, partnerships, or business development team. * Credibility with portfolio company CEOs, CFOs, and CIOs, and the ability to connect AI capabilities to operating and financial outcomes. * Nice to have: an operating partner or value creation role at a PE firm; experience in the private equity or commercial due diligence practice of a strategy consulting firm; experience with portfolios in insurance, healthcare, or financial services; relationships with sovereign wealth funds or Middle East investors. **Your Impact** =============== In your first 6\-12 months, you will: * Build and manage relationships with operating partners, value creation teams, and deal teams at the largest private equity firms, including fund\-of\-funds, and sovereign investors that invest across many sponsors. * Develop programmatic partnerships that give Brain Co. repeatable access to portfolio companies across a sponsor's fund, beyond one\-off engagements. * Lead our AI due diligence offering for sponsors evaluating acquisitions, and turn those engagements into portfolio company relationships after close. * Originate and close AI value creation engagements with portfolio companies, working with our vertical general managers and forward\-deployed engineering teams on scoping, pricing, and delivery. * Own the channel's pipeline, forecast, and targets, including qualifying portfolio companies against our ideal customer profile early in the cycle. * Build and lead a team that covers sponsors by tier and region. * Develop case studies and proof points tied to outcomes for sponsor, portfolio company, and LP audiences. **How Success Will Be Measured** ================================ Success in this role means building a PE channel that drives real revenue and lasts. We'll look at business impact (pipeline, closed revenue, and how many portfolio companies each sponsor relationship opens up), the quality and speed of execution from diligence through deployment, how well you work with our GMs and engineering teams, the judgment you bring to where we focus, and whether the channel keeps producing throug partnerships, a strong team, and a predictable forecast. **What You'll Bring** ===================== *Critical capabilities* * Fluent, daily usage of AI tools (Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) as your default way of working. You can point to concrete, recent examples of how AI changed your approach to a real problem. * Strong first\-principles problem\-solving in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments. You’re comfortable operating before the "right" process or tool exists yet. *Demonstrated ownership* * A track record of owning outcomes end\-to\-end, including the parts nobody explicitly assigned to you. * Comfortable being the most capable person in the room on a problem your team hasn't solved before, because you used AI plus judgment to get there faster than experience alone would allow. *Relevant expertise* * Hands\-on experience in private equity, with AI tooling embedded directly into that work and applied to your actual workflow (prompting, agents, evals, or equivalent, whichever fits the role). * Can speak concretely to what you've automated, sped up, or stopped doing manually in the last year because of AI. *Strong communication* * Communicates complex or ambiguous work clearly and concisely, in writing and in person, including explaining AI\-driven decisions to people who aren't AI\-native. * Translates technical or AI\-generated output into business impact for stakeholders or clients who may be skeptical of or unfamiliar with the tooling. **How We Work** =============== People at Brain Co. are expected to: * Own outcomes. * Write clearly. * Give direct, respectful feedback. * Move quickly with sound judgment. * Stay close to customers. * Build for production. * Use AI thoughtfully to improve quality, speed, and leverage. **Compensation** ================ We pay competitively for every role and back that with meaningful equity, because we want the people building Brain Co. to genuinely share in what we build together. Beyond salary and equity, we invest in country\-specific benefits because we want our team to feel taken care of, not only compensated. The annual base salary range for this role is $99,831 \- $259,137\. We publish this range for every role, in every location, as a matter of policy regardless of whether local law requires it. Actual pay will depend on scope, skills, experience, and location. This role is also eligible for equity. **Location** ============ This role is based in San Francisco, US and follows an onsite/hybrid model. Relocation and immigration support may be available. **Equal Opportunity and Accessibility** ======================================= Brain Co. is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We provide reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities or sincerely held religious beliefs \- contact talent@braincompany.ai to request one. Ready to build with us?

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Voice)
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** At **Bandwidth**, we shape how the world connects. We're the global communications software company and Tier 1 network operator with global reach. The voice, messaging, and emergency services infrastructure behind the brands and apps you use every day. Because we own the network we build on, *the problems you'll solve here are bigger, more complex, and more impactful.* And as communications shifts to AI, we're the infrastructure layer making it possible. We call ourselves BANDmates because building something this big takes collaboration, different perspectives, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to the table. We're experts who speak like humans. Ready to build what's next? **\#JoinTheBand** **What We Are Looking For:** As a **Software Engineer** on our Voice team, you'll help build the systems that decide how calls are routed across Bandwidth's network and carriers around the world, and the data pipelines that keep those decisions accurate. You'll work on services that carry live traffic, so careful engineering and strong testing habits matter. We work AI\-first: you'll use AI coding agents every day to learn the codebase, build and test faster, and automate the work around it. **What You'll Do:** * Help define features and their design with the team, then ship them end to end in the Java services that route calls, from tests through deployment and monitoring. * Build and harden data pipelines that ingest, validate and publish large routing and pricing datasets, with automated checks that stop bad data before it reaches production. * Design REST APIs and internal tools that make routing data safe and easy to manage, with the needs of the people and customers who rely on them in mind. * Automate deployments, health checks and routine operations across VMs, Kubernetes and AWS. * Use AI coding agents daily to explore unfamiliar code, write and refactor code and tests, analyze data and draft documentation, and verify every change before it ships. * Bring new tools and technologies, including AI tooling, into the team when they solve a real problem without creating bigger ones. * Investigate routing questions with real call and pricing data, help resolve production issues, and join the on\-call rotation once ramped up. * Write tests, documentation and runbooks for what you build, and review your teammates' code. **What You Need:** * 2 \- 4 years of professional software engineering experience, mainly backend, including features you helped design and shipped to production yourself. * Experience delivering tasks with limited oversight, including working through unfamiliar problems on your own. You can walk us through an example. * Proficiency in Java and Spring Boot, including writing unit and integration tests for the code you ship. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding agents (such as Claude Code) in your day\-to\-day development. You can walk us through, or demonstrate live, how you use them and how you check their work. * Strong SQL: you can write and optimize queries with complex joins and aggregations on large tables, and validate that the results are correct. * Experience designing REST APIs, including versioning, error handling and idempotency. * Working knowledge of Linux and scripting in Bash or Python. * Experience deploying and debugging your own services using CI/CD pipelines and containers. * Methodical debugging: you form a hypothesis, check it against logs, metrics and data, and explain the answer clearly. **Bonus Points:** * Telecom, VoIP or CPaaS experience, or familiarity with SIP, number portability, call routing, least\-cost routing or carrier rate management. * Experience building your own AI\-powered tools, scripts or agent workflows. * Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse. * Experience with Ansible or other configuration management. * Front\-end experience. * Experience with Go, AWS, or Datadog or similar observability tooling. **The Whole Person Promise:** At Bandwidth, we're pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our "Whole Person Promise." We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well… * 100% company\-paid Medical, Vision, \& Dental coverage for you and your family with low deductibles and low out\-of\-pocket expenses. * All new hires receive four weeks of PTO. * PTO Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you're embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your PTO – not even with email. * Additional PTO can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges. * "Mahalo moments" program grants additional time off for life's most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild. * 90\-Minute Workout Lunches and unlimited meetings with our very own nutritionist. Are you excited about the position and its responsibilities, but not sure if you're 100% qualified? Do you feel you can work to help us crush the mission? If you answered 'yes' to both of these questions, we encourage you to apply! You won't want to miss the opportunity to be a part of the BAND. Applicant Privacy Notice

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer (Voice)
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** At **Bandwidth**, we shape how the world connects. We're the global communications software company and Tier 1 network operator with global reach. The voice, messaging, and emergency services infrastructure behind the brands and apps you use every day. Because we own the network we build on, *the problems you'll solve here are bigger, more complex, and more impactful.* And as communications shifts to AI, we're the infrastructure layer making it possible. We call ourselves BANDmates because building something this big takes collaboration, different perspectives, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to the table. We're experts who speak like humans. Ready to build what's next? **\#JoinTheBand** **What We Are Looking For:** As a **Software Engineer** on our Voice team, you'll build and run the real\-time services that decide how voice calls move across Bandwidth's network. These systems sit on the path of every call, so latency, reliability and correctness are non\-negotiable. We work AI\-first: engineers on this team use AI coding agents every day to design, build, test and operate software, and we expect you to help push that further. You'll be key to the success of the features you own and work closely with teams beyond your own. **What You'll Do:** * Design, deliver and operate real\-time call routing features that run within tight latency budgets across multiple data centers and cloud regions. * Lead larger projects end to end: write the stories, explore the options, document the design, and break the work into safe incremental releases. * Engineer for reliability: define SLOs, design failure behavior (timeouts, circuit breakers, fail\-open vs. fail\-closed, graceful degradation), and prove it with load and failure testing. * Lead production investigations end to end, from SIP traces and packet captures to logs, metrics and distributed traces, and turn every incident into a lasting fix. * Use AI coding agents across your work, including design exploration, implementation, test generation, code review and incident analysis, and share the prompts, skills and tool integrations that help your teammates move faster. * Write proposals and join working groups on improving how we build software, including AI\-assisted engineering practices. * Review code and tests with care, help unblock teammates, and collaborate beyond your own product area to find the best solution for the company. **What You Need:** * 5\+ years building and operating backend systems in production, including at least 2 years owning a latency\- or availability\-critical service end to end (design, rollout and on\-call). * Advanced Java and Spring Boot: you can write and review concurrent code, and you have diagnosed and fixed JVM performance problems (profiling, garbage collection, thread contention) in production. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding agents (such as Claude Code) for real engineering work, beyond autocomplete. You can walk us through, or demonstrate live, how you break down a multi\-step task for an agent, give it the right context, and verify its output before it ships. * Strong SIP knowledge: dialogs and transactions, INVITE and REGISTER flows, key headers and response codes. * Working knowledge of telecom numbering and routing. * Experience designing distributed systems for high availability. * Experience designing relational schemas and tuning queries (MySQL/MariaDB or similar), and using Redis or another cache in production. * Experience defining SLOs and alerts, and using metrics, logs and distributed tracing (Datadog, OpenTelemetry or similar) to diagnose production issues. * Experience shipping containerized services to Kubernetes through CI/CD pipelines with automated tests and safe rollout practices. * Experience leading a project from requirements to production, including writing the stories and the design proposal. * Strong code review skills. * Clear written and verbal communication, including design proposals and root\-cause analyses. **Bonus Points:** * Experience at a CPaaS, carrier or VoIP provider. * Experience with Session Border Controllers, OpenSIPS/Kamailio or SIP header manipulation. * Experience with international voice routing. * Experience building AI tooling for engineers, such as agent workflows, MCP servers or integrations, or evaluations of LLM output. * Experience with AWS and infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK). * Experience with Kafka or other event streaming. **The Whole Person Promise:** At Bandwidth, we're pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our "Whole Person Promise." We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well… * 100% company\-paid Medical, Vision, \& Dental coverage for you and your family with low deductibles and low out\-of\-pocket expenses. * All new hires receive four weeks of PTO. * PTO Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you're embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your PTO – not even with email. * Additional PTO can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges. * "Mahalo moments" program grants additional time off for life's most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild. * 90\-Minute Workout Lunches and unlimited meetings with our very own nutritionist. If you answered 'yes' to both of these questions, we encourage you to apply! You won't want to miss the opportunity to be a part of the BAND. Applicant Privacy Notice

These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! **Position Summary:** This job is responsible for providing leadership, technical direction and oversight to a team delivering technology solutions. Key responsibilities of the job are to provide oversight of the design, implementation, and maintenance of complex computer programs, align technical solutions to business objectives, and ensure that coding practices/quality comply with software development standards. Job expectations include conducting multiple software implementations and applying both depth and breadth in knowledge of several technical competencies. **Responsibilities:** * Designs, develops and is accountable for feature delivery * Applies enterprise standards for solution design, coding and quality * Ensures solution meets product acceptance criteria with minimal technical debt * Guides the team on work breakdown and execution * Works with the Product Owner to ensure that product backlog/requirements are healthy, with clear acceptance criteria * Plays a team lead role (as an individual contributor) and mentors the team * Guides team members with skills and practices (planning and estimation, peer reviews, and other engineering practices) **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of job related experience required . * Extensive front\-end development experience using Sparta, Angular versions 2 and 4–22, React, Vue.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, SASS, and JSON, Playwright, with a focus on responsive interfaces and cross\-browser compatibility. * Experienced in building reusable component libraries and micro\-frontends to deliver consistent user experiences across authenticated and unauthenticated channels. * Proficient in Git and Bitbucket for branching, pull requests, and code reviews; SonarQube and security scanners for code quality validation; and browser Developer Tools and IDE debuggers for troubleshooting and profiling front\-end and back\-end applications across development, SIT, and production environments. * Drive defect triage, root cause analysis, and production issue resolution. Communicate technical status, solution options, recommendations, and change notices clearly to management, executive leadership, site owners, and technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Desired Qualifications** * Apply WCAG 2\.1/2\.2 accessibility standards and enterprise branding and regulatory guidelines. * Optimize web performance through lazy loading, code splitting, caching strategies, and Core Web Vitals monitoring. * Implement secure front\-end practices, including input validation, Content Security Policy (CSP), and mitigation of XSS and open redirect vulnerabilities. * Support modernization initiatives involving cloud adoption, CI/CD automation, and AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot. **Skills:** * Automation * Influence * Result Orientation * Stakeholder Management * Technical Strategy Development * Architecture * Business Acumen * Risk Management * Solution Delivery Process * Solution Design * Agile Practices * Analytical Thinking * Collaboration * Data Management * DevOps Practices **Shift:** 1st shift (United States of America) **Hours Per Week:** 40

jobs.description: **Systems Engineer (Datacenter)** **Location:** Northbrook, IL About the Role Bell Flavors \& Fragrances is seeking a Systems Engineer to design, implement, administer, and continuously improve our enterprise datacenter infrastructure, compute and storage platforms, virtualization technologies, and business continuity solutions. In this role you will help ensure the availability, performance, reliability, and recoverability of the systems that support our business operations. As a key member of the Infrastructure \& Operations team, you will serve as a technical subject matter expert across physical and virtual server infrastructure, enterprise storage, and backup and recovery platforms, balancing day\-to\-day operations with initiatives focused on modernization, automation, standardization, and operational resilience. You will collaborate with infrastructure, cybersecurity, service desk, and business technology teams and report to the Sr. Manager, IT Operations. **What You Will Do** * Execute infrastructure projects and perform proactive monitoring, maintenance, patching, and optimization of assigned platforms and services * Investigate recurring incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement permanent corrective actions * Provide advanced troubleshooting and serve as an escalation resource for the Service Desk and other IT teams * Monitor backup operations, investigate failures, and ensure scheduled protection activities complete successfully * Develop, maintain, and validate recovery procedures and disaster recovery documentation * Support vulnerability remediation, configuration hardening, access reviews, and compliance initiatives * Identify opportunities to streamline processes, reduce manual effort, and improve efficiency * Evaluate emerging datacenter and infrastructure technologies and recommend improvements * Maintain accurate technical documentation and share knowledge across the team * Participate in scheduled maintenance activities and an on\-call rotation, as required **What You Bring** * 6\+ years of progressive IT infrastructure experience, including at least 3 years of hands\-on experience with Windows server administration, enterprise virtualization, and enterprise storage * Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for administration, automation, and troubleshooting * Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure operations, security principles, and IT service management (incident, request, and problem management) * Experience supporting distributed users across multiple locations; manufacturing, warehouse, or branch environments strongly preferred * Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across endpoint, network, and application layers * Excellent written and oral communication skills with both technical and non\-technical audiences * Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented, and able to manage priorities in a fast\-paced environment * Flexibility with working hours based on user needs **Why Join Bell?** * Opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a critical security role * Collaborate in a supportive, team\-oriented culture * Be part of a company that values innovation, integrity, and continuous improvement * Competitive salary range $82,500 \- $150,000 and benefits package Bell Flavors \& Fragrances develops products for food, beverage, cosmetic, personal care, and household care companies throughout the world. Bell has nine manufacturing plants worldwide including the United States, Canada, Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, Germany, Singapore, and China. Bell operates sales offices in more than 40 countries and is proud to be privately held by the Heinz family. www.bellff.com (http://www.bellff.com) #### **Experience** Required* 6\+ years of progressive IT infrastructure experience, including at least 3 years of hands\-on experience with Windows server administration, enterprise virtualization, and enterprise storage Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. jobs.description: **Software Engineer II, AI Developer Tools** **Location:** Hybrid (3 days in\-office, weekly), Exton/Philadelphia, Pennsylvania **Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.** **Position Summary** We are looking for a Software Engineer II to build production\-quality AI\-powered developer tools, reusable skills, and practical agentic workflows. Your initial focus will be reusable tools and automation that help engineering teams code, test, debug, document, review, and deliver software more effectively. You will work hands\-on with model APIs, developer platforms, repositories, and external data to turn promising ideas into maintainable solutions. This is not a prompt\-only or research role. require travel. * Requires sitting or standing at will while performing work on a computer (or any other *physical requirements*). **Qualifications** * A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * At least 3 years of professional software development experience delivering production\-quality applications, services, or developer tools, with strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, and React. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience building at least one substantive AI\-enabled application, developer tool, or workflow through professional, personal, or open\-source work, including one or more of the following: + AI agents or multi\-step agentic workflows + AI\-powered tools for coding, tool\-calling capabilities, or Model Context Protocol integrations * Experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into production software using APIs, SDKs, or developer platforms. * Experience designing typed interfaces and structured outputs between probabilistic model behavior and deterministic application code. * Experience with REST APIs, Git\-based development, automated testing, and CI/CD practices. * Ability to move independently from an idea to a working prototype, then collaborate with others to integrate and productionize it in an existing codebase. * Practical understanding of unreliable model output, context constraints, privacy and data security, evaluation, and the need for human oversight. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings, limitations, and trade\-offs clearly. **What Will Make You Stand Out** * A portfolio, GitHub repository, technical demonstration, or professional project showing a substantive AI tool or workflow you have personally built. * Experience evaluating and integrating one or more agent frameworks or AI development platforms, with clear reasoning for the implementation choices. * Experience with tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs, memory, orchestration, or multi\-agent collaboration. * Experience connecting AI\-enabled workflows to GitHub, GitHub Copilot, Azure DevOps, Model Context Protocol servers, internal tools, or other data sources. * Experience creating AI\-enabled workflows for coding, testing, debugging, code review, documentation, or engineering knowledge discovery. * Experience defining evaluation methods, regression tests, and success measures for quality, reliability, latency, cost, and user impact. * Experience adding privacy, authorization, prompt\-injection, rate\-limit, fallback, or observability controls to AI\-enabled systems. * Evidence of ongoing experimentation through personal or open\-source projects, technical demonstrations, technical writing, or hackathon work. * Experience with a TypeScript/React monorepo and tools such as pnpm, Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or Module Federation. * Experience with iTwin.js, CesiumJS, WebGL, digital twins, BIM, CAD, geospatial, or infrastructure software. \#LI\-RB1 \#LI\-Hybrid This is a Hybrid role. **What We Offer:** * Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success. * An attractive salary and benefits package. * Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice. * Celebrate milestone achievements and moments that matter through our colleague recognition award programs and our Bentley Achievers platform. * A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups. * Be part of a company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact. **Who We Are:** Bentley Systems (Nasdaq: BSY) is the infrastructure engineering software company. We provide innovative software to advance the world’s infrastructure – sustaining both the global economy and environment. Our industry\-leading software solutions are used by professionals, and organizations of every size, for the design, construction, and operations of roads and bridges, rail and transit, water and wastewater, public works and utilities, buildings and campuses, mining, and industrial facilities. Our offerings, powered by the iTwin Platform for infrastructure digital twins, include MicroStation and Bentley Open applications for modeling and simulation, Seequent’s software for geoprofessionals, and Bentley Infrastructure Cloud encompassing ProjectWise for project delivery, SYNCHRO for construction management, and AssetWise for asset operations. Bentley Systems’ 5,200 colleagues generate annual revenues of more than $1 billion in 194 countries. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** Bentley is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, pregnancy, protected veteran status, religion, national origin, age, genetic information or any other protected characteristic. jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Machine Learning
jobs.description: **Be Part of the Next. Be Berkadia.** ===================================== Berkadia is built on deep expertise, strong relationships, and a commitment to excellence across the commercial real estate industry. What sets us apart is our people. As a values\-driven organization, we foster a culture where collaboration thrives, growth is encouraged, and employees are empowered to make an impact. Together, our people strengthen our business and help shape the future of Berkadia. Are you ready to be part of the next? Discover your next opportunity at Berkadia and apply today. As a Senior Engineer, Machine Learning at Berkadia, you’ll be at the forefront of applying cutting\-edge machine learning and generative AI to redefine how the commercial real estate industry operates. Berkadia now has a dedicated machine learning team and an established generative AI system — Berkie — which is transforming the way Berkadians work. In this role, you will contribute directly to expanding and improving Berkie, building on top of proprietary company data to create intelligent systems that drive operational efficiency, enhance workflows, and generate revenue. You will work closely with product, engineering, architecture, and data teams to design, implement, and scale AI systems \- ranging from predictive modeling and traditional machine learning pipelines to agentic systems, intelligent document processing, and generative AI applications. This is a high\-impact position for someone passionate about applying AI to real\-world problems, who thrives in a collaborative environment and stays ahead in a fast\-moving field. **Responsibilities** * Design, implement, and maintain production\-ready machine learning systems using both generative and traditional techniques. * Architect end\-to\-end AI solutions for use cases such as intelligent document processing, agentic systems, and information retrieval. * Drive the continued development of *Berkie*, Berkadia’s generative AI platform, ensuring it delivers meaningful access to proprietary data and supports efficiency and growth across the business. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams — including product, engineering, and data — to identify impactful problems and translate them into scalable AI solutions. * Write maintainable, high\-quality code using Python and modern cloud infrastructure; use notebooks as needed for experimentation and rapid iteration. * Establish and contribute to best practices in MLOps, including model deployment, monitoring, observability, and continuous improvement. * Participate in peer reviews, design discussions, and team learning sessions to foster transparency and knowledge\-sharing. * Document system designs, decisions, and outcomes to improve clarity and reproducibility across the team. * Stay up\-to\-date with the rapidly evolving ML and GenAI landscape; self\-learning and curiosity are essential to success in this role. * Take initiative, share wins, and work with purpose — we value engineers who care deeply about their craft and their impact on others. **Qualifications** Qualifications to perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. jobs.description: Locations: **New York, New York** **Job description** ------------------- **About this role** You will be part of the Trading Engineering team supporting Aladdin, BlackRock’s investment operating system used internally and by financial institutions globally. The team operates at the intersection of finance and technology, building robust solutions that support investment and trading workflows with a focus on reliability, speed, scalability, and technical excellence. The team brings together engineers, traders, product managers, and other partners to solve complex problems and deliver technology that drives meaningful business outcomes. The environment emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, open dialogue, and high\-quality engineering. **Your role and impact** ------------------------ You will be at the heart of Aladdin, building the technology that supports BlackRock’s and our clients’ investment and trading operations. You will design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications and high\-performance Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), working closely with traders, product managers, and engineers to translate requirements into impactful solutions. You will troubleshoot technical challenges, optimize microservices and data\-processing pipelines, and explore new technologies that improve system performance. Through hands\-on engineering, mentorship, and collaboration, you will help strengthen the reliability, security, and efficiency of mission\-critical trading systems. This role provides the opportunity to make an impact in a global trading environment while working on complex technical problems and supporting the continued development of engineering talent. **Your responsibilities** ------------------------- In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. distributed NoSQL data storage platforms and Ignite. * Experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Open Container Initiative (OCI) container image packaging and runtime, enterprise\-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, and continuous integration and continuous jobs.title: Platform Engineer II
jobs.description: About Blackhawk Network: Today, through BHN’s single global platform, businesses of all kinds can tap into the world’s largest network of branded payment solutions. BHN helps businesses grow revenue, increase loyalty, motivate and reward their teams, disburse funds and engage consumers. Branded payment solutions include the issuance and distribution of gift cards, egifts, corporate payouts and rewards, along with the technology to deliver these products in seamless, integrated ways. BHN’s network spans the globe with more than 400,000 consumer touchpoints. Learn more at BHN.com. **Hybrid flexibility:** At Blackhawk Network, you’ll enjoy the best of both worlds—focused remote work plus in\-person collaboration at our Coppell, TX office. This rhythm gives you the tools, connection, and autonomy you need to make a real impact. Overview: The Operations Command Centre (OCC) is looking for a Platform Engineer II who combines strong engineering judgement with confident ownership of production services. This is not a traditional Platform Engineering or NOC role: you will improve the systems you operate, using automation, observability and sound operational practice to prevent incidents, shorten diagnosis and restore service safely. You will work across BHN’s production platforms and partner closely with application, infrastructure and business teams. At this level, you are expected to independently investigate complex issues, take a leading role in major incidents, and keep technical and non\-technical stakeholders aligned through clear, timely communication. You will also turn operational learning into durable improvements across reliability, tooling and ways of working. Responsibilities: **Major incident leadership \& production operations** * Participate in the 24×7 on\-call rotation and take ownership of production issues through triage, mitigation, recovery and handover. * Lead or co\-lead major incident bridges: establish a shared understanding of impact and priorities, bring the right responders together, assign and track actions, and maintain momentum toward safe service restoration. * Make effective decisions under pressure; assess evidence, risks and options; escalate promptly when impact or uncertainty warrants it; and avoid unvalidated or unsafe changes. * Provide concise, regular updates tailored to the audience—covering customer or business impact, current status, actions underway, risks, decisions needed and the next update time. * Maintain a clear incident timeline and ensure actions, owners and decisions are captured for effective handover and later review. * Contribute to blameless post\-incident reviews; identify systemic causes and actionable corrective work, then track improvements through to completion. * Recognise recurring failure patterns and operational risk, and work with service owners to reduce repeat incidents and improve recovery readiness. **Platform engineering \& automation** * Design, build and maintain automation that removes repetitive work, reduces operational risk and improves consistency. * Develop internal tools and self\-service capabilities that make platform operations safer and improve engineering productivity. * Improve CI/CD and infrastructure workflows, including deployment safety, rollback readiness and operational guardrails. * Contribute to infrastructure\-as\-code, configuration management and container\-platform solutions using maintainable engineering practices. * Prefer engineered, measurable and supportable solutions over repeated manual intervention; document operational dependencies and failure modes. **Observability \& reliability engineering** * Improve service visibility through meaningful metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and actionable alerts. * Tune alerting to identify customer\-impacting conditions early while reducing noise and alert fatigue. * Use production and incident data to identify reliability risks, capacity concerns, performance trends and improvement opportunities. * Define, measure and use Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and operational health measures with service teams. * Share findings and recommendations clearly, using evidence to help teams prioritise reliability work. **Intelligent operations \& continuous improvement** * Use AI\-assisted engineering tools where appropriate to improve delivery, investigation and documentation; validate outputs and follow security, privacy and engineering controls. * Identify practical opportunities for incident summarisation, contextual diagnostics, knowledge retrieval and workflow automation. * Help evaluate and operationalise intelligent tooling with appropriate human oversight, testing, auditability and failure handling. * Contribute to runbooks, knowledge systems and operational learning that make troubleshooting faster and more consistent. Qualifications: **Required** * Demonstrated experience in Platform Engineering, SRE, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, Pro oduction services and independently handling complex technical troubleshooting; experience leading or coordinating high\-severity incidents is essential. * Strong written and verbal communication: able to explain technical issues in plain language, write concise status updates and handovers, facilitate discussions, and communicate calmly and confidently under pressure. * Strong Linux fundamentals and practical experience with AWS or another major cloud platform. * Working knowledge of Git and modern software\-development practices, plus practical scripting or automation experience in Python, Bash or a similar language. * Sound judgement, clear ownership and a collaborative approach: able to coordinate across teams, make progress amid ambiguity, and escalate with the right context. * A continuous\-improvement mindset, including the ability to turn incidents and operational data into prioritised, measurable engineering changes. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. **Helpful experience** * Kubernetes, Docker or other container platforms; Jenkins or comparable CI/CD systems. * Observability and logging tools such as Splunk, New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry. * ServiceNow or similar incident, change and service\-management platforms. * Infrastructure as Code, including Terraform, CloudFormation or comparable tools. * Major Incident Management practices, incident command or facilitation, post\-incident review and corrective\-action tracking. * Distributed systems, high\-availability services, payments or other environments where service continuity is critical. * Responsible use of AI\-assisted development or operations tools, with a focus on measurable outcomes and validation. *We seek candidates who not only demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in emerging technologies but have also successfully implemented and utilized AI tools to enhance their work, improve processes, or deliver measurable results. Our teams embrace continuous learning and the thoughtful integration of AI to create meaningful impact – for our employees and the future of work.**Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and drug screen.* Benefits: Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, Blackhawk Network offers benefits including 401k with employer match, medical, dental, vision, 12 paid holidays throughout the year 2026, sick pay accrual according to state law, parental leave, life insurance, disability insurance, accident and illness insurance, health and dependent care flexible spending accounts, wellness benefits, and flexible time off for all full\-time employees. EEO Statement: Blackhawk Network provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Blackhawk Network believes that diversity leads to strength. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Blackhawk Network encourages applicants with previous criminal records to apply to all positions and, pursuant to the San Francisco and Los Angeles Fair Chance Acts (and other “Fair Chance” laws), Blackhawk Network will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. jobs.description: **Your Role** The Data Engineer / Snowflake Database Administrator Principal is responsible for the administration, reliability, performance, security, and optimization of Stellarus’ Snowflake data platform. This is a hands\-on technical role with primary responsibility for Snowflake database administration while also supporting data engineering capabilities across the enterprise data ecosystem. The ideal candidate brings strong Snowflake administration and database fundamentals along with experience in, or the ability and interest to quickly learn, modern data engineering tools and technologies. This individual will work across traditional DBA responsibilities and data engineering activities, helping ensure that data is securely stored, efficiently processed, reliably moved, and available to downstream applications, analytics, and reporting platforms. The principal will partner closely with Data Engineering, Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, Analytics, and application teams to administer Snowflake, troubleshoot complex platform and data issues, optimize workloads, support data pipelines and integrations, and automate operational activities. This role is well suited for a hands\-on technologist who is comfortable owning Snowflake administration while expanding beyond traditional DBA responsibilities into modern cloud data engineering. **Your Work** In this role, you will: * Serve as a hands\-on Data Platform Engineer responsible for building, evolving, and operating Stellarus' Snowflake\-based data platform as a product, delivering reliable, secure, scalable, and cost\-efficient data capabilities that enable product teams, analytics, and downstream applications. * Own the platform roadmap and product mindset: gather requirements from engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders, define platform capabilities and standards, and measure success through adoption, developer productivity, reliability, and cost efficiency. * Design and build Snowflake platform architecture across development, test, staging, and production, including accounts, databases, schemas, virtual warehouses, stages, storage integrations, and network and security configurations, with all changes delivered through code rather than manual administration. * Manage Snowflake and supporting Azure resources as code using Terraform (Snowflake and AzureRM providers), schemachange, Snowflake CLI, or equivalent tooling, with versioned, peer\-reviewed, and repeatable deployments. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for database objects, data pipelines, dbt projects, Airflow DAGs, and environment configuration, including automated testing, linting, approvals, environment promotion, and rollback strategies. * Enable developer self\-service through reusable templates, Terraform modules, pipeline frameworks, golden paths, and guardrails that let teams onboard data sources, request access, and ship data products quickly while preserving governance. * Design, build, and own production ELT/ETL pipelines that move data between source systems, Azure storage (ADLS Gen2/Blob), Snowflake, downstream applications, analytics platforms, and enterprise systems, including integration with REST APIs and event\-driven sources. * Develop, schedule, and operate workflows in Apache Airflow, including DAG design, dependency management, retries, SLAs, alerting, custom operators and hooks, testing, and deployment on Azure (AKS or managed offerings). * Build Snowflake\-native data processing using SQL, Python, Snowpark, stored procedures, tasks, streams, dynamic tables, Snowpipe and Snowpipe Streaming, external tables, and Iceberg tables, selecting the right pattern for batch, micro\-batch, and near\-real\-time workloads. * Implement transformation frameworks such as dbt, including modeling standards, testing, documentation, incremental strategies, and CI\-based validation. * Integrate with Azure services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Event Grid, Event Hubs, Service Bus, Logic Apps based on product and project needs. * Design and implement scalable data models (dimensional, data vault, and analytical or operational structures) that support analytics, reporting, operational, and product use cases. * Build data products with defined ownership, contracts, SLAs, and documentation, and implement data quality checks, reconciliation, lineage, and cataloging to drive trust and discoverability. * Define and implement SLIs and SLOs for pipelines and data products, and build observability using Snowflake alerts and notifications, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and tools such as Datadog or Grafana to track data freshness, pipeline health, platform performance, and security events. * Design and maintain a least\-privilege RBAC model using functional and access role hierarchies and managed access schemas, automated through code and integrated with identity providers. * Implement authentication and network secur  such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar technologies preferred. * Snowflake certification, such as SnowPro Core or SnowPro Advanced, preferred. * Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause\-analysis skills with the ability to independently investigate and resolve complex database and data pipeline issues. * Ability and willingness to learn new technologies quickly and work across both database administration and data engineering responsibilities. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience operating in regulated, healthcare, enterprise, or complex technology environments preferred. **ABOUT THE TEAM About Stellarus and the Ascendiun Family of Companies** Stellarus, launched in January 2025, is designed to scale innovative healthcare solutions that support customers in creating a health care experience deserving of their family, friends, and neighbors. To achieve our mission, we foster an environment where all employees can thrive and contribute fully to address the needs of the various communities we serve. You will work in a team of high\-performing Data Engineers, Data Scientists and Data Analysts. You will have deep technical expertise in the Databricks Intelligence Platform. **Databricks Platform \& Data Engineering** * Design, build, and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, and Spark SQL. * Implement and maintain data governance, security, and access controls using Unity Catalog. * Create real\-time feature pipelines and datasets for ML models. * Manage and organize Databricks resources according to security and governance standards. * Architect and optimize data solutions that grow at scale * Drive performance tuning, reliability, and cost efficiency across Databricks environments. **AI \& ML Enablement** * Build feature pipelines and curated datasets for model training, evaluation, and inference. * Partner with data scientists and AI engineers to support model deployment using MLflow (experiment tracking, model registry) and Databricks Model Serving. * Support Generative AI use cases, including Vector Search, RAG data pipelines, and Mosaic AI capabilities. * Contribute to LLMOps practices: versioning, automated testing, monitoring, and governance for AI data assets. **DevOps \& Operational Excellence** * Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data and AI workloads, using Git for source control, branching, and releases. * Monitor jobs, workflows, and notebooks to resolve operational issues and ensure proper data flow. * Ensure data quality, lineage, and compliance with enterprise security and responsible AI standards. **Collaboration \& Leadership** * Participate in early design reviews to drive robust, optimized enterprise data solutions. * Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions with stakeholders, architects, and product teams. * Mentor junior data engineers and promote engineering best practices. **Minimum Qualifications** ========================== jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Robot Applications & Behavior)
jobs.description: Burro is the leading robotics company in the world by number of robots working outdoors in the field with real customers. Our mission is to free people from tedious work and solve the critical labor shortages faced by farmers and others that work outdoors. To accomplish our mission, we need a world\-class, diverse team where everyone feels comfortable sharing their ideas. With this in mind, we strive to create a work environment where every employee can be themselves and express their perspective – this enables us to deliver the most creative and innovative solutions to problems our customers face. Headquartered in Philadelphia with an office in central California, and backed by top Agtech and autonomy investors, including S2G, Catalyst, Translink, Cibus, FPrime, Toyota Ventures, FFVC, Xplorer, and Radicle, Burro was created to solve the labor shortages facing farmers using robotics. Burros can be described as Disney's Wall\-E for agriculture and work outdoors, in a 1\.0 format. They function, today, as computer vision based autonomous ground vehicles for carrying, towing, and scouting, and are designed to lay the base for the fully autonomous future of work outdoors. We have 700\+ robots in our growing fleet deployed in paid commercial use within vineyards, nurseries, berries, and beyond, and demand for our product is accelerating, so we are growing our team. **The Role** We are hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** for the Robot Applications and Behavior team. This team owns what the robot does once it's working at a customer site. This is a fully hands\-on individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll spend your time designing and writing the code that runs missions, handles faults and recovery, and turns new robot capabilities into features customers use. You'll join a team of engineers who design, ship, and support the robot's behavior stack in the field. You'll drive features end to end with your teammates, from design through field validation, and share design and code review with the rest of the team. The ideal candidate has shipped software on deployed robots or comparable physical systems and is happy to follow a feature wherever it leads in the stack. ### **Responsibilities:** * Build and extend the robot's mission and task logic: state machines, task sequencing, and fault handling and recovery * Take robot features from design to field deployment, such as autonomous docking and scheduled missions * Ensure mission execution holds up in the field: power cycles, dropped connectivity, and missions that only partly complete * Build the robot behavior behind remote operator commands, such as clearing a stop, manual moves, and resolving conflicts between robots * Instrument behaviors with events and telemetry that support alerts, fleet metrics, and field debugging * Triage field\-reported issues: reproduce them from logs and fleet data, fix them, and verify on hardware * Write design docs for your work, take part in design reviews, and review teammates' code * Work with Autonomy, Perception, and SLAM to turn their capabilities into behavior customers can see and use * Work with DevOps and QA on the test and release workflows the team depends on ### **Requirements:** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field * 5\+ years of professional experience building production software, including time on robots, autonomous vehicles, drones, or comparable physical systems * Strong proficiency in C\+\+ and Python * Able to pick up backend services, web front ends, and messaging such as MQTT when a feature calls for it * Shipped software on commercially deployed robots, vehicles, or comparable physical systems, and debugged it under real\-world conditions: partial observability, unreliable state, and failures that only reproduce on hardware * A safety\-first approach to design, with an understanding of how stop states, motion, and localization confidence limit what a robot is allowed to do * Ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Willingness to travel occasionally to Burro's test farm and customer sites to see the robots working in the field ### **Nice\-To\-Haves:** * Shipped behavior, planning, or mission\-level software on commercially deployed robots or vehicles * Experience designing systems and interfaces that other engineers build on top of * Built or maintained a behavior framework, task planner, or mission executive running across a fleet * Simulation for testing robot behavior * Multi\-robot coordination or fleet traffic management * Fleet observability or robot log tooling, such as Foxglove * Proficiency in ROS * Experience with middleware such as Zenoh or DDS * Experience with outdoor or unstructured environments such as agriculture, logistics, or construction * Prior startup experience, especially in robotics ### **Perks:** * Competitive salary and benefits package (medical/dental/vision) * Early\-Stage Equity * 401K Plan * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave **RECRUITERS**: We are **not** accepting agency resumes for this position. Please do not forward or submit resumes through our website or to any of our employees directly. Burro is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Data Engineering \& Feature Development** * Develop and maintain feature stores and data transformation pipelines that supply high\-quality, well\-governed training and inference data * Partner with the Data Engineer on the shared data capability, including the Data Backbone initiative. Governance, Compliance \& Ethics** * Ensure all AI/ML solutions comply with applicable regulations including HIPAA, GDPR, and 21 CFR Part 11 for models used in GxP contexts * Document model design, training methodology, validation results, and known limitations in accordance with CSL quality and regulatory standards * Apply responsible AI principles inc ** * Prior AI or ML work in pharma/biotech, life sciences, healthcare, or a comparably regulated setting with formal model validation practice * Knowledge of responsible AI frameworks, model explainability tools (SHAP, LIME), and bias detection * Familiarity with healthcare data standards (HL7 FHIR) or regulatory validation in GxP environments * Experience with time\-series forecasting, NLP for clinical or operational text, or computer vision * AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty or equivalent certification * Hands\-on experience with the UiPath platform (for example, UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, AI Center, and Document Understanding) to integrate AI/ML and generative AI models into automated business workflows. * Technical training or certification in vendor\-specific technology, such as UiPath (for example, UiPath Certified Professional) **Competencies** * Intellectual Curiosity — continuously explores new AI techniques and evaluates their practical applicability to business challenges * Product Mindset — prioritizes AI solutions that deliver measurable, production\-ready value over academic experimentation * Responsible Innovation — applies ethical AI principles and ensures compliance without sacrificing performance * Cross\-Functional Collaboration — works effectively across data, product, engineering, and regulatory teams * Communicates with Clarity — explains complex model behavior and trade\-offs to diverse technical and non\-technical audiences Evaluation\-Driven Mindset * \- Writes evaluations before deploying. pipelines. * Monitor and improve call\-quality metrics such as MOS, ASR, ACD, and PDD. **Reliability, Security, and Operations** * Operate Linux production systems with confidence * Build security hygiene into feature delivery * Design for high availability and graceful degradation * Participate in a L3 on\-call rotation **Modernization and Technical Strategy** A key part of this role is helping modernize the voice stack: * Assess what is working, what is fragile, what is expensive to operate, and what is slowing the roadmap. * Create a clear plan for refactoring, migration to newer technologies, and practical build\-vs\-buy decisions. * Modernize legacy Python patterns without downtime. **Technical Leadership and Collaboration** * Maintain a high standard for the telephony codebase through code reviews, design discussions, and the quality of the work delivered. * Partner with product, support, and hosted phones teams on capacity planning, customer escalations, and roadmap trade\-offs. * Communicate technical risk, status, and decisions clearly to both engineering and non\-technical stakeholders. **Required Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, phone systems. * **.NET / C\# experience**, particularly where voice services interface with the broader CallRevu platform. **Mindset and Operating Style** * Treats telephony infrastructure with the problem half\-solved. * Strong written and verbal communication; can explain a tricky SIP or queue issue to a non\-telephony engineer or to a support lead without losing them. * Mentors by example jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: **Who we are** At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go\-to\-market acceleration has driven industry\-leading growth. In fact, we're the largest and fastest\-growing automotive marketplace, and we've been profitable for over 15 years. **What we do** The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and \~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people\-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion\-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride! **Role overview** As a member of the Data Science team with a focus on CarGurus's international products, the Senior Data Scientist, International will be responsible for implementing, training and testing machine learning models in support of CarGurus's fastest growing markets in the UK and Canada. Potential areas of support and ownership include Search Ranking, Recommendations, and Instant Market Value algorithms. **What you'll do** * Partner with product and engineering teams in CarGurus UK and Canada to understand their product requirements and data assets * Implement, train, and evaluate machine learning models using Python and AWS SageMaker. * Develop and maintain data pipelines to supply training and inference data for models, using SQL and Snowflake. * Collaborate with engineers to deploy models to production * Evaluate performance of production\-deployed models * Design A/B tests of the Data Science team's models and analyze their results * Communicate solutions to stakeholders through written documentation, demos and presentations, and data visualizations * Collaborate with other data scientists, machine learning engineers, and business stakeholders to scope, design, and implement machine learning projects **What you'll bring** * Curiosity about widely varied datasets and their possibilities for unlocking customer value. Self\-motivated to perform exploratory analyses and build proof\-of\-concept solutions. * Proven experience turning data into successful products * Knowledge of standard Machine Learning techniques for supervised and unsupervised learning across structured and unstructured datasets. Comprehensive knowledge of, and real\-world experience with, measurement, evaluation, and testing of models. * Experience deploying and/or maintaining machine learning services in production * Proficiency in Python or similar languages widely used in the data science community * Proficiency in SQL * Ability to communicate technical details and analytical findings to both technical and non\-technical audiences * Advanced degree (or proven experience) in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or any quantitative science which makes use of advanced data analytics or statistical or machine learning techniques **Working at CarGurus** We reward our Gurus' curiosity and passion with best\-in\-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work\-life balance and individual well\-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives. CarGurus may require in\-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in\-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate. **We welcome all** CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That's why we hope you'll apply even if you don't check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus. \#LI\-Hybrid
