This role is best suited for engineers who enjoy debugging complex codebases, investigating test failures, reviewing code quality, and evaluating the performance of AI\-powered coding agents. **Strong proficiency in Python, debugging, unit testing, and containerized environments is required.** This is a project\-based engagement with the potential for ongoing work following an initial calibration pilot. **Key Responsibilities:** * Audit and evaluate multi\-step AI coding agent workflows and software engineering tasks. * Review and analyze unfamiliar codebases, Git repositories, unit tests, and Docker environments. * Investigate test failures and determine whether they are caused by flawed benchmarks or actual coding errors. * Debug test assertions, execution environments, container configurations, and runtime issues. * Evaluate the quality, correctness, and performance of AI\-generated coding solutions. * Collaborate with research scientists through daily calibration sessions. **Required Skills and Qualifications:** * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in Software Engineering, Research Engineering, SDET, or QA Automation. * Strong proficiency in Python and experience with at least one additional programming language, such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, C\+\+, or Rust. * Practical experience with Git and version control workflows. * Experience with unit testing frameworks such as pytest, unittest, Jest, or Mocha. * Hands\-on experience with Docker and containerized environments. * Strong debugging, analytical, and code\-review skills. * Ability to understand and evaluate unfamiliar codebases and investigate complex technical issues. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with SWE\-bench or other software engineering and coding benchmarks. * Experience working with or evaluating AI\-powered coding agents. * Familiarity with Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation.

jobs.title: Lead Field Engineer - Automated Logic
jobs.description: **About Carrier** Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting\-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world\-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier. **About ALC** At Automated Logic, we've been developing and supporting intelligent building solutions that have helped customers, including small businesses to Fortune 500 corporations, operate their buildings more efficiently for over 40 years. Our solutions help reduce energy consumption, lower utility, operating and maintenance costs, and improve indoor air quality, occupant comfort, and productivity. Technology that supports the buildings and industry of today and tomorrow requires a wide range of talents and skill sets. **About This Role** At Automated Logic, a Carrier Company, we provide a work home for seasoned experts. As a Lead Field Engineer, you are the primary technical owner for turn\-key project delivery. If you are a proactive leader who thrives on end\-to\-end accountability and solving high\-stakes automation challenges, you’ll fit right in. Our technicians say: “I finally found it. Not just a job. Not just a paycheck. A work home.” If that sounds like you, welcome home. **Key Responsibilities** * **Turn\-Key Delivery:** Own the install, commissioning, and troubleshooting of DDC systems. Deliver full software solutions, including sequencing, graphics, and alarms. * **Technical Leadership:** Act as the lead resource and mentor for junior techs. Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, ensuring predictable, high\-quality outcomes. * **Risk \& Coordination:** Partner with Project Managers to manage risk and align execution. Coordinate with teams to ensure clear communication and reliable delivery. * **Travel \& Flexibility:** Travel as needed and stay adaptable to shifting priorities, project demands, and field workloads. * **Proficiency \& Growth:** Demonstrate deep proficiency with ALC products, system architectures, and ASHRAE guidelines. Apply this expertise to deliver safe, high\-performance systems across complex customer environments. * **Project Integrity:** Maintain expert\-level documentation, including commissioning logs and progress tracking, to ensure safe and compliant system delivery. **Required Qualifications** * High School Diploma or GED. * 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in the Building Automation or HVAC Controls industry. * Must possess a valid, current Driver’s License and be insurable by the company’s insurance carrier. * Ability to lift items up to 50 lbs and perform physical tasks such as squatting and climbing for extended periods. * Capable of working over 8 feet above grade and proficient in the use of ladders and motorized lift equipment. **Preferred Qualifications** * **Leadership \& Mentorship:** Proven ability to act as a technical authority and mentor junior engineers in a collaborative field environment. * **Complex Project Delivery:** Executes turnkey building automation solutions with minimal oversight, focusing on high\-quality field execution and resource management. * **Advanced Integration \& Networking:** High skills\-level proficiency in integrating diverse platforms and managing complex TCP/IP and wireless networking. * **System Troubleshooting:** Advanced diagnostic skills for resolving high\-level technical challenges in controls, sensors, and software, at the equipment and system level. * **Training \& Communication:** Dedicated to delivering site\-specific technical training to building owners and operators while maintaining clear documentation. **Pay Range** The annual salary for this position is between $64,500\.00 \- $129,500\.00 annually. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed.**Other Compensation** This position may be entitled to short\-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.**Benefits** Employees are eligible for benefits, including: * **Health Care Benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives * **Retirement Benefits** * **Time off and Leave**: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation * **Disability**: Short\-term and long\-term disability * **Life Insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment** * **Tax\-Advantaged Accounts:** Health Savings Account; Health Care Spending Account; Dependent Care Spending Account * **Tuition Assistance** **To learn more about our benefits offering, please click here** **Work with us \| Carrier Corporate****.** The specific benefits available to any employee may vary depending on state and local laws and eligibility factors, such as date of hire and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements. **Carrier EEO Statement and Accommodations Process** Carrier is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, participate in an interview, or otherwise engage in the hiring process, please contact us at Carrier.Recruiting@carrier.com. We will make every effort to meet your needs in accordance with applicable laws. **Application Deadline** Applications will be accepted for at least 3 days from Job Posting Date: 24 November 2026**Job Applicant's Privacy Notice** Please click on the link to review the Job Applicant Privacy Notice. **Use of AI** Technology\-enabled tools may support parts of the recruitment process, with oversight by people.

jobs.title: Data & AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Catholic Charities Fort Worth is seeking a **Data \& AI Solutions Engineer** to build secure data and AI solutions that expand organizational learning capacity. This role is responsible for designing, building, testing, deploying, and supporting practical solutions that improve decision\-making, service delivery, and organizational effectiveness. You will connect data, systems, and organizational knowledge to develop trusted AI capabilities, including intelligent agents and multi\-agent solutions that combine governed data with approved document context. Success in this role requires strong technical judgment. You'll determine what works, why it works, and whether it should be deployed. **This role may be a fit if you:** * Prefer evidence over assumptions * Are highly analytical and detail\-oriented, with a commitment to accuracy * Enjoy evaluating technology, not just implementing it * Like solving complex problems with incomplete information * Can translate organizational challenges into scalable, secure systems * Are comfortable being the expert others rely upon The ideal candidate brings a bachelor's degree in a related field and at least three years of relevant experience. Experience in nonprofit, human services, education, healthcare, or other mission\-driven environments is preferred. **Top Accountabilities** * Develop Data and AI Capabilities * Connect Data, Systems \& Organizational Knowledge * Deliver Trusted \& Responsible Solutions * Support Adoption, Learning \& Continuous Improvement **What Will You Be Doing?** **Develop Data and AI Capabilities** * + Design, build, test, deploy, and support practical data and AI solutions that improve service delivery, decision\-making, and organizational capacity. + Develop retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) applications that combine governed organizational data and documents with large language models to produce grounded, cited responses subject to appropriate human review. + Translate program and operational needs into clear technical requirements, prototypes, production solutions, and reusable components in collaboration with program, evaluation, data, and technology stakeholders. + Develop data agents and multi\-agent solutions that combine governed structured data with approved document context and clearly distinguish source evidence from generated interpretation. + Evaluate models, retrieval approaches, agents, and solution designs for accuracy, groundedness, cost, latency, security, maintainability, and mission value; document tradeoffs and recommendations. **Connect Data, Systems \& Organizational Knowledge** * + Build and maintain solutions on the organization’s cloud data platform (currently Microsoft Fabric), including warehouse and Lakehouse components, data pipelines, medallion data flows, identity\-resolution routines, and secure integrations with enterprise systems and APIs. + Implement governed ingestion of approved organizational documents using metadata, document\-processing, and search services while preserving source, version, effective\-date, ownership, and access\-control information. + Develop context\-registry data and metadata that link documents to programs, measures, versions, and effective dates so analytics and AI use the applicable organizational context. + Support certified semantic models and implement approved glossary terms, measures, descriptions, synonyms, lineage, stewardship metadata, sensitivity labels, data\-quality controls, and data loss prevention requirements established through the organization’s data governance program and tools. + Build hybrid, vector, and semantic retrieval capabilities with security trimming, de\-identified or minimum\-necessary AI\-facing data, and row\-level security that provide the governed retrieval foundation for RAG applications and other AI solutions. **Deliver Trusted \& Responsible Solutions** * + Configure answer provenance so AI outputs identify the measures, data sources, and cited document passages, versions, and dates used to generate each response. + Create and maintain an evaluation gold set of validated questions and use repeatable correctness and groundedness testing after material changes to data, definitions, indexes, models, or prompts. + Implement human\-review controls and reviewer routing for low\-confidence or flagged outputs; ensure AI\-generated content does not become an approved definition, finding, or program decision without appropriate review. + Apply version control, deployment pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, logging, error handling, and audit records so solutions are reliable, supportable, and traceable. **Support Adoption, Learning \& Continuous Improvement** * + Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, data flows, support procedures, configuration records, and end\-user guidance; provide demonstrations and hands\-on support for responsible adoption. + Use preview and emerging capabilities in bounded pilots, maintain production sys Python and SQL * Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and working with structured and unstructured data * Experience with cloud data platforms, data pipelines, dimensional and/or medallion architectures, data quality, and identity resolution * Experience with generative AI and retrieval patterns, including embeddings, hybrid or vector search, RAG, agents, evaluation, citations or provenance, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls * Working knowledge of Power BI semantic models and data\-governance practices such as business glossaries, stewardship metadata, lineage, sensitivity labeling, DLP, access controls, row\-level security, and minimum\-necessary data * Experience with Git\-based version control, deployment pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, logging, documentation, and change management * Demonstrated ability to turn unclear organizational needs into practical, secure, maintainable solutions, access emerging capabilities, and explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills Strongly Preferred: * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric (including Warehouse, Lakehouse, and Data Factory) or comparable cloud data platforms * Experience with Microsoft Azure AI services (including Azure AI Search, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Microsoft Foundry, and Fabric data agents) or comparable AI services * Experience in nonprofit, human services, education, healthcare, or another mission\-driven environment **Here's the Good Stuff...** * **Full\-time position with a starting salary of $100,000**. Final offer is determined by relevant experience, work history, education and internal equities. * Medical/ Dental/ Vision/ Short Term Disability/ Accident Insurance/ Hospital Indemnity Insurance/ Critical Illness/ ID Shield * Health Savings Account \- CCFW contributes **$100 per month**. * **100% Company paid** Long Term Disability * **100% Company paid** Basic Life and AD\&D Insurance * **16 paid Holidays** (including being closed Christmas Eve through New Years Day) * Tiered PTO Accrual by tenure: + Vacation Time \- **100 hours in your first year**. + Sick Time \- **48 hours in your first year**. * 403(b) with employer match from day one \- **up to 6%** * **3 weeks paid parental/critical illness leave** * Employee Assistance Program * CCFW Participates in the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program (**PSLF**) * Mentorship Program * Wellness Program * Financial Coaching **I'm In! Next Steps** We want to know more about you! To proceed through our process, we need your... * **Completed Application** * **Resume** * **Culture Index Survey** Apply on our website: https://catholiccharitiesfortworth.org/joinourteam/ Be sure to complete all fields so we know who to contact. **Working at Catholic Charities Fort Worth** You'll join a mission\-driven team and agency dedicated to supporting our clients. We have been entrusted with a 116\-year legacy of doing good and we have set forth a bold goal of ending poverty in our community. Our services are uniquely positioned to address a myriad of key factors that keep families from reaching their bigger, brighter future. jobs.title: Engineer, Structural
jobs.description: Job Summary: CECO Environmental is a global leader in providing sustainable solutions for industrial air, water, and energy transition. Since 1966, we’ve been addressing the world’s most pressing environmental challenges. Our mission is to protect people, the environment, and industrial equipment, making a tangible impact across industries like renewable energy, semiconductor manufacturing, power generation, and water treatment. As a purpose\-driven company, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and integrity, ensuring that every project we undertake creates lasting positive change. At CECO, you’ll be part of a growing, dynamic team committed to a cleaner, safer, and more sustainable future. We are proud to share that CECO was named one of Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Companies for 2025 and that Forbes recognized CECO as one of America’s Most Successful Small Cap Companies for 2026, marking our third consecutive year on the Forbes list. CECO Environmental is a publicly traded company on the Texas Stock Exchange under the ticker CECO, reflecting our strong growth, financial performance, and commitment to delivering value to shareholders. As part of the CECO Environmental family of brands, **Peerless Emissions Control** plays a critical role in delivering specialized air solutions that protect both people and the environment. By joining our team, you’ll contribute to our shared mission of protecting global industrial operations and shaping the future of environmental stewardship. The **Structural Engineer** designs safe, efficient main and secondary structural systems for industrial exhaust ducting. This role supports power generation projects utilizing large\-scale combustion turbines. You will perform calculations, create Structural Analysis 3D models, and collaborate with fabrication teams. Preference will be given to candidates who can work onsite in Addison, TX; however, remote candidates may be considered for the right individual. **Your Responsibilities Will Be:** * Structural Analysis: Perform member sizing conforming to LRFD and/or ASD methods per AISC 360 bending, deflection, and stability checks using static loading and environmental or operating loading such as: wind, seismic, and thermal calculations for exhaust ducting systems \[1]. * Design \& Modeling: Develop 3D structural models of ducting, internal liners, and support steel. * Code Compliance: Ensure designs meet AISC 360, ASCE 7, AWS D1\.1, and applicable international building codes. * Fabrication Support: Review fabrication drawings, answer shop inquiries, and resolve material issues. * Collaboration: Coordinate with pipe stress/mechanical engineers, project engineers/managers, and drafting personnel. * Documentation: Prepare clear, organized structural calculation packages for client review. **Required Qualifications:** * 7\+ years related experience * Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Mechanical or Structural Engineering. * Proficiency in STAAD.Pro, or RISA\-3D, and AutoCAD. * Basic understanding of high\-temperature materials and thermal expansion. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with Autodesk® Inventor or similar 3D mechanical design software. * Certification: Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) status preferred. * Basic understanding of thermal expansion concepts in large lined and insulated ducting or plate structures. * Experience FEM work analysis and mesh modeling. * Knowledge of common industrial welding practices and fabrication constraints. * Ability to interpret process drawings; P\&IDs and coordinate ducting layouts with process requirements **Travel Requirements:** * Travel is expected to be no more than **5%** of working time. **ADA Requirements:** Work Environment; Office Position: This position is based remotely. jobs.title: AI Engineer IV
jobs.description: **Who we are…** Cell Signaling Technology (CST) is a different kind of life sciences company, one founded, owned, and run by active research scientists, with the highest standards of product and service quality, technological innovation, and scientific rigor for over 20 years. We consistently provide fellow scientists around the globe with best\-in\-class products and services to fuel their quests for discovery. Helping researchers find new solutions is our main mission every day, but it's not our only mission. We're also dedicated to helping identify solutions to other problems facing our world. We believe that all businesses must be responsible and work in partnership with local communities, while seeking to minimize their environmental impact. That's why we joined 1% for the Planet as its first life science member, and have committed to achieving net\-zero emissions by 2029\. **The role...** The AI Engineer designs, builds, measures and runs the AI agents CST employees use every day. You will build custom agents, configure agent frameworks, and connect assistants such as Claude to CST data and tools through MCP servers and skills. Above all, this role is about building agents that give correct answers. At CST, a confident wrong answer about a product, a target or a customer is worse than no answer. Your agents must ground every answer in the data and context they have, and recognize when a question goes beyond what that context supports. When it does, they say so clearly, show what they do and don't know, and point users to the right source or person. You are also CST's guide to a field that changes every month. You decide, with stakeholders, which new capabilities to adopt now and which to hold back. The goal is to keep CST current without losing the stability teams need to get work done. You are the public face of AI at CST: you train users, gather their feedback and turn it into better agents. **What you will do...** Build and run agents * Design, deploy and operate AI agents that answer questions and do work across CST's scientific, commercial and operational domains. * Turn business problems into well\-scoped agent use cases, and prioritize them by value, feasibility and risk. * Build bespoke agents in code where off\-the\-shelf tools fall short, using agent SDKs, tool calling and retrieval. * Configure and manage agent frameworks on our platform, such as Snowflake Cortex Agents, Cortex Analyst and Cortex Search. * Enable assistants such as Claude across CST by building and maintaining MCP servers, connectors and skills. * Design the tool layer agents use: tool schemas, permission scopes, access controls, audit trails and error handling. * Build the retrieval layer for unstructured content such as data sheets, protocols and publications: embeddings, chunking, vector search and retrieval quality. * Design multi\-agent workflows where specialized agents hand off tasks and share context. * Own agents in production: monitoring, incident response, cost and safe handling of confidential data. Measure and improve * Define what "good" means for each agent: accuracy, groundedness, task completion, latency, cost and user satisfaction. * Measure how well agents know their limits: how often they answer correctly, decline correctly, or answer when they should have declined. * Build evaluation sets and automated regression tests, and run them before and after every change. * Instrument agents with logging, tracing and evaluation hooks so they can be trusted, debugged and improved in production. * Tune agents through prompts, instructions, tools, retrieval and model choice, based on evidence rather than anecdote. Shape the semantic foundation * Advise data engineers and intelligence and insight engineers on ontologies, semantic models and metric definitions that let agents reason correctly about CST data. * Help define how core business concepts (products, targets, applications, customers, orders) are named, related and governed, so agents and people get the same answer. Set the pace of adoption * Track progress in models, agent frameworks and tools, and test what matters for CST. * Recommend what to adopt, pilot or wait on, balancing the cost of falling behind against the need for stable tools. * Keep a clear roadmap and change process so users know what is changing and when. Be the face of AI at CST * Train users through workshops, office hours, demos and self\-serve guides. * Manage stakeholders across business, science and IT: gather needs, set expectations, report results and secure support. * Keep documentation current: agent catalog, how\-to guides, evaluation results, architecture and runbooks. Work as part of the data team * Collaborate daily with data engineers and intelligence and insight engineers on shared data products, pipelines and semantic layers. * Share standards and reusable components so the whole team can build with AI. **Who you are and what you bring to the team...** * 4\+ years in software ti\-step workflows and failure handling. * A track record of evaluating LLM systems with test sets and metrics, including hallucination and groundedness, and improving them based on results. * Working knowledge of data modeling, semantic layers or ontologies, and why they matter for AI accuracy. * Clear communication with non\-technical audiences; experience training users or presenting to leaders. * Sound judgment on data security, privacy and responsible AI. **Ideally, you have...** * Experience with Snowflake. * Experience building MCP servers or Claude skills, or with frameworks such as the Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, CrewAI or similar. * Experience with multi\-agent designs: orchestrator and subagent patterns, agent handoffs or agent\-to\-agent protocols. * Experience with vector databases and retrieval evaluation. * Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tools, or custom evaluation pipelines. * Familiarity with knowledge graphs or ontology standards (LinkML, RDF, OWL, SKOS). * Background in life sciences, biotech or manufacturing, or comfort learning scientific vocabulary such as targets, pathways and applications. * Experience as an internal product owner or change agent rolling out new tools. * Degree in computer science, data science, a life science or equivalent experience. This position has a starting base salary range of $140,000 \- $202,000 per year, which the company, in good faith, reasonably expects to pay for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, qualifications, experience, and internal equity. **What we offer...** At Cell Signaling Technology (CST), we recognize that people will always be our most important asset. Providing a safe, inclusive, and stimulating working environment that understands the importance of diversity, human dignity, and meaningful work is as important as establishing company policies that incorporate excellent health insurance and pay benefits. We recognize that the development of people is the key to their happiness and thus ensure every employee has impactful discussions with their manager and develops actionable performance and professional development plans. Lastly, we are committed to engaging and supporting our employees in committees and philanthropy that benefit their local communities and environment through community investment programs. **Benefits** * Medical (BCBS) and Dental (Delta Dental) plans paid at 90% * Vision Insurance * Life Insurance, Short and Long Term Disability * Flexible Spending accounts * 401(k) Plan with 6% match * Tuition Reimbursement * Generous PTO package * Parental Leave * Pet Insurance * Employee Assistance Program * Onsite Subsidized Cafeteria * Free Parking Cell Signaling Technology (CST) is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, status as a veteran or as a member of the military or status in any group protected by applicable federal or state laws. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. **AGENCIES** All resumes submitted by search firms/employment agencies to any employee at Cell Signaling Technology (CST) via email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method will be deemed the sole property of CST unless CST engaged such search firms/employment agencies for this position and a valid agreement with CST is in place. In the event a candidate who was submitted outside of the CST agency engagement process is hired, no fee or payment of any kind will be paid. If you are a California resident, more details on how we process your personal information can be found here.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview:** Cellebrite’s (Nasdaq: CLBT) mission is to enable its global customers to protect and save lives by enhancing digital investigations and intelligence gathering to accelerate justice in communities around the world. Cellebrite’s AI\-powered Digital Investigation Platform enables customers to lawfully access, collect, analyze and share digital evidence in legally sanctioned investigations while preserving data privacy. Thousands of public safety organizations, intelligence agencies and businesses rely on Cellebrite’s digital forensic and investigative solutions—available via cloud, on\-premises and hybrid deployments—to close cases faster and safeguard communities. To learn more, visit us at www.cellebrite.com, https://investors.cellebrite.com/investors and find us on social media @Cellebrite. **Position Overview:** As a Solutions Engineer, you aim to lend your technical proficiency to the sales account team throughout the sales journey. This contribution is vital for amplifying growth and securing the successful introduction of Cellebrite’s comprehensive digital intelligence solutions to law enforcement agencies across the Mountain Region through the Northeastern U.S. territory. This role demands extensive travel (50\-75% of the time) and will directly report to the regional manager of Solutions Engineering for State and Local Government East. To ensure success, seamless cooperation with the R\&D, Product Business Management, Customer Success Management, Technical Customer Support, and Marketing teams is essential. **Responsibilities:** * Foster relationships with potential and existing clients to actively determine current and prospective customer technology needs and gain a deep understanding of their product requirements. * Collaborate effectively with Account Executives to create and uphold account strategy plans, spotlighting newfound opportunities for expansion. * Establish yourself as a dependable technical consultant for Cellebrite's clients by: * Equip customers with a thorough understanding of Cellebrite's solutions portfolio and industry trends to propel their objectives. * Showcasing the technical benefits, cost\-effectiveness, and operational enhancements of our solutions. * Collect feedback and effectively relay it to the corresponding internal teams. * Attend educational workshops, review professional literature, build personal networks, and engage in professional groups to stay updated professionally and technically. * Document customer interactions and escalate issues as required. * Organize and host discovery workshops with key strategic clients to identify workflow inefficiencies and amplify the value of our existing solutions. Deliver a tailored strategy to aid decision\-making within these organizations. * Represent the company at industry trade shows and conferences to promote the value of Cellebrite's newest solutions and technologies. * Foster a collaborative environment by working in unison with your Solutions Engineering peers. * Maintain competitive awareness and provide competitive differentiation during sales engagements. Requirements: * Holds a bachelor’s degree or possesses equivalent practical experience. * Prior experience collaborating with or working in Law Enforcement, Federal, or Military organizations is advantageous. * Familiar with mobile/computer forensics tools, methodologies, and best practices. * Be able to discuss, display, or relate to LEO Investigator skills such as: * Understanding forensic techniques and how to apply them to gather evidence in an investigation. * Noticing subtle details that might be crucial to solving a case. * Ability to analyze complex information, identify patterns, and solve problems logically. * Broad background in Information Technology \- Familiarity with Windows/Linux environments, networking, SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, and storage systems or Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, or Public Safety leadership are a plus. * Exceptional skills in public speaking and presentation * Robust abilities in business analysis * Proven leadership capabilities across various functions Office Location: Remote

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI analytics platform (Chord)
jobs.description: **About Chord** Most AI analytics breaks the moment it meets a real business. Fetching the numbers is the easy part. The hard part is knowing which definition of revenue the finance team trusts, and why last quarter’s spike shouldn’t count. Chord gives AI that context, so teams can ask questions in plain language and get answers they can act on. Chord recently acquired Zenlytic, combining Chord’s data foundation (from collection through modeling) with Zenlytic’s analytics agent. We started in commerce and now work with enterprise teams well beyond it. Our next big bet is context that improves itself: a system that learns from every correction and decision, so the agent gets more accurate the more a company uses it. We’re a small engineering team that puts AI at the center of how we build, and every engineer owns meaningful parts of the product end to end. Chord is backed by top investors and led by experienced operators. Our company is proudly remote\-first, distributed across North America. For this role, we prefer candidates based in New York City, and we’ll also consider candidates in Montreal, Canada. US residency is not required. **The Opportunity** * We’re looking for a Software Engineer to help Chord build the context layer for agentic commerce — the platform that enables AI agents to understand, reason, and safely operate real commerce businesses. * You’ll help build Chord’s AI analytics platform, including the agent harness and data layer it runs on, shipping real work from week one. You’ll do it mostly by directing coding agents well, then owning the result. A large part of the role is supporting our largest enterprise customer, which runs Chord in a private cloud, and becoming their main technical point of contact. Our stack includes a Python backend (Flask/FastAPI, Celery, SQLAlchemy on Postgres) and a React/TypeScript frontend built with Vite, running on Docker and Kubernetes. As our next Software Engineer, you will be a key member of the engineering team and will report directly to our VP of Engineering. **As our next Chordian, you will:** * Build on our AI analytics platform, including the agent harness, the semantic layer, and the data tooling behind it. * Work product tickets end to end: triage, spec, design, implement with agents, review, and ship, making sound design calls with limited direction. * Support our largest enterprise customer’s private\-cloud deployment on a two\-week release cycle, including UAT fixes, deploy\-day support, and bug turnaround, and become their main technical point of contact within your first few months. * Shape our coding\-agent workflow, where agents pick up tickets from Slack and Linear, by finding where it breaks and owning the fixes. * Review pull requests from teammates and agents, and help raise the bar on how we use coding agents. * Document your work, including runbooks, ticket specs, and release notes. To be successful in this role, you’ll need: * About 3 to 6 years of experience shipping production software, including debugging in production. * Experience building or debugging LLM\-backed features in production, such as agent loops, tool calling, and tracking down non\-deterministic failures. * Something real you’ve shipped with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) that you can show us. * Experience with Python or TypeScript/React, and a willingness to work in both. * The ability to read code you didn’t write, including agent output, and spot what’s wrong, including design and maintainability problems, not just bugs. * Clear written communication, including with customers, and comfort being the person a customer turns to when something breaks. * Experience with enterprise software releases, UAT cycles, or private\-cloud deployments is a plus. * Comfort reading SQL is a plus. Most of ours is generated from a YAML semantic layer (similar to LookML), so writing it by hand matters less. * Experience building or using MCP servers or clients, including auth and tool design, is a plus. * Experience owning containerized releases on Kubernetes, including image builds, versioning, rollback, and fixing vulnerabilities a scan flags, is a plus. * Customer\-facing or support experience is a plus. Working at Chord, you can expect: * An investment in your physical and mental well\-being; we offer 100% employee Medical Benefits coverage, with 69% dependent coverage. * Flexible PTO; we encourage you to take the time you need to be your best self at work. * An onboarding package and annual work from home stipend to ensure you have everything you need to be successful while working remote. * Generous Parental Leave with customizable transition back to work program. * The benefits of working from home, with opportunities to spend quality time with the team at Chord in\-person events throughout the year. * To make an impact! We’re an early\-stage company, which means there is space to champion ideas, and create and lead initiatives at any level in the Organization. This is a full\-time, salaried position that includes Equity. * **About your application and the interview process** ---------------------------------------------------- Chord is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you’re unsure about your qualifications for this position, we still encourage you to apply. Our interview process for the role begins with an exploratory conversation with a member of the hiring team. After that, we’ll invite you to Zoom sessions with a range of stakeholders from across our organization. We aim to get to know you and allow you to learn more about our team and product while being respectful of your time. **The pay range for this role is:** 150 \- 200 USD per year(New York, NY) 150 \- 200 CAD per year(Remote (Montreal, QC, CA))

jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer
jobs.description: **As our Sr. Data Engineer, you’ll help drive Concora Credit’s Mission to enable customers to Do More with Credit – every single day.** **The impact you’ll have at Concora Credit:** We’re looking for a Sr. Data Engineer to build and run the data integrations that connect Concora Credit with our partners, processors, and credit bureaus. You’ll bring source data from systems like our card processor into our Azure Databricks lakehouse. You’ll also build the outbound files our retail partners and credit bureaus depend on. Working closely with business stakeholders, you’ll turn integration requirements into reliable, well\-monitored pipelines that deliver accurate data on time, every time. This position is located at our Beaverton, OR office and has a hybrid schedule. We’re onsite Monday through Thursday. We hire people, not positions. That's because, at Concora Credit, we put people first, including our customers, partners, and Team Members. Concora Credit is guided by a single purpose: to help non\-prime customers *do more* with credit. Today, we have helped millions of customers access credit. Our industry leadership, resilience, and willingness to adapt ensure we can help our partners responsibly say yes to millions more. As a company grounded in entrepreneurship, we're looking to expand our team and are looking for people who foster innovation, strive to make an impact, and want to Do More! We’re an established company with over 20 years of experience, but now we’re taking things to the next level. We're seeking someone who wants to impact the business and play a pivotal role in leading the charge for change. **As our Sr. Data Engineer, you will:** * Design, build, and maintain inbound pipelines that ingest data from internal and third\-party sources (e.g., our card processor) into the data lake using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Delta Lake * Build and deliver outbound data feeds and files to partners and credit bureaus, meeting each recipient’s format, schedule, and validation requirements * Partner with business stakeholders to gather and clarify integration requirements, then translate them into technical designs and delivery plans * Put data quality checks, reconciliation, and alerting in place so issues are caught before data reaches the lake or leaves the company * Manage file transfers (SFTP, APIs, and similar) securely, in line with data security and compliance requirements for sensitive financial data * Build reporting tables when needed to support business and operational reporting * Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve integration failures, and keep runbooks and documentation for each feed up to date * Implement CI/CD for data workflows using Azure DevOps and Git * Mentor junior engineers and contribute to integration standards and best practices **These duties must be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.** We know experience comes in many forms and that many skills are transferable. If your experience is close to what we're looking for, consider applying. Diversity has made us the entrepreneurial and innovative company that we are today. **Requirements:*** 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, with a focus on data integration and ETL/ELT * Hands\-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Azure Databricks, and Delta Lake * Strong SQL and Python/PySpark skills * Proven experience building and supporting both inbound and outbound integrations with external partners or vendors * Experience producing and validating structured files (fixed\-width, delimited, XML/JSON) to partner specifications * Experience with secure file transfer (SFTP), APIs, and job scheduling and orchestration * Ability to gather requirements directly from business stakeholders and turn them into working solutions * Strong habits around data validation, reconciliation, and operational monitoring * Experience with version control and CI/CD pipelines * Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail * Strong communication skills with both technical and non\-technical partners * Ability to work independently and manage several integrations at once in a fast\-paced environment **Preferred Qualifications:*** Experience in financial services, credit cards, or lending * Experience with card processor data (e.g., Fiserv/First Data, TSYS) * Familiarity with credit bureau reporting (e.g., Metro 2 format) for Experian, Equifax, or TransUnion * Experience working with sensitive data under PCI or similar compliance requirements * Experience with Unity Catalog and Databricks Workflows * Familiarity with encryption for file exchange (e.g., PGP) **What’s In It For You:*** Medical, Dental and Vision insurance for you and your family * Relax and recharge with Paid Time Off (PTO) * 6 company\-observed paid holidays, plus 3 paid floating holidays * 401k (after 90 days) plus employer match up to 4% * Pet Insurance for your furry family members * Wellness perks including onsite fitness equipment at both locations, EAP, and access to the Headspace App * We invest in your future through Tuition Reimbursement * Save on taxes with Flexible Spending Accounts * Peace of mind with Life and AD\&D Insurance * Protect yourself with company\-paid Long\-Term Disability and voluntary Short\-Term Disability Concora Credit provides equal employment opportunities to all Team Members and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Employment\-based visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Concora Credit is an equal opportunity employer (EEO). Please see the Concora Credit Privacy Policy for more information on how Concora Credit processes your personal information during the recruitment process and, if applicable, based on your location, how you can exercise your privacy rights. jobs.title: Software Engineer L2
jobs.description: **About Curative** Curative is building the future of health insurance with a first\-of\-its\-kind employer\-based plan designed to remove financial barriers and make care truly accessible: one monthly premium with $0 copays and $0 deductibles\*. Backed by our recent $150M in Series B funding and valuation at $1\.275B, Curative is scaling rapidly and investing in AI\-powered service, deeper member engagement, and a smart network designed for today’s workforce. Our north star guides everything we do: healthcare only works when people can actually use it. That belief drives every decision we make: from how we design our plan, support our members, to how we collaborate as a team. If you want to do meaningful work with a team that moves fast, experiments boldly, and cares deeply, Curative is the place to do it. We’re growing fast and looking for teammates who want to help transform health insurance for the better. **Summary** We are hiring forward deployed software engineers to be the single technical owner of a business\- critical internal platform. Each engineer owns one surface end to end: architecture, production, roadmap, and stakeholder relationships. Candidates are matched to a team after the interviews: growth, plan accounting, provider payments, or pharmacy benefits. **How we build** At Curative, AI writes most of the code. Engineers direct it. We use agentic AI coding tools as the primary development surface. A senior engineer here routinely runs multiple agents in parallel: one implementing a feature, one resolving review comments, one chasing down a flaky test. The engineer’s job is to set context, make the decisions the AI can’t make, and keep the bar high on what ships. This is not a role for someone who wants to hand\-roll every line. It is also not a role for someone who will accept whatever the AI produces. We are looking for the engineer in between: strong enough fundamentals to catch a wrong answer in a few seconds, disciplined enough to review every diff, and ambitious enough to drive several times the output of a traditional IC. On a surface where the output has to add up and the system has to stay up, that discipline matters more than usual. Strong systems and architecture thinking is important, as is product taste. This is a fully remote position. **What you’ll own** * The codebase. A full\-stack Python \+ TypeScript application with real domain complexity. Code review, architecture, and quality bar are yours. * Production. Cloud infrastructure, deploy pipeline, observability, on\-call, incident response, and cost. Some surfaces are always\-on; design for resilience. * Sensitive data. Platforms touch PHI and/or financial data. Privacy discipline is built in, not bolted on. * Operational metrics. Beyond uptime: whether numbers reconcile, workflow completion rates, how much manual work the software actually eliminates. Surface what the data shows and close the loop. * Stakeholder relationships. You’re the engineer in the room with ops specialists, accountants, marketers, or network leads. Translate pain into scope, push back when a request won’t solve the real problem, earn trust by shipping. * The roadmap and strategy. Co\-own the plan with product and business stakeholders. Sequence work, flag what’s infeasible, propose what nobody has asked for yet. * Integrations. A growing set of connections to internal services and external partner, provider, or financial systems. * AI agents. Build and extend agents (we already run them on the Claude API) that take manual, repetitive work off people’s plates. * AI leverage tooling. Skills, evals, fixtures, prompts, and integrations that make agents effective on your codebase. * The domain. You won’t arrive an expert, but within 90 days you’ll know the workflows well enough that every prompt carries the right context. **What we’re looking for** **Foundational skills (non\-negotiable)** You need these because you are the last line of defense on what the AI produces. The bar is not “can write it from scratch in an interview.” The bar is “can read a 400\-line AI\-generated diff and spot the subtle bug in 90 seconds.” On these platforms, that bug is often a number that’s quietly wrong. * 5\+ years shipping production software. Enough reps that you recognize bad code before you can articulate why. * Real fluency in Python and TypeScript. Not “I can read it,” but fluent. You will direct work in both every day: Next.js and React on the frontend, FastAPI and SQLAlchemy on the backend. You should be equally unbothered by a typed codebase and by an older JavaScript one. * Strong SQL and relational database fundamentals. You can read a query plan, spot an N\+1, know when a migration is unsafe at scale, and reason carefully about the joins and aggregations that decide what a number ends up being. * Sharp written communication. You will spend more time writing prompts, specs, and PR descriptions than writing code. Note: Prior healthcare, insurance, or domain\-specific experience is not required. We care far more about your track record owning a product surface and the systems behind it, in a role where the business could see the results. Any industry counts. What we do look for is real interest in the problem space your team owns. **AI\-first working style (also non\-negotiable)** * You already use Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or equivalent as your primary development tool, not as a side autocomplete. * You have opinions about how to structure prompts, when to split work into subagents, and how to keep AI output from drifting. * You review every AI\-generated diff. You do not merge on vibes. * You treat the AI as a junior engineer with infinite throughput: high leverage, zero judgment, needs supervision. * You enjoy building tooling that makes AI more effective on your codebase: skills, evals, fixtures, integrations. * You see AI leverage as what makes it possible for one engineer to own a full product surface and stay close to users, not as a reason to stay heads\-down in a terminal. **Strongly preferred** * A portfolio of AI\-assisted work: skills you wrote, agents you built, automations you shipped. * Experience being the single owner of a non\-trivial service in production. * Domain experience in one of our team areas helps: growth or marketing engineering; financial systems such as billing, payments, or reporting; or real\-time, high\-availability services. * Experience with document and file ingestion at scale: parsing messy real\-world spreadsheets, PDFs, and email attachments into structured data. * Experience with sales or CRM systems, especially replacing one. **Why this role** Healthcare is one of the highest\-leverage places software can make a difference, and the platforms that run a health plan are where a lot of that leverage lives: winning employers, getting the money right, and keeping benefits working in real time. We are a company where a single engineer can own one of those platforms end to end. That is a scope most companies split across several teams. Your day might span building an agent that reads an inbound RFP into a structured quote request, debugging why two systems disagree on a number, digging into reliability and usage metrics to understand why throughput dipped, demoing a new workflow to an ops lead, and setting the technical strategy for your platform. If you have been looking for a role where you own the full loop, from problem discovery through production, where the work has a number attached to it that you can watch move, and where AI\-first isn’t a buzzword but the actual way work gets done, this is it. **Perks \& Benefits** * Curative Health Plan: 100% employer\-covered medical premiums for you and 50% coverage for dependents on the base plan. + $0 copays and $0 deductibles with completion of the Baseline Visit + Preventive and primary care built in + Mental health support + One\-on\-one care navigation + Chronic condition programs: diabetes, weight, and hypertension + Maternity and family planning support + 24/7/365 Curative Telehealth + Pharmacy benefits * Comprehensive dental and vision coverage * Employer\-provided life and disability coverage with additional supplemental options * Flexible spending accounts * Generous time off policy plus 11 paid annual company holidays * 401K for full\-time employees * Up to 8–12 weeks paid parental leave, based on role eligibility

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Short Intro and About the Job: **Job Summary** At Danone, Manufacturing the best products and supplying them to meet demand is a key driver for our plant teams. We are currently looking to hire an **Automation Engineer** based in our manufacturing plant in **Fort Worth, Texas.** The Automation Engineer plays a critical role in driving safety, efficiency, and reliability across all automated systems in our yogurt production facility. This position covers the full scope of operations—from processing and fillers to packers, over wrappers, x\-ray inspection, laser and wax coding, labeling, palletizers, stretch wrappers, and automated warehouse systems. The engineer will lead continuous improvement initiatives, design and implement control systems, and ensure compliance with food safety, cybersecurity, and automation standards. This role requires strong technical expertise, collaboration with cross\-functional teams, and the ability to manage projects from concept through commissioning. **Key Responsibilities** As a key member of our team, you will play an important role in driving our mission forward. The following responsibilities outline the core expectations and contributions for this position: * Lead automation projects across packaging and processing areas, prioritizing safety, quality, and production performance. * Design, program, and troubleshoot PLC/HMI systems (Allen\-Bradley ControlLogix, CompactLogix, FactoryTalk View SE/ME). * Maintain and improve robotics, vision systems, and motion control for high\-speed packaging lines. * Update and enforce automation documentation, standards, and cybersecurity compliance. * Perform software and firmware upgrades across diverse OEM platforms. * Develop and deliver training programs for operators and maintenance teams on new and existing systems. * Collaborate with OEMs and vendors for quoting, project execution, and compliance with company standards. * Support SCADA/MES integration for real\-time data, OEE, and traceability. * Define and track KPIs for automation performance and reliability. * Ensure compliance with PMO, OSHA, EPA, FDA, and other regulatory requirements. * Participate in risk assessments and implement safety interlocks per ISO 13849 and ANSI standards. * Provide on\-call support as part of the automation team rotation. * Perform other duties as assigned **Physical Demands** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs, balance; stoop, kneel or crouch; talk and hear. The employee will lift and/or move up to 60 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. **Work Environment** Work is performed in a manufacturing environment with exposure to moderate noise and temperature variations. Occasional work at heights required. Work schedules could include nights, weekends and/or holidays to provide the ability to support a 24/7 manufacturing environment as business needs dictate. PPE required; safety\-first culture. **Engagement in our Integrated Work Systems** Ensure adherence to plant standards and procedures (including but not limited to GMP, AIB, FDA, IWS, Quality, Safety, Finance, ISO, HOPE, Danone Behaviors, Daily Direction Setting, Driving OE). As a fundamental piece of the organization, your responsibility is to participate and own the implementation and deployment of IWS system and its pillars (Leadership foundation, Daily Direction Setting, Driving OE; Autonomous Maintenance; planned Maintenance; Focused Improvement; Education and Training; Environmental, Health and Safety; Quality; Organization; Supply Network; Early Equipment Management) with the objective of owning your space, owning your performance (Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Mobilization, Nature) and owning your continuous improvement. **Compensation \& Benefits:** Danone USA additionally offers a performance\-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. About You: The ideal candidate will bring a combination of education, experience, and skills that enable them to excel in this position. The following qualifications outline what we’re looking for, including both required and preferred criteria: **Education \& Experience:** * High School Diploma or G.E.D. required * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Automation, Industrial or Mechatronics Engineering (preferred) * 5\+ years’ experience in automation and controls within manufacturing required * Experience with high\-speed packaging lines and robotics required * Ability to support a 24/7 manufacturing environment as business needs dictate. Work schedules could include nights, weekends and/or holidays to provide the ability to support needed. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:** **Required** * PLC programming (Allen Bradley ControlLogix, Studio 5000\) * Proficiency with Rockwell Automation software and Ladder Logic * HMI development (FactoryTalk View SE/ME) * Industrial networking (EtherNet/IP, Profinet, OPC UA) * Strong troubleshooting skills (mechanical, electrical, controls) * Strong documentation and change control discipline * Excellent communication and collaboration skills **Preferred** * SCADA/MES platforms (Ignition, FactoryTalk SE) * Vision systems (Cognex, Keyence) for label/code verification * Safety systems design (ISO 13849, OSHA) and risk assessment * Proficiency in Structured Text programming * Robotics integration (Fanuc, Omron, Allen Bradley) and servo tuning * Knowledge of food safety standards (HACCP, AIB, PMO, FDA) **A Plus (Highly desired)** * Knowledge of automated warehouse systems and WMS integration * Familiarity with CIP/SIP automation for processing equipment * Knowledge of traceability systems * Ability to support capital projects About Us, We offer and What's next: Danone USA is an industry\-leading food \& beverage company, with a mission to bring health through food to as many people as possible. Founded in the Bronx in 1942 as Dannon Milk Products, Danone USA now employs 5,000 people across more than 10 U.S. manufacturing facilities. When you join Danone USA, you’ll help make products for well\-known brands including **Activia®**, **DanActive®**, **Danimals®**, **Dannon®**, **evian®**, **Follow Your Heart®**, **Happy Family® Organics**, **International Delight®**, **Light \+ Fit®**, **Nutricia ®**, **Oikos®**, **Silk®**, **So Delicious® Dairy Free**, **STōK®** **Cold Brew Coffee ®**, **Too Good \& Co™**, and **YoCrunch®**. You’ll be part of one of the largest Certified B Corps™ in the world, working to make sure our company creates real value for people and the planet. Danone USA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. It is our policy to give equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to legally protected characteristics, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state/provincial and/or local law. For our EEO policy statement and your EEO rights under law click here. \#LI\-NORAM \#LI\-ONSITE \#LI\-KH1 Employee \& Applicant Privacy Policy

jobs.description: FEQ327R430 **Forward Deployed Program Lead** **About the team** The Office of the Field CCO works with the Chief Marketing and Chief Revenue Officers of Databricks’ largest customers to redesign how their commercial organizations operate. We build a peer community of CMOs and CROs, partner with them on go\-to\-market transformation programs, and ensure those programs deliver measurable business results. The work cuts across sales, marketing, field engineering, and partner teams, and it runs on the customer’s own data. **About the role** You will help to shape and lead Databricks’ strategy for driving AI transformations with our customers. You will report directly to the Field CCO. This is a role with broad scope that will require you to collaborate across the business: you will set how we deliver transformation engagements, select and run our first 10 pilot accounts, and shape the reusable solutions field engineering builds. You will get work done through account teams, field engineering, field marketing, and enablement. **What you’ll do** **Shape the reusable solutions** * Decide, with field engineering, which pilot solutions become reusable skills and agents (for example, an account research agent or a pipeline risk review) so the next 10 accounts can deploy in weeks rather than months. * Own how the pieces fit together into a coherent offering for a CMO or CRO: which components combine for which workflow, and what the customer needs in place to use them. * Pressure\-test field engineering’s designs against real customer workflows and set the acceptance criteria an asset must meet before it goes to the field. * Collaborate with our AI FDE team, product team, and FE regional leadership on the solutionization of workflows/companions. **Set the delivery model** * Define how a GTM transformation engagement runs from first executive conversation to production: stages, roles across account, field engineering, and professional services teams, entry and exit criteria, and governance. * Set the standard for account plans on transformation opportunities and review each plan with the account team before it goes to the customer. A strong plan names the executive sponsor, the two or three workflows in scope (for example, pipeline forecasting or campaign attribution), the data required, and the business result being targeted. **Select and run the pilot program** * Define the selection criteria for the first 10 pilot accounts (executive sponsorship, data readiness, commercial potential, willingness to go public) and finalize the list with sales leadership. * Program\-manage the pilots. Set the operating cadence: weekly working sessions with account teams, monthly customer steering committees, and a quarterly review with the Field CCO. * Define and track the metrics for each pilot. Measure business outcomes such as forecast accuracy, sales cycle length, or cost per qualified lead, alongside workflow adoption and consumption. * Identify stalled pilots early and escalate with a specific recovery plan. **Build the CMO and CRO community** * Partner with field marketing to launch and run CMO and CRO councils across North America and EMEA: membership criteria, agenda, and a format that gives members a reason to return. * Partner with the Office of the CMO on thought leadership for flagship events such as Data \+ AI Summit and executive dinners, including keynote narratives, customer case studies drawn from the pilots, and point\-of\-view papers on how commercial organizations are changing. **Enable the field** * Partner with ops and the enablement team to build the mechanisms that teach field engineers and sellers how the solutions work, when to position them, and how to deploy them: playbooks, demo environments, certification paths, and deal reviews. highly technical products, product operations, GTM strategy, business operations, technical program management, or deploying technical/AI solutions with customers. * **Cross\-Organizational Execution:** 4\+ years collaborating on cross\-functional programs that drive committed outcomes across Product, Field Engineering, and Marketing, including at the executive level. * **Communication:** Ability to communicate technical concepts to both non\-technical and technically proficient audiences, including tailoring messages for potential customers and executives. * **AI \& Automation:** Demonstrated and creative use of AI\-driven tooling and automated workflows. * **Sales/Marketing Expertise:** Experience building or working with MarTech/SalesTech, including an understanding of marketing workflows, MMM, MROI, and GTM ontologies. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * **Hands\-On AI Agent Deployment:** Direct experience scoping, deploying, or evaluating AI agents or predictive analytics workflows (experience with product development for AI agents a plus). * **Some coding experience** with React, TypeScript, SQL, or Go. * **MBA** or equivalent professional experience. * **Experience with customer\-facing strategy**, GTM strategy, or value engineering at a high\-growth data or AI software company (experience interfacing with end customers to influence software development preferred). **Pay Range Transparency** Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non\-commissionable roles or on\-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job\-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Evals
jobs.description: **About David AI** ------------------ At David AI, our vision is to bring impactful AI into billions of lives through voice. Our mission is to help the world's leading AI companies build better voice models and agents. We're building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind those models. Founded in 2024, we're a fast\-growing Series B company backed by NVIDIA, Meritech, First Round, YC, and others, with \~70 people across San Francisco and New York City. **About this role** ------------------- We're building David AI's first **Forward Deployed Evals** team. Voice models can only improve on what someone can measure, and most of what matters in voice has never been measured well. This team finds those gaps with our customers and builds the evals to close them. As a **Forward Deployed Engineer, Evals**, you'll be the primary partner to a set of customers' research teams. In a typical week, you might spot a regression in the latest model checkpoint and design a targeted eval for it, build it end\-to\-end, calibrate findings against human ratings, and follow through to ensure the model improves. This is a builder role that is intentionally cross\-functional, requiring you to be capable across GTM, Ops, Product, Research, and Engineering to deliver on outcomes. **In this role, you will** -------------------------- * Be the evaluation partner to research teams at the world's leading AI labs: learn what they're trying to fix in their voice models, and find what they haven't thought to measure yet. * Dig into human and automated eval results, pin down exactly where and why a model fails, and decide which failures deserve a dedicated eval. * Go from idea to working eval in days, independently building whatever the problem calls for: human data pipelines, detectors trained on human labels, or synthetic test harnesses. * Make every number defensible: an eval you ship should track what people actually hear, and it should hold up when a senior researcher pushes on it. * Tell research leads what to focus on in their next checkpoint and why, with the data to back it up. * Productize what works, or turn it into a playbook the team can repeat. * Shape how forward deployed evals work at David AI as one of the first people on the team. **Your background looks like** ------------------------------ * 2\-7\+ years of experience as a technical builder across engineering, product, operations, and research (we're hiring at multiple levels); this might have been as a forward deployed engineer, applied data scientist, ML engineer, product manager, management consultant, or something else entirely. * You're exceptional at building with AI agents, and you've personally built at least one ambitious thing you can walk us through in detail. * You move fast. You solve problems in days that might take someone else a month, and you own ambiguous, high\-stakes work end to end. * Strong, demonstrated analytical chops: experiment design, statistics, and knowing whether a metric actually captures what you care about. * Strong customer presence: you have the credibility and clear communication to earn the trust of technical customers and senior stakeholders. * Excited to work in person in San Francisco or New York. **Bonus points if you have** ---------------------------- * Been a founder, or founding engineer/PM/etc. at a startup. * Experience with speech, audio, or voice models. * Built or published a benchmark you can share with us. * Experience working with human raters, annotation, or data\-labeling workflows. * Worked at an AI data or evals company. **Benefits** ------------ * Unlimited PTO. * Top\-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans. * FSA \& HSA access. * 401k access. * Meals 2x daily through DoorDash \+ snacks and beverages available at the office. * Unlimited company\-sponsored Barry's classes. **Visas** --------- We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H\-1B *transfers*, H\-1B1, O\-1, E\-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on STEM OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world. Compensation Range: $165K \- $225K

jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 15 years of experience in software engineering and applied machine learning/AI systems. * Experience operating at a principal or distinguished IC or technical leadership level. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related technical field. * Experience designing and deploying self\-improvement loops, self\-healing agentic harnesses, autonomous coding/execution agents, or closed\-loop online/offline evaluation platforms. * Strong technical foundation in LLM post\-training, alignment, and quality optimization (such as SFT, RLHF/DPO, synthetic trajectory generation, evaluation benchmarks, or automated prompt/skill optimization). * Proven track record of architecting, building, and shipping high\-traffic, low\-latency consumer or platform systems at massive scale (100M\+ users). * Expertise in architecting and scaling large\-scale distributed backend/serving infrastructure and production LLM inference or agentic orchestration runtimes. **About the job** ----------------- As a Principal/Distinguished Engineer IC within GeminiApp, you will serve as the technical anchor bridging Agentic Harness Infrastructure and Quality \& Foundational Capabilities. As we unify Gemini Chat and Tasks onto a single agentic runtime powering everything from fast informational queries to complex, long\-running multi\-step workflows and sub\-agents, your mission is to push our harness to the next frontier of reliability and intelligence. Your primary focus is architecting and building a self\-healing, self\-improving agentic harness—leaning into frontier models to drive automated, closed\-loop improvement across the stack. Beyond the obvious roadmap, you will identify unorganized technical opportunities across evaluation, trajectory quality, and harness architecture—spending \~70\-80% of your time in code and prototypes on high\-leverage problems and \~20\-30% driving cross\-organizational technical strategy and mentorship. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $307000 \- $427000 (USD) \+ 30% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Define the next\-generation architecture for LLM\-driven evaluation and automated failure triage across long trajectories, multi\-step planning, and sub\-agent execution, enabling teams to diagnose and close quality gaps. * Serve as a technical anchor connecting Agentic Platform \& Infrastructure with Quality \& Foundational Capabilities, identifying architectural opportunities where runtime design and model quality intersect. * Design and build automated closed\-loop systems that continuously improve agentic quality—combining fast runtime loops with slow loops. * Partner with GDM GenAI post\-training, tools/harness, and knowledge\-work teams to co\-evolve upstream model capabilities alongside downstream harness abstractions. * Spend \~70\-80% of your time writing production code, prototypes, and architectural designs that turn agentic and post\-training research into reliable production systems. jobs.title: Software Engineer
