The role independently develops, implements, integrates, tests, troubleshoots, and supports software solutions for automated warehouse systems while applying technical and domain knowledge to engineering decisions and issue resolution. The position actively contributes to software and system design discussions, takes ownership of assigned software solutions and technical outcomes, and collaborates with customers and cross\-functional teams to support successful project execution and create customer value. The role provides opportunities for continued growth within the Software Engineering career path through deeper technical and domain expertise, broader solution and project ownership, and developing technical and/or project leadership capabilities. The base pay range for this role is estimated to be $ 76,500 \- 105,000 at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as work location, education, experience, knowledge, and skills. **We offer:** ============= **Key Responsibilities:** * Participate as a key member of project teams delivering software modifications, enhancements, retrofits, and upgrades to automated warehouse systems. * Independently develop, configure, implement, integrate, and test software solutions, taking ownership of assigned solutions and technical deliverables. * Work with customers and cross\-functional teams to understand requirements, evaluate technical needs, and actively contribute to software and system design decisions. * Conduct unit and integration testing and participate in on\-site commissioning and system validation to ensure solutions meet defined project and customer requirements. * Drive software debugging and troubleshooting within assigned project scope, coordinating issue resolution and engaging other technical resources when appropriate. * Collaborate with customers and cross\-functional teams to communicate progress, identify risks, coordinate technical activities and assigned deliverables, and support successful project execution. * Participate in code and design reviews, providing technical feedback and sharing knowledge with project team members. * Develop and maintain software and system documentation, including technical specifications, user guides, and job aids. * Provide standby and post\-implementation software support as assigned, driving issue resolution within the engineer’s area of responsibility. * Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing to less\-experienced engineers and take on increasing responsibility for technical coordination, customer communication, and project deliverables as experience and capability develop. Other responsibilities as required. * **Skills \& Capabilities:** * Proficiency in one or more programming languages and the ability to learn and apply new technologies. Relevant technologies include C/C\+\+, C\#, VB.NET, JavaScript, and TypeScript. * Working knowledge of software development environments and tools, including Windows/Linux, web technologies, Git/TFS version control, and debugging tools. * Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL; relevant technologies include Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and PostgreSQL. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to independently diagnose and resolve technical issues and contribute to solution design. * Proactive and self\-motivated, demonstrating ownership of software solutions and sound judgment in seeking guidance or escalating issues. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate technical information to customers and cross\-functional teams. Team\-oriented with the ability to collaborate, share knowledge, provide technical guidance, and develop technical and/or project leadership capabilities. * **Experience Desired:** * Five or more years of experience in software engineering, software development, industrial automation, material handling, or a related technical field is desired. * Experience independently developing, implementing, testing, debugging, and troubleshooting software solutions in a project or customer delivery environment. * Experience owning software solutions or technical deliverables through implementation, integration, testing, and commissioning. * Experience interpreting customer and project requirements and contributing to software or system design decisions. * Experience participating in code reviews, design reviews, or other collaborative technical review activities. * Experience collaborating directly with customers and cross\-functional teams to support technical decisions and successful project execution. * Experience providing technical guidance or coordinating engineering activities within a project team is beneficial. Experience with industrial automation, material handling, automated warehouse systems, or integrated software and control systems is preferred. * **Education \& Certifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred; equivalent education, training, or relevant experience may be considered. No specific professional certifications are required. * **Tasks and Qualifications:** ============================= Additional Job Details and Information: * Domestic travel up to 25% required. * Ability to work in customer warehouses and industrial environments as required. * Follow applicable customer\-site and Dematic health and safety requirements. * Dematic provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment based on characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws. * Qualified individuals must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation. * Reasonable accommodations will be considered for qualified individuals in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role:** As a Data Engineer, you'll play a key role in establishing and developing DCS's data infrastructure. You'll be responsible for bringing together data from multiple business systems, improving data quality, and building scalable solutions that support our organization's growth and future data initiatives. We're looking for someone who is excited about building from the ground up and is comfortable working within an evolving data environment. You'll have the opportunity to influence the tools, processes, and architecture that shape how DCS collects, manages, and utilizes its data. You'll work closely with stakeholders across the organization to understand business processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop reliable data solutions. We'll appreciate your collaborative mindset, curiosity, technical expertise, and willingness to get into the details to solve complex problems. Sound like you? Read on. **In this role, you will…** * Establish and develop the foundation for DCS's data infrastructure, helping define the tools, architecture, and processes that will support future growth. * Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and integrations across multiple business systems, including CRM platforms, QuickBase, and other internal applications. * Extract, clean, transform, and consolidate fragmented data to improve accessibility, accuracy, and consistency. * Develop and maintain reliable ETL/ELT processes to support the movement and transformation of data. * Identify and address gaps in existing data structures, integrations, and processes. * Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to understand business workflows, operational challenges, and data requirements. * Establish best practices for data quality, governance, documentation, and reliability. * Develop data solutions with scalability, performance, and long\-term maintainability in mind. * Build the underlying data infrastructure necessary to support future analytics, reporting, automation, and machine learning initiatives. * Continuously identify opportunities to improve how DCS collects, manages, and utilizes its data. **What you'll need to succeed:** * 3\+ years of experience in data engineering or a related technical discipline. * Hands\-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines and integrations. * Experience working with fragmented, complex, or inconsistent data across multiple source systems. * Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with Python or other relevant programming languages. * Experience with ETL/ELT processes, data modeling, and database architecture. * Strong understanding of data quality, transformation, and integration practices. * Ability to work within a developing data environment and establish processes where they may not already exist. * Strong problem\-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to navigate ambiguity. * Ability to take ownership of technical initiatives and drive solutions from concept through implementation. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * A willingness to develop an understanding of our industry, business processes, and operational challenges. **It would be great if you also have…** * Experience building data infrastructure or establishing data engineering capabilities from the ground up. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric or similar cloud\-based data platforms. * Familiarity with CRM platforms, Quickbase, or other enterprise business systems. * Experience integrating data through APIs and third\-party applications. * Familiarity with data warehousing, lakehouse architecture, or cloud\-based data storage solutions. * Knowledge of the material handling, supply chain, distribution, warehouse, or manufacturing industries. **About Us:** Conveyor may be in our name, but it's only part of what we do. DCS was founded in 1982 and has grown to serve major clients in multiple industries by providing material handling, full\-scale warehouse operations and conveyor design solutions that are custom crafted for their need. We don't sell ready\-made systems \- we build relationships that empower us to craft custom solutions together. It's the teamwork approach, sharing ideas and building upon them, that produces the best results. And DCS is committed to creating an extraordinary employment experience for our team. We work like crazy to hire and develop great people, build relationships, and ensure that the programs and services we offer our team are among the best in the business \- from a killer snack wall and casual work environment to flexible PTO and opportunities to give back within the community. **More reasons to join our team:** * We pride ourselves in our family\-like culture and casual, but focused, work environment * We offer competitive salaries and health benefits * Our 401K program includes a 100% match up to 5% * Participation in our Discretionary Profit\-Sharing Program * We offer our employees flexibility and autonomy * We do community outreach projects throughout the year * We know how to throw company events * We work hard, but we also know how to have fun! *Individuals seeking employment at Designed Conveyor Systems are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. Accommodation is available to applicants with a disability condition, when applying, testing, or interviewing for a position. Please let us know if you need accommodation.*

jobs.title: Engineering Lead
jobs.description: **Overview** ============ The Engineering Lead leads the architecture, delivery, and engineering team for Independent AI Evaluation Foundation (IAEF) (https://www.independentevals.org/), a platform for evaluating the trustworthiness of artificial intelligence (AI). Reporting to the Founding Director of IAEF, this leader combines technical ownership, team development, security leadership, and external representation. Independent AI Evaluation Foundation (IAEF)’s mission is to identify and reduce barriers to evaluating the efficacy, transparency, and safety of specific educational AI\-centric solutions used by students and opportunity seekers in their educational context. IAEF is a fiscally sponsored project of Digital Harbor Foundation. Digital Harbor Foundation is dedicated to fostering learning, creativity, productivity, and community through education with a vision of digital equity for everyone. Driven by our sincere belief that access to opportunity is a basic right, we take bold yet practical actions to support making a better future now. Through a portfolio of projects focused on developing leadership within communities, we support those closest to challenges to take deliberate actions based on a design thinking approach, backed by data analysis, grounded in a practice of collective impact, and driven by a commitment to racial equity. **Education and Experience Requirements** ========================================= **Required** ------------ * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including at least four years in senior technical leadership at a startup, evaluation or audit firm, machine\-learning infrastructure company, or research\-grade platform team. * Experience building and operating a platform with a plugin, extension, or component model, and running AI evaluation, red\-teaming, machine\-learning observability, or model\-testing systems in production. * A record of hiring and retaining senior engineers in a distributed team, including at least one applied machine\-learning or agentic\-systems specialist. **Strongly preferred** ---------------------- * Prior CTO, VP Engineering, or founding\-engineer experience at an early\-stage company that raised institutional capital; experience enabling external developers to build on a platform; and prior evaluation\-methodology work with academic or civil\-society partners. * A PhD and extensive experience at a frontier AI research laboratory are not required. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** ==================================== * Ability to design reusable platform components and work with human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) transcripts, benchmark scores, and large language model (LLM) red\-teaming results. * Ability to communicate technical decisions to enterprise security leaders, foundation program officers, investors, customers, and partners. * Ability to prioritize competing technical and organizational needs and lead a distributed engineering team through delivery, operational issues, and growth. * Understanding of the operational separation required between a public benefit corporation, a companion nonprofit, and grant\-funded programs. * Strongly preferred: experience leading implementation of ISO 42001, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, or SOC 2 requirements, rather than participating only as a reviewer. **Additional Notes** ==================== This is a full\-time, remote\-first role based in the US or EU. New York or the San Francisco Bay Area is strongly preferred for quarterly in\-person meetings with the Founding Director of IAEF, partners, and board. Travel is approximately 15% for funder meetings, partner sites, conferences, and off\-sites. **Role and Responsibilities** ============================= **Platform architecture and delivery** -------------------------------------- Own the Workbench’s Design Test Analyze* Publish (DTAP) workflow, Component Contract, Artifacts API, component registry, and canvas interface. * Create a persistent, structured, queryable evaluation history rather than one\-off engagement exports, and integrate the existing red\-teaming platform, administrative dashboard, and HITL data\-capture architecture instead of rebuilding them from scratch. * Decide when to build or buy authentication, storage, orchestration, LLM\-provider services, and sandboxing for the planned notebook environment. **Engineering leadership** -------------------------- * In conjunction with the Human Resources Department of Digital Harbor Foundation, recruit, develop, and retain the engineering organization against the approved build plan, including Staff/Senior Backend, Senior Frontend, DevOps/site reliability, Applied Machine Learning, and Senior Product Manager roles * Set planning, code\-review, on\-call, incident\-response, and roadmap\-review practices; provide engineering progress and risks for board and funder reporting. **Evaluation platform strategy** -------------------------------- * Partner with the IAFE’s Founding Director and Evaluation Science Lead to translate HITL red teaming, automated benchmarks, LLM red teaming, LLM\-as\-judge, and drift detection into a Component Contract that supports all three Test artifact types and planned agentic components. **Security, compliance, and trust** ----------------------------------- * Lead the PBC’s technical security program, including SOC 2 readiness, safeguards for HITL transcripts and adversarial prompts, and customer security reviews. Provide technical requirements for data processing agreement (DPA) templates in partnership with authorized legal and operations reviewers. * Lead vendor risk reviews for LLM providers, cloud infrastructure, and third\-party evaluation tools. * Coordinate with Digital Harbor Foundation’s Leadership, where applicable, on required approvals, funder restrictions, and separation of PBC and nonprofit resources, data, and intellectual property under approved agreements. Escalate unresolved risks rather than independently determining legal or sponsor policy. **External representation and fundraising** ------------------------------------------- * Represent IAEF in technical conversations with customers, partners, funders, and press, and own the technical content of investor fundraising decks, roadmap materials, demonstrations, and due diligence reviews in partnership with the Founding Director of IAEF and Digital Harbor Foundation’s leadership. * Lead the developer\-relations narrative for software and agent development kits (SDK/ADK) as the Component Contract opens to outside developers in Phase 1, partnering with the Developer Relations \& Ecosystem hire planned for Period 2\. **Other Duties** ================ This job description is not a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties, or responsibilities required for this role. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. **Compensation** ---------------- Compensation for this full\-time position is $215,000 \- $315,000 annually, commensurate with experience. Digital Harbor provides a best\-in\-class, comprehensive set of benefits to support the team. All regular, full\-time employees are eligible to receive: **Health Benefits \& Insurance** -------------------------------- * Carefirst Blue Cross Blue Shield \- Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance (100% of the premium paid for employees and 85% of dependents) * Pre\-Tax Health Savings Account (HSA) (with $365 monthly employer contributions) * Pre\-Tax Flexible Savings Account (FSA) * Paid Accidental Death \& Dismemberment (AD\&D) Insurance * Paid Short\-Term \& Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Paid Basic Life Insurance * Supplemental Voluntary Life Insurance (Employee, Spouse \& Dependent Children) * Total Pet Plan and Supplemental Wishbone Pet Insurance * Employee Opportunity Program (EAP) \- Health and Wellness * Wellness Reimbursement Program **Retirement** -------------- * 401k Retirement Plan (with 6% matching) **Paid Time Off** ----------------- * 15 Days Paid Time Off Per Year * 20 Days Paid Time Off Per Year (after 3rd Anniversary) * 25 Days Paid Time Off Per Year (after 6th Anniversary) * 16 Paid Holidays (14 common plus 2 flexible holidays, including Dec 25 \- Jan 1\) * Paid Bereavement Leave * Paid Parental Leave for Moms and Dads (two weeks after first year) If our mission and vision align with your personal values, please apply! A cover letter outlining your qualifications for the position, along with your resume, is required. Interviews will be conducted virtually. Digital Harbor and IAEF are equal opportunity employers. 6yDMI3ZJKI

jobs.title: Engineer, Embedded
jobs.description: At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths. We are \#EnergizedByGrowth. DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading\-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel\-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock\-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States. *Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States.* *Based in Downers Grove, IL, Dover Corporation® (NYSE: DOV). Meaningful contribution to shared development standards, reusable components, documentation, and quality\-control practices. * Effective technical guidance and code review support for other developers. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration that improves technical feasibility, project planning, and release quality. * Write efficient, DRY code and enforce that standard through peer review Technologies Supporting the Role: * Craft CMS experience (required), Asana (or any project management tool) SCSS, JS (ES6\), Tailwind, Webpack, Git, DDEV, PHP, Nginx, Cloudflare, Claude Web performance tools such as Screaming Frog, phpMyAdmin, BrowserStack, etc. Education: BA or BS in marketing, design or business, or comparable education/experience Requirements: * 5\+ years of experience in web development. jobs.title: Engineer - MLOps & Scientific Platforms - Data Foundry
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. **Locations:** San Francisco, CA; Louisville, CO; Indianapolis, IN Lilly Small Molecule Discovery is purpose\-built to create molecules that make life better for people. Discovery Technology and Platforms (DTP) accelerates molecule discovery by building optimized foundational platforms, streamlining lab operations through advanced technologies and data connectivity, and investing in novel capabilities. Data Foundry is a multidisciplinary team within DTP that enables AI\-native drug discovery through four integrated pillars: Architecture4Insight (data infrastructure and scientific software), Methods4Insight (analytical and computational methods), Automation \& Scale4Insight (lab automation and agentic workflows), and Preparedness4Insight (data governance and readiness). These pillars empower every Lilly scientist to make optimal decisions by providing seamless access to data, insights, and AI\-driven capabilities—serving both human scientists and autonomous AI agents. Position Summary We are seeking an Engineer \- MLOps \& Scientific Platforms \- Data Foundry to operationalize Data Foundry’s scientific tools and analytical methods into actionable\-prototypes. You will build the ML deployment pipelines, model serving infrastructure, API layers, and observability guardrails that make our scientific discovery methods and tools reliable, scalable, and consumable, both by discovery scientists and by the Frontier AI group’s autonomous agents. This role sits at the interface between Methods4Insight (which develops analytical methods) and Architecture4Insight(which provides the agile data infrastructure). Your job is to ensure every scientific tool Data Foundry produces are analytics\-ready, well\-monitored, and exposed through APIs with the response\-time guarantees and error handling that both human users and AI agents require. Responsibilities MLOps \& Model Lifecycle Management * Build and maintain end\-to\-end ML deployment pipelines: experiment tracking, model versioning (MLflow, Weights \& Biases), containerized model serving, and automated retraining triggers. * Develop model registry infrastructure and feature engineering pipelines that enable computational scientists to access models. * Implement monitoring and alerting for data pipelines, APIs, ML models, and agentic systems (LLMOps) to ensure system reliability and performance at scale. * Build dashboards and metrics tracking for pipeline execution, API latency, token usage, model prediction quality, and system health * Establish structured logging and tracing infrastructure for debugging and performance optimization across scientific data systems Scientific Tool Agile Deployment * Deploy predictive and analytical methods from Methods4Insight (e.g. cheminformatics, structural biology, bioinformatics, reaction informatics) with versioning, structured error handling, and response\-time guarantees that enable insight generation in agile manner. Productionize when and where needed in partnerships with Tech@Lilly. * Build serving infrastructure supporting both synchronous (interactive scientist queries) and asynchronous (batch and agent\-invoked) workloads in partnership with Tech@Lilly and Frontier AI. * Define and implement API contracts, documentation standards, and testing frameworks that ensure scientific tools are analysis ready, robust and consumable by external teams including Frontier AI. Platform Engineering \& Integration * Build and operate cloud\-native model serving infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) using containers, Kubernetes, and infrastructure\-as\-code. * Develop CI/CD pipelines for ML models: automated validation, A/B testing, canary deployments, and rollback procedures. * Integrate model serving with Data Foundry’s data pipelines, ensuring models have access to properly formatted, versioned training and inference data. Frontier AI Interface \& Collaboration * Partner with the Frontier AI team and Tech@Lilly to ensure Data Foundry’s scientific tools are exposed via well\-defined interfaces (REST APIs, MCP\-compatible endpoints) that agents can invoke programmatically. * Collaborate on API performance requirements: latency targets, throughput guarantees, and graceful degradation under load. * Work with Methods4Insight scientists to ensure deployed models include appropriate uncertainty quantification and work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F\-1 CPT, F\-1 OPT, F\-1 STEM OPT, J\-1, H\-1B, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, or L\-1\. Preferred Qualifications * Pharmaceutical or biotech research industry experience. * Strong Python skills; experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn) and ML lifecycle tools (MLflow, W\&B, Kubeflow, or similar). * Proven track record building and deploying production model serving infrastructure — containerized endpoints, RESTful/gRPC APIs, and operational monitoring * Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), Kubernetes, and CI/CD automation. * Strong communication skills with ability to collaborate across computational scientists, software engineers, and partner teams. * Experience operationalizing scientific or computational models (cheminformatics, bioinformatics, structural biology, QSAR, molecular simulations, PK/PD, systems biology, or ODE\-based models). * Hands\-on experience with model monitoring, drift detection, and automated retraining systems. * Familiarity with API gateway patterns, event\-driven architectures, and service mesh technologies. * Experience with feature stores, data versioning (DVC), or experiment tracking at scale. * Exposure to AI agent frameworks (MCP, LangChain) or building APIs that AI systems invoke programmatically. * Experience with C, C\+\+, CUDA, or GPU\-accelerated computing for optimizing model training/inference performance; familiarity with containerizing HPC workloads (Singularity/Apptainer). Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace\-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response. Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ\+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL). Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is $99,000 \- $180,400 Full\-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company\-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well\-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees. \#WeAreLilly

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **ABOUT DBI** For over 20 years, DBI has been a leader in the evaluation of damaged structures, consistently redefining the standards of excellence in our industry. We deliver independent analysis to clients in the insurance and legal industries. Hard evidence, expertise and accuracy drive our work. In a complex and ever\-evolving industry, our mission is to bring clarity to every client we serve. DBI is part of the Cor Partners family of companies, serving the insurance, risk management and legal communities. Headquartered in Midtown New York City, we have more than 30 locations across the United States, including Atlanta and Dallas, and both our footprint and our team are growing. We believe the best ideas come from looking at familiar problems in new ways. That forward\-thinking, innovative and people\-focused mindset is what sets us apart, and technology is central to how we grow. **SUMMARY OF JOB PURPOSE**: DBI is building new enterprise applications on two fronts: platforms for our clients, and the systems our own teams use every day. Both share one goal: to make complex work simple, clear and elegant for the people who use it. Our work runs on dense documents, site data, cost estimates and expert judgment, often thousands of pages for a single claim. It arrives as spreadsheets, CSVs, PDFs, reports and feeds from other systems, some well structured and some barely structured at all. Turning that into fast, clear and correct answers for clients and consultants is a data problem first, with AI and design challenges close behind. The Senior Software Engineer plays a central role in building these platforms end to end, from the data that feeds them through the services, APIs and screens clients use. The role is hands\-on: designing, building, shipping and supporting production software, and helping set the engineering standards the team builds on. The Senior Software Engineer is involved early, applies critical thinking from raw data through to what the client sees, and helps shape solutions rather than building to a fixed spec. The first major project is a new client\-facing enterprise application that DBI is building in house, which the Senior Software Engineer will help take from the first line of code through delivery, with a strong pipeline of projects to follow. The Senior Software Engineer reports directly to the Partner and Creative Director and is expected to travel 10–20% of the time for project work, training and company needs. **THE TECHNOLOGY TEAM** The Senior Software Engineer joins a small, close\-knit team that works collaboratively, with a strong culture and a high standard for quality, and works alongside: * The Partner and Creative Director, who leads the team and is hands\-on in project work. * The IT Director, who leads DBI's environments, infrastructure, and security, and brings deep engineering experience to the team. * The Senior Director of Data Science \& AI, who sets AI and engineering direction and is closely involved in the engineering itself, from approach and code to releases and data migration. * The Product Manager, who shapes the product, roadmap and priorities, and works with engineering at every stage, from requirements and data modeling through architecture and testing. * The IT team, who support DBI's systems, users and day\-to\-day operations. **PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**: * Design, build, ship and support production web applications end to end, including data models, backend services, APIs and the frontend screens clients use. * Build the ingestion and transformation layer that brings data from spreadsheets, CSVs, PDFs and other systems into a consistent data model shared across DBI's applications, working with the Senior Director of Data Science \& AI and the Product Manager. * Help maintain and evolve the schemas, contracts and APIs other applications depend on, changing them as the business and source data change. * Build validation, audit trails, versioning and lineage into the data flow, so any figure on screen can be traced back to the file it came from. * Build the checks, reconciliation, and monitoring that keep our data accurate and catch bad data before a client does. * Build frontend features from designer mockups, including import and validation screens, dashboards, reporting and document generation. * Work with the Senior Director of Data Science \& AI on AI\-assisted features, such as extracting and classifying data from documents, with human review where accuracy matters. * Implement secure authentication and role\-based access for staff and clients using Microsoft Entra ID. * Partner with the IT Director on environments, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, releases and security. Support deployments, monitor production, and resolve defects, data issues and performance problems. * Write and maintain automated tests, including data quality, API and UI tests. * Help define DBI's engineering standards for s ns such as MCP, and evaluating and monitoring model output. * Document processing at scale: OCR, PDF parsing, table extraction and the realities of scanned and inconsistent source files. * ETL or ELT pipelines across semi\-structured and unstructured sources. * Data governance in practice, including lineage, audit trails, versioning and data quality. * Node.js and TypeScript services, including GraphQL APIs. * Deployment with Docker and Azure services such as Blob Storage and Azure Database for PostgreSQL. * Application monitoring with Azure Application Insights or similar tools. * Experience integrating enterprise applications such as Workday and NetSuite, including APIs, identity, master data and transactional workflows. * Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth, or similar identity and access management for web applications. * Infrastructure as code, preferably Bicep. * Automated testing frameworks, preferably Playwright, and a working knowledge of computer\-use agents. * Advanced frontend work, including design systems, component libraries or data visualization. * Working with external development teams. * Experience in insurance, claims, forensics, engineering, legal, construction, regulated financial services or another field where accuracy and the ability to show your evidence matter. **SKILLS AND ABILITIES** * A drive to make complex things simple, with care for how people experience the software. * Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences, including clients. * Strong attention to quality and detail, and pride in delivering polished work. * Ability to work independently and as part of a small, collaborative team. * Strong time management and organizational skills; able to balance multiple projects and deadlines. * A security\-first approach, following secure development practices and treating sensitive client data with care and discretion. **WHAT WE OFFER** * Meaningful work: build the platforms DBI's clients and consultants rely on, with real data and real impact. * Room to grow: we are a growing Technology team and company * Modern tools and learning: current AI coding tools, cloud environments, and support for ongoing learning. * Stability with momentum: the backing of an established firm and the Cor Partners family, with the energy and close\-knit culture of a team building something new. **WORKING CONDITIONS**: This is a hybrid role, with work performed in a DBI office two days a week and remotely the rest of the week. This role may require flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, or holidays, to support releases, production issues, or project deadlines. The position also requires 10–20% travel to support projects, training, satellite office locations, and company operations. In addition, this role may involve visits to client sites, new office buildouts, and renovations, which can include active construction zones. While safety protocols will be followed, the employee may occasionally be exposed to noise, dust, or other environmental conditions typical of a construction site. **PHYSICAL ACTIVITIES AND REQUIREMENTS**: The work requires frequent use of a computer, keyboard, and other office equipment, requiring close visual acuity to view a computer screen, read printed documents, and review code. The employee must be able to sit or stand for extended periods of time, walk between office locations, and participate in meetings or project discussions. This role may also require handling and transporting equipment such as laptops, monitors, and other technology hardware. The employee should be able to lift, carry, push, or pull items weighing up to 40 pounds. Occasional bending, stooping, crouching, or reaching may be required. The employee may be required to work in active construction zones, which could involve exposure to noise, dust, or limited ventilation. Physical agility and awareness are required to safely move through these environments.

jobs.title: Data Security Engineer
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** Designs, implements, and administers controls that protect Everence’s unstructured data while enabling authorized collaboration. The position focuses on Microsoft Purview Information Protection, sensitivity\-label encryption, data loss prevention, and insider risk management across email, collaboration, and endpoint channels; the Mimecast email security gateway; Microsoft Entra External ID B2B collaboration; secure use of SharePoint and OneDrive; and annual access reviews of sensitive data. Working with data owners, IT, and Legal and Compliance, this role protects sensitive information throughout its lifecycle across Everence’s regulated entities. **RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES** * Develop and maintain standards and procedures for discovering, classifying, labeling, sharing, retaining, and protecting sensitive unstructured data, such as documents, email, and collaboration content. Work with business owners to establish data ownership. * Administer Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels, publishing policies, and label encryption for internal and external recipients. Tune sensitive information types and trainable classifiers, test access in supported applications, and maintain authorized recovery procedures. * Configure and tune Microsoft Purview DLP (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and endpoints), insider risk management policies, and Mimecast gateway data protection controls, aligned with Zscaler web DLP. Investigate exposure and insider risk alerts and coordinate containment with incident response staff, who own incident investigation. * Maintain Lightbeam discovery coverage and scan health. Validate classification accuracy and work with data owners to remediate excessive access and exposed sensitive data. * Implement SharePoint and OneDrive security standards with platform administrators, including sharing links, external access restrictions, and site and document labeling. * Partner with identity administrators on Entra External ID B2B guest onboarding, sponsorship, and removal, coordinating MFA, Conditional Access, cross\-tenant settings, and encrypted document rights. * Lead the annual access review process for sensitive data repositories and B2B guests. Work with data owners to certify access, remove excessive permissions, and retain review evidence. * Assess data security risks in collaboration workflows, new systems, and approved AI services, including Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness (oversharing remediation and label\-aware behavior). Evaluate, pilot, and troubleshoot data security solutions. * Implement approved retention and disposition controls with records owners and Legal and Compliance, preserving legal holds. * Maintain runbooks, configuration records, and audit evidence. Automate recurring tasks and report protection coverage, sharing exposure, DLP trends, and remediation progress. Operate under separation\-of\-duties and least\-privilege requirements for privileged data security roles. **QUALIFICATIONS** Education: * Bachelor's degree in computer science, MIS, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent education and practical experience preferred * Certifications such as Microsoft SC\-401, SC\-300, CISSP, or Security\+ are beneficial Experience: * Five years of relevant experience in IT administration, Microsoft 365, information security, or data protection, including SharePoint and OneDrive * Hands\-on experience implementing and administering Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels (including encryption), DLP, and insider risk management, with the ability to test and troubleshoot production controls * Experience administering an enterprise email security gateway (Mimecast preferred) or comparable email or web DLP controls * Experience planning, testing, and documenting technology changes, assessing data exposure, analyzing logs, and coordinating incident response; access review or recertification experience is preferred * Experience with PowerShell scripting; Microsoft Graph experience preferred * Experience with Lightbeam or comparable data discovery and classification tools is strongly preferred Skills and Abilities: * Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, B2B guest access, SharePoint and OneDrive permissions, and how identity, sharing, and document protection interact * Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST CSF 2\.0 and ISO 27001; Understanding of GLBA and HIPAA, and familiarity with financial\-institution examination expectations (FFIEC, NCUA, OCC), preferred. Audit, compliance, or governance experience is beneficial * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prioritize, manage multiple assignments, and maintain accurate records * Maintain strict confidentiality of company and client information; employment is contingent on a background check, given privileged access to sensitive data * Alignment in supporting the Everence mission of empowering financial well\-being for faith\-inspired living **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:** None **SCHEDULE:** Full\-time (Periodic nights and weekends may be required for planned change windows and escalation of significant data exposure incidents.)

jobs.description: * Engineering * Miami * Full\-time ### **Description** Fetcherr builds responsible AI that transforms market complexity into measurable profit growth. At the core of the company is the Market Model \- a proprietary AI\-powered model delivering accurate, granular demand predictions with 96% forecast accuracy and real\-time decision intelligence for commercial teams. Built on a glass\-box architecture, it uses market data \- not personal data \- with full transparency into logic and outcomes. First deployed in global aviation, the technology is industry\-agnostic and scales across volatile markets. Fetcherr delivers a consistent average profit uplift of 7%, with corporate partners including Delta, Virgin Atlantic, WestJet, Viva, and Azul. We are looking for an **AI Engineer** to design and implement the decision\-making logic of our Price Optimizer. You will translate complex business rules into mathematical models and production\-ready Python code, supported by a dedicated Data Engineering team that handles the underlying infrastructure. Your primary mission is to build the "brain" of our system. You will work at the intersection of Data Science and Product, ensuring our simulation and optimization engines accurately reflect real\-world pricing strategies and market dynamics. While you will write production code, you will rely on our Data Engineers for ETL pipeline orchestration and distributed compute scaling. **Responsibilities**: * **Implement Business Logic:** Translate intricate pricing rules and commercial strategies into robust Python code and mathematical constraints. * **Refine Optimization Models:** Develop and tune the simulation and revenue management algorithms that drive our pricing recommendations. * **Write Clean Code:** Contribute high\-quality, tested, and maintainable code to the core logic repositories. * **Analyze \& Improve:** Use data to validate model behavior and identify edge cases where business rules clash with algorithmic outputs. * **Collaborate:** Partner with Solution Architects to define logic requirements and with Data Engineers to integrate your models into the Dagster pipelines. ### **Requirements** * 4\+ years of experience in Data Science or Algorithmic Development with Python. * Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into code and logical rules. * Strong background in Mathematical Optimization, Simulation, or Logic Programming. * Fluency in the PyData stack (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy). * Experience writing production\-quality code (not just notebooks) \- you understand modular design and unit testing.

jobs.title: Data Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Description** ======================== The Data Integration Engineer designs, builds, and supports the integrations that bring data from The Specialty Alliance’s enterprise financial and business systems—including NetSuite, Workday, and Coupa—into the landing zone of the Azure/Snowflake analytical environment. The role builds API\-based, file\-based, and other connector\-based integrations that are secure, reliable, monitored, and repeatable. The role owns ingestion from source to landing: authentication, extraction, incremental loading, schema handling, error handling, logging, and delivery of raw data into Azure storage and Snowflake landing/raw schemas with complete audit metadata. Downstream normalization, modeling, and semantic\-layer work is performed by data engineers and analytics engineers, who depend on this role for complete, timely, and traceable source data. Data from these systems supports financial reporting, revenue recognition, general ledger and close reconciliation, procurement and spend analytics, and workforce analytics. Integrations must meet the control, traceability, and access standards expected for financial and HR data. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Integration design and build** -------------------------------- * Build and maintain integrations from NetSuite, Workday, Coupa, and other financial and business systems into the Azure/Snowflake landing zone. * Use the appropriate pattern for each source: REST/SOAP APIs, vendor reporting services, database or query interfaces, SFTP/flat\-file exports, managed connectors, or event\-driven feeds. * Implement full and incremental extraction, including change detection, watermarks, pagination, rate\-limit handling, retries, and historical backfills. * Land data in Azure Data Lake Storage and Snowflake raw/landing schemas in source\-faithful form, with load metadata (source, extract time, batch ID, record counts, file hashes). * Configure Snowflake ingestion (external stages, storage integrations, COPY INTO, Snowpipe) in line with platform standards. * Document each integration: source objects, fields, extraction logic, schedules, dependencies, and known limitations. **Reliability, monitoring, and support** ---------------------------------------- * Build orchestration, alerting, and logging so failures, late data, schema changes, and volume anomalies are detected quickly. * Implement completeness checks and source\-to\-landing reconciliation (record counts, control totals) for financial and HR data. * Provide production support, troubleshoot failures, perform root\-cause analysis, and maintain runbooks. * Meet data\-delivery schedules tied to financial close and reporting calendars. **Security and controls** ------------------------- * Manage credentials, OAuth clients, integration users, and certificates through Azure Key Vault and approved secret\-management practices. * Apply least\-privilege access to source systems and landing zones in partnership with Security and system owners. * Support classification and protection of sensitive data, including employee PII, compensation, banking, and vendor data. * Follow change\-management, code review, and CI/CD practices; keep integration code under version control. * Retain extract evidence and lineage needed for audit and close support. **Collaboration** ----------------- * Work with NetSuite, Workday, and Coupa system owners and IT Enterprise Applications to understand data structures, custom fields, configuration changes, and release schedules. * Coordinate with vendors on API access, limits, and support issues. * Partner with the Enterprise Data Architect and data engineers on landing standards, naming, and handoff to modeled layers. * Assess new source systems, including systems acquired through practice onboarding or M\&A, and estimate integration effort. **Required Skills and Competencies** ==================================== * **Integration engineering:** Designs reliable full and incremental extraction with retries, idempotent loads, and backfill capability. * **Programming:** Strong Python and SQL; comfortable with JSON, XML, and CSV data structures. * **Data handling:** Manages schema changes, nested data, data types, and late\-arriving records. * **Operational rigor:** Builds monitoring, logging, and alerting as part of every integration. * **Security awareness:** Handles credentials and sensitive financial and HR data appropriately. * **Documentation:** Produces clear integration specifications and runbooks. * **Collaboration:** Works effectively with system owners, vendors, and downstream engineering teams. **Required Technologies** ========================= * Python (requests, data\-processing libraries) and SQL. * Azure data services: Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Key Vault; Azure Functions or Logic Apps. * Snowflake: stages, storage integrations, COPY INTO, Snowpipe, roles and grants. * REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth 2\.0, JSON/XML, SFTP. * Git and CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub). **Desired Skills, Experience, and Technologies** ================================================ * NetSuite integration: SuiteTalk REST/SOAP web services, SuiteQL, saved searches, SuiteAnalytics Connect. * Workday integration: Workday web services (SOAP/REST), Reports\-as\-a\-Service (RaaS), integration system users and security groups. * Coupa integration: Coupa REST API, scheduled flat\-file exports, and Coupa data objects (requisitions, POs, invoices, suppliers). * Managed ingestion tools such as Fivetran, Airbyte, Matillion, or Informatica. * Orchestration and transformation tools such as Airflow, dbt, or Snowflake Tasks/Streams. * Infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep) and Snowflake environment automation. * Experience with healthcare, MSO, or multi\-entity organizations, including practice\-management or revenue\-cycle source systems. * Understanding of financial data (GL, subledgers, chart of accounts, AP, procurement) and HR data concepts. * Experience supporting SOX or audit\-sensitive data flows. * Certifications: SnowPro Core or Data Engineer; Microsoft Azure Data Engineer Associate. * Employment Notes The Specialty Alliance is an equal opportunity employer. This description reflects the principal responsibilities of the role and is not an exhaustive list; duties may change based on organizational needs.

jobs.title: M1S Principal Control Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description: **BACKGROUND** -------------- The Giant Magellan Telescope is one of the most powerful ground\-based telescopes ever engineered. It is designed to push the boundaries of human knowledge and explore the unknown. Now under construction at Las Campanas Observatory in Chile’s Atacama Desert, one of the premier locations on Earth for astronomy, the telescope will deliver the highest\-performing combination of image quality, field of view, and light sensitivity ever achieved. From this southern hemisphere location, the Giant Magellan Telescope will use seven of the world’s largest mirrors to uncover the mysteries of dark matter and dark energy, investigate the origins of chemical elements, and search for signs of life on distant exoplanets. When complete in the 2030s, the Giant Magellan Telescope will be one of the largest public\-private funded science projects in history. It is the work of the GMTO Corporation, a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit and international research consortium, founded by 16 universities and research institutions from the United States, Chile, Australia, Brazil, Israel, South Korea, and Taiwan. Our culture is impactful, inclusive, and fearlessly innovative. We tackle the most complex engineering challenges and scientific questions alongside talented individuals who share a passion for advancing humanity’s understanding of the Universe. We invite you to join our team and leave your mark on the future of astronomy and beyond. **The Universe Awaits®** ------------------------ **Team** -------- Primary Mirror Subsystem (M1S) **Supervisor** -------------- Primary Mirror Subsystem (M1S) Element Manager **JOB SUMMARY** --------------- The Giant Magellan Telescope primary mirror (M1\) comprises seven 8\.4\-meter mirror segments, which must be positioned and controlled to function as a 25\-meter aperture telescope. The M1 Subsystem (M1S) consists of an active optics control system and a thermal control system. The active optics control system supports the individual mirror segments providing the means to actively adjust the positions of the mirrors, deform their reflective surfaces to the desired shapes, and protect the mirrors during a seismic event. The thermal control system stabilizes the temperatures of the mirror substrates. M1 Subsystem components are integrated into steel weldments delivered by the Telescope Structures Element. The M1 glass mirror segments are delivered by the Optics and Opto\-Mechanics Element. Together, the weldments, mirror segments and the M1 Subsystem comprise the M1 mirror cells. The M1S Principal Control System Software Engineer will be responsible for development of the GMT M1S active optics and thermal control system control algorithm and software implementation including support actuator control performance tuning, hardware and device control interface development and testing, troubleshooting and resolving challenges, updating documentation, and presenting at peer and gate reviews. This role is also a leadership position responsible for interface development and collaboration with the Observatory Software team. This candidate must be able to exchange ideas and reach consensus from different points of view. This role is considered the bridge between the hardware and software environments which requires a deep understanding of the active support control system and the device control software to implement solutions to interface challenges while working within the frameworks governed by the Observatory Software team. This requires close collaboration within the M1S and the Observatory Software teams developing and testing a design that meets requirements. **JOB DUTIES** -------------- * Lead, develop, maintain, and extend the GMT M1 Device Control Systems. * Integrate software with support actuators, hardpoints, thermal\-control hardware, calibration systems, and custom electronics. * Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, optical and systems engineers. * Participate in subsystem integration, laboratory testing, and commissioning activities. * Diagnose and resolve hardware, firmware, networking, and software issues. * Develop and maintain engineering tools, simulations, and automated test frameworks. * Produce documentation, procedures, and operational support materials. * Present control system software implementation in formal design reviews. **ESSENTIAL SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES** --------------------------------------------- * Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, physics, mechatronics, or related field. * Demonstrated leadership, collaboration, and communication skills especially in reaching consensus to different ideas * Demonstrated experience developing software for complex electromechanical systems. * Strong proficiency in modern C\+\+ development. * Experience with object\-oriented software design. * Experience developing software for Linux environments. * Experience with multithreaded, concurre otion\-control systems. * Familiarity with closed\-loop control systems, particularly for position, velocity, force, and thermal\-control loops. * Experience using source control systems such as Git. * Experience developing automated tests. * Experience preparing engineering documentation and participating in formal design reviews. **DESIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES** ------------------------------------------- **Real\-time control:** * Experience with the development of deterministic, low\-latency software systems. * Experience with the implementation of finite\-state machines and sequence logic. * Knowledge of control theory, including PID control, filtering, feed\-forward control, calibration and system identification. * Experience supporting systems operating at kilohertz update rates. **Industrial automation:** * Experience working with Beckhoff hardware. * Familiarity with distributed control systems architectures. * Experience integrating software with industrial field busses, particularly EtherCAT. * TwinCAT development. * EtherLab development. * EtherCAT development. * Modbus development. * OPC UA, TCP/IP, and other industrial communications protocols. **Embedded systems:** * Experience with software development for microcontrollers and custom electronics. * Familiarity with serial communications protocols such as RS\-232, RS\-485, SPI, I2C and CAN. * Experience troubleshooting hardware/software integration issues. **Scientific and engineering computing:** * Experience with MATLAB and Python. * Experience processing large engineering data sets. * Familiarity with numerical methods, calibration procedures, and statistical analysis. **Software engineering practices:** * Agile development methodologies. * Requirements management. * Risk management and configuration management. * Hardware\-in\-the\-loop and system\-level integration testing. **Domain\-specific experience:** * Telescope control systems. * Astronomical active optics. * Electromechanical control systems. * Thermal management systems. * Vibration analysis and mitigation. * Pneumatic control systems. * Safety\-critical or mission\-critical systems. **WORKING CONDITIONS** ---------------------- * Normal office environment * Lab environment * Position located in Tucson, AZ, (relocation assistance available) * Pasadena or remote with regular travel to Tucson and Pasadena may be considered * Domestic and International travel to visit supplier and M1S integration sites **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** ------------------------- * No special requirements **DIRECT REPORTS** ------------------ None **FEATURED BENEFITS** --------------------- * Medical insurance * Vision insurance * Dental insurance * Disability insurance * 401(k) **HIRING RANGE** ---------------- $150,000\- $190,000 The salary for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, and training. **APPLYING** ------------ #### **Please submit your application:** **APPLY HERE** If your skills and experience are a match for the position or if we need additional information, we will contact you. If we do not see a suitable match between your qualifications and the position, we will keep your information on file in the event future positions become available that are more suitable to your qualifications. We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request an accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career center as a result of your disability. To request an accommodation, contact a Giant Magellan Telescope Corporation Human Resources Representative.

We welcome feedback and understand the value of working together to accomplish more than what is possible individually. \#LI\-JD6 \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-Technology **Who are we?** At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world. jobs.description: **ABOUT THE ROLE** **Title:** Lead Network Engineer **Classification:** Full\-time, Exempt **Manages:** N/A **Location:** Seattle Area, WA **Travel:** \< 60% **PRIMARY FUNCTION** The Lead Network Engineer plays a key role in the delivery of GMI services. The focus of this role is to maintain network infrastructure across multiple environments. This includes firewalls, switches, routers, Access Points and Controllers across several manufactures (ex: Cisco, Meraki, Palo Alto, Foritnet, etc). This is a player\-coach role: you will spend most of your time hands\-on in client networks while owning escalations, task tracking, and the technical growth of the team. They will be supporting network deployment, troubleshooting, optimization, and wireless site survey projects. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on technical professional with strong traditional networking expertise and wireless survey experience. They identify and resolve system performance and security issues, ensuring alignment with industry best practices. Collaborating with cross\-functional teams, they integrate robust networking solutions into operational and development processes. The Lead Systems Engineer stays current with emerging technologies and threats, proactively enhancing system reliability and security, while mentoring team members to foster technical growth. Time Split (approximate): 80% hands\-on engineering and escalations, 20% leading, delegating and mentoring. **General Responsibilities** **People** are the most important part of GMI and the reason we are successful. The Lead Network Engineer will: * Demonstrate and promote an understanding and commitment to the GMI culture and core values. * Mentor Network Engineering team, build skills\-development plans and give regular direct feedback. * Provide leadership input on engineering performance, skill gaps, and staffing needs. * Collaborating with other teams: Working with Customer and GMI internal teams to obtain business requirements, assess solutions, implement technical solutions, and drive client success through innovation and experience. * Build credibility with clients by setting and executing against expectations in line with project scope. * Evaluate technology tools and develop knowledge to deliver assigned duties. * Maintain and proactively manage utilization target assigned by leadership. * Ensure accurate project time reporting and accountability to project tasks. * Speak fluently about GMI services and communicate business opportunities to the sales team **Process** is a foundational component of our service delivery and guides our team to success. The Lead Network Engineer will: * Work directly with the internal engagement lead and clients to review sold projects prerequisites, review and gather requirements, develop and deliver solutions. * Review expectations committed to during the sales process, understand and manage any changes in expectations and manage them throughout the engagement, communicate and resolve exceptions with leadership. * Continuously improve our work product and process through project execution experience. * Delegate work to Network Engineering team based on skill, workload, and development goals. * Define and maintain network standards, configuration baselines, and hardening guidelines across client tenants. * Build repeatable runbooks for Engineering and NOC team to resolve common issues without escalation. **Technology** expertise is why our customers trust GMI. We deliver custom solutions based on specific customer challenges. The Network Engineer will be responsible for: * Perform hands\-on configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization of routers, switches, and firewalls in enterprise environments. * Conduct wireless site surveys (predictive, passive, and active) using industry\-standard tools (e.g., Ekahau, AirMagnet, or equivalent). * Design and implement wireless solutions, including access point placement, channel planning, and coverage validation. * Diagnose and resolve complex Layer 2/3 network issues involving routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP), VLANs, STP, QoS, and security policies. * Perform network migrations, refreshes, and cutovers with minimal downtime. * Performance Monitoring: Monitor and optimize the performance of services. * Collaboration: Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including IT, security, and application development, to ensure seamless integration. * Documentation: Create and maintain detailed documentation of infrastructure setups, and operational procedures. * Coordinate with the NOC and lead troubleshooting of complex outages, routing problems, VPN failures, and performance issues. * Write or review root\-cause analyses for significant network incidents. * Review and consult on existing deployments for best practice standards. * Staying up\-to\-date with emerging technologies: Keeping abreast of the latest industry trends and technologies. * Provide subject matter expertise, guidance and recommendations to drive successful client outcomes; act as an escalation point where strong solution knowledge is needed across GMI * Coordinate with Pre\-sales team reviewing BOM and solution for accuracy. **Qualifications** Education * Bachelor’s degree in CS, Math, Engineering, MIS, CIS or related field is preferred, but not required. * Relevant industry certifications (CCNP PCNSE or equivalent certification required; Bonus points for CWNA) **Knowledge and Experience** * 7\+ years of hands\-on network engineering experience, including at least 2 years as a senior engineer or escalation point. * Experience leading, mentoring, or delegating work to other engineers (formal or informal team lead). * Routing \& Switching (Cisco, Arista, Juniper, or equivalent). * Firewalls (Cisco ASA/Firepower, Palo Alto, Fortinet, or equivalent). * Wireless (Cisco, Meraki, Aruba, or equivalent). * Proven wireless survey experience – must be able to independently perform RF site surveys and deliver professional survey reports and heatmaps. * Solid understanding of 802\.11 standards, RF fundamentals, and wireless troubleshooting. * Ability to work independently at customer sites with minimal supervision. * Accountable self\-starter with strong organizational and interpersonal skills * Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with clients. * Demonstrated performance as an engineer and consultant managing complex projects in various enterprise environments * Excellent time management, prioritization, problem solving, and decision\-making skills in a fast\-paced, agile environment * Problem\-solving and team management skills with a focus on delivering high\-quality results. **Additional Information** * While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, sit, talk, hear and use hands and fingers to operate a computer * Ability to sit at a computer terminal for an extended period * Light to moderate lifting is required * Ability to use a ladder is required * Valid driver’s license and ability to travel by air and rental car. * Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer / Technical Lead
jobs.description: Going helps more than 2 million members travel more for less. We find exceptional flight deals, from mistake fares to deep discounts, and get them to members before they disappear. Our membership has grown on one promise: we save you money on the trips you actually want to take. We are a small, fully remote team with outsized reach. Every engineer's work lands in front of millions of travelers, often the same week it ships. Now we're rebuilding how we build: simplifying our platform, raising our quality bar, and using AI where it measurably makes a small team faster. We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer / Technical Lead for our flight data platform: streaming ingestion with Kafka, normalizing and merging flight offers across providers, an S3 data lake (Parquet, Iceberg), and the Elasticsearch cache that serves the prices and deals members see. You'll also own our current deal\-detection system until the new platform replaces it. This role is half technical lead, half business owner. You'll own the platform's technical strategy and know what's being worked on, why it matters, and who's doing it. You'll also own its outcomes with the business: setting goals, reporting what moved and why, and deciding what we do next alongside Product, Marketing, Operations and Analytics. * **Reports to:** Director of Engineering * **Location:** Remote (US time zones) **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own the platform end to end.** Own the architecture, reliability and roadmap of our data platform, from Kafka ingestion through the lakehouse to the services that consume it. Make the key technical calls, know which to delegate, and keep the platform's contributors and the other team leads aligned through design docs and code review. * **Be the business's data partner.** Own your team's goals. Plan initiatives anyone in the company can understand, report progress and learnings at our cross\-functional metrics meeting, and bring a cause and a proposed path when something is off track. * **Use AI with judgment.** Use coding agents and LLM tools where they make you and the platform's contributors faster, verify what they produce, and help set the review and testing standards for AI\-generated pipeline code and SQL. * **Make the data trustworthy.** Build the validation, monitoring and alerting that catch bad data before members do, and lead the response when something slips through. * **Design for change.** Build source\-agnostic models so we can add or replace data providers without breaking consumers, and make replay and backfill routine instead of risky. Know what the platform costs, where it's slow, and what we can remove. Start simple and earn complexity. * **Partner with Data Science and Analytics.** Make it easy for them to build on reliable data, from dashboards and models to AI\-powered member features. **What you know** ----------------- **Required:** * You’re legally authorized to work in the United States and able to work US\-hours. * **An experienced data engineer.** 6\+ years in data engineering, including 2\+ years as the technical lead for a production data system: owning its technical direction and driving decisions with the engineers around it. * **A technical lead, not a manager.** You stay hands\-on in the code and drive technical decisions without needing to make all of them yourself. * **An owner of outcomes.** You want to own goals with the business, explain why numbers moved, and propose what to do next. * **A systems thinker.** You reason clearly about trade\-offs between scalability, reliability, cost, and complexity, and you can explain them to people who aren't data engineers. * **AI\-pragmatic in practice.** You use coding agents and LLM tools daily, know where they help and where they fail, and verify their output. You've helped other team members adopt them. * **A strong data modeler.** You design models that are source\-agnostic and evolve without breaking their consumers. * **Fluent in streaming.** You understand Kafka (or similar), delivery semantics, idempotency, and how to replay and backfill safely. * **Lakehouse\-literate.** You understand Iceberg (or Delta/Hudi), catalogs, and distributed query engines, and how they behave at scale. * **Strong in Python and SQL.** Python is the primary language of our data platform. * **A clear remote communicator.** You write well, work async effectively, and can turn a technical incident into a plain\-English update. **Preferred:** * Experience in flights or travel: airfare data, GDSs, NDC, metasearch, OTAs, or airline retailing * Experience with pricing, alerting, or real\-time data pipelines * Subscription or membership business experience, including experimentation and A/B testing * Hands\-on experience with some of our stack: AWS (S3, Glue Data Catalog, EKS), Confluent Cloud (Kafka, Schema Registry, Avro), Apache Iceberg and Parquet, Starburst (Trino), Elasticsearch, Postgres and Redis, Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog, and Ruby on Rails (our primary backend framework) * Experience supporting data science, ML, or LLM\-powered features, including building or operating LLM\-powered pipeline steps (e.g., enrichment, matching, or data\-quality checks) and evaluating their output * Took a data platform through a major migration or simplification (e.g., consolidating systems or moving to managed services) **Why you might love working here** ----------------------------------- * The salary for this role is $165,000 \+ equity * 100% remote work environment * Annual team retreats, with past destinations including Asheville, Scottsdale, Washington D.C., Vancouver, and Mexico City * Open vacation policy, with a 15\-day minimum * Comprehensive health, vision, dental, and life insurance * 401(k) with a 5% match * $750/quarter remote work, wellness, and wisdom stipend * Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave * Meetup stipend when you cross paths with a co\-worker * Continuing education \& development reimbursement * Challenging problems to solve and an awesome team to collaborate with every single day *We want you to bring your authentic self to work every single day. We accept you for who you are and consider everyone on an equal opportunity basis without regard to ancestry; age; appearance; color; gender identity and/or expression; genetics; family or parental status; marital, civil union, or domestic partnership status; mental, physical, or sensory disability; national, social or ethnic origin; past or present military service; sexual orientation; socioeconomic status; race; religion or belief; hair length; organ donor status.
