jobs.title: ASIC CAD IP Engineer, Cloud TPU
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 4 years of experience with managing vendor engagements and library delivery schedules in an ASIC design environment. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering with an emphasis on VLSI, physical design, or EDA methodologies. * 3 years of experience in ASIC CAD/design enablement, foundation IP quality assurance, or physical implementation in advanced foundry nodes (e.g., TSMC). * Experience with library validation and compilation tools (e.g., Siemens Solido Crosscheck, Synopsys Library Compiler) across standard cell, memory, or macro libraries. * Experience in building physical design flows or working on physical design convergence * Track record of building automated scripts or release pipelines that standardize third\-party collateral and prevent downstream design issues. * Interest in expanding technical scope across physical design flows, methodology automation, and custom silicon implementation. **About the job** ----------------- In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting\-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML\-driven systems. Every custom Google Cloud Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) begins with its physical building blocks—foundry Process Design Kits (PDKs), standard cell libraries, high\-speed memories, and specialized third\-party Intellectual Property (IP). As an Application\-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) Computer\-Aided Design (CAD) IP Engineer, you will sit at the intersection of external semiconductor ecosystems and Google's Artificial Intelligence (AI) hardware tapeouts. Rather than managing silicon collateral manually, you will engineer automated Python and Tcl validation pipelines that transform foundry and vendor deliveries into clean, unified, production\-ready releases. Your automation and quality gates directly safeguard multi\-billion\-transistor TPU schedules, catching cross\-view discrepancies before they reach physical implementation and signoff. Because you will partner with Physical Design, Static Timing Analysis (STA), CAD Methodology, and foundry partners, this role offers an end\-to\-end view of advanced\-node chip execution—with direct mentorship and room to grow your ownership across Google's silicon infrastructure. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $138000 \- $197000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Coordinate incoming library and IP releases from foundry and EDA partners, building automated Python and Tcl workflows to ingest, standardize, and deploy deliverables across TPU projects ahead of project milestones. * Drive automated integrity checks and multi\-view library validation across timing, power, physical, and layout views (.lib, .db, .ndm, .lef, .gds) using QA tools such as Siemens Solido Crosscheck, alongside Logic Equivalency Checking (LEC) via Synopsys Formality or Cadence Conformal to verify functional consistency across revisions. * Collaborate with Physical Design, STA, and CAD engineers to compile libraries, debug cross\-view integration issues, and ensure smooth execution from early bring\-up through tapeout. * Develop physical design PnR flows on leading technology nodes. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Applied ML and Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in software development. * 5 years of experience with ML design and end\-to\-end Machine Learning (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging). * 5 years of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field. * Experience in system design, system architecture, distributed systems, software engineering, and full\-stack development. * Experience with Generative AI (e.g., Large Language Models (LLMs), diffusion models), development workflows, and use cases. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * 8 years of experience with data structures/algorithms. * 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction. * 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross\-functional, or cross\-business projects. * Experience with the latest GenAI techniques and methodologies. * Experience in Ads, or high\-volume quality systems * Product intuition with an ability for efficient hypothesis testing and iteration. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. Ask Advisor leverages agentic AI to deliver a multimodal support experience for advertisers navigating complex journeys across Google and external websites. By translating Agentic AI and UI control into a tangible offering, Ask Advisor enables AI to diagnose issues, plan resolutions, act autonomously on behalf of advertisers, and escalate to human representatives across Marketing, Sales, and Support. Featured during keynote presentations at Google Marketing Live (GML), Ask Advisor is a project that shapes the future of our marketing, sales, and support experiences. jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: The Company: **Serving the People Who Serve the People** Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn. Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud\-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe. Want to know more? See more of what we do here. Job Summary: **Position Summary** -------------------- The Senior DevOps Engineer is an advanced engineering position responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting automation, deployment, monitoring, and operational reliability across cloud and hosted application environments. This role partners closely with software engineering, site reliability, security, infrastructure, and architecture teams to improve continuous integration and continuous delivery processes, infrastructure automation, platform operations, and service resilience across increasingly complex environments and delivery pipelines. The successful candidate will demonstrate deep hands\-on experience with DevOps practices, cloud infrastructure, systems administration, automation, and troubleshooting, along with the ability to independently lead complex technical efforts from planning through implementation. This position is intended for senior engineers who are expected to apply advanced technical judgment and drive significant improvements in platform reliability and efficiency by applying AI across CI/CD, observability, incident response, and infrastructure designing and operation—optimizing builds and pipelines; detecting and diagnosing failures faster; using predictive insights to spot anomalies and bottlenecks; and recommending cost and resource\-utilization improvements, while also providing technical leadership, mentoring, and day\-to\-day guidance to other engineers. The role includes leadership of complex projects and technical workstreams, coordination across teams, and influence over engineering practices and delivery outcomes.**Career Growth and Work Environment** -------------------------------------- This is a senior individual contributor position intended for engineers who operate with a high degree of independence, advanced technical judgment, and strong technical leadership capability. The Senior DevOps Engineer is expected to lead complex technical work, drive meaningful platform and operational improvements, influence engineering direction, mentor other engineers, and serve as a trusted technical leader across DevOps, cloud operations, automation, and reliability initiatives. This is a full\-time position and may include participation in a rotational on\-call support model. The role may support systems and environments critical to business operations and therefore requires strong adherence to established operational, security, and compliance standards, along with a willingness to take ownership of complex issues, improve documentation and process maturity, guide less experienced engineers, and lead technical initiatives that strengthen delivery and operational effectiveness. While this role includes technical leadership and mentoring responsibilities; it does not include formal HR people management. **Security Requirement:** Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program. What Your Impact Will Look Like: **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own and support software delivery activities, including build, deployment, release, and environment management processes across multiple complex applications and infrastructure environments. * Design, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines used to build, test, secure, and deploy applications with greater efficiency, consistency, resiliency, and scalability. * Architect, provision, configure, and maintain infrastructure in cloud and hosted environments using automati timization, and reliability engineering). * Mentor engineers and lead initiatives to scale AI capabilities, frameworks, and best practices. * Have experience using Python (or similar) to build operational tools with guardrails. Pay Range: USD $128,000\.00 \- USD $165,000\.00 /Yr. About Us: Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit! **Security and Privacy Requirements*** Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program. * Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies. **The Team*** We are a remote\-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand. **The Culture*** At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to be a part of our journey. * A few culture highlights include – Employee Resource Groups to encourage diverse voices * Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important and sometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work\-life balance and current affairs. * Microsoft Teams communities focused on wellness, art, furbabies, family, parenting, and more. * We bring in special guests from time to time to discuss issues that impact our employee population **The Impact*** We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here. The Benefits: At Granicus, we offer a **comprehensive and flexible benefits package** designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance—starting from day one. Here’s what you can expect as a U.S.\-based team member: **Flexibility \& Balance** * **Flexible Time Off –** Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and live your life. * **Company\-Wide Wellbeing Days –** Paid days off to unplug and focus on your mental health. * **Work From Home Reimbursement –** Support a productive home office environment. **Health \& Wellness** * **Multiple Health Plan Options –** Including a 100% employer\-paid plan. * **Employer HSA Contributions –** When enrolled in a High\-Deductible Health Plan. * **Fitness Reimbursement Program –** Stay active, your way. * **On\-Demand Mental Health Support –** Access to Headspace and other wellness tools. **Family \& Future** * **Paid Parental Leave –** For both birthing and non\-birthing parents. * **Traditional \& Roth 401(k) –** With a generous company match. * **Life \& AD\&D Insurance –** 100% employer\-paid coverage for peace of mind. **Growth \& Recognition** * **Online Learning Platforms –** Fuel your professional development. * **Competitive Salary \& Bonuses –** Your contributions are valued and rewarded. Equal Opportunity Employer: Granicus is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants and employees will be considered for employment and advancement without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, age, genetic information, sexual or affectional orientation, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, familial status, military or veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Engineer, Machine Learning
jobs.description: Great Lakes Cheese is beginning an AI\-enabled decision intelligence journey. We will invest deliberately, validate value through focused use cases and use successful outcomes to guide future investment. In this role, you will translate that strategy into production\-ready solutions in partnership with business and technology teams. You will build AI agents, automation and predictive models on data from SAP ECC, SAP BW, MES and our plant operations. You will work directly with plant, supply chain, quality, finance and HR leaders. Your work will improve how we make cheese: yield, quality, planning and the daily decisions behind them.This is a builder role with meaningful ownership. You will contribute to the standards, patterns and tools used by future hires and the existing data team. You will also share practical knowledge as the team expands from on\-premises BI into cloud and AI engineering. **Job Responsibilities** ------------------------ **AI and agentic solutions** * Develop, test, and integrate production AI and agentic solutions using large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, machine learning frameworks and, where appropriate, coordinated agent workflows to support process automation. * Build AI agents with Claude (API, Agent SDK, MCP, Skills) and Microsoft Copilot (Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI Foundry) that connect securely to SAP, MES and Microsoft 365 data. * Automate repetitive, high\-volume work across finance, supply chain, quality, HR and IT with Python, APIs and low\-code tools. * Build, test, and integrate machine learning capabilities across manufacturing use cases such as yield and giveaway optimization, demand forecasting, quality prediction, downtime analysis and predictive maintenance. **Model lifecycle, governance and adoption** * Execute model selection benchmarks, performance, validation, and knowledge retrieval optimizations to implement reliable AI models and support organizational governance standards. * Set up evaluation, monitoring and guardrails for accuracy, cost, security, data privacy and responsible AI use. * Document best practices for version control, CI/CD pipelines, testing protocols, and agent templates to ensure consistent quality and knowledge sharing across projects. **Partnership and enablement** * Build functional prototypes for assigned use cases, evaluate performance against established parameters, and transition successful models into production. * Share reusable Python, cloud and AI engineering practices with the existing SAP BW and database team through documentation, pairing and solution reviews. * Help evaluate vendors, tools and platforms, and present results to business leaders in plain language. **Required Education and Experience** ------------------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in computer science (required). * Two years of professional experience in software, data or ML engineering, including meaningful hands\-on experience building and deploying AI, ML or LLM\-based solutions. * Strong Python skills (must\-have): production\-quality code, pandas/PySpark, REST APIs, packaging, testing and debugging. * AI agents and copilots: Hands\-on experience building AI agents or copilots using one or more enterprise AI platforms or frameworks, such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, LangGraph, LangChain or LlamaIndex. Experience should include tool integration, orchestration and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Demonstrated experience designing and deploying agent workflows with tool use, orchestration, memory where appropriate and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * AI frameworks and LLMOps tooling: familiarity with observability, tracing, prompt management, evaluation and model\-hosting tools such as Langfuse or Hugging Face. * Automation track record: automated business or IT processes end to end and can show the time or cost saved. * RAG and LLM engineering: embeddings, vector search, chunking strategy, prompt design and evaluation, working knowledge of Hugging Face models and libraries. * Machine learning fundamentals: regression, classification, time\-series forecasting and model validation with scikit\-learn, PyTorch or similar. * Strong SQL and experience working with large enterprise datasets. * Infrastructure and platform: Foundational knowledge of cloud AI and data platforms, such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Foundry, with exposure to compute, storage, networking, environment management and cost monitoring. * Ability to explain technical results to non\-technical business users and plant teams. **Preferred Education and Experience** -------------------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in computer science (required). * Two years of professional experience in software, data or ML engineering, including meaningful hands\-on experience building and deploying AI, ML or LLM\-based solutions. * Strong Python skills (must\-have): production\-quality code, pandas/PySpark, REST APIs, packaging, testing and debugging. * AI agents and copilots: Hands\-on experience building AI agents or copilots using one or more enterprise AI platforms or frameworks, such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, LangGraph, LangChain or LlamaIndex. Experience should include tool integration, orchestration and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Demonstrated experience designing and deploying agent workflows with tool use, orchestration, memory where appropriate and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * AI frameworks and LLMOps tooling: familiarity with observability, tracing, prompt management, evaluation and model\-hosting tools such as Langfuse or Hugging Face. * Automation track record: automated business or IT processes end to end and can show the time or cost saved. * RAG and LLM engineering: embeddings, vector search, chunking strategy, prompt design and evaluation, working knowledge of Hugging Face models and libraries. * Machine learning fundamentals: regression, classification, time\-series forecasting and model validation with scikit\-learn, PyTorch or similar. * Strong SQL and experience working with large enterprise datasets. * Infrastructure and platform: Foundational knowledge of cloud AI and data platforms, such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Foundry, with exposure to compute, storage, networking, environment management and cost monitoring. * Ability to explain technical results to non\-technical business users and plant teams. **Working Conditions** ---------------------- * Occasional exposure to industrial operations including: temperature extremes from approximately 35ºF to 100ºF; noise levels in excess of 85 dB; moisture and moving machinery. * Work is performed in an office setting. **EEOC \& Disclaimer** ---------------------- Great Lakes Cheese is an Equal Opportunity Employer \- Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities.

jobs.title: AI Builder - Sales Tools
jobs.description: Groupon connects 42 million customers with local experiences \- restaurants, events, wellness and travel \- and the million\-plus merchants who deliver them. Our mission is to get people offline and into the real world at prices that make it possible. We're an AI\-native company in the middle of a platform transformation, moving from a deals marketplace to an experience discovery platform that works for customers and merchants at the same time. **Senior AI Builder, Sales Tools** ================================== **About the Role** ================== Groupon's North American and international sales teams sign and grow the local merchants who power our marketplace. The tools they use every day decide how much selling actually happens: who to call next, how to reach them, what to say, and what happened afterward. Today that stack mixes third\-party software with AI tools we built in\-house. You will own it end to end and, as it matures, extend into the tools merchants use to run their business on Groupon. This is an AI builder role. You don't write tickets and wait, and you don't hand\-write SQL or code either: your agents write it, and you read it well enough to know when it's wrong. You run a fleet of coding and data agents (Claude Code or similar) that pull the data, build the tool, instrument it, and test it. Your job is to decide what to build, direct the agents, judge whether the output is right, and get it into reps' hands in days, not quarters. Product passion means you care about the rep's day more than the stack: you ship what makes selling easier, and you measure it. You will have the model budget, agent access to our sales and marketplace data, and permission to ship to reps from your first week. This is a high\-leverage seat: one builder, a fleet of agents, and the reps who use what you ship a desk away. You report to the SVP of Global Operations, work day to day with Sales leadership, and hand what works to shared engineering and data teams to harden and scale. Groupon is rebuilding itself as an AI\-native company. In 2025 we returned to growth in both billings and revenue for the first time in a decade, with $1\.7B in gross billings and 16\.2M active customers, and our CEO has publicly committed to embedding AI agents into every function. **What You'll Do** ================== * Build the tools our sales reps and managers use every day: prioritization, prospecting and outreach, calling and email, coaching, and account alerts. Build them with agents, not with a backlog. * Ship your first working tool to reps within your first two weeks, then ship every week after that. Sit with the sales teams, shadow calls, and kill what reps don't use. * Put AI agents inside the product: rank who to call, draft the outreach, coach the manager, summarize the account. Build the evals that prove each one helps, and retire the ones that don't. * Own the numbers: rep productivity, contact rates, tool adoption, and revenue per rep, with decisions made on clean experiments. * Decide what we build and what we buy across the sales stack, on top of our CRM. With agents, build is often the faster answer; you prove it case by case, including who maintains it. * Turn what you build into agents and playbooks that reps and managers run themselves. **Basic Qualifications** ======================== * 2\+ years building and shipping software products, as a product manager, engineer, or founder. * You build with AI coding agents every day (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) and have shipped software real users depend on that way, end to end, without an engineering team doing it for you, at work or on your own. * Your agents write your SQL and analysis, and you can read what they wrote: you catch the bad join, the double\-counted metric, or the experiment that can't answer the question before it reaches a decision. * You have shipped at least one LLM feature measured with evals, not demos. * A track record of moving a business metric through experiments you designed and instrumented, with results you can quantify. * Experience building products for a sales, support, or operations workforce, or on top of a CRM. **Process:** ============ * Recruiter Screen * Case study * Interview loop * reference checks * Offer Interviews include a live session where you build with agents; we provide the tools. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Shipped LLM or agentic features into production: ranking, assistants, multi\-step agents with tool use, MCP or similar orchestration. * Experience with Salesforce and sales engagement platforms. * Experience in a marketplace, local commerce, or SMB\-facing business, including self\-service products for merchants or customers. **Compensation and Location** ============================= For New York, NY\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $175,000 to USD $225,000 per year. For Chicago/Dallas, TX\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $160,000 to USD $205,000 per year. You will be eligible to participate in Groupon's annual bonus program, and may be offered an equity award and other types of compensation. You will also be eligible for benefits including medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, and paid time off. This role is hybrid and is not eligible for fully remote work. You will spend at least half of your time in our Chicago, Dallas or New York office, alongside the sales teams you build for. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. **Equal Opportunity** ===================== Groupon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Groupon will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records consistent with applicable law, including the New York City Fair Chance Act. Accommodations may be available based on religious and/or medical conditions, or as required by applicable law. To request an accommodation, contact \[accommodations email]. **Groupon** **is an AI\-First Company** We're committed to building smarter, faster, and more innovative ways of working and AI plays a key role in how we get there. We encourage candidates to **leverage AI tools** during the hiring process where it adds value, and we're always keen to hear how technology improves the way you work. If you're passionate about AI or curious to explore how it can elevate your role **you'll be right at home here.** Groupon's purpose is to build strong communities through thriving small businesses. To learn more about the world's largest local e\-commerce marketplace, click here. You can also find out more about us in the latest Groupon news as well as learning about our DEI approach. If all of this sounds like something that's a great fit for you, then click apply and join us on a mission to become the ultimate destination for local experiences and services. **Beware of Recruitment Fraud:** Groupon follows a merit\-based recruitment process without charging job seekers any fees. We've noticed an increase in recruitment fraud, including fake job postings and fraudulent interviews and job offers aimed at stealing personal information or money. Be cautious of individuals falsely representing Groupon's Talent Acquisition team with fake job offers. If you encounter any suspicious job offers or interview calls demanding money, recognize these as scams. Groupon is not responsible for losses from such dealings. For legitimate job openings (and a sneak peek into life at Groupon), always check our official career website at Groupon Careers

jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer, Agentic Security
jobs.description: ### **Who We Are \& What We Do** At Helix, our mission is simple: to help everyone improve their lives through their DNA. Ready to make a real\-world impact with your skills? At Helix, we're transforming healthcare by making genomics a standard of care. We partner with health systems and life science companies to accelerate the integration of genomic data into clinical practice. Join us in building a future where healthcare is personalized, proactive, and powered by genomics.### **Your Career Path \& Development** We are committed to your long\-term growth. We invest in you through:* Cutting\-Edge AI Tooling: We equip our engineers to innovate at speed. You'll have full access to GitHub Copilot, frontier models (like Claude and OpenAI), Gemini, and other new tools as they emerge, all supported by our dedicated internal AI team. * Continuous Learning: Sharpen your skills with full access to the entire Udemy learning database. * Internal Mentorship: Learn from experts across our global team through tech demos, pair programming, and collaborative projects. * Clear Advancement: We provide a framework for you to grow from one role to the next, with clear expectations and support from your manager. * Travel: Opportunities to travel to the US for collaboration with our global teams. **What Is Special About This Role?** Genomic data is some of the most sensitive data there is, and protecting it is central to everything Helix does. As the company grows and threats evolve faster, we believe security engineering is becoming agentic: autonomous systems find, validate, and fix vulnerabilities, and engineers review and approve the results. The goal is for agents to triage and validate critical vulnerabilities, propose fixes, run tests, and open pull requests for engineer review. We will expand what agents can do as their results show they are reliable. The same approach extends to our cloud infrastructure, code, and security operations, with agents that harden systems, verify configurations, detect threats, and respond to incidents. This role builds those systems. It's hands\-on: most days you'll be directing agents and shipping systems across application security, infrastructure security, and the emerging field of Agentic Security. What success looks like: * Critical vulnerabilities are validated and remediated against targets set from an agreed baseline, with engineers reviewing and approving each fix. * Cloud infrastructure is hardened and continuously verified, and drift is caught and corrected automatically. * Code and CI/CD pipelines are secure by default, with controls enforced automatically. * Agents take on more autonomy as their evals and track record support it. **As a Staff Security Engineer, Agentic Security, you will:** * Architect and build an agentic vulnerability defense platform that finds, validates, and fixes vulnerabilities at machine speed, designed so engineering teams can extend it with their own context and evals. Apply agents offensively to test our defenses continuously. * Harden and continuously verify our cloud infrastructure, including identity, network, and workload security, with automation that detects and corrects drift. * Build durable security controls across source control and CI/CD that scale as the company grows. * Build guardrails that keep autonomous agents safe, including least privilege, audit\-ready logging, human approval, and rigorous evals. Expand what agents can do on their own as their track record supports it. * Encode security expertise into the skills, rules, and context that engineers' coding agents use, so they write secure code by default. * Automate security operations with continuous agents that detect, investigate, and respond across code and cloud. Take part in incident response. * Delegate implementation to agents, running many in parallel with clear specs and context, then critically evaluate the output for correctness, security, and production\-readiness. * Evaluate and champion new AI tools and workflows, and create reusable patterns that help security and engineering teams use AI well. * Lead cross\-functional Security and Engineering initiatives to define and adopt standards for agentic security. Coach engineers on applying those standards. * Drive priority vulnerability remediation to closure. * Mentor engineers on secure agent design and operation. **About you:** * BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of professional experience in software, infrastructure, or security engineering, including significant hands\-on cloud or application security work. * 2\+ years building with LLMs and agentic systems. You've designed, shipped, and operated multi\-agent systems in production, and you have strong opinions about evals, guardrails, and how agents fail. * Daily, hands\-on use of AI coding harnesses (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) as the core of your development workflow. * Deep fluency in Python and Go, enough to r r models and security tooling as they become available. * **Ownership:** You'll build a new platform from the ground up and decide how Helix uses agents to protect genomic data. * **Influence:** You'll work directly with security and engineering leadership and help shape how engineers across Helix use agents safely. * **Growth:** A clear advancement framework with a path toward Principal\-level scope. ### **What We Offer: A Commitment to Your Success** We take care of our team with benefits that provide flexibility and support for your growth—what we call *prestaciones superiores a las de la ley.** Competitive Compensation: A strong base salary plus an annual performance bonus. + Expected Helix Base: $126,417\-$170,980 MXN/monthly + Expected Helix Discretionary Annual Bonus: 10% of your annual salary * Comprehensive Health: 100% employer\-paid premium for our Bronze Family Health Insurance plan, with eligibility from your first day. * Allowances \& Stipends: + Home Office Stipend: we will reimburse up to $500 USD for essential workspace items, so you are fully equipped to perform your best. + Phone Allowance: 700 MXP monthly. + In\-Office Perks: 80 MXP daily for transport and 250 MXP daily for snacks on office days. + Generous Time Off: Flexible vacation policy plus all national holidays. * Hybrid \& Remote Flexibility: + Hybrid: Our office is located at WeWork \- Varsovia, Mexico City. We gather intentionally in our office space once per week to work on things like pair programming/live collaboration, skillshare sessions, social segments, team lunches, and volunteering opportunities. Juárez, Cuauhtémoc, CDMX. + Remote (for team members living 80 km or more outside Mexico City): We'll invite you to our CDMX office 3\-6 times a year for key training and team meetings. These visits are a great chance to connect in person and strengthen our Helix community. Helix cover travel and accommodation. **Expected Interview Process:** 1\) Recruiter Screen 2\) Manager Screen 3\) Technical Sessions (including AI\-centric exercises) 4\) Executive Interview 5\) Offer### **What To Expect During Your Onboarding Week:** We want to make sure your first week is spent learning the foundations. You will be invited to live orientation sessions and spend time with your hiring manager developing your individual roadmap to success. This experience will include sessions that cover your benefits, security \& privacy training, an introduction to the OKR framework used at Helix and our communication tools and norms.### **What To Expect During Your First 90 days:** First 1 \- 5 days: You’ll spend time learning the Helix way, completing training and onboarding for your roles, and getting introduced to your team and relevant stakeholders. You’ll also gain a deeper understanding of our customers, our products, the impact we make in the lives of our communities, and how to thrive at Helix through participation in Helix U. Day 6 \- 30: You’ll spend time contributing to projects, deeply familiarizing yourself with team and company processes, and developing a deeper understanding of Helix’s products, services and capabilities. Day 31 \- 90: You’ll build your OKRs with your manager, start to take ownership of projects and initiatives on your team, and begin to demonstrate your impact on the Helix mission.#### **To learn how Helix collects, uses, and protects your personal information during the recruitment process, please review our Privacy Notice.** #### ***Helix is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.***

jobs.title: Platform Analyst, Talent Engineer
jobs.description: **About HOF Capital** HOF Capital is a global multi\-stage venture capital firm that partners with the world’s best founders and helps them build generational category\-defining technology companies. Since launching its first fund in 2016, the firm has invested in some of the most successful technology startups of the past decade (e.g., SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI, Neuralink, xAI, etc.) and achieved top\-tier investment performance throughout its history, which has enabled the firm to grow rapidly to \~$13B of assets under management (AUM). HOF’s LPs include many of the world’s leading institutions and business owners. Beyond capital, our platform team gives founders what they need to win, from customer introductions to top talent. **The role** You will build HOF’s community of early\-career engineers, researchers, operators, and students. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you know what separates an ML researcher from an infrastructure engineer from a hardware engineer, and what each kind of company actually needs. Or you’re curious enough to learn it fast. You use that to put the right people in front of the right portfolio companies. Engineers trust you because you take the time to understand their work, and they show up to your events because they’re worth their time: intimate dinners, and technical talks with brilliant minds, not mixers with name tags. You’ll work side by side with our investment team, and some of the people you meet will become the founders we back. **What you will own** * **The talent network.** Build and maintain a standing network of high\-potential engineers, researchers and students, organized by discipline (ML, infrastructure, embedded and hardware, product engineering, etc.) and seniority. Get to know them individually and personally so you know when they’re likely to move and can match them to the right opportunity. * **Student and university relationships.** Identify and build lasting relationships with top programs and student\-led clubs through treks, sponsorships, and other events. Use those relationships to place students and new grads in internships and first jobs across the portfolio, and to fill every recruiting event we host with the most relevant engineers. * **Engineering community events.** Plan events engineers actually want to attend, from small dinners and poker nights to hackathons. Build each guest list around portfolio companies and roles behind the event, run it with the investment team, and follow up so every event leaves behind relationships worth keeping. * **Deal signal.** The best founders often come out of your network. Spot the engineers and researchers who are about to leave and build something, and make sure HOF is the first call. You’ll work closely with our investors, and for the right person, this grows into sourcing deals alongside them. * **Portfolio hiring support.** Take in engineering and intern searches from portfolio companies, work directly with the founder on what the role actually requires, get them in a room with the best\-fit candidates, and manage our recruiting partners on searches we can’t fill directly. * **Founder and deal support.** Help founders build their early technical teams, and help the investment team show founders what HOF can do for them on hiring. * **Systems and reporting.** Design how the network runs: how candidates and searches are tracked, what gets measured (placements, event conversion, network growth), and how results are reported to the team. **What we are looking for** * **An eye for exceptional people.** You can spot the person in the room who’s going to be great before their resume says so, and you can explain why. * **A natural connector.** You get real satisfaction from introducing two people who should know each other, and the introductions you make tend to turn into something. * **You’ve built a community, not just joined one.** You started, led, or grew a talent community people actually wanted to be part of, such as a student club, hackathon, builder group, or online community. You can point to what it became because of you. * **Taste for events.** You know what engineers want to show up to, and you’ve run something people talked about afterward. * **A working map of engineering.** You know how engineering breaks down, across ML, infrastructure, hardware, and product, well enough to know who fits where. Or you’re curious enough to learn it fast. A technical background helps but isn’t required. * **Relentless follow\-through.** You’re organized and follow\-up\-heavy. Nobody you meet falls through the cracks. * **Early in your career.** 0 to 2 years of experience in any field. What you’ve built matters more than where you’ve worked. HOF Capital is a global multi\-stage venture capital (VC) firm that partners with the world's best founders and helps them build generational category\-defining technology companies. Since launching its first fund in 2016, the firm has invested in some of the most successful technology startups of the past decade (e.g., SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI, Neuralink, xAI, etc.) and achieved top\-tier investment performance throughout its history, which has enabled the firm to grow rapidly to \~$15B of assets under management (AUM). Pay: $100000\.00 \- $140000\.00 / year Pay: * Bonus pay Benefits: * Paid time off * Health insurance * Dental insurance * Vision insurance Job Type: fulltime Schedule: * 12 hour shift * Weekend availability * Monday to Friday * On call * Overtime Education: High school degree Work location: On\-site New York / San Francisco. 1/2 Bond St, New York, NY, 10012

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: MEDHOST is hiring for a Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI to join their team! The Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI is a senior\-level engineering position that builds and owns AI\-powered systems, features, and development workflows for IBM i enterprise applications. Applied AI — as distinct from AI research — is the practical implementation and deployment of AI technologies to solve real\-world problems in production: integrating existing models and frameworks (such as IBM Bob, LLMs, and agent toolchains) into working software, building reliably and scaliably, and focusing on measurable business outcomes rather than advancing theoretical algorithms. This engineer bridges the gap between data science and software engineering, taking AI from concept to deployed, maintainable production reality. The role requires deep IBM i expertise — particularly in Db2 for i SQL (schema design, query optimization, stored procedures, and data modeling) and solid RPGLE/CL engineering — combined with the ability to direct AI tools across the full development lifecycle: from specification drafting and AI code generation through testing, debugging, documentation, and modernization. The engineer authors precise technical specifications that drive AI code generation, reviews and validates AI\-produced outputs, and integrates approved solutions into production with full engineering accountability. This is not a traditional write\-code\-from\-scratch role. It is an engineering role for someone who thinks at the level of technical architecture and specification, uses AI to accelerate and scale implementation, and applies rigorous human judgment to ensure every AI\-generated artifact meets quality, security, and compliance standards before it reaches production. **WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT:** Most software engineers write code. In this role, you apply Applied AI — directing AI tools to generate, validate, and deploy that code — and your value comes from the precision of your specifications, the rigor of your review, and the depth of your IBM i expertise. You will spend more time crafting technical intent than typing syntax, more time validating AI reasoning than debugging from scratch, and more time building reusable AI\-driven workflows than executing repetitive tasks manually. If you are energized by working at the intersection of AI capability and engineering discipline, and you want to shape how an organization delivers software in an AI\-first world, this position is built for you. The remote role is eligible to anyone in the U.S. and Canada. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** **1\. AI\-Driven Technical Specification and Design** ----------------------------------------------------- * Author AI\-ready technical specifications — versioned Markdown documents precise enough for an AI agent to implement a feature with no additional explanation required from the author. * Define solution design, data flow, component boundaries, integration points, IBM i object structures, API contracts, and error\-handling rules in sufficient detail that AI can generate correct, production\-quality SQL (DDL, DML, stored procedures, triggers, and views), RPGLE, and CL. * Collaborate with Product Owners, UX designers, and QA from day one of each feature to ensure technical specs align with business intent and are testable end\-to\-end. * Contribute to Gate Reviews by presenting the technical approach, answering feasibility and risk questions from stakeholders and architects, and demonstrating technical viability through AI\-generated prototypes built from the spec. * Maintain specs under version control; freeze approved versions during the build phase and manage change control for spec updates that arise during implementation. **2\. Applied AI Code Generation, Review, and Validation** ---------------------------------------------------------- * Direct AI coding assistants (e.g., IBM Bob, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) to generate Db2 for i SQL (schemas, queries, stored procedures, views, and indexes), RPGLE, CL, and supporting artifacts from approved technical specifications — applying Applied AI principles to focus on production quality and maintainable outcomes. * Critically review, test, and validate all AI\-generated code — verifying correctness, security, performance, and conformance to IBM i engineering standards — before any output is integrated or promoted. * Use AI for code comprehension, impact analysis, and reverse\-engineering of existing legacy IBM i programs to produce current\-state technical documentation that supports modernization and change. * Leverage AI tools for automated unit test generation, test data preparation, and regression coverage across SQL routines, RPGLE service programs, and CL procedures. * Maintain human accountability for every promoted artifact: AI accelerates delivery; the engineer owns the result. **3\. Technical Leadership and IBM i Engineering Excellence** ------------------------------------------------------- ion, automated testing, and promotion to production. * Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, AI agent orchestration frameworks, or similar AI toolchain integration for IBM i or enterprise development environments. * Experience in Agile delivery, cross\-functional spec drafting teams (Product Owner / UX / QA / Tech Lead model), and distributed engineering teams. * Experience with IBM i modernization patterns — APIs, hybrid cloud integration, and ILE restructuring — using Applied AI\-assisted analysis and code generation. * Advanced Db2 for i experience: query plan analysis (Visual Explain), SQE optimizer hints, index advisor, SQL performance monitoring via QSYS2 plan cache views, and migration of legacy DDS\-based file access to modern SQL DDL and embedded SQL. * Experience building or contributing to an internal AI Center of Excellence, including creating reusable Applied AI patterns, skills, ADRs, or development standards. **Salary Range:** 90 \- 135k USD, annually **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE:** * AI generates a majority of implementation code; the engineer's time is invested in specification quality, architectural decisions, and rigorous validation — not repetitive coding tasks. * Technical specifications are precise enough that AI can implement a feature correctly without additional clarification from the author. * Applied AI\-generated code meets production quality standards on the first review pass due to specification depth and prompt precision. * Other engineers on the team measurably improve their Applied AI development practices as a result of mentoring and shared reusable AI assets. * As\-built specifications are accurate and version\-controlled, enabling future AI\-driven changes to proceed from a reliable baseline. * SQL and Db2 for i data\-layer artifacts (schemas, stored procedures, indexes, and queries) are well\-designed, optimized, and documented, reducing data\-access bottlenecks and providing a maintainable foundation for RPGLE and application\-layer code. DISCLAIMER This description outlines the basic tasks and requirements of the position and is not a comprehensive listing of all duties. Management reserves the right to modify duties and responsibilities as organizational needs evolve. **WHAT WE OFFER:** * Plenty of opportunities to grow your career * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits * 3 weeks of vacation plus 5 personal days to recharge * Employee stock ownership and RRSP program * A chance to give back through community involvement Flexible work arrangements to suit your lifestyle * **About us:** MEDHOST, founded in 1984 and headquartered in Franklin, Tennessee, is a leading provider of healthcare information technology solutions. Serving healthcare facilities nationwide, MEDHOST offers a comprehensive suite of products, including electronic health records (EHR), financial management systems, and patient engagement platforms. Their mission is to empower healthcare organizations to enhance patient care and improve business operations through innovative, user\-friendly solutions. In January 2024, MEDHOST was acquired by N. Harris Computer Corporation, further strengthening its position in the healthcare IT industry. **About Harris Computer:** Harris provides mission critical software solutions for the Public Sector, Healthcare, Utilities and Private Sector verticals throughout North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. Working for Harris is the perfect opportunity to fulfill your professional goals as well as achieve your personal dreams! Our employees enjoy a casual work environment that offers comfort while providing superior service to our customers. We offer a comprehensive benefit package as well as other additional “Perks”! * We empower our employees to make a difference * We have an award\-winning culture * We offer opportunity to learn * We are financially strong and we are owned by the largest software company in Canada (CSI) We have fun! * \#LI\-remote

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer – AI & Retail Transformation

The ideal candidate is a hands\-on technical leader who can work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering organizations to identify opportunities, define scalable solutions, and translate business challenges into measurable technology outcomes. Responsibilities****Technical Leadership \& Architecture:** * Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable, resilient, and high\-performance enterprise applications. * Define architectural patterns, engineering standards, and best practices across distributed systems and microservices. * Design and implement robust APIs and integrations across enterprise platforms using REST and GraphQL. * Drive technical roadmaps, architecture reviews, technology evaluations, and build\-versus\-buy decisions. * Identify opportunities to modernize legacy applications, simplify technology\-led transformation. * Present architectural recommendations, technical trade\-offs, and implementation strategies to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Connect business priorities applications, integrations, and distributed systems. * Strong understanding of AI transformation, generative AI, intelligent automation, or AI\-enabled enterprise solutions. * Experience working in consulting environments or partnering directly with senior business and technology stakeholders. * Proven ability to lead architecture decisions, influence multiple engineering teams, and mentor senior engineers. * Experience modernizing legacy systems and delivering scalable, secure, and reliable production applications. * Strong communication, problem\-solving, and executive stakeholder engagement skills. **Technical Skills****Backend \& Application Engineering*** Java, Spring Boot, Python, C\#/.NET, or comparable enterprise development technologies. * Microservices and distributed systems. * RESTful APIs, GraphQL, API design, and enterprise integrations. **Cloud \& Architecture*** Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform. * Enterprise application architecture and cloud\-native solutions. * Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform. **Data \& Integration*** SQL and relational databases, including PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and Oracle. * NoSQL databases and enterprise data integration. * Event\-driven architecture, Kafka, and message\-based integration patterns. * ETL/ELT concepts and enterprise data pipelines. **AI \& Intelligent Automation*** Generative AI, LLM integration, and AI\-enabled applications. * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and workflow automation. * Experience evaluating and integrating AI capabilities into enterprise systems. **Engineering Practices \& Tools*** CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Agile delivery. * Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps. * Application monitoring and observability tools such as New Relic, Dynatrace, or Azure Monitor. * Secure API design, OAuth 2\.0, SSO, and enterprise application security. **Preferred Qualifications*** jobs.title: Principal Engineer, AI Hardware and Silicon Technology
jobs.description: **Job Type:** Full\-Time l **Location** : San Francisco CA l **Department:** AI Infrastructure Supply Chain l **Reporting to:** Senior Manager, PLM \| **Work Location Type:** \#Hybrid IREN is a leading AI Cloud Service Provider, delivering large\-scale GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s vertically integrated platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid\-connected land and data centers in renewable\-rich regions across the U.S. and Canada. The **Principal Engineer, AI Hardware and Silicon Technology** owns IREN's independent technical view of the AI hardware market: evaluating GPUs, accelerators, and AI systems, building the integrated hardware roadmap, and providing the technical recommendation behind the sourcing strategy. Reporting to the VP, AI Infrastructure Supply Chain, this senior individual\-contributor role works with the CTO, CCO, and Supply Chain organization to build the technical requirements into the sourcing strategy. The role partners closely with Technical Sourcing, Engineering, Data Center Engineering, Network Engineering, Commercial, and Capital Markets to ensure IREN buys and builds for the right platforms at the right time. With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever\-evolving applications of high performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way \- responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in. * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred. * 12\+ years of experience in AI or high\-performance compute hardware, ideally at a silicon vendor, server OEM/ODM, hyperscaler, or large\-scale cloud provider. * Deep, current expertise in one hardware domain, ideally compute systems (GPU and accelerator architectures and the systems built around them), across more than one silicon vendor. * Working knowledge of the adjacent domains, including high\-performance networking (InfiniBand and Ethernet fabrics), memory, storage, optics, and data center power and cooling, with the ability to draw on IREN's Network and Data Center Engineering teams for depth in those areas. * Hands\-on experience benchmarking hardware against real training and inference workloads and building total\-cost\-of\-ownership models. * Proven experience interpreting supplier technical roadmaps under NDA and translating generation changes into schedule, purchasing, and fleet\-value implications. * Demonstrated independent judgment, with a track record of giving clear recommendations, including when they differ from a vendor's or a colleague's preference. * Strong executive presence and communication skills, with a track record of explaining technical trade\-offs plainly to senior executives, customers, and lenders, and of operating autonomously as a senior individual contributor in a fast\-moving business. * Own IREN's independent, evidence\-based view of the AI hardware landscape across GPUs, custom accelerators, and AI systems from all major and emerging silicon vendors. * Evaluate platforms end to end, comparing options on performance per workload, cost per unit of compute, power draw, software ecosystem maturity, supply availability, and expected useful life. * Build IREN's integrated hardware roadmap, in partnership with Technical Sourcing, CTO and CCO orgs: consolidate supplier technical roadmaps, gathered with Technical Sourcing, into a single view across GPU, CPU, memory, storage, networking, and optics, aligned to our build schedule, and give early warning of generation changes that affect our schedule or fleet value. * Provide the technical recommendation for major hardware purchases and allocations, developed jointly with Technical Sourcing and Engineering, and approved by the CTO and the VP, AI Infrastructure Supply Chain. * Define how IREN benchmarks and qualifies new hardware, including proof\-of\-concept and pilot deployments. * Partner with the CTO as the primary technical counterpart, ensuring recommendations are reviewed and approved independently of the commercial buying decision. * Define the hardware requirements of each platform, including rack power density, liquid and air cooling, floor loading, network topology, and redundancy, and partner with Data Center Engineering, which assesses fit against current and planned sites. * Draw on the Network and Data Center Engineering teams for depth in networking, optics, power, and cooling where they shape system choice. * Produce concise, decision\-ready papers and a regular hardware outlook for the CEO and senior leadership. * Serve as the hardware subject\-matter expert in selected customer and partner discussions, in support of Commercial. * Supply clear, defensible technical input on hardware life, obsolescence, and residual value for lender and investor materials, in support of Capital Markets. Other important requirements * Pre\-employment screening, including background check and substance testing may be required according to company policies. * This role involves frequent travel to silicon vendor, OEM/ODM, and data center sites, and industry events. * IREN does not yet have an office in the Bay Area (a Santa Clara office is planned); until it opens, this role will work remotely, transitioning to hybrid on\-site work once the office is established. jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, AI Productivity
jobs.description: **We're transforming the grocery industry** At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. **Instacart is a Flex First team** There’s no one\-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in\-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. **Overview** ------------ Instacart's AI Productivity team builds the AI\-powered platforms and tools that help our engineers and the broader R\&D organization move faster, reduce toil, and deliver higher\-quality experiences for customers, shoppers, retailers, and brand partners. We have been at the forefront of applied AI for years, and we move quickly: we prototype, ship, learn, and retire what is no longer the best answer. As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will set the direction for how AI changes the way Instacart builds products and software, and you will drive that change across the whole company. You will stay close to where the AI industry is heading, anticipate where the industry and Instacart will be 18 to 36 months from now, and turn that view into strategy, pilots, and adoption at scale. That means more work handled in the background by orchestrated, cost\-efficient, and compliant agents, so people can focus on the work that needs human judgment. This is a hands\-on, high\-visibility role. You will write code, partner with senior engineering and finance leadership, evaluate vendors and prototypes, and lead organizational change, including the cultural and people side of adoption. This position is remote\-friendly within North America. **About the Job** ----------------- * Define and drive the company\-wide strategy for AI\-assisted software and product development, anticipating where the industry and Instacart are headed over the next 18 to 36 months. * Lead adoption of AI tools and agentic workflows across engineering and R\&D, including company\-wide rollouts, and own the organizational change that comes with them: culture, learning, communication, and working through resistance. * Increase engineering throughput by growing the volume of background and parallel agentic work each person can handle, with high quality, strong safeguards, and clear cost controls. * Build and prototype hands\-on: lead large features, pilots, and proofs of concept that change how work gets done, and scale the ones that prove their value. * Define how we measure impact, moving beyond "are people using it?" to "are they using it effectively?", and report outcomes clearly to executive audiences. * Partner with engineering leaders, Security, Legal, and Finance to manage AI cost, security, and compliance as usage grows. * Evaluate vendors and emerging tools, deciding what to buy, what to build, and what to retire. * Mentor and influence senior engineers across all pillars, and represent AI productivity across the company through forums such as lunch\-and\-learns and brown bags. **About You** ------------- ### **Minimum Qualifications** * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production systems at scale. * Production experience with large language models at the frontier: you have shipped LLM\-powered capabilities in real products and understand what good inference engineering looks like. Using AI tools alone is not enough. * A track record of scaling AI beyond yourself to an entire organization, with measurable outcomes and a candid account of the organizational challenges you faced. * Experience navigating the business side of AI, including cost management, security and compliance, and vendor evaluation and procurement. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Track record of building and driving adoption of AI tools or platforms across an engineering organization of 500\+ engineers, not just a single team. * Experience measuring and communicating the impact of AI on developer productivity and throughput (for example, DORA/SPACE metrics, agent task volume, cycle time) to executive audiences. * Experience managing AI spend at scale, including cost modeling, budgeting, and optimization across models and vendors. * Hands\-on experience with agentic systems, including orchestrating background and parallel agents with strong safeguards. * Deep knowledge of AI safety, security, privacy, and compliance practices (for example, guardrails, PII handling, and data governance), and experience partnering with Security and Legal on them. * Experience fine\-tuning or adapting foundation models, and building retrieval and evaluation systems around them. * Demonstrated technical leadership and mentorship across multiple organizations, including influencing senior staff engineers, VPs, and C\-level leaders. \#LI\-Remote Instacart provides highly market\-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here. For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below. CA, NY, CT, NJ $304,000 \- $321,000 USD WA $292,000 \- $308,000 USD OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI $279,000 \- $294,500 USD All other states $254,000 \- $268,000 USD

jobs.description: **FSC Technical Support Engineer (Remote With Travel/Must be located with North America)** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Johnson Controls is seeking an FSC Technical Support Engineer to support advanced Metasys server installations, upgrades, migrations, and other complex server\-related activities. In this role, you will work closely with branch project teams, technicians, customers, and customer IT to help deliver reliable Metasys server outcomes and, when project demand allows, provide Level 2 BAS technical support through the Field Support Center. **Role Overview** ----------------- This position combines advanced BAS technical support with hands\-on Metasys server project execution. You will help assess project readiness, plan and deploy server solutions, resolve technical issues, validate completed systems, and provide technical handoff and training. The role requires a strong balance of technical depth, customer coordination, and disciplined project execution. Travel may vary based on workload and project demand, with approximately **50% travel anticipated, including occasional multi\-day onsite suppo**rt. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Plan and execute new Metasys ADS/ADX installations, upgrades, migrations, and server replacements. * Support complex Metasys server environments, including SQL Server, Split ADX, MVE, virtualization, redundancy/high availability, cloud\-hosted systems, and other advanced server install scenarios. * Engage with branch teams during project planning and estimating to review architectures, technical requirements, project risks, and engineering effort. * Work with customer IT teams to coordinate Windows Server, SQL Server, networking, DNS, Active Directory, IIS, virtualization, firewall, cybersecurity, and related infrastructure requirements. * Develop and execute implementation, backup, validation, and rollback plans aligned to project complexity. * Troubleshoot server, database, application, network, and infrastructure issues during project delivery. * Create and improve technical documentation, installation guidance, knowledge articles, tools, and reusable deployment practices. * Provide advanced BAS Level 2 technical support, product testing, troubleshooting, and technical consultation through the Field Support Center when deployment workload permits. **How You Will Do It** ---------------------- * Own each deployment with accountability, safety, and integrity, from readiness review through handoff and validation. * Stay close to the work by coordinating directly with branches, technicians, customers, and customer IT to remove obstacles before they delay the project. * Use structured planning and clear rollback steps so every installation, upgrade, or migration is executed with discipline and traceability. * Improve every day through candid troubleshooting and continuous improvement, turning complex issues into practical guidance, knowledge articles, and better deployment standards. * Win as one team by building trust across project teams, support teams, and IT partners while keeping communication clear and professional. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Degree or diploma in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Building Automation, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. * Strong experience with Metasys installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. * Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server and Microsoft SQL Server environments. * Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, DNS, Active Directory, IIS, and enterprise IT infrastructure. * Experience with VMware and/or Hyper\-V virtualization. * Excellent diagnostic, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills across application, server, database, and network environments. * Strong communication skills with the ability to lead technical discussions with branch personnel, customers, and IT professionals. * Ability to independently plan and execute complex technical work while appropriately engaging other technical resources. * **Ability to travel 50% based on project demand, including occasional multi\-day onsite engagements.** **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with Metasys ADS/ADX, MVE, Split ADX, server redundancy, or complex Metasys architectures. * Experience with BAS server migrations and production system upgrades. * Experience working directly with customer IT organizations. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory, certificates, and enterprise cybersecurity. * Experience providing technical training or mentoring other technicians. **Why Join Us** --------------- This role offers the opportunity to work on advanced Metasys server projects while supporting a broad range of internal and customer\-facing technical challenges. You will collaborate across branches, Field Support Center teams, and customer IT organizations, helping improve deployment quality, documentation, and technical consistency while developing your expertise in complex building automation environments. If you are ready to bring your Metasys and server expertise to a high\-impact support and project delivery role, we invite you to apply. **HIRING SALARY RANGE:** $91\-135k (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.) **This role offers a competitive Bonus plan that will take into account individual, group, and corporate performance.** This position includes a competitive benefits package. **The posted salary range reflects the target compensation for this role. However, we recognize that exceptional candidates may bring unique skills and experiences that exceed the typical profile. If you believe your background warrants consideration beyond the stated range, we encourage you to apply.** To support an efficient and fair hiring process, we may use technology assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help identify and evaluate candidates.
