You’ll work directly with the founders and Account Executives to win our most strategic customers. From the first discovery call through technical evaluation and close, you’ll understand how a prospect operates, identify where AI can make the biggest difference, and build demonstrations that make that opportunity tangible. Our customers need to understand how an agent will connect to their systems, follow their policies, handle exceptions, and serve their borrowers. You’ll turn those questions into a clear solution and a credible path to production. As our founding hire in this function, you’ll also build the foundation for sales engineering at Kastle: our demo environments, technical discovery process, and standards for bringing engineering into a deal. What you learn in customer conversations will directly influence what we build next. This role is for someone who loves building, understands how to win enterprise deals, and wants to help create a function from the ground up. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Own the technical sale.** Partner with founders and Account Executives from discovery through close, identifying technical requirements, addressing objections, and helping prospects make confident buying decisions. * **Go deep into customer workflows.** Understand borrower journeys, operational bottlenecks, existing systems, and compliance requirements. Identify the strongest initial use cases and define measurable success criteria. * **Build demos that win deals.** Configure AI agents and create tailored demonstrations around a prospect’s workflows, policies, and customer experience. * **Lead technical evaluations.** Scope and run proofs of concept, coordinate resources, troubleshoot issues, and demonstrate results against agreed success criteria. * **Architect the solution.** Map integrations with loan servicing systems, APIs, data sources, and telephony platforms. Identify dependencies and constraints early. * **Build trust across the buying team.** Work directly with executives and engineering, security, compliance, and operations teams to address their questions and requirements. * **Set deployments up for success.** Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and Product Managers to transfer customer context, agreed scope, architecture, and commitments into implementation. * **Build the sales engineering foundation.** Create reusable demo environments, integration prototypes, technical collateral, and evaluation playbooks. Help define how the function grows. * **Shape the product.** Bring customer needs and competitive insights directly to the engineering team, helping distinguish immediate deal requirements from broader product opportunities. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * **4\+ years of relevant experience** in sales engineering, solutions engineering, or a technical role working directly with enterprise customers. * Experience owning technical discovery, custom demonstrations, and evaluations within complex enterprise sales cycles. * Strong technical fundamentals. You can work with APIs, understand authentication and data flows, and write Python, JavaScript, or similar code to build prototypes and integrations. * Clear communication across audiences, from engineers reviewing an architecture to executives evaluating a business case. * Commercial judgment. You know which technical questions matter to a buying decision and how to focus your effort on resolving them. * High agency and attention to detail. You can take an ambiguous customer problem, structure an approach, and drive it forward with limited guidance. * A builder’s mindset. You’re excited to create the tools, processes, and standards that future hires will use. * Curiosity about how businesses operate and a willingness to learn banking and lending workflows in depth. **Especially Relevant Experience** ---------------------------------- * Building or selling conversational AI, voice agents, contact center software, or workflow automation. * Navigating enterprise security reviews and integration requirements. * Joining an early sales engineering team or building a customer\-facing technical function. **Why Join Kastle** ------------------- * **Build a foundational function.** Define how Kastle demonstrates its product, runs technical evaluations, and wins enterprise customers. * **Work directly with the founders.** Have a short path from customer insight to product and company decisions. * **Own consequential work.** Help financial institutions adopt AI in workflows that affect millions of customers. * **Grow with the company.** Help shape the team, hiring standards, and operating approach as sales engineering scales. * **Great team:** work side by side with a world\-class team product and GTM teams that will reshape the trajectory of your career * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Perks \& Benefits:** At KCF, we are committed to providing best\-in\-class benefits, engaging development opportunities, and powerful perks that are focused on bringing out the best in you. Full\-time benefits include: * 100% company\-paid Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, and Life Insurance premiums * Health Savings Account with generous employer contributions * Flexible work model for most positions, "work from home, work from anywhere" * Competitive compensation \& bonus opportunities * Four weeks Paid Time Off; Paid Holidays \+ "Flex" Holiday * 401(k) with company match * Monthly cell phone and internet stipend * $500 annual wellness reimbursement * Learning culture committed to growth and continuous development **Mission \& Values:** KCF Technologies exists to solve the world's machine health problems to drive safety and sustainability for our communities. We empower industry to eradicate downtime, waste, and injuries with KCF's Machine Health Solutions Platform. Learn more at www.kcftech.com Curious about what working at KCF is really like? Explore Life at KCF here! If you're an A\-player who wants to be part of one of the most important companies revitalizing machine health across the world, KCF is the place for you. If our values resonate with you, please keep reading! Core Values: Smarts: We are humbly aggressive lifelong learners. Grit: We are scrappy, proactive problem solvers who don't stop until the job is done. Drive: We demonstrate an insatiable hunger to serve others. Responsibility: We do the right thing and contribute to the greater good. Autonomy: We own our work and define how we do it, while aligned with the greater mission. **Where You Come In:** As an Embedded Software Engineer on KCF's Hardware Team, you will design and build the firmware for our IoT products, which monitor the health of equipment in real industrial environments every day. You will collaborate closely with hardware and software engineers to take products from schematic to the field. We're open to candidates at a range of experience levels. Final title (Embedded Software Engineer II or Senior Embedded Software Engineer) and compensation will be based on your skills and experience. This is an on\-site role at our Pinnacle office in State College, PA. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. **Essential Functions:** * Develop embedded software, firmware, and supporting tools for KCF's IoT products * Actively participate as a member of the embedded software team and attend team meetings * Collaborate with hardware engineers, system architects, product managers, project managers, and other software teams * Create and execute software test procedures and automated test frameworks * Debug embedded software issues and test failures * Use version control and issue tracking tools to track code changes and assigned tasks * Produce documentation for software projects such as design specifications and release notes * Mentor junior members of the team * Review Git Pull Requests from other team members * Assist in defining high\-level architecture and requirements for embedded software projects * Develop automation to improve team performance and software quality * Other duties as assigned by the supervisor and other KCF leadership staff **Qualifications:** * 2\+ years of relevant experience in embedded software or firmware development * Bachelor's degree in a related field and/or equivalent experience * Experience with embedded C/C\+\+ and at least one other programming language * Experience with one or more scripting languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc.) * Experience with embedded hardware architectures (ARM, MSP430, etc.) and communication buses (I2C, SPI, USB, RS\-232/422/485\) * Ability to read hardware schematics and vendor datasheets * Experience with hardware troubleshooting tools (oscilloscope, multimeter, JTAG debugger, etc.) * Experience with Git and version control best practices * Willingness to pick up new programming languages and tools as needed **Preferred Qualifications:** * Familiarity with wireless communication protocols (Bluetooth, Wi\-Fi, etc.) * Familiarity with Linux and/or embedded RTOSes (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, etc.) * Familiarity with electronics and PCB design * Experience with software testing tools and practices (unit testing, integration testing, etc.) * Experience with automated build/test pipelines (CI/CD) * Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools as part of the design and coding workflow * Hands\-on experience implementing real\-time digital signal processing (such as FFTs, digital filtering, and spectral analysis) on resource\-constrained microcontrollers * Experience developing and deploying demodulation and/or fault\-detection algorithms for vibration and accelerometer data At KCF Technologies, we are an Equal Opportunity Employer. The only things we require for employment, compensation, advancement and benefits are performance and a good team attitude. No one will be denied opportunities or benefits, and no employment decisions will be made, on the basis of race, religion/creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, disability that does not prohibit performance of essential job functions, protected veteran status, medical condition, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, possession of a general education development certificate ("GED") as compared to a high school diploma, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal or state laws. KCF complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which KCF has facilities.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineering Delivery Manager (Job ID - 3549)
jobs.description: ### **Job Description** **Applied AI Engineering Delivery Manager** **Job Description** We are looking for an experienced Applied AI Engineering Delivery Manager with 10 to 12 years of overall experience to lead the delivery of complex, large\-scale technology programs that increasingly leverage AI and agentic tools. This role empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design, enhancing customer experiences and driving sustained growth and value creation. The Applied AI Engineering Delivery Manager balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve complex delivery challenges, while using AI and agentic tools to compress planning, risk\-identification, and reporting cycles so the team can focus on the judgment calls AI cannot replace: stakeholder alignment, trade\-off decisions, and delivery leadership. This role requires a blend of strong program and people management skills, deep technical delivery experience, and fluent, responsible use of AI to accelerate delivery outcomes. **Responsibilities** * Manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of large\-scale application programs, overseeing application performance, reliability, and scalability. * Coordinate system upgrades, patches, and enhancements across the technology landscape. * Ensure seamless integration with related upstream and downstream systems. * Lead and manage projects related to system transformation and modernization, including the adoption of AI\-enabled engineering practices. * Develop project plans, timelines, and budgets, using AI tools to accelerate estimation, scenario planning, and risk modeling. * Coordinate with vendors, system integrators, and internal IT teams to ensure aligned delivery. * Monitor project risks, issues, and dependencies, leveraging AI\-driven insights to flag emerging risks earlier. * Collaborate with business stakeholders and operations teams to gather requirements and translate them into system functionality. * Act as the liaison between technical teams and business users, ensuring clear and continuous communication. * Manage and mentor application developers, analysts, and support staff, fostering adoption of AI and agentic tools in daily engineering workflows. * Promote Agile/DevOps practices for continuous delivery and improvement, augmented with AI\-assisted code review, testing, and release management. * Ensure effective workload planning and team performance across the delivery organization. * Ensure accurate business logic implementation and data integrity across systems. * Oversee reporting and analytics, using AI to automate dashboarding and surface actionable delivery insights. * Support data exchanges and integrations with external and partner systems. * Ensure timely resolution of production issues and incidents, applying AI\-assisted root\-cause analysis to speed up triage. * Establish SLAs and monitor service performance, using AI\-based monitoring and anomaly detection tools. * Drive continuous improvement and process optimization, embedding AI and agentic tools as force\-multipliers across the delivery lifecycle. * Evaluate and pilot emerging AI and agentic engineering tools (such as Claude Code, Claude Co\-work, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to improve delivery velocity, quality, and cost efficiency. * Establish guardrails and governance for responsible AI use in engineering delivery, including human\-in\-the\-loop review, evaluation, and escalation paths. ### **Requirements** * 10 to 12 years of consulting and/or industry experience in technology delivery or engineering management roles. * Experience managing large\-scale application programs supporting complex business processes and system integrations. * Experience supporting clients in one or more of the following areas: system delivery, application modernization, data integration, or technology operations. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. * Experience managing mid\-to\-large size engagements or workstreams and leading multiple team members. * Experience mentoring or leading multiple team members across cross\-functional delivery teams. * Hands\-on exposure to AI\-enabled software delivery, including use of GenAI or agentic tools for requirements analysis, code generation, testing, or documentation. * Understanding of responsible AI practices, including guardrails for hallucination, bias, and drift, and the use of evaluation harnesses before and after deployment. * Experience with modern agentic AI tools such as Claude Code, Claude Co\-work, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, or Visual Studio Code is a plus. * Ability to travel 0\-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team. * Effective written and verbal communication skills. * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product. * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships. * Ability to lead projects or workstreams. * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment. * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor. * Ability to meet deadlines. * Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineers (Job ID - 3550)
jobs.description: ### **Job Description** **Applied AI Engineer** **Job Description** We are looking for a motivated Applied AI Engineer with 3 to 5 years of overall experience to actively engage in the engineering craft, taking a hands\-on approach to building and supporting high\-visibility projects. Your contributions will help deliver solutions that delight customers and users, while driving tangible value for business investments. You will apply your growing engineering expertise across multiple programming languages and modern frameworks, consistently delivering quality, outcome\-focused work. The ideal candidate is a collaborative team player eager to learn, grow, and contribute, working with cross\-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy software solutions, while building hands\-on experience using AI and agentic tools across the engineering lifecycle. **Responsibilities** * Contribute to a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes, helping develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes. * Support technical design, development, testing, integrations, and ongoing support for assigned product components. * Participate in requirement analysis and component\-level design under the guidance of senior engineers. * Contribute to the integrity of architecture and technical stack to enterprise standards, managing dependencies, code quality, and ongoing maintenance. * Stay hands\-on, self\-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, frameworks, and AI\-enabled engineering practices. * Write high\-quality, supportable, scalable code, and participate in code reviews to support team quality standards. * Support rapid, inexpensive experimentation, including AI\-built prototypes, to help solve customer needs. * Engage with product teams before, during, and after delivery to help ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time. * Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning, helping deliver lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery to support well\-informed decisions. * Apply AI and Agentic SSDLC practices to support automated deployments with quality checks embedded across the development lifecycle. * Use AI tools for code generation, review, testing, and documentation to accelerate delivery while maintaining quality standards. * Build domain\-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product, translating business and user needs into technical specifications and code. * Communicate clearly with teammates, sharing updates, blockers, and technical trade\-offs in a well\-structured manner. * Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams, building constructive relationships and contributing to a culture of co\-creation. ### **Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related discipline. * 3 to 5 years of experience with one or more of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, C\#, .NET, Java, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, as well as unit testing frameworks. * 1\+ years of experience building AI/ML applications, with hands\-on GenAI exposure across LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open\-source models), RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, or vector databases. * 1\+ years of experience with cloud\-native engineering, using FaaS, PaaS, or micro\-services on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including exposure to their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI. * Working knowledge of engineering standards and best practices, with a willingness to learn and adopt new standards under guidance. * Understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, and algorithms. * Exposure to methodologies and tools such as Agile, DevSecOps, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, or agentic AI frameworks (e.g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent) is a plus. * Ability to work in your local office at a minimum of 3 days per week. * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. * Ability to travel 0\-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team. * Effective written and verbal communication skills. * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product. * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships. * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment. * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor. * Ability to meet deadlines. * Eagerness to learn and receive mentorship from senior team members.

jobs.title: Tech Lead/Software Engineer III - PDC
jobs.description: Attention: Kapitus is aware that individuals posing as recruiters may be communicating with job seekers about supposed positions with Kapitus. Kapitus has received reports that the content and method of communication can vary, but messages may contain requests for payment (e.g., fees for equipment or training) and/or for sensitive financial information. Kapitus will **never** ask a candidate for employment for payment or financial information during the initial application or interview process. All open positions are posted in location specific employment portals available at www.kapitus.com/careersAll legitimate Kapitus job postings on employment sites will direct candidates to complete an application through these portals before completion of the hiring process. Candidates with additional questions or concerns regarding any recruiting communications or Kapitus' recruiting process in general should email **recruiting@kapitus.com** As a Tech Lead/Software Engineer III at Kapitus, you will be responsible for leading a dynamic service development team with the design, development, and implementation of scalable and efficient cloud native services in alignment with Kapitus business goals. Your contributions will empower Kapitus to continue helping small business owners find lending options so they can make payroll during tough times, scale to meet market demands, and make large purchases to scale their operations. The ideal candidate would have deep expertise in PHP, CakePHP and legacy application architecture, and experience maintaining, troubleshooting, and modernizing older PHP applications (PHP 5\.6\), \& leading major framework and PHP version upgrades. This individual must demonstrate strong technical ownership, architectural expertise, and independent problem solving skills, serving as the primary technical owner of a mission\-critical enterprise platform while providing reliable support during US business hours and driving its long\-term stability, performance, and modernization. **What you will do:** **Lead Service Development:** * Take ownership of the end\-to\-end service development lifecycle, from conceptualization to deployment, ensuring high\-quality deliverables within specified timelines. **Architectural Design:** * Collaborate with product and business stakeholders to design scalable and resilient service architectures that meet business requirements while adhering to best practices and industry standards. **Technical Leadership:** * Provide guidance and mentorship to a team of developers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. **Code Review and Quality Assurance:** * Conduct thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to coding standards, performance optimization, and maintainability. Implement robust testing strategies to uphold product quality. **AWS Expertise:** * Utilize your extensive experience with AWS services to architect, deploy, and maintain cloud\-based solutions, leveraging services such as ECS, S3, Lambda, and others as appropriate. **Financial Industry Integration:** * Apply your understanding of financial industry requirements to tailor solutions that address integration needs and comply with regulatory standards. * Build a deep understanding of our current infrastructure and identify improvements to keep Kapitus on the forefront of FinTech **Agile Methodologies:** * Drive agile development practices within the team, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, to ensure efficient delivery and continuous improvement. **Collaboration and Communication**: * Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including product management, QA, and operations, to ensure alignment of development efforts with overall business objectives. **What we're looking for:** =========================== * Bachelor or Master's degree in computer science. * Minimum of 6\+ years of experience in software development as tech lead or senior/staff developer, with a focus on backend service development. * Strong proficiency in AWS cloud services development and infrastructure management. * Experience with relational databases (MSSQL and MySQL) and NoSQL DB. * Proven experience in designing and architecting scalable, high\-performance systems. * Experience in the financial industry is highly preferred. * Experience with PHP is highly preferred. * In\-depth understanding of agile methodologies and experience leading agile teams. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams. * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities. **Kapitus Total Rewards Package Includes:** * **Competitive Base Salary Range** of $117,800\-$189,000\. Kapitus is providing this as a good faith salary range to comply with applicable law. The applicant's final salary will depend on a number of factor bility** –Up to 10% annually * **Health Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and employer\-paid vision plans through UnitedHealthcare (UHC), with various coverage levels available to meet the needs of our employees and their families. Additional perks through UHC include: Sweat Equity, free subscription to the Calm App, UHC rewards, Real Appeal, and Quit For Life. * **Flexible Spending Account:** Set aside pre\-tax dollars from your paycheck to pay for qualified out\-of\-pocket medical, dental, vision, pharmacy or dependent care expenses. * **Lifestyle Spending Account:** Employer sponsored post\-tax benefits that allow reimbursement for expenses related to physical, mental and financial well\-being. * **100% Company Paid Insurances:** Kapitus fully covers the cost of basic short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, as well as vision insurance, ensuring our employees have comprehensive protection without any personal expense. * **Voluntary Insurance:** Supplemental life insurance as well as enhanced short\- and long\-term disability coverage are available through Mutual of Omaha, providing additional security for our employees. Additionally, Colonial Accident and Hospitalization insurances are also available, offering further protection against unforeseen events. * **Paid Maternity and Parental Leave:** Beyond state\-mandated leave policies, Kapitus provides company\-paid maternity and parental leave, supporting our employees during important family milestones. * **Commuter Benefits:** We offer pre\-tax benefits on parking and commuter expenses to cover travel to and from work. * **LifeBalance Program:** Enhance your lifestyle with our LifeBalance membership, which offers discounts on outdoor activities, the arts, health, and fitness. Additional benefits include: + Pet and car insurance discounts. + Financial services such as LegalShield. + Relaxation and stress management tools. * **Plum Benefits Discount Program:** Access exclusive discounts on shows, travel, car rentals, and more, enriching your personal and family life. * **Tuition Reimbursement:** Pursue further education with up to $5,000 annually in tuition reimbursement, plus opportunities to attend relevant conferences and career development events. Managed through our LSA plan, Kapitus Academy. * **Travel Reimbursement:** We also offer travel reimbursement for all work\-related travel, supporting your involvement in career and personal development activities. * **Paid Time Off and Sick Time.** * **Retirement Benefits**: Our 401K plan is managed through Fidelity. To support your long\-term financial goals, the company provides a 25% match on your contributions, up to 6% of your annual salary. **About Kapitus:** Kapitus is one of the most reliable and respected names in small business financing. As both a direct lender and a marketplace built with a trusted network of lending partners, we can provide small businesses with the financing they need when, and how it is needed. We have spent our entire existence building a culture that makes us excited to come to work in the morning. Our company is fast paced, teammates need to be self\-directed and have an internal motivation to do the right thing, even when the right thing takes a lot of hard work. We show our teammates our appreciation by offering great benefits, competitive pay and solid opportunity for growth. **Company Mission:** At Kapitus, our mission is to help small business owners grow their organizations by providing tailored, transparent, and ethical financing solutions. We invest in every business owner's story and we are dedicated to building lasting relationships to champion their goals. We promise to keep the best interests of our clients at the center of the financing process by operating with transparency, fairness, and integrity. **Consideration will be given to qualified remote candidates residing in states where Kapitus and/or one of its subsidiaries has an established physical presence.**

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - RL & Optimization
jobs.description: Overview: Keysight is a mission\-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our \~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do. At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award\-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits. Software \& AI Labs is seeking a Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join the Models \& Data Science program. The program develops the core AI/ML models behind Keysight’s design, simulation, calibration, and measurement solutions. The Reinforcement Learning Engineer will develop RL agents and optimization methods for automated measurement sequencing, closed\-loop RF tuning, and adaptive calibration. This early\-career role is suited to a recent graduate with a strong foundation in reinforcement learning and software engineering who wants to apply RL to real RF and measurement problems. The successful candidate will work alongside senior ML engineers and RF measurement experts, learn Keysight’s calibration and characterization workflows, and grow into ownership of RL components that ship in Keysight products. Responsibilities: * Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Robotics, or a related field. * 0\-2 years of industry experience. Graduate research, internships, and thesis work in reinforcement learning count toward the requirement. * Solid understanding of reinforcement learning fundamentals, including policy gradient, actor\-critic, and value\-based methods. * Hands\-on experience implementing or training RL algorithms such as PPO, SAC, or DDPG. * Proficiency in Python and PyTorch. * Experience with RL tooling such as Gymnasium, Stable\-Baselines3, RLlib, or equivalent. * Strong foundation in linear algebra, probability, and optimization. * Good software engineering habits, including version control, testing, and readable code. * Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to work well in a team. Qualifications: * Coursework or experience in RF, microwave engineering, electromagnetics, or signal processing. * Familiarity with S\-parameters, VNA measurements, calibration methods (SOLT, TRL), or de\-embedding. * Experience with Bayesian optimization or Gaussian process methods. * Experience applying RL to control, robotics, hardware\-in\-the\-loop, or design optimization problems. * Working knowledge of C\+\+ or CUDA. * Experience with instrument control (SCPI, IVI, VISA) or scikit\-rf. * Experience with generative models (VAEs, GANs, Diffusion) for data augmentation. * Publications, open\-source contributions, or competition results in reinforcement learning. Careers Privacy Statement Keysight Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Sr. Network & Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: At Kids2, we’re really good at what we do. And when we’re great at our jobs, we help parents be great at their jobs. Parenting is demanding, and that’s where we come in. We want to reimagine how brands can make it easier for early stage parents – not by just selling them products, but by providing holistic solutions that transcend borders, categories and aisles. No matter our title or department, at Kids2, our job is to create more tiny wins for parents, so they can create bright futures for their little ones. That’s a big task! We’re serious about what we do, AND we love to have fun. Our team is hardworking, entrepreneurial, and passionate about helping families create millions, if not billions of tiny wins. **SUMMARY** The Senior Network \& Infrastructure Engineer owns the network that connects Kids2's US offices, the Suwanee data center, Azure, Hong Kong, mainland China and Mexico. This is a senior, hands\-on role on a small Global IT team, owning network architecture and the roadmap as well as firewalls, WAN and site\-to\-site tunnels, remote access VPN, and Meraki wired and wireless networks. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** * Own the network architecture, design standards and roadmap across all sites. * Lead network projects such as China connectivity and WAN and firewall refreshes, from design through cutover. * Manage carriers and network vendors, and give input on the network budget. * Administer FortiGate and Cisco ASA/FTD (FMC) firewalls, including rules, policies, upgrades and change requests. * Review firewall rules and logs, and keep configurations backed up and documented. * Operate the IPsec tunnels and carrier\-managed WAN (DTNaaS) between the US, Azure, Hong Kong and China. * Troubleshoot tunnel, routing and circuit issues, and work with carriers on outages and changes. * Own Cisco Secure Client and Meraki client VPN, including configuration, client deployment, upgrades and user issues. * Administer Cisco Meraki MX, MS and MR across all sites, including SSIDs, VLANs, switching, alerts and inventory. * Operate certificate\-based Wi\-Fi (SCEPman, RADIUS/NPS) and work with the endpoint team on the device profiles that deliver certificates. * Plan and lead office network buildouts and moves with the manager and regional IT staff. * Renew public and internal certificates, including SAP system certificates. * Manage internal and external DNS. * Submit changes through Jira Service Management, review other network changes before they go through, and write runbooks for every system owned. * Serve as the final technical escalation point for network issues. * Mentor the help desk and regional IT staff on network work. * Take part in after\-hours maintenance windows across US and Asia business hours. **QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** * 7 or more years of network engineering experience in a multi\-site company. * Production experience administering FortiGate or Cisco firewalls, site\-to\-site IPsec VPN and WAN routing. * Experience with Cisco Meraki (MX, MS and MR) and remote access VPN such as Cisco Secure Client. * Experience with network connectivity into mainland China and Azure networking. * Experience leading network projects and managing carriers and vendors is preferred. **EDUCATION \& SKILLS** * Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Certificate lifecycle and DNS administration; 802\.1X wireless with RADIUS and certificate\-based authentication. * Clear written documentation and the ability to work with regional IT staff across time zones. **CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS** * CCNP, Fortinet NSE 6 or NSE 7 preferred. **COMPUTER/TECHNICAL SKILLS** * Must be proficient with FortiGate, Cisco ASA/FTD and FMC, Cisco Meraki, Cisco Secure Client and IPsec VPN. Working knowledge of RADIUS/NPS, SCEPman, DNS, Azure networking, Jira Service Management, and PowerShell or Python for network tasks. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** * While performing the duties of this job, the team member is regularly required to talk or hear. * The team member frequently is required to sit; have flexible use of hands; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. * The team member is occasionally required to stand and walk. * The team member must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, including racking network hardware. * Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** * General office environment in Atlanta, GA (hybrid) * Regular on\-site work at the Suwanee data center * After\-hours maintenance windows across US and Asia business hours We offer competitive pay, flexible hours, and generous benefits. Plus, to keep things fun (because we are all kids at heart), we offer a host of team member activities and philanthropic efforts throughout the year and company\-wide awards and recognition for a job well done! Check out our website at www.kids2\.com and our social media pages on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram for more information and open positions in the career section. Drug Free Workplace M/F/D/V

jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Science
jobs.description: **Who We Are** At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission\-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities. **The Role** As a Data Scientist at Kyndryl, you will play a critical role in transforming complex business challenges into measurable, high\-value outcomes through advanced analytics and machine learning solutions. Partnering closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and AI engineers, you will identify high\-impact opportunities across areas such as forecasting, propensity modeling, optimization, and customer analytics—driving innovation that shapes the future of enterprise operations. In this role, you will own the end\-to\-end data science lifecycle, taking solutions from initial problem definition and hypothesis development through exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, experimentation, and rigorous model validation. Utilizing tools such as Python, SQL, scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch, you will build predictive and prescriptive models while working alongside Data Engineering to establish reliable, governed datasets and reusable features. You will also partner with AI Engineering to productionize your solutions through scalable pipelines, APIs, and enterprise applications. Beyond model development, you will champion responsible AI practices—ensuring explainability, bias assessment, privacy, security, and strong model governance—while continuously monitoring deployed models for drift and performance to recommend timely optimizations. You will serve as a trusted analytical advisor, translating complex statistical findings, model assumptions, and expected business value into clear, actionable insights for both technical teams and executive stakeholders. If you are passionate about leveraging data and machine learning to drive operational efficiency, revenue growth, and superior customer outcomes, this role is for you. **Your Future at Kyndryl** Kyndryl’s focus on providing innovative IT and AI solutions to its customers means that as a Data Scientist, you will work with cutting\-edge cloud and enterprise technologies while continuously learning and growing your technical skills. You will have the opportunity to contribute to large\-scale, transformative projects and collaborate with a global network of data, AI, and technology professionals. Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID\-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID\-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment. **Who You Are** You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. Equally as important, you bring a growth mindset—keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused, prioritizing measurable customer and business success in your work. Finally, you are open and borderless—naturally inclusive and collaborative in how you work across multidisciplinary teams. Required Skills and Experience * 7\+ years of experience developing statistical, predictive, and prescriptive machine learning models to solve complex business problems. * Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, alongside practical experience with core data science and machine learning libraries (such as Pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch). * Deep understanding of statistics, probability, experimental design, feature engineering, model selection, and rigorous model evaluation. * Demonstrated experience working with, cleaning, and extracting insights from large, complex, and imperfect enterprise datasets. * Practical familiarity with cloud data and AI platforms, such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric. * Solid understanding of MLOps principles, including model versioning, testing, deployment, drift monitoring, and end\-to\-end lifecycle management. * Proven ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured analytical approaches and measurable success criteria. * Strong communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to clearly articulate analytical findings, model limitations, and business value to both technical and executive stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across business, data engineering, analytics, and AI engineering teams. * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline. Preferred Skills and Experience * Hands\-on experience deploying and scaling machine learning solutions within an enterprise production environment. * Direct experience working with Microsoft Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Foundry, or comparable enterprise AI platforms. * Exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI agents—particularly where predictive models complement agentic solutions. Relevant professional certifications in Data Science, Machine Learning, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, or NVIDIA. * The base compensation range for the position in the U.S. is \- $143,640 to $273,000 based on a full\-time schedule reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation Kyndryl, in good faith, believes it may pay for the role at the time of this posting. Your actual compensation may vary depending on multiple factors legally permitted in the applicable jurisdiction, including, but not limited to, geography, relevant job\-related skills, education and experience, certification and licenses, internal pay equity, and market and business consideration. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement. There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations: California (San Francisco Bay Area): $172,440 to $327,600 California (All Other): $158,040 to $300,360 Colorado: $143,640 to $273,000 Massachusetts/ Virginia: $143,640 to $300,360 New York City: $172,440 to $327,600 Washington: $158,040 to $300,360 Washington DC: $158,040 to $300,360 This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. **Being You** Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single\-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way. **What You Can Expect** With state\-of\-the\-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well\-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company\-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non\-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed. **Get Referred!** If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.title: Engineer II, Enterprise Data Lakehouse
jobs.description: **Where Ambition Meets Innovation** Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting\-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals. **Job Overview:** At LPL Financial, we consider it our mission to take care of our financial advisors so they can take care of their clients. Joining as a Data Engineer II, you will be a hands\-on contributor to our Enterprise Data Lakehouse (EDLH) team, designing, building, and owning production data pipelines that ingest, transform, and curate data across our AWS\-based lakehouse platform. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work. **Requirements:** * 3–5 years of hands\-on data engineering experience, with demonstrated experience designing, building, and owning production data pipelines end\-to\-end. * 3\-5 years in Python for data pipeline development, including PySpark, boto3, and pandas, with experience developing unit and integration tests. * 3\+ years hands\-on experience with AWS data and lakehouse technologies, including Amazon S3, AWS Glue (PySpark), Amazon Athena and AWS Lambda. * 2\+ years experience/knowledge of data lakehouse architectures and modern table formats such as Apache Iceberg, including partitioning, schema evolution, metadata management, and performance considerations. * 3\+ years experience designing and implementing end\-to\-end data pipelines across ingestion, transformation, storage, and consumption layers, with a focus on reliability, file sizing, and small\-file management. **Preferences**: * Strong SQL and PySpark skills, including performance optimization, complex joins, and merge/CDC patterns for large, partitioned datasets. Experience with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake is preferred. * Familiarity with event\-driven data processing using technologies such as Kafka/Confluent and Amazon EventBridge. * Working knowledge of data pipeline integration with APIs, including API access patterns and security concepts such as OAuth2/JWT, IAM, and cross\-account roles. * Experience implementing and troubleshooting production data quality controls, logging, monitoring, and alerting to support reliable data pipeline operations. * Working knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code technologies such as Terraform, AWS CDK, or AWS CloudFormation for deploying and promoting data pipeline changes across environments. * Ability to evaluate technical options and trade\-offs with the ability to work independently while seeking guidance from senior engineers as appropriate. **Pay Range:** $42\.12\-$70\.19/hour### Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer! **Company Overview:** LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor\-mediated marketplace(6\) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2\.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. Join the LPL team and help us make a difference by turning life’s aspirations into financial realities. Please log in or create an account to apply to this position. Principals only. EOE. **Information on Interviews:** LPL will only communicate with a job applicant directly from an **@lplfinancial.com** email address and will never conduct an interview online or in a chatroom forum. During an interview, LPL will not request any form of payment from the applicant, or information regarding an applicant’s bank or credit card. Should you have any questions regarding the application process, please contact LPL’s Human Resources Solutions Center at (855\) 575\-6947\. EAC 5\.19\.26

jobs.title: Product Manager - AI (San Diego, CA)
jobs.description: **Annual Salary Range: $100k \- $120k plus a quarterly bonus plan. This role is 100% on site at our San Diego, CA office.** LendSure Mortgage Corp. is a fast\-growing Wholesale Lender offering Non\-QM loan solutions. LendSure helps mortgage originators grow their business by offering loan solutions to borrowers who do not fall into conforming guidelines. At LendSure Mortgage Corp., we have created an environment where high\-energy professionals can learn, excel, grow and feel great about their contributions to our success. We are committed to attracting and retaining top talent throughout the United States. LendSure offers full salary, benefits, and opportunity to grow within the company. **Overview** LendSure is seeking a highly analytical, technically capable, and entrepreneurial Forward\-Deployed Product Manager focused on applying artificial intelligence to our workflows. This is a hands\-on role that combines product management, business process analysis, systems architecture, and AI\-assisted software development. The successful candidate will work across all areas of the company\-including business units and technical teams\-to understand existing workflows, identify opportunities for enhancements and automation, and design better ways of working. In addition to defining product requirements and coordinating with in\-house and external development teams, this individual will be expected to take substantial ownership of design and implementation tasks. Using modern AI tools and AI\-assisted engineering techniques, they will rapidly prototype new tools, applications, automations, and workflow enhancements; refine those products in dialogue with our development teams and end users; and ultimately integrate those solutions into production. This role should propose and drive adoption of modern AI tools across our workflows while nevertheless ensuring that new tools and processes integrate smoothly with LendSure's existing infrastructure and operations. This requires someone who can think holistically about systems, anticipate downstream impacts, and balance innovation against reliability, maintainability, security, and continuity. The role will involve frequent interaction with business stakeholders and senior executives. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable conducting a detailed workflow discovery session with an operations team, designing a technical solution, building a working prototype with AI assistance, troubleshooting an integration, and presenting a strategic recommendation to company leadership. **Key Responsibilities** * Conduct discovery across business departments to understand and document existing workflows, identify inefficiencies, and uncover opportunities for automation and improvement. * Design and document optimized future\-state workflows, including process changes, system requirements, and implementation plans, with particular emphasis on AI. * Evaluate and prioritize initiatives based on impact, complexity, cost, and expected returns. * Design new applications, internal tools, integrations, and workflow automations. * Build prototypes and production solutions using AI\-assisted development tools, taking projects from initial concept through implementation. * Ensure solutions integrate effectively with existing systems and can be maintained and built upon for future business processes and product channels. * Develop and execute testing strategies, including functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT). * Facilitate stakeholder workshops, demonstrations, and working sessions to gather feedback and drive decisions. * Present findings, recommendations, and project results to senior executives. * Coordinate production rollouts, including documentation, training, and change management. **Qualifications** * Experience in product management, business process engineering, systems analysis, software development, or a related discipline. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex processes and develop practical solutions. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools, including the ability to use them effectively for application development and technical troubleshooting. * Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, system architectures, data flows, and integration designs. * Understanding of APIs, databases, software architecture, and modern application development practices. * Familiarity with software testing, deployment, and ongoing application maintenance. * Excellent communication and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple initiatives and work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Experience** * Experience in mortgage lending, financial services, or another complex business environment. * Familiarity with wholesale mortgage lending workflows, including Sales, Processing, Underwriting, and Closing. * Experience with the Encompass LOS or the Salesforce CRM. * Proficiency with AI coding agents and development platforms that support agentic coding and application development. * Experience building internal applications, dashboards, workflow automation tools, and operational utilities. * Familiarity with cloud platforms, modern application architectures, and low\-code/no\-code development tools. * Experience introducing new technology and processes into established organizations. **What We're Looking For** The ideal candidate is a **builder who thinks like a product manager and approaches problems like a business process engineer**. We are looking for someone who is naturally curious about how businesses operate and enjoys challenging conventional approaches. You should be resourceful, entrepreneurial, and comfortable taking initiative without waiting for detailed instructions or predefined solutions. You should also be pragmatic and business\-oriented, recognizing that the best solution is not necessarily the most technically sophisticated one. The ability to balance innovation with practical considerations, anticipate unintended consequences, and gain buy\-in from stakeholders is essential. Finally, you should enjoy working across organizational levels, from collaborating with frontline employees to presenting directly to senior leadership. Above all, we are looking for someone who takes ownership, moves quickly, embraces emerging technology, and is motivated by the opportunity to meaningfully improve how an entire company operates. Since our founding, LendSure has achieved significant success, growing the organization from a concept to one with sales teams nation\-wide and operational centers in California, Rhode Island, and Georgia. Our loan originations surpassed $100mm in our first 18 months. LendSure's success is due to our innovation and a company culture based on service excellence, where employees are provided with the resources and support to help them grow and achieve greatness. LendSure is highly committed to attracting, developing and retaining top talent throughout the United States. **This employer participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.**

jobs.description: Role Overview: We're looking for a Principal Engineer to architect, fine\-tune, and deploy on\-device small language models (SLMs) for consumer security at scale. While you won’t own the agent orchestration platform itself, you’ll work closely with it to ensure models behave correctly in multi\-turn conversations and make reliable tool\-calling decisions. This role sits at the intersection of edge ML, applied LLMs, and production engineering. Success requires navigating real\-world tradeoffs: latency vs. capability, privacy vs. accuracy, on\-device vs. cloud execution, and cost vs. performance. This is a Hybrid position located in a hub location of Frisco, TX, San Jose, CA, Newport Beach, CA, or New York, NY. You will be required to be onsite on an as\-needed basis, typically 1\-4 days per month. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to this location and are not offering relocation assistance at this time. Position Details: **About the role:** * Design and deploy small language models optimized for on\-device inference (Mac, iOS, Android, Linux) * Lead model optimization efforts including quantization, pruning, distillation, and efficient inference pipelines * Fine\-tune models to improve tool selection accuracy and conversational behavior in security\-focused workflows * Build evaluation frameworks to measure model efficacy, tool\-calling accuracy, conversation quality, and safety in production * Create synthetic data and workflow simulations to train and validate security\-relevant conversations * Partner closely with agent orchestration systems to optimize multi\-turn dialogue behavior and state handling * Implement cost\-optimization strategies such as intelligent on\-device vs. cloud routing, prompt caching, batching, and token efficiency * Integrate cloud\-based LLMs when deeper reasoning or broader context is required * Build production ML systems that detect threats and protect users directly on\-device * Set technical standards and architectural direction for AI/ML across the security platform * Influence engineers, architects, and technical leaders through design reviews, technical guidance, and engineering best practices. * Design and maintain scalable AI evaluation harnesses that enable automated testing, benchmarking, and regression detection across model quality, tool\-calling behavior, safety, and production workflows. * Develop red\-team testing frameworks and adversarial evaluation methodologies to measure and improve model robustness, security, and resiliency against emerging threat scenarios. * Build reusable AI engineering platforms, tooling, and infrastructure that accelerate model experimentation, evaluation, deployment, and operational monitoring across multiple teams and products. **About you:** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, with 5\+ years focused on ML/AI * Proven experience shipping ML models to production with transferrable skills to deploy these on edge or mobile platforms * Experience with conversational AI systems and tool/function\-calling architectures * Strong Python and systems programming skills (C\+\+ or Rust) for performance\-critical code * Drive cross\-functional technical initiatives that span multiple products and engineering organizations. * Deep expertise in model jobs.title: EE Integration Release Engineer
jobs.description: Tätigkeitsbereich:Forschung \& Entwicklung incl. Design Fachabteilung:EE Engineering Gesellschaft:Mercedes\-Benz Research \& Development North America, Inc. Standort: Mercedes\-Benz Research \& Development North America, Inc., Atlanta, GA \+1 Startdatum:sofort Veröffentlichungsdatum:24\.11\.2026 Stellennummer:MER0004B21 Arbeitszeit:Vollzeit Aufgaben At Mercedes\-Benz Research \& Development North America (MBRDNA), we are committed to delivering world\-class automotive technologies that push the boundaries of what is possible. Our teams of highly skilled engineers and designers use cutting\-edge software and technology, to enhance the driving experience and reduce environmental impact. Position Overview: Embedded within Mercedes\-Benz Research \& Development North America, Inc., the Vehicle Integration team drives to establish Mercedes\-Benz as a technology leader in the US luxury segment. Our team develops, tests, and validates US Software applications in order to deliver the best US customer experience possible. We perform product research to influence and drive innovation and improve vehicle features at different touch points throughout the customer journey. The Vehicle Integration team is seeking an EE Integration Release Engineer to perform the end\-to\-end E/E update process for the North American prototype fleet and participate in the departments E/E integration testing activities in the area of overall vehicle E/E systems (Infotainment, ADAS, Body, on/off\-board testing) from a customer’s point of view. This role sits at the intersection of software release management, vehicle integration, and system validation. The engineer is accountable for ensuring that every prototype vehicle in the North American fleet is at the correct HW/SW release level, that all systems are correctly commissioned after flashing, and that cross\-domain behavior —including ADAS, telematics, infotainment, e\-drive, and powertrain — is validated and documented before US market release recommendations are issued. Work is performed on camouflaged prototype passenger car platforms. Priorities are continuously re\-evaluated against customer feedback, market changes, and business priorities per ISO 9001 standards. Key Tasks \& Responsibilities E/E Update Planning \& Execution * Perform overall E/E vehicle updating process for MBRDNA: planning, scheduling, and execution of all HW/SW release updates required to bring test vehicles to the correct release level. * Perform and supervise vehicle updates using DTS Monaco and the Mercedes\-Benz SoftwareTankstelle (SWT) toolchain. * Manage critical\-path flashing of gateway controllers within complex vehicle network topologies; apply fail\-safe deployment sequencing to prevent communication loss across downstream ECU sub\-networks. * Commission all systems post\-flash to confirm correct functionality, and document results to carline and functional\-area standards. * Establish timing and execution agreements with business partners; identify and resolve bottlenecks across a multi\-project vehicle fleet. * Support HW availability and compatibility planning; cross\-reference planned software releases against installed hardware variants per vehicle to confirm compatibility before flashing. jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ US Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- General \& Administrative **Compensation** ---------------- * $114,593 – $230,000 • Offers Bonus MeridianLink runs a comprehensive background check, credit check, and drug test as part of our offer process. I**t is not typical for offers to be made at or near the top of the salary range.** The actual salary will be determined based on experience and other job\-related factors permitted by law including geographical location. Meridianlink offers: * Insurance coverage (medical, dental, vision, life, and disability) * Flexible paid time off * Paid holidays * 401(k) plan with company match * Remote work All compensation and benefits are subject to the terms and conditions of the underlying plans or programs, as applicable and as may be amended, terminated, or superseded from time to time. \#LI\-REMOTE MeridianLink has made a company\-wide commitment to AI. Claude is deployed across the enterprise, every employee carries an AI fluency goal, and leadership has funded a portfolio of AI investments tied to measurable business outcomes. The gap between a promising pilot and a system people rely on every day is where most AI initiatives stall. This role exists to close that gap. You'll be the builder embedded with our business teams — Finance, Go\-to\-Market, Customer Experience, Services, and Operations — turning real operational friction into working AI solutions, shipping them, measuring the value, and making sure they stick. You'll work with direct executive sponsorship from the Chief Transformation Officer and the autonomy to move fast on reversible decisions. **What you'll do** ================== ### **Embed and discover** * Sit with one or two business domains at a time, learn how the work actually gets done, and surface the highest\-value opportunities for AI — the ones that redirect hours, cut cycle time, or remove error\-prone handoffs * Turn fuzzy asks into crisp problem statements, success metrics, and a buildable MVP scope within days, not weeks ### **Design, build, and deploy** * Build production\-grade solutions on Claude — Projects, Skills, Claude Code, and agentic workflows — connected to the systems our teams live in (Salesforce, NetSuite, Asana, Jira, Microsoft 365, our Databricks data platform, and internal APIs) via connectors and MCP * Write the integration code, prompts, evaluations, and guardrails that make a solution reliable enough to run without you * Ship fast with time\-boxed experiments and small test groups, then harden what works ### **Measure and scale** * Instrument every solution for business value — hours redirected, turnaround time, adoption, quality — and report it against our enterprise AI scorecard * Convert one\-off wins into reusable patterns, connectors, and playbooks the next team can adopt * Coach team champions so solutions have local owners, and feed what you learn back into our enterprise AI fluency program ### **Operate responsibly** * Build inside our AI governance framework: approved tools, data\-handling standards, and the security and compliance requirements of a fintech serving regulated financial institutions * Partner with Security, Data, and Business Systems so solutions are supportable and sustainable — never shadow IT **How we work** =============== We optimize for transparency over perfection — a red metric is fine, a hidden one is not. Most decisions are two\-way doors: we expect you to make them with your sponsor and keep moving. You'll get a weekly check\-in with the Chief Transformation Officer and a clear set of outcomes, not daily direction. You'll be measured on what's running in production and doing useful work. **What success looks like in the first 90 days** ================================================ * Three AI solutions shipped and in daily use across at least two business domains, each with a baseline and a measured result * A starter library of reusable connectors, prompts, and evaluation patterns * A prioritized, sized backlog of next opportunities co\-owned with business sponsors **What you bring** ================== * 6–9 years in software, solutions, integration, or implementation engineering, including 2\+ years shipping LLM\-based workflows that real teams use in production — not demos * Hands\-on depth with Claude (or equivalent frontier models), including agentic workflows, tool use, connectors/MCP, and prompt and evaluation design * Strong Python and/or TypeScript; comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, and integrating SaaS systems * Working fluency with enterprise data — SQL, data warehouses, and the judgment to know when a data problem is the real blocker * A track record of working autonomously with ambiguous scope, and of saying “here's what I shipped” rather than “here's what I'd recommend” * Clear, direct communication with executives and front\-line users alike; you can run a discovery session and a demo in the same afternoon **Nice to have** * Prior Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or AI implementation role * Experience in fintech, lending, or another regulated SaaS environment * Exposure to Salesforce, NetSuite, Databricks, or revenue and finance operations processes * Experience with change enablement — getting people to adopt, not just getting systems to work Compensation Range: $114,593 \- $230,000 Apply for this Job

jobs.description: The Automotive Vehicles team is searching for a creative and experienced Software Systems Engineer to help us bring NVIDIA's autonomous vehicle solution out to the world! jobs.description: WORK OPTION: The NBA currently provides eligible employees the option of working remotely one day per week. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **Position Summary** The National Basketball Association (NBA) is seeking a highly skilled Sr AI Site Reliability Engineer to own the reliability, performance, security and operational readiness of the league's enterprise AI platform and agentic systems. Reporting to the Head of Technology \& Infrastructure Operations, this senior technical expert owns AI SRE Operations, applying site reliability engineering discipline to AI gateways, AI identity, agent runtimes, model serving, integrations, and the connected AI enterprise infrastructure these services depend on. The role partners with AI platform engineering, Cybersecurity, application and business technology teams to translate the NBA's AI vision into resilient, observable, cost\-governed production services. It is an infrastructure engineering and operations role, not a model development role: development teams retain ownership of models and applications, while the Sr AI Site Reliability Engineer provides the platform enablement, operational standards and production support that let approved AI use cases run securely at enterprise scale. The position is an individual contributor role in the SRE AI Operations capability being established within Infrastructure \& Operations. **Major Responsibilities** **AI SRE Operations, Reliability and Incident Management** ---------------------------------------------------------- * Own AI SRE operations for the enterprise AI platform, defining and meeting service level indicators, service level objectives and error budgets for AI gateways, agent runtimes, model serving, inference, integrations and connected AI enterprise infrastructure. * Lead incident management for AI workloads, including on\-call protocols, post\-incident reviews and systemic reliability improvements across models, agents, integrations and MCP servers. * Operate the agent runtime and harness, including orchestration, scaling, memory, tool usage and workflow execution, so that agents run consistently, securely and reliably in production. Operate model serving and the inference platform, including compute, routing, optimization, caching and orchestration, supporting multiple model providers and both foundation and custom models at enterprise scale. * **AI Gateway, Identity and Agent Communication** ------------------------------------------------ * Operate and harden the AI Gateway as the single, governed entry point for all AI models, agents and AI applications, enforcing authentication, routing, guardrails, rate limiting, cost controls and policy on every AI interaction. * Operate the MCP Gateway as a secure broker between agents and MCP servers, enforcing identity, authorization, traffic policy and auditing for all agent\-to\-tool communication. * Establish and manage AI identity for users, agents and services, including service identities, delegated permissions, credential management and least\-privilege access to models, tools and data. Manage Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) communication, discovery, orchestration and workflow coordination so that agents can securely collaborate, delegate tasks and share context across business domains. * **Agent, MCP and Integration Lifecycle** ---------------------------------------- * Maintain the agent registry as the centralized catalog of approved agents, tools, skills, versions, ownership and metadata, enabling secure discovery, reuse, lifecycle tracking and interoperability. * Manage the complete agent lifecycle, from development and testing through deployment, monitoring, updates, retirement and governance review. * Provide centralized management of MCP servers, tools, connectors and integrations, including consistent onboarding, versioning, access management and operational support. * Connect AI models and agents to enterprise applications, data platforms, APIs and event streams through standardized, supportable connectors with consistent security, error handling and monitoring. prompt injection defense, jailbreak testing, and output\-quality regression. * Background supporting media, sports, entertainment, or live\-event operations. **Other key attributes /
