jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Applied AI
jobs.description: **About Norm** Norm builds AI\-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale. Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. Our shared agentic platform connects that progress across teams and services. Founded in 2023, Norm brings together experts across engineering, research, product, design and professional practice. Our legal and compliance platform serves institutions representing more than $35 trillion in combined assets under management. Norm also powers Norm Law, LLP, an affiliated AI\-native law firm whose attorneys advise leading institutions on complex corporate matters. **AI Fluency:** Norm prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day\-to\-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem\-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end\-to\-end. Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands\-on experience, not theoretical familiarity. **This Role** ------------- Applied AI builds Norm’s frontier AI products in close partnership with the people who use them. As an Engineering Manager, you’ll lead 4–8 engineers across one or two teams building AI agents for expert work. Your team works directly with attorneys at Norm Law and with enterprise clients, and you’re responsible for what it ships, how it ships, and how the people on it grow. This is a player\-coach role, with roughly half your time on people management and half on technical contribution, project coordination and delivery. You’ll remain close to production code, agent architectures and evaluations. **How You’ll Work** ------------------- The Applied AI team brings together full\-stack engineering, product and AI deployment experience. We work on the most difficult and valuable applications of AI to legal practice, including diligence, contract review, and fund formation, combining research, evaluations and product engineering across the full development cycle. You’ll work with Norm Law partners and associates: scoping products, reviewing live output and turning expert feedback into the next release. We start with a focused problem, build a high\-performing AI solution, then generalize what works. You’ll coordinate rollout plans with Engineering, Product and Design, work closely with the research team, and help other engineering managers develop through mentorship. **You Will** ------------ * Build a team that works hand in hand with attorneys. Set up the team so attorney judgment shapes product decisions, test sets and release gates from the start. * Build agent systems for document\-heavy expert work, including multi\-agent orchestration, ingestion and retrieval over large document sets, tool\-using agents with deterministic checks, and the evaluation infrastructure behind them. * Own the path from prototype to production. Get early versions in front of attorneys within weeks, measure how they use them, and decide with evidence whether to keep investing. * Contribute technically through production code, code review, architecture decisions, project coordination and execution. * Turn recurring patterns, such as document ingestion, an agent harness or a review interface, into shared components the rest of Norm’s engineering organization can build on. * Hire, coach and develop engineers through regular feedback, clear expectations and opportunities to grow. * Coordinate project delivery and rollout plans across teams, raising risks early and keeping commitments grounded in evidence. **Skills \& Experience \- Core** -------------------------------- * You are currently an engineering manager with at least 3 years of experience managing engineers, ideally on applied AI, forward\-deployed or product teams that shipped to demanding customers. * You still build. You can review production code, assess an agent architecture and tell a weak evaluation from a strong one. * You have taken software from early prototypes into production and can explain the technical and delivery decisions you owned. * You are steady in front of customers. You stay calm when stakes are high and raise risks before they turn into surprises. * You develop people. You have hired strong engineers and given them feedback they could act on the same week. * You collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical experts and turn their judgment into practical product and engineering decisions. **Skills \& Experience \- Pluses** ---------------------------------- * Experience building and evaluating LLM\-backed products, agent systems or document\-heavy workflows. * Experience in legal, financial services or another regulated industry. You do not need a legal background; the team’s legal engineers and attorneys bring the domain expertise. * Experience generalizing successful product patterns into reusable components across teams. **What Success Looks Like \- 90 Days** -------------------------------------- * You understand your team’s products, architecture and attorney workflows, and have contributed to a shipped release. * You have clear priorities and a working delivery and feedback cadence with your engineers, attorney partners and peer managers. * Your team uses attorney\-reviewed examples and evaluations to guide product decisions and release readiness. * Your engineers have clear expectations and regular coaching, and you have identified the most important delivery and team\-development priorities. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- **Base salary:** $275,000 \- $325,000 per year The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. **Equity:** Included **Benefits:** 401(k) with employer match, health, dental, vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, free lunch in office daily, employee referral bonus program **Relocation:** **\[If applicable]** For candidates needing to relocate to NYC, we provide relocation reimbursement. **Work Location** ----------------- **Location**: New York City (One World Trade) **Work** **model**: Hybrid **In\-office expectation**: 3–4 days per week To learn more about Norm, visit our **website**.

jobs.title: ML Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Opportunity** **About the Institute** Do you want to be part of an exciting new Institute focused on combining human and machine intelligence into working AI solutions? We are building a pioneering research and innovation hub in AI—one that will shape the way humans and machines collaborate for decades to come. Led by Prof. Samuel V. Scarpino, the Institute for Experiential AI is built around the challenges and opportunities made possible by human\-machine collaboration. The Institute provides a framework to design, implement, and scale AI\-driven technologies in ways that make a true difference to society. Our ability to respond to the opportunities afforded to society will depend on training and building a workforce that is AI\-capable and prosperous. Founded in 1898, Northeastern is a global research university and the recognized leader in experience\-driven lifelong learning. Our world\-renowned experiential approach empowers our students, faculty, alumni, and partners to create impact far beyond the confines of discipline, degree, and campus. **The Culture** Here at the Institute for Experiential AI (EAI) we are committed to the highest standards in all we do. Working at the EAI offers opportunities, an environment, and a culture that just isn’t found together anywhere else. This is the right place for you if you’re curious, motivated by the future of technology, and want to be part of a unique and diverse community that works on high\-impact research, educational, business, and societal problems. **Position Summary** Northeastern University's Institute for Experiential AI is opening an ML engineer with special focus on physical AI systems, knowledge aggregation and AI for control and optimization for a DOE Genesis project led by Dr. Ayan Paul. The ML Engineer will be based at the Boston campus, MA, conduct applied research, prepare work for submission to journal/conference publications, and contribute to extramural funding applications. The ML Engineer will work on projects that will include developing AI models for signal processing. Participation in this project will include scientific programming, data analysis, training AI models, manuscript preparation, meeting with collaborators, mentoring graduate students, etc. About the project: CLARA (Cognitive Layered Agentic Reasoning for ARIS) is a three\-year, Genesis Mission Phase II project led by Northeastern University with MSU/FRIB and Gravitate AI. It will build an agentic AI system for operating the Advanced Rare Isotope Separator (ARIS) at FRIB. ARIS operations are limited by the gap between LISE\+\+ simulations and observed beam behavior. As a result, weekly beam development takes 16 to 24 hours, about half of which goes to manual isotope calibration. Planning a new experiment takes about 20 days, and no predictive monitoring exists for roughly 200 time\-correlated machine parameters. CLARA addresses this with three objectives: * **Planning and tuning.** Bayesian optimization uses LISE\+\+ as a physics\-informed prior, alongside paired forward and inverse neural surrogates trained on simulation and EPICS archive data. These power a Planning Agent for non\-experts and an Expert Tuning Agent. * **Calibration.** Diffeomorphic image registration maps simulated particle identification (PID) distributions to measured ones from a single measurement. * **Monitoring and knowledge.** Quickest Change Detection models (classical CuSum and a transformer\-based DeepQCD) and a hazardous\-configuration classifier make up a Safety Agent with gated beam\-interrupt authority. A Critic module commits validated tunes to a knowledge graph built with eGoT. The targets are reducing experiment planning time to 1 to 2 days, beam development time to about 4 hours, and thus facilitating 500 to 800 extra beam hours per year. The project aims to advance from TRL 3 to TRL 6–7 and to validate transfer to at least one non\-ARIS separator. The ML Engineer hired for this position will work with Benjamin Gyori at Khoury College, Deniz Erdogmus at the College of Engineering, and Ayan Paul at EAI and is expected to develop AI algorithms, RAG pipelines and agentic systems for the Genesis project, collaborate with the FRIB experiment at the Michigan State University and Gravitate AI. Qualifications * MS in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or related fields or currently enrolled in a master’s program. * A minimum of 3\-4 years of experience working with ML/AI (TensorFlow/Pytorch) and ETL pipelines. * Proficiency in Python and R. Experienced with Unix and remote computing clusters. * Having experience in wrangling large datasets, building databases and ETL is preferred. * An ability to write clean and well\-documented code and work with GitHub repositories. * Experience in signal processing in the spaciotemporal domain. * Excellent organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking. * An ability to troubleshoot and problem\-solve in response to challenges, especially, in an iar domain. Experience with AWS is a plus but not required. Experience with high performance computing is preferred. * Values \& Abilities: * Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to communicate effectively with a variety of different stakeholders from various academic backgrounds. * Respect for diversity and the importance of interdisciplinary teams. * Self\-starter and innovative thinker and a team\-player who can collaborate effectively in a university setting. Open\-minded, assertive, and professional when collaborating and working within our team and with other groups within Northeastern University, Harvard Medical School, and University of Virginia. * Key Responsibilities: The Data Science and Machine Learning Engineer will be responsible for a wide variety of data\-oriented tasks, including: * Building data preprocessing pipelines for ML/AI models (TensorFlow/Pytorch) for data from ARIS. * Training machine learning models for signal processing * Documenting the entire process and all the codes generated and maintaining structured and regular commits in a Github repository. * Write reports/prepare slide decks describing work performed. * Contribute to scientific manuscripts and grant proposals where appropriate. **Position Type** Temporary **Additional Information** Northeastern University considers factors such as candidate work experience, education and skills when extending an offer. Northeastern has a comprehensive benefits package for benefit eligible employees. This includes medical, vision, dental, paid time off, tuition assistance, wellness \& life, retirement\- as well as commuting \& transportation. Visit https://hr.northeastern.edu/benefits/ for more information. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. This job is for a current or anticipated job vacancy. **Pay Rate:** $40/hour

jobs.title: Sr ServiceNow Developer
jobs.description: **About Northern Trust** As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. The ServiceNow Platform developer is accountable for designing and building end‑to‑end technical solutions on the ServiceNow platform and its core capabilities, in partnership with Enterprise Platforms leadership. This role ensures ServiceNow is secure, resilient, scalable, and supportable, while enabling enterprise business and IT workflows through well‑architected solutions aligned with enterprise standards. This role partners closely with platform leadership, process owners, enterprise architects, and senior IT stakeholders to translate platform strategy into durable technical designs, reference architectures, integrations, and operational practices that deliver measurable business value. The Senior ServiceNow Platform Engineer operates as a principal‑level individual contributor and the platform’s recognized technical authority, shaping platform direction, setting engineering standards, and ensuring ServiceNow solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, governance, and ITSM practices. The role is expected to operate with full autonomy, own the most complex and high‑risk technical work, and serve as a mentor and force multiplier for engineers and analysts across the organization. **Responsibilities** * Own the technical strategy and operational lifecycle of features on the ServiceNow platform, shaping the respecitve roadmap with platform leadership and driving platform optimization, upgrade strategy, and retirement decisions while ensuring stability, security, and scalability. * Define the architecture and design standards for ServiceNow solutions across ITSM and related capabilities (e.g., Incident, Change, Request, CMDB, Knowledge, Integrations), establishing reference patterns that keep solutions well‑architected, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards. * Lead complex technical implementations and enhancements, including workflow design, scripting, integrations, data models, and performance tuning; serve as technical lead for large, multi‑team initiatives and set the engineering direction for major programs. * Provide Tier 2 support, leading critical incident investigations, directing root cause analysis, and driving long‑term corrective and preventive actions across teams. * Influence and partner with enterprise architecture, security, infrastructure, and application leaders to design and govern secure, compliant, and supportable integrations between ServiceNow and upstream/downstream systems. * Establish and evolve platform operational discipline, including monitoring, alerting, runbooks, release readiness, change controls, and operational metrics, and drive adoption across teams to improve reliability and predictability. * Define, track, and analyze platform health and performance metrics, including availability, incident trends, change success rates, and technical debt; present insights, risks, and strategic recommendations to platform and IT senior leadership. * Set documentation and engineering standards, and ensure high‑quality technical documentation, including design patterns, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles; reduce reliance on tribal knowledge and improve onboarding readiness. * Mentor and coach ServiceNow engineers, analysts, and administrators, lead technical reviews and communities of practice, and raise overall platform maturity and engineering quality. * Stay ahead of ServiceNow platform capabilities, industry trends, and ITSM and ITAM best practices, evaluating emerging technologies and proactively recommending innovations and continuous improvements aligned with business and IT strategy. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred. * 5\+ years of experience in ServiceNow platform engineering, architecture, administration, or development roles. * 3\+ years of hands‑on experience designing, configuring, and supporting large‑scale enterprise ServiceNow implementations (ITSM and related modules). * 5\+ years of experience providing Tier 3 platform support, including acting as the primary technical escalation point for critical and complex issues. * Proven ability to independently architect, implement, and support complex ServiceNow solutions and integrations at enterprise scale. * Expert‑level scripting and configuration experience (e.g., business rules, script includes, client scripts, workflows/flows). * Strong documentation skills with experience establishing standards for enterprise‑grade technical documentation and operational runbooks. * Strong communication skills with the ability to influence and advise technical and non‑technical stakeholders, including senior leadership. * Eligible to work in the United States without current or future employer visa sponsorship. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience owning or co‑owning ServiceNow strategy for ITSM, roadmaps, or governance models, ideally at enterprise scale. * Strong understanding of ITIL 4 practices, particularly Incident, Change Enablement, Problem, and Service Design. * Experience designing and operating enterprise integrations (REST/SOAP, event‑driven patterns, identity and access integrations) and defining integration standards. * Experience supporting platform upgrades, patching, and release management in regulated or high‑availability environments. * Hands on experience implementing best practices for CMDB architecture, data quality, and service mapping concepts. * Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD, or automated testing approaches within ServiceNow or comparable platforms. Salary Range: $114,500 \- 194,700 USD*Salary range is a good faith estimate of base pay. Northern Trust provides a comprehensive benefits package including retirement benefits (401k and pension), health and welfare benefits (medical, dental, vision, spending accounts and disability), paid time off, parental and caregiver leave, life \& accident insurance, and other voluntary and well\-being benefits. Northern Trust also provides a discretionary bonus program that may include an equity component.* **Work Authorization** Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Northern Trust will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H\-1B, L\-1, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, F\-1, J\-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment\-based visa). **Working with Us** As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. **Reasonable Accommodation** Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nu** ============ Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human\-centered services. Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability. Visit our Institutional Page ***About the Role*** -------------------- At Nu, you’ll work with a view of customer behavior that few companies have. Many companies predict what people might buy from page likes and video views. Nu sees what customers actually spend on, through their financial transactions. nuFormer is the first banking transformer foundation model used in production to improve financial decisions for more than 100 million customers across multiple countries. Its teams turn this data into a deeper understanding of customers and into models that make a real difference in people’s financial lives. You’ll work alongside colleagues from many backgrounds, tackling hard problems where artificial intelligence meets financial services. ***You’ll be Responsible for*** ------------------------------- Leading a team who improve the data behind nuFormer. Your team will explore how better data quality, richer financial signals, and new ways of preparing and using data can expand what the model can do. You’ll grow your engineers, set the team’s technical direction, and turn research findings into production improvements. You’ll also stay hands\-on in technical decisions, including reviewing designs and contributing code when the path forward is unclear. * Guides the team’s research and engineering work on the data behind nuFormer, and delivers measurable production improvements to model performance and data quality. * Gives regular feedback, discusses performance and career goals, and coaches each engineer toward their next stage of growth. * Translates company goals into engineering priorities and a medium\-term technical roadmap. Coordinates with partner teams and updates the roadmap as needs change. * Makes architecture decisions, reviews system designs, and contributes code to solve complex problems, from design through implementation. * Spots and resolves issues such as poor data quality, declining model performance, unstable training, and infrastructure bottlenecks. Reviews models for quality, accuracy, and bias. * Reports progress and priorities to leaders, explains technical tradeoffs in plain language, and brings relevant new research into production ***What We're Looking For Someone Who Has*** -------------------------------------------- ***Required*** * A master’s degree or PhD in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field. * Experience developing software in production. * Experience leading the design and improvement of machine learning systems, including data processing, model evaluation, deployment, debugging, and fine\-tuning. * Experience in technical leadership, including directly managing machine learning teams in large\-scale environments, such as major technology companies or frontier research labs. * Experience setting technical strategy and roadmaps that cover the full machine learning lifecycle, from bringing data into the system to serving models in production. * Experience working with product, data science, and research partners to define problems suited to machine learning and deliver measurable results. * A record of hiring, developing, and retaining machine learning engineers, and of building teams that make progress amid uncertainty. ***Nice to Have*** * Experience with advanced deep learning architectures, including transformer\-based models. * Experience running data\-focused machine learning research on how data quality, selection, and representation affect model performance, and applying the findings to training data and systems. * Experience applying techniques from published research to production systems. * Experience carrying out responsible AI practices, such as risk assessments, bias mitigation, and model quality reviews. * Examples of using AI tools to change a workflow, with measurable gains in efficiency or quality. * Ongoing practice building your own AI skills, such as writing prompts, designing the context given to models, or coordinating multiple AI agents ***Location*** * Miami, United States * Washington DC, United States ***Work model*** **Hybrid 2\-3 times/week**: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu\-hybrid\-work\-model/ ***Our Benefits*** ------------------ * Total compensation includes base salary, RSUs and benefits. Base salary range: $216k \- $324k. Location\-Specific Disclosures + Opportunity of earning equity at Nu + Medical Insurance + Dental and Vision Insurance + Life Insurance and AD\&D + Extended maternity and paternity leaves + Nucleo \- Our learning platform of courses + NuLanguage \- Our language learning program + NuCare \- Our mental health and wellness assistance program + 401K Saving Plans \- Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account + Work\-from\-home Allowance + Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers. To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.description: **About this Job** ------------------ The Division of Administration/Office of Technology Services has a vacancy. This position is located in the Architecture, Standards \& Platform Section. Req. 228705 The Office of Technology Services (OTS) aims to be a responsible partner in delivering innovative, effective, and reliable solutions that support and enhance the IT functions within the Executive Branch Departments. The Office of Technology Services will work to increase the return on the State's investment in technology by promoting smart decision\-making, solving problems intelligently, increasing the rate of project success, and fostering a skilled and professional staff. This position is within the Office of Technology Services (OTS), Architecture Standards and Platforms, Development Enterprise Applications section. The incumbent is responsible for the development of new and existing applications using tools and processes according to the standards developed by OTS. Division offices perform a wide variety of activities, including the following: * Overseeing the state’s capital construction program * Working to provide state and federal grants for community development * Development of the state budget * Providing technology services * Giving agencies guidance in the state purchasing and contracting process as they seek goods and services * Administering a program that provides federal funds to help Louisiana residents recover from a series of devastating hurricanes **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- Five years of experience in information technology; OR Six years of full\-time work experience in any field plus three years of experience in information technology; OR An associate's degree in information technology plus three years of experience in information technology; OR A bachelor’s degree plus three years of experience in information technology; OR A bachelor’s degree with twenty\-four semester hours in an information technology, computer science, engineering, mathematics, or business analytics field plus two years of experience in information technology; OR A master’s degree plus two years of experience in information technology. EXPERIENCE SUBSTITUTION: Every 30 semester hours earned from an accredited college or university will be credited as one year of experience towards the six years of full\-time work experience in any field. The maximum substitution allowed is 120 semester hours which substitutes for a maximum of four years of experience in any field. NOTE: A certification in an approved area may be substituted for the education and/or experience requirements at the time of hire or promotion, provided the appointment is made from a Certificate of Eligibles. **Job Specification** --------------------- The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here. **Job Duties and Other Information** ------------------------------------ Job Duties: **Leads core application development and analysis activities to deliver high quality:** * Leads the design, coding, compilation, testing, debugging, and documentation of new or existing applications within accepted standards, procedures and guidelines. * Influences and guides the implementation of the State’s software delivery strategy, providing guidance and review of designs to ensure methodology, best practices and standards are followed and to ensure overall quality of solutions. * Identifies, researches and resolves programming, data, or system software problems, frequently on an individual basis in consultation with other employees and/or users. * Explains program and system modifications to product owners and developers. **Stays engaged and aligned with organizational initiatives and continuous improvement efforts:** * Oversees the evaluation of feature and change requests to determine specific tasks and effects on existing programs and systems. Explains program and system modifications to product owners and developers. * Contributes technical guidance and expertise for software modernization initiatives. * Adopts and enables technology standards, researches and remains informed of new technologies and development tools in line with the OTS Technology Stack. * Provides leadership, advice, training and mentorship to team members and other staff on current best practices around software development and delivery. * Performs all other tasks, special projects, analysis, studies, and plans as directed. Information from the background check will not necessarily preclude employment, but will be considered in determining the applicant’s suitability and competence to perform in the position. jobs.title: Sr. Systems Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.** **The Opportunity** Are you a passionate technical expert with a strong background in presales engineering and a knack for transforming customer challenges into innovative solutions? If so, you'll thrive in our dynamic Systems Engineering team at Nutanix, where you’ll have the opportunity to leverage your skills to drive customer success and be part of a collaborative environment focused on cutting\-edge enterprise cloud technology. **About the Team** The Sr. Systems Sales Engineer will be part of the Systems Engineering \& Solution Sales team at Nutanix, a dynamic group based in Houston. This team's culture is characterized by collaboration, innovation, and a strong customer\-centric approach. Their mission is to identify and align technology opportunities with customer business goals, ensuring that clients achieve success through the integration of Nutanix's advanced solutions. jobs.title: Lead Data Science Engineer
jobs.description: Company On The Spot Development Team Stealth teams Department Data \& Analytics Belarus Poland Georgia Remote B2B Data \& Analytics Stealth teams Remote Belarus Poland Georgia ### **About On The Spot** On The Spot Development helps tech companies build engineering teams in Poland and Georgia. For this role, On The Spot Development is the recruitment partner of a customer that is not named publicly yet. ### **About the team** Our customer is a fast\-growing, VC\-backed HR\-tech startup. Their product helps people automate their job search, from finding relevant roles to preparing applications. ‍ You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering Leads to shape technical solutions, set quality standards, and grow the team’s capabilities. ### **About the role** You’ll guide the DS/ML team and turn research into production solutions that directly improve the user experience. Recommendation systems are the main focus. You’ll also work on classification, matching, structured data extraction, and AI agents for workflow automation. You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering Leads to shape technical solutions, set quality standards, and grow the team’s capabilities. This is a hands\-on role. You must be able to write production code and deliver solutions end\-to\-end yourself, while leading the team through research, development, deployment, and ongoing improvement. ### **Responsibilities** * **Technical direction for AI features.** Build a roadmap with Product and choose approaches based on expected impact, evidence and cost. * **Team leadership.** Plan work, assign ownership, manage risks and dependencies, review code and experiments, mentor team members and help hire as the team grows. * **Recommendations and personalization.** Improve retrieval and ranking using profile, content and behavioral signals. Handle cold start, incomplete data, changing preferences, freshness and diversity. * **Applied ML and AI agents.** Build classification, matching, extraction and automation capabilities. Choose between traditional ML, LLMs and simpler methods based on the problem. * **Data, research and evaluation.** Build reliable datasets and features, test hypotheses and set clear quality standards. Validate labels, prevent leakage, account for behavioral bias and connect offline evaluation with real user outcomes. * **Production delivery.** Build and deploy models and services yourself. Establish monitoring and release checks, resolve regressions, and balance quality with latency, reliability and cost. ### **Requirements** * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Data Science or ML engineering, building and maintaining production solutions. * 2\+ years leading a DS/ML team while staying technically hands\-on. * Production experience with recommendation systems: retrieval, ranking, personalization and behavioral signals. * Personal experience deploying and operating ML models or services, including monitoring, troubleshooting and rollback. * Strong Python and SQL, with current experience writing maintainable production code. * Practical knowledge of model training, feature engineering, embeddings and classification. * Experience with offline evaluation and A/B tests, and with linking technical metrics to product results. * Strong system design skills across data pipelines, training, inference, service integration and scaling. * Practical understanding of LLMs, their limitations and how to evaluate their outputs. * Independence and sound judgment: you structure open\-ended problems, explain trade\-offs, challenge proposals and drive work to a verified result. ### **Nice to have** * Experience with marketplaces or two\-sided matching. * Hybrid search, vector databases and ANN indexes. * Session\-based recommendations and exploration strategies. * Production experience with LLM agents, tool use and structured extraction. * Model distillation or active learning. ### **Benefits** The benefit package will be discussed individually during the interview process.

jobs.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to build a new Data Processing Unit (DPU) platform spanning networking and storage. You will solve problems involving packet processing, host\-to\-DPU data movement, concurrency, and predictable performance under congestion and resource pressure. You will be the technical owner of a substantial component: its architecture, interfaces, implementation, performance, and operational readiness. Starting from broad requirements, you will resolve design choices and drive delivery with partner engineers. You will propose changes that cross component boundaries and align them with subsystem owners. Deep networking expertise is essential; storage familiarity is required and substantial storage experience is especially valuable. **What you will do** * **Own component architecture and delivery.** Translate broad requirements into a component design and executable milestones. Make architectural and implementation decisions within agreed subsystem boundaries and carry the work through production. * **Design high\-performance data paths.** Build packet processing, network virtualization, forwarding, policy, or acceleration capabilities. Make deliberate choices about concurrency, buffering, memory ownership, and hardware interfaces. * **Define and coordinate interfaces.** Establish component contracts with networking, storage, firmware, and hardware partners. Resolve dependencies and drive integration; escalate tradeoffs that require subsystem\-wide decisions. * **Own component performance.** Define representative benchmarks and performance targets. Investigate throughput, tail latency, CPU utilization, and memory efficiency, validating improvements under load and resource pressure. * **Evaluate storage interactions.** Assess how component choices affect storage I/O performance, backpressure, and failure handling. Work with storage engineers to preserve correctness and reliable recovery. * **Deliver production readiness.** Own component instrumentation, fault handling, compatibility, and upgrade behavior. Drive qualification and operational improvements, including difficult cross\-layer debugging and production support. * **Guide engineers and engineering quality.** Mentor engineers, lead component design reviews, and establish useful tests and performance regression checks. Help feature owners make independent decisions within the architecture. * **Improve responsible AI practices.** Validate AI\-assisted work and help the team adopt effective coding, testing, debugging, and documentation practices. Reduce repetitive work while preserving quality, accountability, and a sustainable engineering experience. **Required qualifications** =========================== * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience in systems or infrastructure software, including substantial hands\-on experience building high\-performance networking data planes. * Demonstrated ownership of substantial component architecture and delivery from broad requirements through production. * Deep experience implementing or optimizing packet processing systems, with strong knowledge of network virtualization, forwarding, encapsulation, and traffic management. * Strong C or C\+\+ proficiency and Linux systems knowledge, including concurrency, memory management, multicore processing, and performance profiling. * Familiarity with storage architectures and data paths, and ability to evaluate how component choices affect storage performance and failure handling. * Ability to diagnose complex correctness or performance issues across software layers using measurements and repeatable experiments. * Experience defining interfaces, coordinating technical dependencies, and owning component performance and operational readiness. * Clear design communication and experience mentoring engineers through reviews, implementation, and debugging. * A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred qualifications** ============================ Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable. Experience with every listed technology is not required. * **Packet processing.** DPDK or comparable user\-space frameworks; virtual switching, connection tracking, policy enforcement, or offload implementation. * **DPU acceleration.** DPUs, SmartNICs, AMD Pensando, NVIDIA BlueField/DOCA, P4, or comparable technologies. * **Storage.** Substantial storage development experience; block storage, NVMe, NVMe over Fabrics, RDMA, or storage virtualization. * **Hardware and production.** PCIe, DMA, SR\-IOV, IOMMU, zero\-copy techniques, hardware co\-design, staged deployments, fault injection, or upgrade compatibility. **What success looks like** =========================== You will deliver a critical component with a clear architecture, stable interfaces, and demonstrated performance and reliability. You will independently resolve component\-level decisions, coordinate integration, and help engineers deliver within that architecture. **Why join us** =============== Shape a new platform through architectural ownership of a critical component. You will make consequential software and hardware tradeoffs, partner with experienced networking and storage engineers, and carry your designs from exploration into production.

jobs.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Builds fault\-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met. Key Responsibilities System Design \& Architecture \- System Scalability: –Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools. –Optimizes code and/or systems for large\-scale data processing in large\-scale systems. –Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members. –Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large\-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. –Implements performance and load testing. System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Design: –Collaborates with team to build fault\-tolerant components capable of withstanding in\-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. –Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions. –Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Voice AI
jobs.description: **About Owner** Owner is the AI\-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants. We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business. It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more. **Product philosophy** Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically. Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it. Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you. **Our vision** We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online. But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive. Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type. In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age. **Our traction** Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website. More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees. **Our team** Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe. We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth. **Where we work** Owner is a remote\-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in\-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location! **Role Overview** The Voice AI team builds the AI that answers a restaurant's phone. When a guest calls, our agent picks up, takes a pickup order validated against the live menu, answers questions about hours and the restaurant, and sends the order straight to the kitchen, or hands the call to staff when a person is the better answer. We also build the tooling that lets restaurants go live without an engineer in every launch. If a restaurant joins Owner, our team is how its phone turns into orders and revenue instead of missed calls, and how guests get what they need while staff stay focused on service. This is not a typical backend or ML role. Real\-time voice is unforgiving: a guest on the line notices every extra half\-second, every interruption handled badly, and every wrong modifier. The team works across streaming speech and LLM pipelines, telephony, turn\-taking, and recovery when speech, model, or network services fail mid\-call, and we measure quality on real calls, not demos. We're scaling well beyond our first live restaurants, and we automate everything we can, including with AI. As the Engineering Manager, you'll lead this team and own its delivery and technical direction. You'll build a team that ships quickly with a high bar for quality, and you'll own hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management. Your scope spans the real\-time voice experience, the systems that connect conversations to restaurant menus and ordering, and the tooling and engineering support that help restaurants launch and run reliably. This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada. For San Francisco\-based candidates: we have a new HQ in the Presidio for optional in\-person collaboration. **Why we’re looking for you** Owner helps independent restaurants grow their business. The phone is still how a huge share of restaurant orders start, and too many of those calls go unanswered or get passed to a busy host. Our voice agents answer those calls, take orders, and help guests get what they need while restaurant staff focus on service. Real restaurants are already using it, and the product has proven the idea. The next challenge is scale. Improving call quality, making onboarding self\-serve, and keeping the agent reliable across more restaurants takes dedicated engineering leadership. Today, voice delivery, technical direction, and engineering support are spread across existing leads. We're hiring an Engineering Manager to own them, grow the team, and set the bar for how we build real\-time voice AI at Owner. **Our Tech Stack** * Voice \& Real\-time: LiveKit, Gemini, streaming STT/LLM/TTS pipelines, full call lifecycle persisted * Agents \& AI: Vercel AI SDK, tool calling, agent loops, conversation state * Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, PostgreSQL * Frontend \& Tooling: React, TypeScript, restaurant onboarding and launch tooling * Observability \& Evals: Datadog, Braintrust, LangSmith, call replay and regression testing **The impact you'll have** * Lead, hire, and grow the Voice AI team. Give direct feedback, support career growth, manage performance, and help engineers take ownership of systems and outcomes. * Set technical direction and turn product goals into focused plans. Partner with Product, Design, and Customer Success to prioritize work around restaurant needs and follow through from development to rollout. * Improve the conversation experience: response latency, turn\-taking, interruptions, and recovery when speech, model, or telephony services fail. * Make phone ordering dependable. Help the team handle menu options and modifiers, validate orders, prevent duplicate submissions, and hand calls off to restaurant staff when needed. * Establish quality measures grounded in real calls. Use call reviews, automated evaluations, and regression testing to improve order accuracy, task completion, and reliability as models and prompts change. * Own the team's production operations and engineering support. Build clear escalation paths, on\-call practices, and incident follow\-through, and turn recurring customer issues into product improvements. * Scale restaurant onboarding and launch tooling so more restaurants can go live with less manual engineering work. **What we’re looking for** * Experience managing software engineers, with ownership of hiring, coaching, career development, and performance. You can build trust, rally a team around a goal, and help experienced engineers do their best work. * A strong software engineering background and recent hands\-on work. You're comfortable setting architecture, contributing code, reviewing designs, and debugging across services. * Experience building and operating production voice AI or real\-time conversational systems, with depth in streaming speech pipelines or speech\-to\-speech models, telephony, latency, turn\-taking, and interruptions. * Experience with LLM tool calling, conversation state, and evaluations for systems whose responses vary. You can connect model behavior to whether a customer successfully completes a task. * Ownership of production reliability, including observability, incident response, and recovery from model, network, and downstream service failures. * Strong product judgment, clear communication, and a record of working closely with cross\-functional partners to ship useful products in a fast\-moving environment. **Compensation and benefits** * The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $240K\-$260K USD depending on level, location and experience, plus a generous pre\-IPO equity package. If you feel the range is too low, still please apply and let us know! * Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, work from anywhere (remote\-first workplace), unlimited PTO \- plus extra fun perks! **Notice \- Employment Scams** Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address. We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond. \#LI\-AB1

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
jobs.description: At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting\-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real\-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth. #### **About the Role** We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer IV to help build, scale, and operate our multi\-tenant cloud platform on AWS. This platform provides shared APIs, data pipelines, and identity services that support products across PDI. You’ll work in a modern TypeScript/Node.js environment that includes containerized services and serverless functions, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and an S3/Parquet data lake. This is a hands\-on senior engineering role for someone who is comfortable diving into an existing codebase, solving complex back\-end challenges, and owning solutions from initial design through production. You’ll also play an important role in modernizing legacy technology, including helping migrate SQL Server and .NET workloads to our cloud platform. ### **What You'll Do** * Design, build, test, and deploy scalable back\-end services and platform capabilities using TypeScript, Node.js, and AWS. * Build and maintain multi\-tenant APIs and event\-driven services using technologies such as REST, MQTT, SQS, and SNS. * Develop solutions with strong tenant isolation, authentication, and security using OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, and JWT. * Research, troubleshoot, and resolve software issues across services, data pipelines, and infrastructure. * Monitor application and platform performance through logs, metrics, and traces, proactively identifying opportunities to improve reliability and availability. * Partner with Product and Support teams to troubleshoot issues, prioritize enhancements, and improve the customer experience. * Provide senior\-level technical input during design discussions and help shape solutions for complex system changes and enhancements. * Identify opportunities to improve system performance, scalability, security, and supportability. * Help modernize legacy technology by migrating SQL Server stored procedures and .NET services to cloud\-native solutions. * Contribute to infrastructure as code, container builds, and CI/CD pipelines. * Write automated unit and integration tests and participate in peer code reviews to maintain high standards for quality and security. * Help reduce technical debt and continuously improve engineering practices and operational efficiency. * Participate in the team's on\-call rotation and incident response. * Share ideas, influence technical decisions, and contribute to the continued evolution of the platform. ### **What You'll Bring** * 6\+ years of professional software development experience, including at least 4 years developing and maintaining back\-end services using TypeScript/Node.js. * 4\+ years building high\-availability, high\-volume distributed services on AWS, using technologies such as Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, SQS, and Cognito. * Strong proficiency with TypeScript, Node.js, SQL, and PostgreSQL. * Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or similar platforms. * Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, OpenTofu, or similar technologies. * Strong understanding of application and cloud security, including OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, JWT, least\-privilege IAM, secrets management, and multi\-tenant data isolation. * Experience serving as a technical lead or senior developer on medium\- to large\-scale projects, with the ability to help drive design, development, and implementation. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex production issues. * Ability to evaluate system needs and recommend solutions that improve performance, scalability, reliability, and supportability. * Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and take ownership in a fast\-paced environment. * A collaborative mindset and willingness to dig into unfamiliar technology, ask questions, and learn quickly. * Ability to influence technical decisions and build alignment without relying on direct authority. * Experience effectively using AI\-assisted development tools while maintaining appropriate engineering, security, and code\-quality standards. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with C\#/.NET or SQL Server, particularly in environments undergoing cloud modernization. * Experience with data pipelines and analytical data technologies such as Parquet, DuckDB, Iceberg, or change data capture (CDC). * Experience modernizing or migrating legacy on\-premises applications to AWS. PDI is committed to offering a well\-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market\-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work\-life balance with ample time off \[time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

AI and Product Engineering to evolve our agentic architecture, translating emerging AI capabilities into scalable, production\-grade systems. * Drive technically complex projects from architecture jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, FeedForward 3D/4D Reconstruction
jobs.description: At Parallel Domain, we believe that autonomous systems – from self\-driving cars to contactless delivery drones – have the opportunity to drastically improve the quality of life for billions of people. That is why we love what we do: enabling our customers to develop their technology safely using the Parallel Domain data generation platform. Our platform revolutionizes the way our customers generate sensor data for AI development. We're looking for people like you to join us in pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence and synthetic data.**About the role** ------------------ Before any physical AI system is trusted in the real world, it has to prove itself in ours. Parallel Domain turns real captured drives into faithful digital replicas — geometry, appearance and motion that perception stacks are trained and validated against. We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to push our feed\-forward reconstruction stack forward — from static 3D toward full 4D scenes over time. You will join a small, deep team where your technical judgment carries real weight from day one, and your work will ship in a pipeline customers depend on. ### **What You'll Do** * **Advance our feed\-forward reconstruction models**. Improve how we predict geometry, camera pose and appearance from real capture with transformer\-based models, and extend it from static scenes to dynamic 4D. * **Train at scale**. Run multi\-node GPU training on large multi\-view and video datasets, and decide what to scale, what to ablate and when a result is real. * **Define what "good" means**. Build evaluation the team trusts for reconstruction quality, temporal consistency and geometric accuracy. * **Explore stronger priors**. Investigate where generative models, such as pre\-trained video diffusion, can help fill gaps the capture did not see. * **Land research in the product**. Work with the pipeline engineers to get results into production, and care whether they hold up there. * **Track the field**. This area moves monthly; form a view on where it is heading and argue for it. ### **What we're looking for** * **Hands\-on feed\-forward reconstruction experience**. You have built or trained feedforward 3D reconstruction models (for example in the lineage of DUSt3R, VGGT, π³ or D4RT), and you know where they work and where they break. * **A track record of models others relied on**. We weight demonstrated depth over years served : a recent PhD with the right focus and an experienced research engineer are both credible here. * **Large\-scale trainin**g. Practical experience with multi\-node, multi\-GPU training and telling a promising run from a stalled one early. * **Strong PyTorch skills** in a large shared codebase with real build and CI. * **Research judgment**. You turn an ambiguous direction into experiments that resolve something, and change your mind when the numbers say so. * **Clear communication** with researchers, pipeline engineers and leadership alike. ### **Strong pluses** These are listed in order of how much they matter to us. * **Feed\-forward Gaussian prediction**. Experience predicting 3D Gaussians directly from images in a single pass, rather than fitting them per scene. * **Top\-tier publications in feed\-forward reconstruction**. First\-author or significant work at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR or SIGGRAPH in this area. * **Video diffusion models**. Familiarity with diffusion or flow\-matching video models, especially camera\-conditioned generation. * **Dynamic scenes**. Work on dynamic reconstruction, scene flow or temporal consistency. * **Real\-world capture**. Experience with automotive, robotics or drone data and its mess: imperfect calibration, motion blur, poses you cannot trust. * **Making big models fast, or open\-source contributions** to widely used reconstruction libraries. €120,000 \- €170,000 a year Fully remote within Europe. The team works on Central European hours, with regular overlap with North America. **Why join Parallel Domain?** We are assembling a team of creative, talented visionaries seeking to build a new technology that will change the world. You will be able to learn, build, and scale our team and technology in a collaborative, creative culture that values every team member. To attract and inspire the right talent, we offer:* Competitive compensation (range will be openly discussed early in our interview process) * Employer\-paid supplemental medical, mental health, dental, and vision benefits. * Flexible paid vacation, sick time, winter shutdown, and 11\+ holidays per year * Paid parental leave * Equipment budget to optimize your setup * Annual learning and development stipend Parallel Domain celebrates diversity and is committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment for all our people. We are committed to providing employees with an environment free of discrimination, bullying and harassment. All employment decisions at Parallel Domain are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications. We will maintain our commitment to and support of equal employment opportunity for all individuals without regard to race, national/ethnic origin, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, family status, genetic characteristics or physical/mental disability. Our commitment extends to any other protected classes which may exist under applicable law. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description: ### **Why Patients Need You** Pfizer's Commercial organization is putting GenAI and AI agents into work that shapes how medicines reach patients, from content creation and review to field and customer engagement. If we can't show that these systems are accurate, safe and behaving as intended, they don't belong in production. You will build the engineering capability that lets Pfizer prove it, before release and every day after. ### **What You Will Achieve** You will own the evaluation and observability capability for AI solutions across the Commercial portfolio, and you will be accountable for the Commercial AI evaluation and observability standards: the metrics, thresholds and technical criteria that inform production\-readiness and ongoing monitoring decisions. You will build shared tooling, datasets and metrics that let product teams measure quality, safety and performance consistently, catch regressions before release, and detect drift and failures in production. You will set your team's priorities and decide where its engineering capacity goes across the portfolio. Success means teams evaluate through your platform by default, release decisions rest on evidence, and production AI issues are caught by monitoring before users or auditors find them. ### **How You Will Achieve It** * Build and run a shared evaluation platform for GenAI and agentic solutions. It covers offline test suites, regression testing in CI/CD, LLM\-as\-judge and rubric\-based scoring, and structured human review workflows. * Set the Commercial AI evaluation and observability standards, including metrics for accuracy, groundedness, hallucination, safety, bias, robustness and task success and the minimum monitoring every production AI solution must have. Calibrate automated scoring against expert human judgment and publish the agreement rates. * Partner with commercial technology leaders to create and govern golden datasets and test sets with domain experts (e.g., medical, legal and regulatory reviewers), including versioning, data lineage and handling of sensitive data. * Implement production observability for AI systems, including tracing of prompts, retrievals, tool calls and agent steps, plus monitoring of quality, drift, latency, cost and guardrail activity, with alerting and incident response. * Evaluate technical and model quality, with business outcomes and value measured separately. * Set the evaluation thresholds and technical production\-readiness criteria that feed release gates run by SDLC Standards \& Governance, and give a clear pass, conditional or fail assessment against them, so go\-live decisions rely on measured results rather than demos. * Partner with Responsible AI, Legal, Privacy, Cybersecurity and Compliance to turn policy requirements into measurable tests and auditable evidence, including support for AI\-related audits and regulatory inquiries. * Run adversarial and red\-team testing (e.g., prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage) with Cybersecurity, and feed the findings back into evaluation suites. * Evaluate models and vendors objectively when teams select or upgrade foundation models, AI platforms or third\-party AI products in partnership with Strategic Partnerships and contracting, so vendor decisions stay joined up. * Report quality and reliability trends across the AI portfolio to senior Digital and Commercial leadership. * Set priorities for the AI quality and observability team and allocate its engineering capacity against portfolio needs, based on risk, release timing and business impact. Make the trade\-offs visible and escalate when demand exceeds capacity. * Lead and develop a team of AI quality and observability engineers that will evolve over time, and coach product and vendor teams, including third\-party and offshore partners, to own their evaluations using shared tooling. ### **Decision Rights \& Escalation** * **Decides:** Commercial AI evaluation and observability standards, metrics, thresholds and minimum monitoring requirements; the technical readiness assessment for each release; team priorities and capacity allocation; evaluation tooling and platform design within enterprise architecture standards. * **Informs:** Release go/no\-go decisions made through SDLC stage gates and product ownership; model, platform and vendor selection decisions led with Strategic Partnerships and contracting. * **Escalates to the Commercial AI Portfolio Lead when:** a team wants to release a solution that does not meet agreed thresholds (risk acceptance); a production issue creates patient\-safety, compliance or reputational exposure; demand for evaluation support exceeds team capacity across priority programs; or Responsible AI, Legal or Cybersecurity cannot agree on how a requirement becomes a test. ### **Qualifications** **Must\-Have** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related field. * 8\+ years of experience in software, ML or data engineering, including 3\+ yea o achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact. **Other Job Details:** * Last Date to Apply for Job: **December 7, 2026\.** * Ability to travel based on business needs * This position is hybrid and requires working onsite 2 to 3 days per week The annual base salary for this position ranges from $189,200\.00 to $315,400\.00\. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 22\.5% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. jobs.title: Senior Manager, AI Engineer – Applied Intelligence
jobs.description: **ROLE SUMMARY** Applied Intelligence is the zero\-to\-one function of Pfizer’s commercial data science organization. It takes ambiguous, high\-value AI and machine learning problems in the commercial business, proves whether they can be solved and whether solving them is worth it, builds the first working version to production standards, and graduates it to the product team that will own and scale it. First versions are built to be understood, reproduced, and extended by teams who did not write them. As a Senior Manager, AI Engineer, you build the systems behind those first versions: the services, pipelines, agent runtimes, and data contracts that turn a proven idea into something that runs, can be trusted, and can be handed over. Current priorities include agentic decision systems that choose which healthcare professionals and consumers to reach, through which channels, and when. These systems take in new data as it arrives, keep track of what has happened and what is still pending, reason over the options, act through channels such as field teams, email, and digital media, and check whether the action worked. Large language models and agents are part of the design where their cost is justified, machine learning models carry the stable, well\-defined parts of the problem, and much of the work is careful software and data engineering. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with informal technical leadership. You will own the architecture of a first\-version system or a major component of one, set the engineering bar through code review and example, and write much of the core code yourself. The role supports US commercial use cases, building capabilities designed to extend to International as they graduate into products. **ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES** * **System design —** Own the architecture of a first\-version decision system or a major component of it: the data model, service boundaries, agent and tool interfaces, and behavior when things fail. Design so new channels, audiences, and signals can be added with little rework, and write down the decisions and the trade\-offs behind them. * **Agentic systems in production —** Build components on large language models with structured outputs, tool use, orchestration across multi\-step workflows, memory and state, and evaluation and guardrails appropriate for a regulated environment. Manage their cost, latency, and quality, and make every automated decision traceable: the data it used, the reasoning and logic that ran, and the action that followed. * **Hands\-on delivery —** Build services, pipelines, and workflow orchestration, mostly in Python, writing much of the core code personally. Build reliability in from the start, with safe retries, clear handling of partial failures, and the ability to replay past data through a new version of the system. * **Data \& decision records —** Own the pipelines and data contracts the system depends on, from upstream data platforms to the channels that act on decisions. Integrate with de\-identification and access controls for patient and consumer data. * **Models in production —** Work with data scientists to put machine learning models and decision logic into production, review the statistical assumptions behind them, and build the monitoring that surfaces drift and degradation before they matter. * **Engineering judgment —** Calibrate rigor to the cost of being wrong now and the cost of fixing later. Apply full validation wherever errors carry real consequences, and run the systems you build with monitoring, alerting, and safe release of changes. * **Graduation —** Build so the receiving product team can own the system: tests, documentation, environments, and a structured handoff covering dependencies, which contracts cannot change without discussion, and what was deliberately left unfinished. Turn what works into shared components and documented patterns that the next first version starts from. * **Engineering standards \& partners —** Set standards for testing, continuous integration and deployment, environments, observability, and documentation. Review external partner engineering work against those standards and own how it fits into the system. * **Technical leadership \& mentoring —** Mentor engineers and data scientists on software and AI engineering practice, and raise the technical standard of the team through code review and example. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS*** **Education \& experience —** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field with 6\+ years of relevant experience; OR a Master’s degree with 5\+ years of relevant experience; OR a PhD with 1\+ year of relevant experience. * **Production systems —** Has designed, shipped, and operated production systems with real reliability requirements, including owning the architecture of a system or a major component. * **Agentic \& LLM systems —** Hands\-on experience building production applications on ata analysis and sustained, detailed technical problem solving, including designing and interpreting statistical evaluations of models. Relocation support available Work Location Assignment: Hybrid Other Job Details: Last day to apply: December 1, 2026 The annual base salary for this position ranges from $139,100\.00 to $231,900\.00\. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 17\.5% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments.
