jobs.title: Software Engineer II (BotStopper)
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions: **Is this identity synthetic?** Detect AI\-generated and manipulated voice and video. **Is this identity risky?** Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals. **Is this identity known?** Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals. Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose\-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI\-driven interactions. Pindrop protects billions of high\-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real\-world interactions annually and protected by 300\+ patents. Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG. ### ### **What you'll do** As a Software Engineer II on the BotStopper team, you will help build the cloud\-native services and machine learning inference infrastructure powering Pindrop BotStopper™\- our real\-time AI voice detection solution that helps enterprises distinguish human callers from automated interactions and recognize known registered AI voices. Built on Pindrop Pulse detection technology and supported by intelligence from the AI Voice Consortium (AIVC), BotStopper helps enterprises identify automated interactions, protect customer experiences, and respond to emerging AI\-driven challenges across contact centers. As a mid\-level individual contributor, you'll bring solid backend engineering experience, take end\-to\-end ownership of assigned features and components, and collaborate closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and SRE to transform emerging technologies into secure, scalable, production\-ready systems. *More specifically, you will:* * Develop, test, deploy, and monitor backend services and APIs supporting BotStopper's real\-time detection and scoring capabilities, ensuring low latency, scalability, and reliability. * Own the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned features and components from implementation and testing through production rollout and operational support. * Help develop backend capabilities supporting known\-AI\-voice identification, including integration with the AI Voice Consortium (AIVC) infrastructure. * Collaborate with Research to integrate detection models and ML\-driven signals into production workflows. * Actively participate in code reviews, sharing knowledge with peers and incorporating constructive feedback to improve code quality and maintainability. * Design and develop backend services and APIs that support integrations with IVR, Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS), telephony, and conversational AI platforms. * Support production operations through incident response, troubleshooting, and applying fixes to maintain system reliability. After an initial onboarding period of approximately three months, participate in the team's established on\-call rotation. * Utilize AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering workflows, while responsibly validating generated code for correctness, security, and performance. ### **Who you are** * You maintain momentum when navigating partial requirements or production issues, recovering quickly from setbacks to continue delivering independently. * You share context, raise concerns constructively, and participate meaningfully in design and code review discussions with your peers. * You consistently deliver production\-ready services and APIs from start to finish, making sound engineering decisions based on available metrics and requirements. * You build trust by being transparent about progress, risks, and blockers, accurately representing work status and system behavior. * You use AI tools to accelerate development while thoughtfully reviewing and validating the output for correctness and security. ### **Your skill\-set** *Must Have:* * 2–5 years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of shipping stable, secure code to production. * Deep proficiency in Go, Python, or comparable backend programming languages, with a strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and concurrency patterns. * Strong Linux/Unix fundamentals and proficiency with Docker and container orchestration frameworks like Kubernetes. * Experience developing and operating cloud\-native applications using AWS, GCP, or comparable platforms. * Hands\-on experience with production data or messaging technologies such as PostgreSQL/Aurora, Redis, Kinesis, or similar systems. on under high\-volume production conditions. * Collaborate with experienced software engineers, research scientists, ML engineers, and product leaders who value thoughtful debate, technical depth, and continuous improvement. * Grow your career by learning to independently design solutions for complex problems and contributing to operational excellence, preparing you for the Senior Software Engineer level. * AI is changing both what we build and how we build it. You'll be encouraged to incorporate AI responsibly into your development workflow, experiment with emerging tools, and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and quality. ### **What we offer** As a part of Pindrop, you'll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice\-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here's a snapshot of the benefits we offer: * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) * Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year, subject to manager approval and applicable company policies. * Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year * Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long\-term success. * While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in\-person moments through regular team on\-sites, company\-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success. * Generous health and welfare plans to choose from \- including one employer\-paid "employee\-only" plan! * Best\-in\-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution * Low\-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind. * Paid Parental Leave \- Including birth, adoptive \& foster parents * + One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It's our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family! * Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work. * Enhanced fertility and GLP\-1 benefits to support family\-building journeys and personalized health needs. * Annual Learning \& Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill\-building, certifications, and continued education. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-HB1 **Not sure if this is you?** ---------------------------- We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you're not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time. ### **AI \- A Transformative Force** At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting\-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine. Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed. ### **Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer** Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

We exist to Elevate Experiences — combining cutting\-edge production with a deeply human touch, holding ourselves to a standard where exceptional is the baseline. We're guided by three core values: Excellence is our attitude. Innovation is our mindset. Our people make the difference. If you show up prepared, take ownership of your craft, and want to grow alongside a team that holds itself to high standards, we'd love to meet you. Pinnacle Live is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where every team member can thrive. **Job Summary** --------------- * **Location:** Remote * **Employment Type:** Full\-time * **Reports To:** SVP, Data and AI Enablement Pinnacle Live's internal Technology Operations team is looking for an Application Development Lead/Manager to guide our high\-performing, AI\-first development team. This is a player\-coach role: you'll lead the team day to day while staying hands\-on in architecture, code reviews, and delivery. You'll own the architectural and security standards behind the applications that support our operations across the organization, and keep them current as our technology and team evolve. You'll set how the team works with AI coding agents — which tools we use, the guardrails around them, and how AI\-generated code is reviewed and shipped. Working closely with product owners and business stakeholders, you'll turn priorities into applications that are accurate, perform well, and are cost\-effective to run. You'll also help recruit and grow the engineers who join the team. **Supervisory Responsibilities** -------------------------------- Manages a small team of engineers **Required Skills \& Knowledge** -------------------------------- To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed herein are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. ### **Required** * 8\+ years of professional software development experience, including at least 5 years leading or managing engineering teams (hiring, coaching, and performance management), with recent hands\-on coding experience. * Strong command of application architecture and security standards, including scalable and maintainable system design, secure SDLC practices, identity and access management, and secrets management. * Hands\-on experience building modern web applications with React and TypeScript/JavaScript, plus RESTful APIs and at least one backend language such as Node.js, Python, or C\#/.NET. * Experience designing, deploying, and operating applications on Microsoft Azure (preferred) — e.g., App Service, Functions, Azure SQL, Key Vault — or comparable services on AWS or GCP. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and source control (GitHub), automated testing, and production monitoring. * Daily, practical use of AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) and a clear point of view on review, testing, and security practices for AI\-generated code. * Track record of improving application accuracy, performance, and cloud cost through monitoring, tuning, and right\-sizing infrastructure. * Excellent written and verbal communication with executive leadership, product and application leaders, and engineers, including explaining technical tradeoffs in business terms. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Preferred** * Experience with cloud cost management practices and tools (FinOps, Azure Cost Management). * Experience building AI\-powered features into business applications (LLM APIs, agents, retrieval). * Experience with SQL Server/Azure SQL and Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) integrations. * Experience running Agile/Scrum delivery alongside product owners. * Background in hospitality, live events, or other multi\-site operational businesses. Pinnacle Live does not provide visa sponsorship for this position **Travel Demands** ------------------ Occasional travel for team gatherings **Benefits** ------------ * Generous time off with PTO, holidays and sick/personal days * 401k with a contribution match * Insurances; health, vision, dental and more ### **Pinnacle Live is an E\-verify and Equal Employment Opportunity Employer** Pinnacle Live is committed to welcoming, valuing, and supporting every person and their unique contributions. We are actively working to foster an environment where diversity, equity, inclusion, belonging, and mutual respect thrive. We recognize that diversity is intersectional, and that actively valuing diversity demands that we continually strive to establish a welcoming atmosphere for all. Pinnacle Live welcomes, openly acknowledges, empowers, and celebrates the diversity of all our team members, clients, and partners, and affirms the identities and experiences of all our members. We strive to create an environment where we actively embrace all forms of diversity.

Establish training and portal revenue, delivery costs, and gross margin by offer with Finance, inventory existing courses and prioritize what to build, digitize, refresh, or retire, and validate one recurring need with buyers. Select one delivery bottleneck with a practice sponsor, calibrate the level definitions for that workflow, and agree on individual progression plans, expert time, and the first digital tool to test. * By six months, show the result of that pilot: who advanced a level, where an agent enabled earlier contribution, what judgment the learner demonstrated, and whether quality and client milestones held, then present the case to expand, redesign, or stop. Publish a priority digital learning path and verify that pilot learners can complete its target workflow, and pilot a paid offer with a defined buyer, price, and cost model, showing actual purchase decisions, customer proficiency, and realized margin before recommending expansion. * By the end of year one, show progress against targets agreed with the VP and practice leaders: time to demonstrated proficiency, independent coverage for priority skills, and expert hours required per comparable engagement, reviewed alongside rework or defects. Review learning revenue and gross margin against plan, separating one\-time training from recurring revenue, and track training purchases on eligible deals, renewals among eligible learning subscribers, and customer ability to perform target workflows. * Own the PS proficiency framework and the plan for moving people through it while they keep delivering: work with each practice to translate levels into observable decisions, work samples, and quality criteria, calibrate assessors across practices, baseline each consultant from observed work, and agree on a target level, next assignment, named coach, review date, and the evidence required for advancement. Develop people on staffed engagements through bounded stretch assignments, and certify progression by observing them validate an output, catch a faulty recommendation, and explain how a changed fact affects the decision. * Own digital enablement tools and AI agents: set the roadmap, commission builds with technical partners, test tools with practitioners against expert\-reviewed cases, put approved tools into the delivery workflow, keep their guidance current as products change, and decide when to improve or retire them. * Own the commercial plan for the customer learning business: build the annual plan and forecast with Finance, set revenue and margin targets with the VP, and design offers customers will buy and renew, from private workshops and role\-based learning paths to an annual portal subscription, validating willingness to pay before you scale. Take each offer to market with Sales, Account Management, and Customer Success. * Own the training curriculum and run the function: set the roadmap for customer users, administrators, and PS consultants, turn high\-demand classroom material into self\-paced modules, guided demonstrations, practice labs, and assessments while preserving live coaching where decisions need feedback, coach trainers and content developers, and protect scheduled customer training commitments. Qualifications: * Leadership in a delivery business: a track record leading teams and setting cross\-practice priorities in enterprise software professional services, implementation consulting, or a comparably complex environment, including trade\-offs between customer commitments, billable delivery, and developing future capacity that you can explain to executives. * Demonstrated proficiency gains: you've taken a capability concentrated in a few people and built credible independent coverage, defined and applied skill standards, developed people on active assignments, and owned digital performance\-support tools, and you can show how you assessed their effect on practitioner judgment and delivery quality. * Commercial ownership of customer education: you've owned financial results for a paid training, learning subscription, or comparable enablement offering and can explain who bought it, why they paid, how you priced and delivered it, and what you changed when sales, margins, or renewals missed expectations. You've led a curriculum team from design through digital publication and can show how you tested whether learners could apply the material. * People and peer leadership: you've developed trainers, practitioners, or enablement leaders and influenced peers who control delivery capacity, and you can challenge a weak certification standard, secure time for practice, and stop an initiative when the evidence no longer supports it. **Even Better If…** * Experience with financial applications. * Experience with energy or utilities customers. * Experience with enterprise SaaS implementations. * Experience with governed AI\-assisted knowledge tools. **PowerPlan is an EOE** Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice Please note that this is a hybrid role that involves a combination of onsite work from our corporate office as well as work from home. While we strive to accommodate flexible working arrangements when sensible, there will be times when onsite work is required. This could include scheduled office days, team meetings, client meetings, or special events.

jobs.title: Software Developer II
jobs.description: Our team is hiring for a forward thinking full stack developer to help bring emergency dispatch technology and services to the next level. This is a full time opportunity that is eligible for our full host of benefits that include health, dental, vision, pet, and legal insurance, 401K options and company matching, PTO, holidays, a hybrid work schedule and more while working at a company that's been voted as a top place to work for 6 years running! Come see why our teams love to work here! **Job Summary** Provide design and development expertise across the full stack: front\-end, back\-end, APIs, databases, and integrations. Create and maintain software products including applications, web pages, client portals, reports and queries, and other products as requested. Leverage modern AI\-assisted and agentic development tools to accelerate delivery, while reviewing and validating everything that ships, whether written by a person or generated by AI. Interface with clients, customers, and internal users to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deploy solutions. Train other team members and provide technical leadership in design and development matters. Help develop and support software development best practices. This role operates on a hybrid work model. **Major Responsibilities** * Design and develop scalable, reusable, secure, and maintainable software components for complex tasks with minimal supervision. * Effectively troubleshoot and diagnose complex software problems. * Ensure web applications are accessible and compatible across major browsers and devices. * Design intuitive and responsive web\-based user interfaces. * Anticipate, identify, and mitigate problem areas. * Develop prototypes and proofs of concept for end users. * Work closely with product managers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions. * Provide direction and guidance to less experienced staff. * Participate in code reviews to ensure quality and adherence to coding standards. * Leverage agentic AI development tools (e.g., Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode, etc.) to design, build, and refactor software, and rigorously review and validate AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including QA and UX/UI. * Write and maintain unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests. * Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends \& other duties as assigned **Education and/or Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience, including relevant boot camps and industry certifications). * Solid understanding of relational databases (e.g., MS SQL Server, MySQL), data modeling, and writing efficient, well\-structured queries. * Solid experience in back\-end development with C\# (.NET / ASP.NET Core) and/or Python (e.g., FastAPI, Django), including building secure APIs and services. Equivalent experience in another modern back\-end stack will also be considered. * Solid experience with a modern JavaScript/TypeScript front\-end framework (such as React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue), including component architecture, state management, and routing. * Solid experience with object\-oriented programming. * Ability to build responsive, accessible UI from design specifications (e.g., Figma) using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript. * Experience with website security and security best practices. * Ability to write flexible, reusable, and documented code. * Strong analytical abilities. * Strong customer service attitude. * Proficiency with Git and branching strategies. * Experience with cloud\-based deployment (Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud) and CI/CD pipelines. * Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted and agentic development tools (e.g., Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode, etc.), with the ability to critically review, test, and validate AI\-generated code. * Experience with unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing and modern testing frameworks. * Solid understanding of REST architecture. **Physical Requirements/Essential Job Functions** * Ability to resolve technical problems efficiently * Ability to communicate technical concepts to both users and programmers effectively * Problem\-solving * Frequent computer use * Sitting for long periods of time * Concentrating for long periods of time. * Work with minimal supervision. * Able to effectively estimate and manage time. **Our Company** As one of Utah's Top Places to work, Priority Dispatch Corp. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are a small, fast\-growing provider of consulting, training, and software products for the public safety market. Priority Dispatch is based in the U.S. in downtown Salt Lake City, Utah. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and matching 401(k) programs, etc. Priority Dispatch Corp. (PDC) provides comprehensive, integrated solutions for Police, Fire, and Medical emergency dispatching. We incorporate the Priority Dispatch System® approved by the International Academies of Emergency Dispatch in all our products. PDC offers multi\-agency emergency dispatching ProQA® software, as well as a card\-set version, AQUA® quality improvement software, training, consulting, and Academy accreditation support. www.prioritydispatch.net Equal Employment Opportunity Employer Click here to view the Federal EEO poster: http://www1\.eeoc.gov/employers/upload/eeoc\_self\_print\_poster.pdf

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer (Claude, AWS), NYC / SF Bay Area
jobs.description: At **Provectus**, you don't prototype in a sandbox and hand a client a slide deck. You embed inside a bank, an insurer, or a health system, learn the work, and ship a Claude \+ AWS system into their real, regulated production. Then you watch the business number move. We're a **Premier AWS Partner** and a **preferred partner in Anthropic's partner network**. That means the newest models, real budgets, and problems that matter, without the layers, politics, and long wait for impact of a firm with a hundred thousand people. 400\+ people, 100\+ customers in production, led by our founders since 2010, offices across North America, LATAM, and EMEA. We're building this team around New York and the Bay Area. There's no enforced in\-office policy, but you need to be close enough to come in on short notice, and every engagement opens with two to four weeks on site with the client. ### **Why Provectus?** * **Frontier access. Anthropic Preferred Partner:** newest Claude models, real budgets, real problems. * **Real tasks (not scope), real deployment.** You go where the operating problem is and ship production code to real users, not slide decks that sit in a drive. * **Embedded, not engaged.** You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process, not a vendor running a project alongside it. Embedded is not staff augmentation. * **Autonomous**. You own the work from framing through to production, visible to clients and founders. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket. * **Your experience stays portable.** Every engagement is a new problem, often in a new industry, so your skills compound instead of narrowing to one product. No legacy maintenance grind, not a single stack. * **Craft \& growth.** Build beside senior FDEs on a Claude certified team, with a real platform (talks, OSS) to grow your name. * **We give you a stage:** Claude certification, conference talks, open source contributions, published work under your own name. ### **What you’ll do:** * Spend the first weeks of each engagement in the operator’s seat, learning the constraints from the inside, then rebuild the function from first principles alongside the client and a Forward Deployed Executive. You are the one who builds it * Be part of the customer’s team, inside their process; work on real tasks, not scoped deliverables, and own the method autonomously * You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry Blueprints, working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it * Deliver across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC, and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare * Help shape how leading enterprises adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment; help build the tooling and frameworks of a growing AI delivery practice ### **What we look for:** * Typically 7\+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands on today and intend to stay that way * Genuinely willing to spend time understanding someone else’s job before writing code; demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly * Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production, not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works * You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a nondeterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why * Strong engineering fundamentals. Dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack * Cloud native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus), including the operational reality of a system someone else inherits * Presales experience. Credible with senior stakeholders: you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room * Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job * Hands on experience with Claude, Claude Code, and Cowork (skills, workflows, MCP, integrations, connectors, custom harnesses) **Nice to have:** * Containers and orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS) and CI/CD in production * IaC depth: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform * Open source contributions or public writing on applied AI ### **What We Offer:** * Full time * On site visits to client’s facilities and our office in NYC once a week * Unlimited Vacation policy * Generous health, vision, and dental insurance * 401(k) matching plan * Base salary $180k to $250k \+ bonuses; OTE up to $300k. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data * No Visa sponsorship ### **We’re real:** * A person reads your application. We filter out AI generated and fraudulent submissions automatically. Every application that clears that filter is read by someone on our team * We may ask for a quick ID verification. Fraudulent applications are common, and this protects real candidates * You’ll meet the people you’d work with. We host AI engineering events in New York and San Francisco. We’d be happy to talk in person. Your interviews are with Pavel Borobov, Solutions Architect, and Stepan Pushkarev, Cofounder \& CEO ### **How we hire:** * Recruitment interview. * Tech interview with our FDE (30 min). * A live engineering building session (1\.5 hours). We hand you a business function and the constraints. You have to understand the job and rebuild it — then say what you’d build and how you’d know it worked. ***Use AI the way you normally would; we expect AI\-generated code. What we look at is how you used AI, the judgment behind your choices, and what you researched beyond what any LLM already knows.*** * Soft skills interview. * Offer discussion. up to 300\.000 USD OTE We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Since opening our first self\-storage facility in 1972, **Public Storage** has grown to become the **largest owner and operator of self\-storage facilities** in the world. With **thousands of locations** across the U.S. and Europe, and more than 170 million net rentable square feet of real estate, we're also one of the largest landlords. We've been recognized as **A Great Place to Work** by the Great Place to Work Institute. And, our employees have also voted us as having **Best Career Growth**, ranked us in the **Top 5% for Work Culture**, and in the **Top 10% for Diversity and Inclusion**. We're a member of the **S\&P 500** and **FT Global 500**. Our common and preferred stocks trade on the New York Stock Exchange. Public Storage is the nation’s leading self\-storage provider, recognized for its iconic orange doors and commitment to delivering simple, reliable solutions to millions of customers across the country. We are expanding our creative team to enhance our consistent and engaging visual brand presence. **Job Description** What You’ll Do Data Engineering \& Pipeline Development (Primary) — 60% * Architect, build, and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines using BigQuery, dbt, Airflow/Cloud Composer, and Pub/Sub * Design and implement layered data models, semantic layers, and modular pipelines that scale as business needs evolve * Establish and enforce best practices for data quality, observability, lineage, and schema governance * Optimize BigQuery for performance and cost efficiency, including partitioning, clustering, and workload\-aware modeling * Work with both structured data and unstructured data such as web logs, call center transcripts, images, and video when required by the use case * Leverage BQML and related data science capabilities for use cases such as anomaly detection, classification, and operational decision support * Deliver reliable, scalable, and high\-performing pipelines that enable downstream ML, analytics, and operational applications ML/AI Platform Engineering — 20% * Convert prototype notebooks and models into production\-grade, versioned, testable Python packages * Deploy and manage training and inference workflows on GCP using Cloud Run, GKE, and Vertex AI * Implement CI/CD, model versioning, rollback strategies, and operational guardrails for ML systems * Evaluate emerging GCP and third\-party products; build shared libraries, templates, and internal tooling that accelerate delivery across teams * Enable ML teams to ship faster with fewer operational failure points Applied AI \& Real\-Time Decisioning — 20% * Support real\-time, event\-driven inference and streaming feature delivery for mission\-critical decisions, including recommendation systems, dynamic experimentation, and agentic AI use cases * Contribute to internal LLM\-based assistants, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and automation agents * Implement model monitoring, drift detection, alerting, and performance tracking frameworks * Evaluate and apply graph\-based data patterns where they improve recommendations, relationship analysis, knowledge retrieval, or decision intelligence Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Partner with data scientists, analysts, and engineers to operationalize models, semantic layers, and data products into maintainable production systems * Collaborate with pricing, digital product, analytics, and business teams to stage rollouts, support experiments, and define success metrics * Participate in architecture reviews, mentor engineers, and communicate technical trade\-offs clearly * Contribute to an engineering culture grounded in ownership, curiosity, thoughtful debate, and continuous learning What We’re Looking For We are looking for someone who is not only technically strong, but also: * Passionate about building high\-quality systems * Hardworking and dependable, with strong ownership of outcomes * Eager to learn, experiment, and deepen expertise over time * Comfortable in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly * Open to collaboration, feedback, and healthy technical debate * Interested in growing both technical depth and leadership capability over the long term **Qualifications** * MS in Computer Science with 4\+ years of experience, or BS in Computer Science with 6\+ years of experience * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience building data pipelines in a code\-first environment using Python, SQL, and dbt * 1\+ year of experience with real\-time or event\-driven systems such as Pub/Sub, Dataflow, or comparable streaming frameworks * 2\+ years of experience owning technical decisions or helping lead engineering direction * 1\+ year of hands\-on experience with graph databases, including graph data modeling, relationship\-centric querying, or graph\-based problem solving Preferred Experience * Experience with GCP and/or AWS * Experience with ML platform tooling or monitoring such as MLflow, Evidently, or Vertex AI * Knowledge of semantic search, vector embeddings, LLM orchestration, or RAG workflows * Experience with graph database technologies such as Neo4j, Neptune, or similar platforms * Familiarity with use cases involving knowledge graphs, entity relationships, recommendation systems, fraud patterns, or connected data analysis * Domain experience in pricing, recommendations, forecasting, or large\-scale customer analytics * Familiarity with geospatial data or map\-based modeling * Some JavaScript experience for lightweight UI or prototyping work Why This Role Will Excite You * You’ll work in a fast\-moving environment where decisions are made quickly and your work drives real business outcomes * You’ll own meaningful parts of the platform, not just execute isolated tasks * You’ll build end\-to\-end solutions—from ingestion and transformation to ML inference and production integration * You’ll have the opportunity to learn quickly, expand your scope, and grow your technical leadership * You’ll join a team that values curiosity, execution, and continuous improvement **Additional Information** **Workplace** * One of our values pillars is to work as One Team and we believe that there is no replacement for in\-person collaboration but understand the value of some flexibility. Public Storage teammates are expected to work in the office five days each week with the option to take up to three flexible remote days per month. Public Storage is an equal opportunity employer and embraces diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply. \*\*Sponsorship for Work Authorization is not available for this posting. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without restrictions or requiring sponsorship now or in the future. We do not provide training plans or support for F\-1 OPT, STEM OPT extensions, or future visa sponsorship.\*\*

jobs.description: **As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.** =============================================================== **Why Join Q2?** Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers. **What Makes Q2 Special?** Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We celebrate our employees in many ways through our year\-round Q2 ChangeMakers awards program and global moments of recognition and connection. We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun and giving back together. From company\-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week—featuring learning, community service, and culture\-building experiences—we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact. **SUMMARY** Q2's Relationship Insights helps financial institutions better understand their commercial banking relationships and make more informed decisions. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Relationship Insights Integrations team, you will design and build the APIs and connectors that move data between Relationship Insights and the systems our customers and partners rely on. You will work across the stack with a focus on secure, reliable, well\-documented integrations, partnering with Product, Engineering, and customer\-facing teams to deliver solutions for financial institution customers. What You’ll Do * Design, build, and maintain the integration services and APIs that connect Relationship Insights to Q2 products, customer systems, and third\-party platforms. * Own features end to end, from design and implementation through testing, release, and production support. * Develop secure, scalable, and observable backend services, with attention to performance, resilience, and data integrity. * Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, and customer\-facing teams to turn integration requirements into clear technical solutions. * Drive technical excellence through code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD practices, and architecture and security reviews. * Participate in on\-call and incident response, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis for integration issues. * Write clear technical documentation and API guides for internal teams and external consumers. * Mentor engineers and help raise engineering standards across the Relationship Insights organization. **RESPONSIBILITIES** Design, implement, integrate, and test software solutions of moderate complexity, including Windows\- and Linux\-based front\-end and back\-end components. * Deliver solutions in live production systems individually and collaboratively. * Support, maintain, and resolve issues for custom features in production systems; occasional on\-call availability may be required. * Ensure adherence to all security, availability, confidentiality, and privacy policies and controls. * Assist and mentor teammates, providing technical leadership and advocating best practices. **EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience. * 5–8 years of software development experience. * Full\-stack .NET development (SQL Server, C\#, HTML/CSS, JavaScript). * Familiarity with MVVM and front\-end frameworks (Vue, Angular, React). * Experience with test automation frameworks and auto\-mocking tooling. * Practical experience with multiple design patterns and SOLID principles. * Domain experience in banking is a plus. * Web development experience. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills. * Experience in all aspects of the software development life cycle and service\-oriented architecture. * Experience in Agile development environments. * Ability to work flexible hours and provide occasional on\-call/emergency support. * Working knowledge of accessibility guidelines (WCAG) applied across product, design, and engineering to support inclusive user experiences. *This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English.* *Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.* **Health \& Wellness** * Hybrid Work Opportunities * Flexible Time Off * Career Development \& Mentoring Programs * Health \& Wellness Benefits, including competitive health insurance offerings and generous paid parental leave for eligible new parents * Community Volunteering \& Company Philanthropy Programs * Employee Peer Recognition Programs – “You Earned it” Click here to find out more about the benefits we offer. **Our Culture \& Commitment:** We’re proud to foster a supportive, inclusive environment where career growth, collaboration, and wellness are prioritized. And our benefits go beyond healthcare—offering resources for physical, mental, and professional well\-being. Click here to find out more about the benefits we offer. Q2 employees are encouraged to give back through volunteer work and nonprofit support through our Spark Program (see more). We believe in making an impact—in the industry and in the community. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status. *Applicants in California or Washington State may not be exempt from federal and state overtime requirements*

jobs.title: Senior Modem HW Design Verification Engineer (AI Driven Next Gen Modem Hardware Development)
jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Modem Technologies **General Summary:** Qualcomm is the world’s *largest fabless semiconductor company* and a global leader in wireless innovation—powering the majority of 3G, 4G, and 5G devices while pioneering the future 6G era. Our hardware engineering teams build industry‑leading modem and RF transceiver solutions enabling the next generation of wireless technology. This is an exciting opportunity to build an AI\-driven business intelligence environment, develop intelligent automation solutions, and bring emerging AI technologies to life in ways that deliver real business impact. This isn't your traditional BI or dashboard development role. access controls, testing, monitoring, and appropriate human oversight. * Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and optimize AI performance, reliability, and cost. ### **What You Bring** * Hands\-on experience building and deploying production AI applications. * Strong technical skills in Python, SQL, LLM APIs, AI agents, tool calling, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). * Experience developing MCP servers or comparable AI tool integrations. * Experience with APIs, databases, data pipelines, and data modeling. * Knowledge of cloud AI platforms, enterprise data architecture, and secure data access. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions. * Intellectual curiosity, a collaborative mindset, and a passion for staying ahead of emerging technologies. * The ability to communicate complex technical concepts to nontechnical audiences. ### **Bonus Points If You Have** * Experience with NetSuite, Shopify, Salesforce, or comparable enterprise platforms. * Experience with Azure AI services, Microsoft 365 Copilot, or other enterprise AI platforms. * Familiarity with Power BI, semantic layers, and traditional business intelligence tools. * Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, or IT service management platforms. * Knowledge of AI evaluation, observability, governance, and production operations. ### **Why You'll Love This Role** * Build innovative AI solutions that make a measurable difference across an entire company. * Work with emerging technologies in a practical, real\-world business environment. * Have the opportunity to influence the direction of enterprise AI adoption. * Collaborate directly with business leaders and cross\-functional teams. * Enjoy the creative freedom to explore new ideas and turn them into meaningful solutions. * Be part of a growing, science\-driven health and wellness company that values innovation. ### **Why You'll Love Working at Quicksilver Scientific** We believe taking care of our employees is just as important as the work we do. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Hi, I'm Akbay, Head of Engineering at Reflow. Most engineering roles at this stage ask you to execute. Pick up tickets, ship features, move to the next one. That's not what we're looking for. Reflow is building something that requires you to care about the outcome, not just the output. We track how work actually happens inside organizations and turn that into intelligence. The data is messy, the product surface is wide, and the problems are greenfield. You need to want to dig into that, not just be okay with it. I'm looking for someone who gets energy from complexity, moves fast without cutting corners on the things that matter, and wants to see their fingerprints on a product that real teams depend on. Someone who wants to build, and to own what they build. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to be doing, read on. Akbay **Why Reflow exists** ===================== Most organizations have no reliable way to understand how work actually gets done. They track outputs, not workflows. They measure activity, not intelligence. The result is a massive blind spot at the operational layer of every team. Reflow closes that gap. We're a workforce and workflow intelligence platform that sees how work flows through an organization and turns that into insight and automation. Our automation agents take the workflows we observe and run them for our customers, across browser and desktop apps, with the company\-specific context that general\-purpose agents don't have. We're early, growing fast, and automation is where we're putting a lot of our weight next. **What you'll actually do in the first 3 months** ================================================= Month 1: Understand the system and fix what matters most. Learn how a recorded workflow becomes an automation, how a run is executed, and how it recovers. Find the parts that hold the system back the most, fix them, and get the improvements shipped to clients, not just merged. By the end of the month customers should notice the difference. Month 2: Make the whole system better. Move from the most critical parts to all of them: workflow creation, execution, recovery, evals, observability and cost. Get to a point where we are confident in every update before it ships, and where we can bring on more clients without any drop in quality, speed or cost per run. Month 3: Drive the project. Take the lead on where automation goes next. Bring your own ideas, sharpen the vision, and keep a close eye on the market: what the model vendors and other agent products ship, what customers ask for, and where Reflow should go to stay ahead. Turn that into a roadmap and steer the project by it. **How the role looks beyond 3 months** ====================================== You own the AI automation project end to end: architecture, reliability, observability, cost, and the roadmap of what it can do next. You stay fully hands\-on, this is a building role. You work closely with the other engineers who contribute to automation, and you help set the technical bar for the project. Beyond automation, you help shape the other AI pipelines in the product, such as our AI companion and the systems that mine our activity data for insight. **Example projects on the horizon:** ------------------------------------ * Build an eval and benchmarking setup that covers our real customer workflows, with regression checks that run on every change. * Push run success rates up across changing UIs, sessions and edge cases, with recovery that fixes the run instead of failing it. * Bring cost per run down with model routing, caching and provider choice, without losing accuracy. * Build end\-to\-end tracing and observability, so any failed run can be replayed and diagnosed in minutes. * Turn live runs and human feedback into reviewed improvements, so automations get better from use, not just from engineering time. * Shorten the path from a recorded workflow to a working automation, with fewer iterations and no engineer in the loop. **What we mean by "own"** ------------------------- Some engineers think owning a system means being the one who gets assigned its tickets. That's not what we need. Owning automation means you know how it's doing today without anyone telling you. You know the success rate, the cost per run, the top failure reasons and which customers they hit. When a run fails, you find out why before a customer asks. When a model or prompt change looks good in a demo, you're the one who asks for the benchmark. You decide what gets built next, and you're accountable for whether it worked. **How we work** =============== High trust, high speed. We don't manage output through meetings or status updates. You'll know what matters, and you'll have the autonomy to go build it. Measured, not vibes. An AI change that wasn't measured didn't happen. We ship against baselines, eval sets and production metrics, not against a demo that looked right once. Cost is part of the design. Inference spend scales with usage. We treat cost per run as an engineering metric, next to accuracy and latency. AI is part of the craft. We use AI tooling actively across engineering. We expect you to have opinions about what works, for agents in production and for your own workflow. Direct collaboration. You'll work closely with backend, data and the client app team, and directly with the founders on roadmap and architecture. No long handoff chains. **Why you should or shouldn't apply** ===================================== This role is for you if: * You have built and run multi\-step agents in production, with real users, real failure modes and real cost. * You were a strong backend engineer before you worked with LLMs, and you still think like one: retries, idempotency, queues, failure handling, monitoring. * You can answer "how do you know it got better?" with numbers, and you have built the setup that produces them. * You care about cost per run as much as accuracy, and you've made tradeoffs between models, providers and architectures to get both. * You want to own a system end to end and be judged by whether it works in production. * You're energized by an ambiguous, fast\-moving space where the playbook is still being written. * You want direct access to the founders and real influence over where the product goes. This role is probably not for you if: * Your agent experience is mostly RAG chatbots, low\-code workflows, or prototypes that never left pilot scale. * You ship prompt changes because they looked better on a few examples. * You think of observability and evals as something to add once things settle down. * You prefer research to shipping, or want a clear spec before you start. * You need someone else to set up infrastructure, deploys or monitoring for you. * You want to manage people more than you want to build. **What we're looking for** ========================== **Required** ------------ * 6\+ years of backend engineering, with production services and pipelines you designed and owned: APIs, workers, queues, real load, on\-call. * Recent, hands\-on experience building agentic systems in production: multi\-step agents, tool use, MCP, agent loops with recovery and guardrails. * Built or owned eval, benchmarking and tracing for LLM systems: golden sets, regression suites, LangSmith, Langfuse or your own. * Experience managing LLM cost and latency in production: model routing, caching, provider choice. * Strong in TypeScript and Python. You'll work in both. * Architecture judgment: you can take a system that was built fast and set the direction for its next stage. * Strong written communication, we're distributed and context needs to travel well in writing. * Open to working across timezones with a globally distributed team. **Nice to haves** ----------------- * Experience with browser or desktop automation: Playwright, Puppeteer, DOM\-based actions, computer\-use agents. * Experience with model gateways and providers such as OpenRouter or Bedrock. * Familiarity with Django and ClickHouse, or similar stacks. * Experience running agents in virtual or sandboxed environments. * Previous experience at an early\-stage or fully remote company. **What Reflow gives you** ========================= * Full ownership of the system at the center of where Reflow is going next. * Work directly with the founding team, your architecture decisions will be visible and they'll matter. * Fully remote, work from wherever you do your best work. * A genuinely hard problem: making AI agents reliable, measurable and affordable on real company work. **Compensation:** ----------------- We offer competitive pay based on the market and where you’re located. The salary ranges in our job postings are intentionally wide because they need to cover both U.S. and international candidates. Our final offer will depend on things like your experience, skill set, and location.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Platform Software
jobs.description: ### **ABOUT US** Reframe Systems is a Physical AI and robotics company on a mission to make high\-performance housing attainable and abundant in the communities where people want to live. Through our vertically integrated delivery model and highly automated microfactories, we deliver climate resilient homes and buildings with greater speed and predictability than traditional construction. Our volumetric modular buildings are produced in our Andover, MA microfactory, with a growing pipeline across North America and a new microfactory on the way. We are building a system that balances repeatability with site\-responsive design, enabling homes that are adaptable to each site, community, and customer need. Our cross\-disciplinary team brings together architecture, robotics, design engineering, software, factory operations, and field delivery to change how housing gets delivered. We're reimagining the future of housing through a smarter and more sustainable system that empowers people to live better. Come build it with us. ### **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** We're looking for a *Senior Software Engineer* to rethink how a construction project gets managed from inception to build. Construction runs on handoffs: a project moves from a customer conversation to a scope, to an estimate, to a set of purchase orders, to a production schedule, with someone at every one of those boundaries re\-entering what the last person already wrote down. The industry has long treated that as the cost of doing business, even though it is where schedules slip, where margin quietly disappears, and why almost nobody in this field can tell you what a building will cost until it is nearly built. As a vertically integrated company, we are building the opposite of that, which means one authoritative representation of a project that everything downstream reads from, so that sales, estimating, procurement, and the factory all work off the same source of truth and a change in one place propagates. You will work closely with the design automation platform, which turns a building design into a manufacturable model and production plan, and the factory software team, to integrate real manufacturing data into our upstream models. This is part of the flywheel that will truly make construction faster and more predictable: real production data, cycle times, quantities, and labor we actually see on the floor, feeding back into how the next project is scoped, estimated, and bought, so that every building we deliver makes the next one more accurate to plan. This is a hands\-on role to deliver a software experience end\-to\-end, from understanding the problem statement to designing and deploying a solution. Your customers are the estimators, buyers, and project teams working alongside you, and you would spend real time with them, becoming an expert in their workflows. If you like taking an ambiguous, high\-stakes part of a business and turning it into software that people run on, there is a lot of ground here. ### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own how a project flows through our systems, from the first customer conversation through to what the factory builds, including every handoff in between. * Design the underlying data model and system of record, so that each function works from one authoritative representation of a project rather than maintaining its own copy. * Build full\-stack applications that turn manual, document\-driven processes into software that operations teams run their day on. * Define the data contracts and interfaces between business functions, and keep them clear enough that engineers and agents can both work against them. * Apply AI to the manual and unstructured parts of the process, and build it to drive value in production not just demo well. * Partner with other software teams to close the loop between what we plan and what we actually produce, so that real operating data improves the next project. * Set the technical direction for how these systems evolve, including where we build and where we buy. * Partner directly with the teams who will use what you build to find the highest\-leverage problem to solve next, then cut scope until it ships. * Mentor and grow other team members; this is an opportunity to shape the software engineering culture in a small, agile team. ### **QUALIFICATIONS** Prior knowledge or **experience in construction or manufacturing is not required**. We'll get you up to speed. ### ***Must Have*** * Bachelor's in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 7\+ years building production software. * Strong full\-stack engineering, ideally in Python and Typescript, including automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting, and root cause analysis. You've owned systems end to end, from data model through interface. * A track record of gathering your own requirements and owning problems end to end, working directly with the people who will use what you build and turning vague operational complaints into scoped work that shipped. * Experience building internal tools for non\-technical operators, with at least one you can point to that got adopted and stayed adopted. * Comfort with data modeling, pipelines, and warehouse work, without needing to be a pure data engineer. * Experience with cloud\-native architecture and containerized deployments. * Experience using coding agents to prototype, reach a solution quickly, and augment day\-to\-day development. * Comfort shipping across organizational boundaries, into systems and teams you don't control. ### ***Nice to Have*** Any of these would be a bonus, but **none are required** to be a strong candidate: * Experience building software next to physical operations: manufacturing, construction, logistics, hardware, or field service. * Depth in one or more of estimating and CPQ, ERP or MRP systems, procurement and supply chain software, or PLM. * Experience integrating with, extending, or replacing an ERP. * Work on a digital thread or similar end\-to\-end traceability program. * Front\-end depth, particularly data\-dense interfaces for operational users. * Deep cross\-functional collaboration skills. ### **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER** *Reframe Systems is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.* *If you believe you have the skills to thrive in this role, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet 100% of the listed requirements. At this time, we are only considering candidates who are authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.* Compensation Range: $140K \- $180K

jobs.title: Data Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **Data Analytics Engineer (NYC)** **About Rent the Runway** **About Us:** Rent the Runway (RTR) is transforming the way we get dressed by pioneering the world's first Closet in the Cloud. Founded in 2009, RTR has disrupted the $2\.4 trillion fashion industry by inspiring women with a more joyful, sustainable and financially\-savvy way to feel their best every day. As the ultimate destination for circular fashion, the brand now offers infinite points of access to its shared closet via a fully customizable subscription to fashion, one\-time rental or ownership. RTR offers designer apparel and accessories from hundreds of brand partners and has built in\-house proprietary technology and a one\-of\-a\-kind reverse logistics operation. RTR has been named to CNBC's "Disruptor 50" five times in ten years, and has been placed on Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list multiple times. **About the Team:** Data is core to RTR's strategy and is embedded across product, logistics, customer experience, and business operations. The Data Analytics team is responsible for delivering accurate, scalable data to the organization, including core data based tool models, data definitions, reporting foundations, insights, and self\-service analytics. We are now growing our Analytics Engineering function within the Data Analytics team to ensure our data models are scalable, maintainable, well\-governed, and aligned to the fast\-paced and evolving needs of the business. **About the Role:** We are looking for a Data Analytics Engineer to enhance our data ecosystem by ensuring scalable, well\-structured, and high\-quality datasets that drive insights across the business. You will be responsible for building and optimizing data models, developing ETL/ELT pipelines, and improving data infrastructure to support analytics and reporting, while unlocking AI capabilities in our reporting and analytics layer. This is a hands\-on role: working closely with our Staff Analytics Engineer, you will build and maintain DBT models, identify opportunities to simplify and refactor existing transformations, and improve testing, documentation, and performance. You will own defined projects end\-to\-end and contribute to the ongoing evolution of our data model. **What You'll Do:** * Build and maintain **DBT models** end\-to\-end: design, implementation, testing, documentation, and optimization. * Refactor legacy models, simplifying **complex SQL** and dependencies while preserving business logic and downstream reporting. * Improve data quality by implementing **DBT tests**, investigating data issues, and contributing to monitoring and alerting for data freshness and accuracy. * Optimize **BigQuery** performance and costs through query optimization, appropriate materializations, partitioning, and clustering. * Collaborate with Data Engineering to maintain reliable data pipelines and improve orchestration and data freshness. * Work with BI Analysts and cross\-functional stakeholders (Ops, Supply Chain, Product, Finance, Engineering) to translate business requirements into reliable, reusable data models that support reporting and self\-service analytics. * Document models, business logic, and dependencies clearly and share knowledge across the Data Analytics team. * Participate in **Git\-based development and PR reviews**, following established standards and assessing the downstream impact of changes before deployment. * Work closely with our Staff Analytics Engineer to contribute to modeling standards, technical improvements, and the ongoing evolution of our analytics foundation. **About you:** * **3\+ years** of relevant experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similarly technical analytics role, including **2\+ years working with DBT in production.** * **Advanced\-level SQL skills**, with experience debugging complex transformations and optimizing queries in cloud data warehouses; **BigQuery** experience preferred. * Experience **building and maintaining data models and pipelines** in fast\-paced, resource\-constrained environments; startup experience is a plus. * Deep commitment to data quality, testing, and documentation, with experience applying these practices through Git\-based development and code reviews. * Pragmatic problem\-solver who balances speed with accuracy and maintainability * Ability to learn from and work closely with experienced data leaders, while taking ownership of your projects. **Nice to Have** * Experience optimizing cloud data warehouse costs, supporting data warehouse migrations, or preparing datasets for AI/ML use cases. * Looker / LookML semantic modeling experience. * Experience with event analytics and subscription lifecycle data (e.g., **Heap, Mixpanel, Segment**). * Experience working in a fast\-growing environment where DBT models required refactoring for scale and maintainability. **Benefits:** At Rent the Runway, we're committed to the wellbeing of our employees, and aim to create a workplace that fosters both personal and professional growth. Our inclusive benefits include, but are not limited to: * Paid Time Off, including vacation, paid bereavement, and family sick leave \- every employee needs time to take care of themselves and their family. * Comprehensive health, vision, dental, FSA and dependent care from day 1 of employment \- Your health comes first, and we've got you covered. * 401(k) match \- an investment in your future. * Exclusive employee subscription and rental discounts \- to ensure you experience the magic of renting the runway (and give us valued feedback!). * Universal Paid Parental Leave for both parents \+ flexible return to work program \- because we know your newest family member(s) deserve your undivided attention. * Paid Sabbatical after 5 years of continuous service \- Unplug, recharge, and have some fun! * Company\-wide events and outings \- our team spirit is no joke \- we know how to have fun! * Office\-centric work \- our corporate employees and technical leaders have the option to work remotely on Fridays, in accordance with Company policies. *Rent the Runway is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with applicable law, we prohibit discrimination against any applicant or employee based on any legally\-recognized basis, including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, age (40 and over), national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), veteran status, uniformed service member status or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.* \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ The anticipated base salary for this position is $100,000 to $119,000\. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including without limitation, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held. \#LI\-EM1 By submitting your application below, you agree that you have read and acknowledge Rent the Runway's Candidate Privacy Policy, found here.

jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the role:** ------------------- Rippling’s Emerging Products teams which span Core Experience, Spend, and IT Products build deeply integrated systems across financial operations, IT administration, employee lifecycle automation, and enterprise security. These are high\-trust product areas where reliability, correctness, security, and scale are critical. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll design and build the services, APIs, and platform primitives that power complex workflows across Rippling’s multi\-product platform. You’ll work on systems involving permissions, policy enforcement, approvals, payments, device and app management, procurement, asset tracking, auditability, and secure handling of sensitive workforce and financial data. This role also supports Rippling’s expansion of AI\-powered workflows across HR, IT, Finance, Spend, and core platform experiences. You’ll help make AI capabilities safe, reliable, explainable, auditable, and enterprise\-ready, while ensuring customers have the trust, transparency, and control needed to adopt automation at scale. **What you will do** -------------------- * Design, implement, and test reliable backend services and APIs that power core product features and business logic at scale. * Work across key technical domains, including API design, data modeling, event modeling, and optimizing service performance. * Own the development lifecycle for defined features, from implementation and testing to deployment, monitoring, and support in a production environment. * Effectively integrate into cross\-functional teams, contribute to technical discovery, and rapidly learn from code and system feedback. **What you will need** ---------------------- * 2\+ years of professional experience as a backend engineer, preferably with Python, Go, or a similar production language, and strong experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL). * Care about business impact, balancing technical craft with speed and the bottom line to deliver value quickly. * Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, dynamic environments, demonstrating resilience and agility in the face of changing product needs. * Excellent skills in communicating complex technical ideas with clarity to enable effective collaboration with peers and stakeholders. **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. *The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will depend on several factors, including but not limited to, location, experience, education, training, and business need. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, commissions, and/or equity, subject to applicable plan documents and company policy. Successful candidates hired for this role may also be eligible to participate in the company's benefits programs, which may include, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement benefits, and/or paid time off, as determined by company policy.* The pay range for this role is: 135,000 \- 225,000 USD per year (US Tier 1\)

SAP's culture encourages curiosity, inclusion, and growth, giving you opportunities to contribute meaningfully no matter your level. **Job Description** **What you'll bring** You have hands\-on experience building and operating ML systems in production, with solid skills in Python, data pipelines, and ranking or retrieval systems. * Python proficiency and hands\-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or scikit\-learn. * Experience building or maintaining data pipelines at scale. Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake, or equivalent. * Solid knowledge of ranking, retrieval, or recommendation systems; experience with multi\-signal fusion or semantic search is a plus. * SQL fluency and comfort working with large\-scale columnar data stores. * End\-to\-end ML ownership across training, evaluation, serving, and monitoring; experience with A/B experimentation is a plus. * Degree not required for this role. jobs.description: We have an opening for an **Audio DSP Engineer** with our automotive client in **Palo Alto, CA**. We work directly with the client, so there are no middle layers, and we can schedule interviews as early as **next week**. We can also provide **accommodation** for the selected candidate.**Role Overview** We're looking for an experienced **Audio DSP Engineer** to join the In\-Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) audio development team for electric vehicle platforms. The role focuses on real\-time audio signal processing, particularly voice communication (ECNR) and audio post\-processing. It is hands\-on: you would develop, integrate, debug, tune and validate audio algorithms on an embedded production platform.**Responsibilities** * Drive the implementation and optimization of the infotainment audio software stack * Develop and integrate voice communication and voice recognition solutions for IVI platforms * Work closely with hardware and system integration teams so the audio stack integrates tightly and meets high quality standards * Partner with the QA team on testing, debugging and validation **Qualifications** * **Audio DSP:** Strong hands\-on experience with speech and microphone\-array signal processing, including several of the following: This experience can come from traditional DSP, deep learning\-based speech enhancement, or hybrid DSP \+ ML approaches. * Acoustic Echo Cancellation (AEC) * Adaptive Beamforming (MVDR or similar) * Noise Reduction (NR) * Residual Echo Suppression (RES) * Voice Activity Detection (VAD) * Automatic Gain Control (AGC) * Wind noise reduction * Direction of Arrival (DoA) estimation * Speech enhancement * **Audio Post\-Processing:** Real\-time playback and post\-processing pipelines, including mixing/routing, volume/gain control, mute/ducking, channel mapping, equalization, filtering and sample rate conversion * **Linux Audio:** Strong understanding of Linux audio architecture, particularly ALSA * Join SPS Commerce and be part of a dynamic team that's transforming the global retail supply chain! **Position Summary:** ===================== We're seeking a Manager I, Development to lead a team of eight software engineers who build and maintain data transformation maps for SPS Commerce suppliers. The team reads data in one format, maps it, and writes it out to each trading partner's specification, working from a shared queue that supports our Customer Success and implementation teams. This is the largest part of the role, about half of your time. * Watch delivery health. Hold regular 1:1s, learn each person's technical strengths and career goals, and build development plans, including cross\-training onto SPS network mapping tools, and conduct annual performance reviews for each engineer considering clear goals and regular feedback discussed throughout the year. * Lead AI adoption.
