jobs.title: AI Platform Operations Manager
jobs.description: **THE COMPANY:** STACK INFRASTRUCTURE (STACK) provides digital infrastructure to scale the world’s most innovative companies. We are an award\-winning industry leader in building, owning, and operating highly efficient, cost\-effective wholesale, colocation, and cloud data centers. Each of our national facilities meets or exceeds the highest industry standards in all operational categories of availability, security, connectivity, and physical resilience. STACK offers the scale and geographic reach that rapidly growing hyperscale and enterprise companies need. The world runs on data. Data runs on STACK. **THE POSITION:** The DevOps Engineer, AI Platform is responsible for automating, deploying, and operating the infrastructure and delivery pipelines that support STACK’s enterprise AI platform on Azure. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on build and run — not oversight. Reporting to Head of AI, Enterprise AI \& Data Strategy org this individual owns the infrastructure\-as\-code, CI/CD, containerization, observability, and release automation that allow AI engineers and enterprise application teams to ship agentic AI solutions, RAG pipelines, and integration services reliably and repeatably. The role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and MLOps — turning platform architecture into automated, governed, observable, and cost\-efficient environments that teams across the organization build on. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Infrastructure Automation \& Infrastructure as Code** * Build, maintain, and version infrastructure\-as\-code modules for Azure environments using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM, including compute, networking, storage, identity, and AI platform resources. * Automate provisioning of AI platform components — Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB, ADLS Gen2, and Databricks — as reusable, parameterized deployment patterns. * Maintain environment parity across development, test, and production, including configuration management, drift detection, and remediation. * Implement and enforce tagging, naming, and resource organization standards that support governance, chargeback, and lifecycle management. * Automate routine platform operations — patching, certificate rotation, key and secret rotation, backup validation, and disaster recovery testing. **CI/CD \& Release Engineering** * Design, build, and operate CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for application code, infrastructure code, container images, and AI/agent deployments. * Implement automated build, test, security scanning, artifact management, and promotion gates across environments. * Establish branching strategies, code review standards, and release management practices in partnership with AI engineering and enterprise application teams. * Build deployment automation for agentic AI services, MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, and integration workloads running on Azure Container Apps and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). * Support model and prompt release workflows — versioning, staged rollout, evaluation gates, and rollback procedures for LLM\-based applications. **Container Platform \& AI Workload Operations** * Operate and tune AKS and Azure Container Apps, including cluster upgrades, node pool sizing, autoscaling, ingress, networking, and workload isolation. * Build and maintain container images, base image standards, and registry governance in Azure Container Registry. * Manage compute scheduling and scaling for AI workloads, including GPU\-backed and inference\-heavy workloads where required. * Implement resiliency patterns — health probes, retries, throttling, quota management, and failover — for AI endpoints and integration services. **Observability, Reliability \& Incident Response** * Instrument platform and AI services with logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and equivalent open\-source tooling. * Build dashboards and service\-level indicators covering platform availability, latency, throughput, error rates, token consumption, and model endpoint performance. * Participate in on\-call rotation, lead incident triage and resolution for platform issues, and drive root cause analysis and corrective actions. * Develop and maintain runbooks, operational documentation, and automated remediation for recurring issues. **Security, Governance \& Cost Optimization** * Implement DevSecOps practices — secrets management in Azure Key Vault, managed identity usage, least\-privilege access, dependency and container vulnerability scanning, and policy\-as\-code. * Partner with Information Security to ensure pipelines and environments meet enterprise security, data residency, and compliance requirements. * Support Azure FinOps practices through cost visibility, rightsizing, reserved capacity, and automated controls on non\-production and idle resources. * Maintain audit trails and change records for infrastruct rack record. * Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code — Terraform, Bicep, or ARM — including module design, state management, and reusable patterns. * Proven experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. * Hands\-on experience with containerization and orchestration — Docker, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure Container Apps or equivalent. * Solid working knowledge of Azure core services — compute, networking (VNet, NSG, Private Endpoints), storage, identity (Entra ID), and Key Vault. * Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash. * Experience with monitoring and observability tooling — Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Prometheus, or Grafana. * Working knowledge of Git\-based workflows, code review practices, and artifact/registry management. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot production issues across infrastructure, network, and application layers. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**: * Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ\-400\), Azure Administrator (AZ\-104\), or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA). * Experience deploying and operating AI/ML workloads — model endpoints, RAG pipelines, vector databases, or agentic services in production. * Familiarity with MLOps tooling and practices — Azure Machine Learning, MLflow, Databricks, or equivalent model lifecycle platforms. * Experience deploying MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or similar integration services connecting AI agents to enterprise systems. * Exposure to agentic AI frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, or AutoGen from a deployment and operations perspective. * Experience with GPU compute provisioning, quota management, and inference cost optimization. * Knowledge of FinOps frameworks and Azure cost optimization practices. * Experience integrating with enterprise systems such as Microsoft 365, Freshworks ITSM, Workday, NetSuite, or Procore. * Experience in data center, hyperscale, or infrastructure\-intensive industry environments. **Compensation Range:** $128,260\.00 \- $146,017\.59**THIS MIGHT BE RIGHT FOR YOU IF:** * You are a strong communicator, you are persuasive and clear, blending analytics with experience in decision\-making. * You do not get flustered easily. You can juggle multiple priorities while balancing urgent requests with shifting timelines and deliverables. * You are a team builder. You take the time to understand and develop the strengths of your resources while formulating long\-term plans for the growth and success of the team. * You are naturally curious and driven toward continual improvement. While you celebrate your successes, you take time to review and analyze campaigns for future learning. **WHY STACK?** * We offer a competitive compensation package with strong benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401K program, flexible spending accounts – even a cell phone subsidy. * We foster a culture of appreciation, including peer\-to\-peer recognition and rewards programs. * Fun is part of our DNA, with events, game nights, happy hours, and barbecues. * We’re growing – this is a great time to join and make an impact! *STACK is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, national origin, mental or physical disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law* ***Note to external agencies****: We are not accepting any blind submissions or resumes/cvs from recruitment agencies. Any candidates sent to STACK Infrastructure, Inc. will not be accepted or considered as a submission without a signed agreement in place. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of STACK Infrastructure, Inc.*

jobs.title: Senior Engineer/Senior Data Center Operator (electrical/HVAC)
jobs.description: The Data Center Operator (DCO) is a facilities\-focused role responsible for the operational integrity, commissioning, and regulatory compliance of the electrical power, mechanical, monitoring and control systems, and the processes that maximize customer uptime in the most cost\-effective way for highly available, concurrently maintainable, fault tolerant mission\-critical data center environments. The DCO ensures that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center operates at peak efficiency and the utmost levels of reliability. This involves planned preventive maintenance, daily corrective work, and response to emergency issues. The DCO is our front line for hands\-on electrical and mechanical troubleshooting and serves as an expert technical resource reporting to the Site Manager, interacting with On\-Site Multi\-Skilled Operators (MSOs) and third\-party vendors. In this role the DCO is also the technical authority over vendor work on site. In addition to scheduling and escorting vendors; the DCO reviews and approves their procedures, witnesses critical steps, verifies results against OEM and industry criteria, and decides when work may start, stop, or be closed out. The DCO is the singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center. Equipment that supports mission\-critical servers must maintain better than 99\.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, standby diesel generators and related fuel systems, electrical switchgear, UPSs, PDUs, AHUs, thermal management equipment and systems, coolant distribution units (CDUs) and facility water loops for liquid cooling, chemical treatment systems (where applicable), pumps, motors, VFDs, and building automation systems. **Responsibilities** **Safety and core operations** * Place SAFETY at the top of anything and everything done, without fail, and remain consistently focused on SAFETY in every task. * Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions of facility systems. * Conduct periodic inspections of building systems (HVAC, electrical distribution) and keep mechanical equipment rooms and enclosures clean, functional, and safe. * Rapid response, investigation, and management of indoor emergency situations and air quality complaints, including humidity. * Maintain complete working knowledge of creating, closing, and tracking work requests (WR); initiate or respond to work orders, follow up, and verify completion of work. **Preventive maintenance and corrective repairs** * Complete planned and ad\-hoc preventive maintenance assignments requiring the skill and direction of several electrical, mechanical, and maintenance trades and engineering disciplines. * Witness critical steps of vendor preventive maintenance and check the work performed against the OEM maintenance checklist before accepting it. * Diagnose corrective issues, set the repair scope with the vendor, and approve the proposed fix before the work order is closed out. * Work with the Site Manager and other stakeholders to track and complete a preventive and predictive maintenance schedule for critical maintenance and system commissioning. **Vendor procedures, pre\-job briefs, and stop work authority** * Review each vendor Method of Procedure (MOP) before work begins and reject it if it is incomplete, unsafe, or does not meet OEM and site requirements. * Lead the pre\-job brief for vendor work, covering scope, sequence, hazards, rollback, and acceptance criteria. * Exercise stop\-work authority for quality and acceptance concerns as well as safety, and delay or hold work that does not meet requirements. * Lead switching operations, or directly supervise the vendor performing switching, in line with the approved MOP and NFPA 70E practices. **Test results, return to normal, and warranty** * Read the as\-found and as\-left test data supplied by vendors and reject out\-of\-range results against NETA, IEEE, and OEM acceptance criteria. * Confirm redundancy is restored and alarms are back to normal before signing off a work order, in addition to restoring the area to its original condition. * Track equipment trends and reliability reports, flag repeat failures, and pursue warranty claims with vendors and OEMs. **Vendor performance and contractor management** * Directly manage contractors and consultants for daily operations and critical maintenance (UPS systems, generators, switchgear, and chiller maintenance). * Score each vendor on quality, safety, and timeliness, note deficiencies, and feed the results into contract renewal and vendor selection recommendations. * Directly manage and supervise Multi\-Skilled Operators in all aspects of day\-to\-day operation and maintenance of electrical and mechanical critical facility equipment. **Emergency response and root cause analysis** * Take command of a live Emergency Operating Procedure (EOP) event, directing MSOs, vendors, and escalation to the Site Manager and management d cooling and technical expertise** * Operate and maintain CDUs and the facility water loop for liquid\-cooled deployments, including leak detection and leak response. * Provide applied electrical, mechanical, integrated controls, and water chemistry technical expertise for the entire data center. **Commissioning, capacity, and efficiency** * Interface directly with the management team, contractors, and consultants for phased data center construction commissioning, including integration and testing of new systems while keeping critical systems online. * Ensure the data center operates at maximum operational efficiency by analyzing operating conditions, recommending new technologies, and improving efficiency and reducing cost. * Own data center white space and back\-of\-house electrical loading and capacity, including client installations and systems. * This position may require unusual hours approximately once every other week to meet critical maintenance windows. * Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned by management. The DCO interacts across all internal departments, including executives, and with clients and vendors. **Desired Skills and Experience** * Strong background operating mechanical and electrical critical systems, design review, layout, and installation, with the ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical one\-lines. * Ability to conduct power and thermal system capacity, safety, and code compliance assessments. * Hands\-on experience installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting large commercial and industrial electrical systems, including: * Medium\-voltage switchgear, including leading or directly supervising switching * 480/277 V and 208/120 V generation and distribution systems * Diesel\-powered AC generators and fuel systems * Static and dynamic rotary UPS systems (where applicable) * Multi\-string flooded cell batteries and monitoring systems * Static switches, PLC and relay logic controls, power monitoring, and data center power distribution and management systems * Ability to review and critique vendor MOPs and run pre\-job briefs, including sequence of operations, lockout/tagout, and rollback plans. * Working knowledge of NETA, IEEE, and OEM acceptance criteria, with the ability to interpret as\-found and as\-left test data (insulation resistance, breaker trip, relay, battery, and UPS testing) and recognize out\-of\-range results. * Experience with warranty administration, trend analysis, and holding vendors and OEMs accountable for repeat failures. * Experience leading root cause analysis and commanding emergency response under a live EOP. * Experience with liquid cooling: CDUs, facility water loops, water chemistry, and leak response (preferred). * Experience scoring vendor performance and contributing to contract renewal decisions. * Current knowledge of NFPA electrical, fire, and life safety and building codes, or the local regulatory equivalent; knowledge of NEC, NFPA 70E, NFPA 72, NFPA 25, and compliance issues. * Expert knowledge of industrial safety best practices (lockout/tagout, arc flash protection, OSHA and state regulations). * Excellent understanding of electrical and mechanical systems in critical data center operations, including feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, ATS units, PDUs, chillers, pumps, air handling units, and CRAC units. * Work directly with customers, internal teams, installation engineers, technical consultants, and implementation personnel to coordinate customer turn\-ups and ensure smooth transition from installation to operation *If you are a motivated and results\-driven individual with a passion for data center services and a knack for building strong client relationships, we want to hear from you. Join us in revolutionizing the data center industry and apply today!* *Salute is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.* *\#SP1*

jobs.description: **Job Title**: Principal Embedded Engineer * Location: Cambridge, MA **About the Job** The Principal Embedded Engineer will serve as a key technical leader within the Global Device \& Packaging Unit (GDPU), responsible for the architecture, development, and delivery of embedded electronics and firmware for connected drug delivery and medical device platforms. Our deep understanding of the immune system and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve lives. **Main Responsibilities** **Embedded Systems Technical Leadership \& Architecture** * Lead system architecture and technical decision\-making for connected medical device programs. * Define and review embedded hardware and software architectures, interfaces, and design tradeoffs. * Drive system\-level integration across electronics, firmware, mobile applications, cloud platforms, and mechanical systems. * Lead technical reviews and provide guidance on design, verification, validation, and risk management activities. * Evaluate emerging technologies and contribute to platform and product technology roadmaps. **Firmware \& Compliance Leadership** * Provide technical oversight of embedded software development activities performed by internal and external engineering teams. * Ensure compliance with IEC 62304 and Sanofi software development lifecycle processes. * Review software requirements, architecture, jobs.title: AI Enablement Engineer
jobs.description: **Requisition ID:** 280195 **Salary Range:** \- *Please note that the Salary Range shown is a guideline only. Salary offered may vary based on factors, including, but not limited to, the successful candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, and experience.* Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture. **Purpose** Are you a hands\-on engineer who enjoys turning ideas into working AI solutions? As an AI Enablement Engineer, you'll work with senior engineers, business teams, and enterprise AI platform teams to design, build, test, and iterate on AI solutions that address real business problems. You'll work across machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI, developing prototypes and reference implementations, experimenting with different approaches, and helping validate the path from an early idea toward production. This role suits someone who enjoys building, learning new technologies, solving problems through experimentation, and seeing their work used by real users. **What You'll Do** **AI engineering and rapid prototyping** * Design and build proofs of concept and prototypes across traditional ML, generative AI, small language models, and agentic AI. * Develop RAG and knowledge retrieval solutions, including document processing, chunking, embeddings, vector search, hybrid search, and reranking. * Build agentic workflows using patterns such as tool calling, structured outputs, state management, memory, and human\-in\-the\-loop interactions. * Develop APIs and integrations that connect AI solutions with enterprise applications, data sources, models, and tools. * Work hands\-on with Python, SQL, Spark, Databricks, MLflow, APIs, and model serving capabilities. * Develop and execute AI evaluations using test datasets, quality metrics, LLM\-as\-judge techniques, and regression testing. * Instrument applications for logging, tracing, latency, quality, and cost monitoring. * Containerize and deploy solutions using cloud\-native development and CI/CD practices. * Contribute reusable code, templates, starter kits, and reference implementations that accelerate future AI use cases. * Follow established engineering, security, privacy, architecture, and model risk standards. **Business partnership and experimentation** * Work with business partners and senior engineers to understand workflows, pain points, user needs, and expected outcomes. * Translate defined business problems into working technical solutions. * Develop early prototypes and put them in front of users quickly to gather feedback. * Participate in demos, technical discussions, and solution reviews. * Experiment with models, prompts, retrieval approaches, and agent architectures to determine what works best for the problem. * Document findings, technical decisions, limitations, and recommendations. * Identify friction points encountered while using enterprise AI platform capabilities and share them with senior engineers and Platform Engineering. **What You'll Bring** * 3\+ years of experience in software engineering, ML engineering, AI engineering, data engineering, or a related field. * Hands\-on experience building AI/ML or generative AI applications. * Strong Python skills, including experience developing REST APIs and writing testable, maintainable code. * Experience with SQL and familiarity with Spark or distributed data processing. * Experience with LLMs, prompting, RAG, jobs.title: Software Engineer, ML infrastructure
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco; Bellevue; New York **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Software **Compensation** ---------------- * $175K – $280K **About Sesame** Sesame believes in a future where computers are lifelike \- with the ability to see, hear, and collaborate with us in ways that feel natural and human. With this vision, we're designing a new kind of computer, focused on making voice agents part of our daily lives. Our team brings together founders from Oculus and Ubiquity6, alongside proven leaders from Meta, Google, and Apple, with deep expertise spanning hardware and software. Join us in shaping a future where computers truly come alive. ### **About the role** Sesame trains and serves its own speech and conversational models. Our goal for ML infrastructure is to keep pushing back the limits on what the ML team can do: train what they want at the scale they want, and get it into production, without the platform getting in the way. GPUs are always in high demand, our data keeps growing, and the models we serve have to respond in real time, so getting there will take a lot of clever engineering. We also want the tools to be world\-class. When someone uses the platform, we want them to notice how well it was built. We're looking for an infrastructure engineer to design and build the systems that make that possible, from the clusters we train on to the platform we serve from. Most of the hard problems today are on the training side, so that's where you'd start, but the role covers serving too. Some of our capacity comes with a managed platform around it. The rest is plain Kubernetes, where we have to create that platform layer ourselves. We want someone with strong opinions about how to do that and the ability to do it. It's a broad role, and you'd have a lot of say in the direction we take. ### **Responsibilities:** * Drive the strategy for our GPU infrastructure across training and serving: clusters, scheduling, storage, and the tooling the ML team uses every day * Design and build the platform the ML team runs on. You decide the architecture, and you write the software * Get more out of scarce GPUs. Build the scheduling policy that decides which jobs run when there isn't room for all of them, and make interrupted jobs pick up where they left off * Decide where training data and checkpoints are stored and how they get to the GPUs. Our datasets are large enough that moving them around can get very expensive * Make and own architecture decisions. Explain the trade\-offs with data and revisit decisions as requirements or evidence change. If self\-hosting a parallel filesystem is the best answer because the cloud's built\-in storage isn't fast enough, make that case with numbers and carry it through * Automate everything you can, especially with agents. Build closed\-loop solutions that cut off toil at the source * Find the bottleneck in a slow training run, whichever layer it's in: checkpoint writes, data loading, the network, one bad node. Fix it with data * Go where the problem is. One quarter that's the training scheduler, the next it's storage, data, or serving * Work with the ML team every day. You're the link between what researchers need and what the software and infrastructure teams build ### **Required qualifications:** * Infrastructure is what you do. You care about scale, reliability, and performance, and you judge your work by how fast the ML team can move * 8\+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time in infrastructure, platform, or ML systems roles. * You've designed and built infrastructure other engineers ran their work on: a scheduler, a compute or storage platform, a cluster control plane. You made the design decisions and wrote the code, and you can name a decision you'd undo if you built it again * You're really good at Kubernetes or a similar compute platform, past the point of using it. You've written controllers or operators, extended a scheduler, or debugged your way into the internals * You've worked hands\-on with GPUs. You can debug them, and you can explain why GPU infrastructure is different from everything else you've run. That experience can come from training, serving, or somewhere else * You know how large\-scale multi\-node training jobs behave, how they fail, and what preemption does to them * You have strong storage fundamentals. You can walk through a real decision where you chose block, object, or a parallel filesystem for a workload, with the throughput and cost numbers behind it * You can say when Kubernetes, Ray, or Slurm is the right base for training and for serving, from having used them * You explain complicated things clearly to people who don't share your background ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Model serving infrastructure at scale (vLLM, Triton, KServe, or similar) * You've built or run a shared training cluster with a batch scheduler (Volcano, Kueue, Slurm, or similar) * You've built or worked on a GPU cloud or an internal training platform at a company that trains its own models * You've run a parallel filesystem in production (Weka, Lustre, VAST, GPFS) * High\-performance networking for training: RDMA over InfiniBand or RoCE, and NCCL * Enough PyTorch distributed training to debug a job alongside the researcher who wrote it * GCP and GKE * You've been a tech lead and still write code every day * You've gone all in on agentic coding and it shows in how you work Sesame is committed to a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome all qualified applicants, embracing diversity in race, gender, identity, orientation, ability, and more. We provide reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Contact careers@sesame.com for assistance. **Full\-time Employee Benefits:** * 401 (k) max employer match: 3\.5% of compensation * 100% employer\-paid health, vision, and dental benefits for you and your dependents * Unlimited PTO and sick time * Flexible spending account with employer matching up to $1,650/year (medical FSA) * Guardian Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Opportunity to share in the company's success with competitive stock options Benefits do not apply to contingent/contract workers. Compensation Range: $175K \- $280K

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, AI Experience (Remote Eligible)
jobs.description: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it's what we show up for every day. Smart Assist is Smartsheet's AI agent for work management, used by enterprise customers to analyze, create, and act on their work. AI Experiences builds the orchestration for Smart Assist and the user\-facing implementations that expose Smartsheet's Intelligent Work capabilities to any AI surface, so users can reach the right intelligence at the right time through a coherent, reliable experience. AI Experiences is a pillar within Applied AI, and this is a full\-stack team. The work spans these areas: the Smart Assist frontend (UI components, interaction patterns, and rendering for AI experiences across Smartsheet); the Smart Assist backend and orchestrator; UX for Smart Assist tools and agents, from response formatting and onboarding to error states. On the backend, the orchestrator routes each request to the right sub\-agent based on user intent, keeps conversation state across multi\-turn interactions, handles fallbacks when sub\-agents are unavailable, and controls feature\-flagged rollout of new capabilities. We partner closely with Agent Engineering on much of this logic. **The role.** You will own features and components of Smart Assist from prototype to production, across the front end, the orchestrator and back\-end services. You will turn ambiguous product asks into reliable, well\-measured behavior customers can trust, and work with product, design, and AI Experience to ship. **You Will:** ------------- * Own a core piece of the Smartsheet AI experience, or a significant part of one (for example conversational analytics, chart\-to\-dashboard creation, or a new entry point into the assistant) from design through production. * Build full\-stack: user\-facing components, the services behind them, and the contracts between the two, with typed APIs, clear error states, and tests. * Design and ship agent tools, skills, MCP tools, and MCP Apps with contracts the model can use reliably, and decide when an action belongs in a tool, a service, or the model. * Shape how agent output appears to users: streaming responses, loading and failure states, and handling of long or partial results, working with design and product. * Build and evolve the Smart Assist orchestrator: intent\-based routing to sub\-agents, multi\-turn conversation state, fallback and degradation handling, and feature\-flag rollout of new capabilities, partnering closely with Agent Engineering. Populate the context the agent receives, such as user locale, timezone, and workspace state. * Define how quality is measured for your area: build golden cases and scorers, set regression gates, and use traces and production signals to decide whether a failure needs a prompt, tool, context, or UI fix. * Instrument features with tracing, structured logs, and latency, cost, and error dashboards, and act on what they show. * Take part in on\-call, security, and cost work for Smart Assist, shared with Agent Engineering. Reproduce production failures and review code for your team. * Partner with PMs, designers, Agent Engineering, AI Platform, MCP, and data teams. Learn how customers use what you build and flag gaps in requirements and tests. * Use AI coding tools to ship faster without lowering the quality bar. **What we're building next:** ----------------------------- Our goal for the coming year is to make Smart Assist safe to trust and hard to leave. You will help shape work across four themes: * **Be everywhere:** an assistant that understands what you are looking at, such as the rows you have selected, and meets you in the flow of work, including smoother import and file upload. * **Build the habit:** an assistant that remembers how you like to work, with personal, team, and organization profiles, quick commands, and a growing UI component catalog. * **Earn the trust:** previews before changes apply, linked sources and explanations for results, AI edits visible in history and activity logs, and a view into the agent's reasoning. * **Work together:** a directory of agents, @mentions, and the ability to save and share results as pages. Further out, the vision is a Smart Assist that finds you before you ask: a proactive, insight\-first surface that learns how your workspace works, suggests prompts personalized to you, brings in context from tools like Slack, Zoom, and documents, supports multiplayer conversations, and offers help inside the chat itself. You would help define the trust model for that experience from real customer learnings and feedback. **You Have:** ------------- * 2–4 years of professional software engineering shipping production systems. * Strong in Python and/or TypeScript/React, with good habits in testing, code review, and debugging. * Experience building and shipping customer\-facing features end to end, including APIs, data modeling, and user\-facing behavior. * 1\+ years building LLM\-powered features in production: tool or function calling, agent loops, prompt and context design, or multi\-step workflows. * Working knowledge of how agents fail (bad tool choice, context overflow, hallucinated arguments, runaway cost) and how to design around it. * Experience designing eval scorers and golden datasets, and using results to make and defend a decision. * Experience with MCP tools and MCP Apps, structured tool calling, or reusable agent skills. * Comfort with production observability and with data\-heavy environments (Databricks or equivalent). * Evidence of using AI coding agents to ship faster without lowering the quality bar. * Clear communication of quality, cost, and reliability findings to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis. **Strong plus:** ---------------- Experience with conversational or chat UI at scale; LLM tracing tools (LangSmith, Phoenix, Braintrust or similar); prompt versioning or CI\-integrated evals; dashboard, charting, or data\-visualization products; enterprise SaaS permissions and entitlements; prompt\-injection mitigation and output validation. **What success looks like:** ---------------------------- * *First 90 days:* ship a feature or improvement to production with eval coverage, and take your first on\-call rotation. * *First 6 months:* own a feature or significant part of a project with measured gains in task success, latency, or user adoption, and contribute at least one reusable component or pattern. **Why this role:** ------------------ * You build the Smart Assist experience used by enterprise customers, with real users and a measurable quality bar. * You work across the stack, from the interface to the agent tools behind it, so you see your work reach customers end to end. * The problems are distinctive: enterprise\-grade permissions and security, and one assistant that works across a broad work\-management product. * You work on the hard parts of production agents, on a team that values engineering rigor and diverse perspectives. **Get to Know Us:** At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you're doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that's magic at work. Let's build what's next, together. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

Additionally, you will collaborate closely with our Client Success team to troubleshoot technical issues, translate client needs into new technical requirements, and architect innovative solutions that enhance the Engine platform. **Requirements** **Must Have** * Experience of end\-to\-end software engineering / solution architecture across the software delivery lifecycle * Experience with software service design and integration, such as RESTful APIs, OpenAPI specification and sequence diagrams * Experience of cloud infrastructure and large\-scale cloud applications * Experience working in a client\-facing role and building relationships with stakeholders * Strong interpersonal communication and collaboration skills. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: Staff AI Engineer Remote, USA Series E healthtech company We empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. We are applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health. We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism, drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs, that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives. Opportunity We are seeking a Staff AI Engineer to join our Core AI team to shape the technical direction of our AI\-driven product using the latest techniques in Gen AI, AI agents, and deep learning. This is powered by our Digital Twin AI, which combines Predictive and Generative AI to provide individualized insights and recommendations that improve the health of our members every day. This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who wants to solve hard, ambiguous problems at the system level, not just within a single feature, but across the architecture, tooling, and standards that the whole Core AI team relies on. You’ll set technical direction across multiple AI products, mentor senior engineers, and be the person others turn to when a problem doesn’t have an obvious owner. Responsibilities Design and build the core architecture for AI systems spanning multiple product areas, ensuring coherence and reuse across different applications. Set the technical bar for the org: evaluation frameworks, testing philosophy, CI/CD for model behavior, and shared infrastructure used across multiple teams. Identify and resolve systemic engineering gaps before they become team\-wide problems, proactively, not just in response to escalations. Take direct ownership of the hardest, most ambiguous technical problems on the team, the ones without an established playbook, and build the solution end\-to\-end. Build and ship conversational agents, deep learning models, and personalization systems that require novel technical approaches. Improve AI/ML systems and services to drive behavior change and sustained metabolic health improvements across our member base. Raise the technical level of the team through code review and design review, this is IC technical leadership, not people management. You will not have direct reports. Partner with product, engineering leadership, and clinical/research teams to turn ambiguous goals into technical designs you then build. Other duties as assigned. Qualifications 8\+ years of industry experience developing AI and Machine Learning systems in production, with a track record of leading technical initiatives that span multiple teams or systems. Deep software engineering fundamentals: testing, CI/CD, system design, code review, with demonstrated experience designing evaluation infrastructure and shared tooling for LLM\-based systems, not just using it. Proven experience setting technical direction and engineering standards at an organizational level, not just within a single team or codebase. Experience creating and scaling applications leveraging LLMs, Generative AI, advanced Prompt Engineering, RAG, and iterative AI evals in production. Track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical decisions beyond your own project. Experience with Voice AI or specialized Language Models (VLMs, multi\-modal, etc.) is a plus. Proficiency in Python and software engineering best practices at a level where you’re often the one defining what “best practice” means for the team. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field. This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. Compensation The compensation range for this position is $250,000\-$265,000 annually.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description: **Principal Product Manager, Security Agents** ---------------------------------------------- This role sits at the center of Sumo Logic's agentic AI strategy. It owns strategy, roadmap and execution for the security agents in Sumo Logic DojoAI, the agents that triage, investigate and help resolve threats on Cloud SIEM and log analytics. You will define what our agents know, what they can do and how far they act on their own. That spans today's SOC Analyst Agent and Summary Agent and the next agents for threat hunting, detection engineering and response. You will report to the SVP of Product Management. You will be the senior product voice for security agents across Engineering, AI/ML, Security Research, Design, Go\-to\-Market and Customer Success. Your job is to turn agentic AI into measurable outcomes for SOC teams in the modern enterprise. ### **Responsibilities** * Define and communicate a multi\-year vision, strategy and roadmap for Sumo Logic's security agents, aligned to product strategy and go\-to\-market priorities. * Own the full lifecycle of each security agent: problem framing, agent design, context and tool selection, prompt and workflow design, evaluation, launch and post\-launch tuning. * Decide where agents act on their own, where they recommend and a person approves, and where deterministic automation is the better answer. Draw those lines clearly and move them as customer trust grows. * Build and own the agents' quality system: eval datasets and pipelines, rollout gates and guardrails. Define success metrics such as verdict accuracy, false\-positive rate, time to verdict, analyst override rate and cost per investigation. * Partner with AI Platform PM and Engineering on agent architecture: multi\-step reasoning, tool use, retrieval, memory, orchestration and multi\-agent patterns. Weigh LLM cost, latency budgets and multi\-tenant scale. * Grow the agent ecosystem through the Sumo Logic MCP Server and agent\-to\-agent interoperability. Our agents should act across customers' security stacks and work inside the AI clients their teams already use. * Design the analyst\-agent experience with Design: evidence\-backed reasoning analysts can see, feedback loops that improve agents, and graceful fallbacks when agent confidence is low. * Serve as a senior voice of the customer. Run SOC ride\-alongs, design\-partner programs and advisory sessions, and review real agent output with practitioners to validate roadmap bets. * Work with Security Research and Sumo Logic's own SOC, our Customer Zero, to turn detection and response expertise into agent playbooks and threat\-intel\-enriched investigations. * Work with Legal, Compliance and Security so agents meet enterprise trust requirements: data privacy, auditability, role\-based permissions and regulated deployments, including FedRAMP. * Own the monetization strategy for security agents with the CRO, the VP of Pricing and Finance, including how agents are packaged and priced on consumption models. * Track the agentic SOC market and competitors to sharpen positioning. Evangelize Sumo Logic's agent vision with customers, analysts and at industry events. * Use AI across the product lifecycle, including prototyping agent workflows, analyzing adoption and speeding up requirements. * Partner with the SVP of Product Management in senior leadership reviews. Mentor PMs building AI features across the portfolio and set the standards for how Sumo Logic builds and measures agents. ### **Required Qualifications and Skills** * 10\+ years of product management in cloud, SaaS or enterprise security software, including significant time as a senior or principal PM owning complex, multi\-team areas. * 2\+ years building AI agent based solutions, or in building security solutions designed to secure AI agents. * Solid understanding of SOC workflows: alert triage, investigation, threat hunting, detection engineering and incident response. You can explain how an L1 analyst's work differs from an L3 threat hunter's. * Working fluency in modern agent architectures: tool use and function calling, RAG, memory, orchestration frameworks, MCP, and the trade\-offs between autonomous and human\-in\-the\-loop designs. * Analytical rigor. You define success metrics before building, measure agent quality empirically, and can explain why precision matters more than recall for autonomous response. * Hands\-on product instincts. You run UAT, review agent output, challenge prompt designs and build prototypes with AI coding tools. * Experience with SIEM, SOAR, DLP, XDR or log analytics platforms and security data at scale. Familiarity with MITRE ATT\&CK. * Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed, globally distributed organization, aligning engineering, design, GTM and executives. * Strong communication. You can whiteboard an agent workflow with engineers, explain agent risk and value to a CISO, and write a PRD a SOC analyst would call accurate. * BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity or a related technical field. An MS, an MBA or equivalent business experience is a plus. ### **About Us** Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI\-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com. Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection. The expected annual base salary range for this position is $185,000 \- $217,000\. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors which include (but aren't limited to) role level, skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, location, and experience. In addition to base pay, certain roles are eligible to participate in our bonus or commission plans and equity awards. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, and paid time off. This position will remain open until filled; there is no application deadline. To be considered, please submit your application. Must be authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and for the duration of employment. At this time, we are not able to offer new non\-immigrant visa sponsorship or OPT hiring for this position.

jobs.description: **Who we are** With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. **What we need** Symbotic is seeking a Staff Robotics Software Engineer to join our Bot Platform team within our Robotics organization. Your job will be to develop robust, production\-grade software for our fleet of autonomous mobile robots supporting inventory distribution and material movement across Symbotic’s automated warehouse systems. **What we do** The Bot Platform team develops the application and platform software that powers Symbotic’s fleet of autonomous mobile robots. We build reliable, scalable software that enables hundreds of robots at each facility to operate as part of a coordinated system, supporting storage and retrieval workflows across a growing network of customer sites. **What you'll do** * Develop and document high\-quality, robust C\+\+ software for real\-time mobile robotic systems, including state and task management, system behaviors, communications infrastructure, hardware interfaces, and logging and telemetry. * Serve as a technical lead by defining architecture, scoping workstreams, guiding engineers, and driving complex projects from design through deployment. * Lead design and architecture reviews to ensure new capabilities are scalable, maintainable, testable, and aligned with software engineering best practices. * Partner across robotics, controls, hardware, systems, test, and program teams to integrate, validate, and deploy new robot capabilities. * Improve automated testing, static analysis, observability, and development processes to increase software quality, reliability, and engineering efficiency. * Troubleshoot complex system and production issues, lead root\-cause investigations, and use telemetry and KPIs to continuously improve robot and overall system performance. * Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the long\-term evolution and technical health of the Bot Platform architecture and codebase. **What you'll need** * Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Robotics, Aerospace, or a related technical field * 7\+ years of experience designing, developing, and deploying production\-grade embedded or robotics software for complex, real\-world applications. * Deep proficiency in modern C\+\+ and experience developing low\-latency, deterministic, multithreaded software on POSIX\-compliant operating systems such as Linux or QNX. * Strong understanding of electromechanical and robotic system integration, including motor control, sensor integration, inter\-process communication, and protocols such as CAN, CANOpen, and Ethernet. * Experience with modern software development practices including Git, CI/CD, automated testing, static analysis, debugging, and rigorous software quality processes. * Proficiency with Python, MATLAB, Julia, or similar tools for data analysis, test automation, system diagnostics, and performance evaluation. * Strong technical leadership and communication skills, including experience leading architecture and design discussions, mentoring engineers, and collaborating across multidisciplinary teams. Experience with autonomous\-system algorithms such as state estimation, planning, controls, or perception is a plus. **Nice to have:** * Fluency in modern algorithms for autonomous systems (state estimation, planning and control, perception) * Experience developing real\-time control software for multi\-DOF motion control systems using motor drives from vendors like Maxon, Elmo, Copley, etc. **Our Environment** * Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver's license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client locations and company HQ. * Employees may be required to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued. **About Symbotic** Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end\-to\-end, AI\-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food \& beverage companies. Applying next\-gen technology, high\-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information. jobs.title: Industrial Application Developer (Rust/C#/Python)
jobs.description: **About Tesco Automation** Tesco Automation is a leading system integrator and consultant specializing in substation and distribution automation, with deep expertise in IEC 61850 digital substation technologies. We deliver turnkey solutions, multi\-vendor integration, protection \& control systems, and hands\-on training across the globe. Our focus on open, interoperable, and future\-ready grid modernization helps utilities, data centers, and industrial clients achieve reliable, high\-performance power systems. **Position Summary** We are seeking an Industrial Application Developer to design, develop, and maintain cross\-platform industrial software that supports the electric utility industry. In this role, you will build reliable, secure, and high\-performing software that runs across Windows, Linux, and macOS, working from initial concept through deployment. Because our software is used in critical power infrastructure, we are looking for someone with experience developing industrial applications, where reliability is essential. Our core languages are Rust, C\#, and Python. Rust experience is a strong asset, and we will support a strong programmer in learning it. You will collaborate closely with engineers, stakeholders, and end users to turn requirements into intuitive features, while helping shape our internal coding standards and development practices. Experience with industry communication protocols such as IEC 61850 and MQTT is a plus, but we will support the right candidate in learning them. This is an excellent opportunity for a developer who enjoys solving complex problems and wants their work to have a real impact on critical power infrastructure. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain industrial software applications and tools. * Implement new features and user interface components that are intuitive, reliable, and performant. * Build, test, and validate software across multiple operating systems, including Windows, Linux, and macOS. * Write clean, well\-documented, and maintainable code, and participate in code reviews with the development team. * Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software defects and performance bottlenecks. * Collaborate with stakeholders and end users to gather requirements and translate them into functional features. * Establish and maintain internal coding standards and development best practices. * Learn and apply communication protocol specifications used in the electric utility industry, such as IEC 61850, Modbus, and MQTT/MQTTS. **Qualifications and Requirements** **Education:** * Bachelor’s or higher level degree in computer science or engineering is required. **Experience:** * 5\+ years of progressive experience in software development, including designing and building applications from concept to deployment. * Experience developing industrial applications, such as utility, automation, or control systems, where reliability and safety are critical. **Technical Expertise:** * Proficiency in at least one of Rust, C\#, or Python, with two or more preferred. Candidates interested in learning Rust are encouraged to apply. * Experience with application frameworks and UI development. * Experience building and deploying cross\-platform applications. * Experience with SQL and relational databases, including writing efficient queries, designing schemas, and integrating databases into applications. * Familiarity with software design patterns and architecture principles, such as MVVM (Model\-View\-ViewModel) or MVC (Model\-View\-Controller). * Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows. * Comfortable working in modern IDEs, such as JetBrains Rider, Visual Studio, or VS Code. * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools or integrating AI capabilities into applications. * Experience with C, C\+\+, or Java is a plus. * Working knowledge of IEC 61850 and MQTT is a plus. * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Flexible schedule * Paid time off Application Question(s): * Are you legally eligible to work in Canada or the United States without sponsorship? * Do you have experience developing software for industrial, utility, automation, or control systems? * Which of the following languages are you proficient in? (Select all that apply) Rust / C\# / Python / None of these Work Location: Remote

Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position. * Degree preferred: Bachelors of Science ME/EE/CE, Electromechanical, Automation * Hands\-on experience operating, maintaining, servicing, or troubleshooting complex equipment in an engineering, manufacturing, test, or laboratory environment. * Experience performing preventive maintenance, basic system troubleshooting, and effective escalation when specialized assistance is required. * Strong mechanical and technical aptitude, including the ability to work with mechanical assemblies, electrical connections, sensors, motors, computers, and automated equipment. * Ability to follow technical procedures, maintenance instructions, system diagrams, checklists, and safety requirements. * Experience using basic hand tools, measurement equipment, diagnostic tools, and service documentation. * Strong organization, documentation, communication, collaboration, and follow\-through skills. * Ability to safely perform the physical activities associated with equipment maintenance, system setup, and laboratory support, with or without reasonable accommodation. * Preferred: Experience maintaining mission\-critical semiconductor test equipment, robotics, medical\-device equipment, automated manufacturing systems, industrial automation, or similarly sophisticated electromechanical platforms. * Preferred: Experience with equipment calibration, system alignment, machine teaching, test\-lot execution, maintenance tracking, root\-cause analysis, or continuous\-improvement methods. *We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position.* *This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.* **Compensation:** The base salary range for this role is $69,100 \-$110,500\. This range is a good faith estimate, and the amount of base salary will correspond with experience and skill set. This range can also fluctuate depending on demand and location. **Incentive Plan:** This job is eligible for discretionary bonus(es) based on financial performance. **Benefits:** Teradyne offers a variety of robust health and well\-being benefit programs, including medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance, paid vacation \& holidays, tuition assistance programs, and more. **\#LI\-NS1** **Job Segment:** Testing, Medical Device Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, Test Engineer, Electrical, Technology, Engineering »

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer, Inverter Soldering
jobs.description: **What to Expect** The Drive Unit Manufacturing Engineering team at Tesla is looking for a highly motivated Manufacturing Engineer to contribute to the development and ramp of inverter manufacturing equipment and processes for our cutting\-edge Drive Units and powertrain products. The inverter is one of the most complex and challenging subsystems designed and manufactured at Tesla, combining high\-voltage power stages, precision electronics assembly, thermal management, and comprehensive electrical test. Soldering is a core part of that assembly, including reflow, through\-hole (THT) soldering, selective soldering with solder quality controlled through AOI and X\-ray. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to Tesla’s world\-class manufacturing facilities. Tesla is a demanding and fast\-paced environment where you will work on a critical subsystem of an incredibly exciting product. In addition to ramping the line, the Manufacturing Engineer works with cross\-functional teams (design, test, quality, and suppliers) to test, validate, and roll out equipment to production. The ideal candidate takes pride in their hands\-on work, analytical ability, organizational skills, and attention to detail. They appreciate an environment where superior work is encouraged, noticed, and rewarded, and where individuals carry tremendous responsibility. They look forward to learning an incredible amount on the job. **What You'll Do*** Drive ramp of an exciting new inverter line by characterizing baseline performance and capability of each system (e.g. PCBA handling, reflow, THT and selective soldering, ERSA, AOI/AXI inspection, power module attach, thermal interface dispensing, fastening/torque, coating/potting, and end\-of\-line test) and drive actions to maintain or improve performance as measured by product quality and tool availability * Own the inverter soldering processes, including reflow, through\-hole (THT) soldering and selective soldering. Develop and maintain process recipes, define parameter windows, and drive solder\-joint quality using AOI and X\-ray to identify defects, confirm root cause, and release process changes * Drive root cause analysis through process, equipment, and power electronics expertise, derive and execute DOEs accordingly, and correlate with upstream/downstream processes and incoming component/supplier quality * Troubleshoot and recover processes by PLC, HMI, or tool management software, and implement changes and improvements * Ensure manufacturing lines meet uptime, availability, and reliability metrics — OEE, cycle time, quality, and first time through * Actively use tool data sources (e.g. MES reports, AOI, AXI results) to quantitatively evaluate and track tool performance and create programs to improve relevant metrics * Work independently and with vendors to understand root cause of failures, propose design or component changes, and implement and validate equipment modifications * Generate and maintain documentation including machine and process specifications, drawings, BOM, spare parts, PFMEA, control plan, and process flow chart **What You'll Bring*** 2 or more years of experience in a production environment and/or a proven manufacturing development track record * Experience with implementing and working on ramping a manufacturing line, including experience with mechanical automation equipment, robots, design of electromechanical systems, PLCs, and motion controls * Experience in power electronics or electronics manufacturing (inverters, converters, chargers, motor drives, or similar), including PCBA/SMT, power semiconductor modules (IGBT/SiC), thermal interface materials, conformal coating/potting, and high\-voltage electrical test * Hands\-on soldering background, including through\-hole (THT) soldering, reflow, selective soldering plus inspection experience with AOI and AXI * Working knowledge of high\-voltage safety practices and ESD control in a production environment * Experience with semi\-automated and automated manufacturing equipment * Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, or equivalent experience #### **Benefits** Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire: * Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction * Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits * Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution * Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High\-Deductible medical plan with HSA * Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits * Company paid Basic Life, AD\&D * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period) * Employee Assistance Program * Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays * Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources * Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance * Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs * Tesla Babies program * Commuter benefits * Employee discounts and perks program * Earned Wage Access: Real\-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels) Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description: **The Opportunity:** Tetra Tech is seeking a **Software** **Engineer I** to join our Ocean Science team. This position will be based in our South Kingstown, RI office, with the flexibility to work a hybrid schedule. **Why Tetra Tech:** At Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry\-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For 60 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting\-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development. Our science\-based planning and design improves lives in our local communities and around the world. **Your Impact:** Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference. Our work leverages cutting\-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world\-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy. **Position Summary:** We’re looking for a **Software** **Engineer I** to join our collaborative team of software engineers and scientists. In this role, you will help implement and advance the next generation of Ocean Science products. The ideal candidate is passionate about using technology to solve complex business problems. As a member of our growing software engineering team, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of our core products. You will design and implement innovative, modular, and scalable software solutions that meet feature and schedule requirements. You will also collaborate with software engineers, project managers, and product owners to develop world\-class products while learning and applying software engineering best practices. **Essential Job Functions:** The following duties are considered essential to the role. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions: * Contribute to the advancement of Ocean Science’s core products and services. * Assist in developing and maintaining web\-based applications using Python, JavaScript, React, and related technologies. * Develop, optimize, and test high\-performance software functions and applications. * Write and maintain unit and integration tests to ensure software quality and reliability. * Work effectively under supervision in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. * Collaborate with Senior Software Engineers and cross\-functional team members to deliver solutions for clients. * Participate in software design discussions, code reviews, and other engineering best practices. * Leverage AI\-assisted development tools to improve productivity, code quality, and engineering workflows. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, ocean engineering, or a related field. * Experience with at least one programming language; preferred languages include Python, JavaScript, Java. * Knowledge of or experience developing dynamic web applications. * Knowledge of or experience with front\-end frameworks. * Strong self\-motivation and problem\-solving skills. * Demonstrated ability to learn and apply new technologies. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience developing dynamic web applications using JavaScript. * Experience building front\-end applications with React. * Experience designing, developing, and deploying API services. * Experience with open\-source web\-mapping libraries, such as Mapbox or Leaflet. * Experience with modern, cloud\-native scientific data formats, such as Zarr or Parquet. * Experience with cloud services, such as AWS or Azure. * Experience applying artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies. **Physical Requirements:** * Ability to sit at a workstation and work on a computer for extended periods. * Ability to communicate effectively in person and through electronic means. * Manual dexterity to use a computer mouse, keyboard, hand tools, and other equipment. * Visual acuity to read and interpret technical documents. **Additional Information:** * This position will be based in our South Kingstown, RI office, with the flexibility to work a hybrid schedule. * This is a full\-time position, typically 40 hours per week, with standard hours of 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday. Additional hours may be required based on project needs. **Life at Tetra Tech:** The perks of working at Tetra Tech include: * Comprehensive and market\-competitive benefits. * Merit\-based financial rewards. * Flexibility and company\-wide commitment to work/life balance. * A collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees. * Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth. **About Tetra Tech:** Tetra Tech is the leader in water, environment, and sustainable infrastructure, providing high\-end consulting and engineering services for projects worldwide. With 25,000 employees working together, Tetra Tech provides clear solutions to complex problems by Leading with Science® to address the entire water cycle, protect and restore the environment, design sustainable and resilient infrastructure, and support the clean energy transition. Tetra Tech is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, marital or familial status, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. Tetra Tech is a VEVRAA federal contractor and we request priority referral of veterans. We invite applications from all interested parties. Explore our open positions at https://www.tetratech.com/careers. Follow us on social media to learn more about our people, culture, and opportunities: LinkedIn: @TetraTechCareers X (Twitter): @TetraTechJobs We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. **Please no phone calls or agencies.** Additional Information * Organization: 100 DIV

jobs.title: Manager, Machine Learning Ops
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary:** The Coca\-Cola Company’s Technology organization is in the midst of a digital transformation that allows our employees to use world class technology to connect our products to our customers all over the world. This journey is a very exciting time for Coca\-Cola and our employees are big contributors to our Success and Growth. Our large scale and complex environment offers an incredible opportunity to address challenges, enable innovative solutions to make a difference for our customers. In this role you will own the lifecycle of machine learning models in production, from release through monitoring, retraining, and retirement. You will help shape how models are versioned, promoted and monitored, and make sure they stay healthy and reliable over time. You will partner closely with data science and engineering teams, operate with minimal direction, and act as a technical reference point for less experienced engineers. **What You’ll Do for Us:** * **Model Deployment \& Operationalization** : Design how machine learning models are deployed, choosing serving patterns such as batch or online based on latency, cost and reliability requirements, and partner with data science teams to take models from experimentation into production. * **Pipeline Automation** : Own the CI/CD approach for machine learning workloads end to end, including gates, artifact management and rollback, using tools such as GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps. Deploy model workloads to services such as Azure Container Instances (ACI) or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). * **ML Lifecycle Management** : Own the lifecycle of production models, including versioning, promotion across environments, retraining and retirement, using Azure Machine Learning and Microsoft Fabric Data Science. * **Monitoring \& Maintenance** : Define what healthy looks like for each production model and service. While Azure ML and Microsoft Fabric are preferred, experience with AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, or similar platforms is highly acceptable. * Programming: Strong proficiency in modern programming languages (such as Python, C\#, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript) with solid mastery of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, design patterns, and clean architecture (SDLC). * Web, API \& Middleware Development: Extensive experience building web applications, scalable RESTful APIs, and enterprise middleware integrations. * DevOps \& Containerization: Proven experience building and owning version control workflows (Git), CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), and containerization ecosystems (Docker, Azure Container Registry, Kubernetes/AKS/ACI). Please note that this role may require a National Agency Check (NAC) and/or background check, and relocation assistance is not available at this time. **Greentree is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or status as a qualified individual with a disability or protected veteran.** **Compensation / Salary Range:** Greentree adheres to federal, state, and local regulations. At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are residents of, and authorized to work in, the following states: AZ, CO, DC, FL, GA, KY, MD, MI, NC, OH, OR, PA, SD, TX, or VA. **Top Benefits** **Core Benefits** **100% paid by Greentree:** Employee Medical Premium on the High\-Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), Basic Life Insurance and AD\&D, Short\-Term Disability (STD), Long\-Term Disability (LTD), Health Reimbursement Account (HRA), 401(k) Match, Job\-Related Certifications, and Training Programs **Elected Benefits:** Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA, FSA, Voluntary Term Life, 401(k) (Roth and Pretax available) **Time Off: PTO, Flexible Schedules, Holidays and Paid Parental Leave:** Work\-life balance is important – we all enjoy some time off for rest and relaxation! Employees receive a very generous amount of PTO which is granted on start date, plus the ability for quick escalation to the next tier. Flexible/hybrid working schedules and 11 paid holidays, in addition to paid parental leave round out the work\-life balance benefits. **Paid Training and Development:** We encourage and support ongoing employee learning and development, consistent with needs of the company, its clients, and markets. Greentree is committed to paying the cost for job\-related certifications and/or training programs.
