jobs.title: Sr Engineer, IT Service Mgmt - IT Infrastructure - Full Time
jobs.description: ***Summary:*** *The Senior Engineer, IT Service Management is responsible for the design, implementation, support and maintenance of solutions within the IT Service Management (ITSM) platform critical to healthcare operations including patient care, clinical applications, and administrative functions for The Guthrie Clinic (TGC). This role ensures high availability and performance for ITSM processes (**change management, asset management, configuration management, incident management, knowledge management, problem management) and the overall CMDB in accordance with ITIL or industry best practices. The* *Sr. Engineer collaborates with IT teams, vendors, and hospital stakeholders to align ITSM processes and tools. This position will be a technology advocate throughout the organization for the effective application of technology to meet business needs and to support business changes and growth*. ***Experience:*** * *Preferred five to seven (5 to 7\) years of experience in implementing and managing ITSM processes and a CMDB in an enterprise environment; healthcare experience preferred.* * *Highly experienced information systems professional with a strong technical background and proven track record of accomplishments in a large, complex multi\-level organization.* * *Expertise in ITSM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow) and configuration of workflows, forms, and reports.* * *Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g., JavaScript, PowerShell, Python) for ITSM integrations.* * *Experience with ITIL processes (change management, asset management, configuration management, incident management, knowledge management, problem management).* * *Experience architecting and deploying ITSM and ITAM solutions within large enterprise environments.* * *Advanced expertise in reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).* * *Experience with web technologies such as JavaScript, HTML, CSS and REST/SOAP web services.* * *Solid understanding of IT infrastructure components such as servers, network, storage systems and virtualization technologies.* * *Experience with ITSM functionalities such as change control, CMDB and ticketing systems.* * *Strong knowledge of healthcare information systems (e.g., Epic, Cerner), cybersecurity and clinical operations.* * *Prior experience delivering high availability systems in a 24/7 environment across geographically dispersed business units.* * *Demonstrated ability to facilitate evaluation of technologies and achieve consensus on technical standards and solutions among a diverse group of information technology professionals.* * *Demonstrated commitment to customer service who has provided responsive and effective support, developed solid working relationships with customers, and delivered high quality, value\-added services that met/exceeded customer expectations.* * *Polished professional with demonstrated information technology experience and strong communication skills that can rapidly gain and maintain credibility with customers and IT colleagues.* ***Education:*** * *Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration or related field strongly desired or an equivalent combination of education and experience.* ***Licenses/Certifications:*** * *Preferred certifications include ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, ITIL 4 Foundation.* Essential Functions: * Configure, deploy, and maintain ITSM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow) to support change management, asset management, configuration management, incident management, knowledge management, and problem management processes. * Design and improve ITSM workflows to streamline IT service delivery, reduce resolution times, and enhance user experience for clinical and administrative staff. * Provide technical expertise to support service desk operations, ensuring effective resolution of incidents and service requests in a healthcare environment. * Develop and implement automation scripts and integrations to connect ITSM platforms with healthcare systems (e.g., EHR, clinical applications) and other IT infrastructure components. * Design and manage change control processes to minimize risks associated with IT system changes, ensuring alignment with TGC policies. * Maintain and optimize IT asset inventories within the ITSM platform, ensuring accurate tracking of hardware, software, and licensing compliance. * Work closely with IT teams, clinical stakeholders, and vendors to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues, and implement ITSM solutions that meet operational needs. * Develop and maintain ITSM performance metrics, dashboards, and reports to provide insights to IT leadership and ensure SLA compliance. * Create technical documentation and provide training to IT staff and end\-users on ITSM tools and processes. * Collaborate with ITSM tool vendors and service providers to ensure platform functionality, upgrades, and adherence to service level agreements (SLAs). * Stay current on ITSM innovations (e.g., ITIL 4, AI\-driven service management, cloud\-based ITSM) and evaluate their potential to improve TGC IT operations. * Anticipates and provides solutions for complex problems and issues, recommends upgrades and enhancements. Rapidly absorbs complex technical and conceptual information to identify issues and implications. Able to present understandable alternatives to both technical and non\-technical individuals at all levels of the organization. * Promotes the use of TGC’s PMO methodology and standards to manage IT initiatives. * Demonstrates commitment to customer service by providing responsive and effective support, developing solid working relationships with customers and IT colleagues, and delivering high quality, value\-added services that exceed customer expectations. * Demonstrates a commitment to excellence in Customer Service with all internal and external customers of TGC. * Performs related duties as assigned and unrelated duties as requested. ***Other Duties: Other duties as assigned.*** Joining the Guthrie team allows you to become a part of a tradition of excellence in health care. In all areas and at all levels of Guthrie, you’ll find staff members who have committed themselves to serving the community. The Guthrie Clinic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The Guthrie Clinic is a non\-profit, integrated, practicing physician\-led organization in the Twin Tiers of New York and Pennsylvania. Our multi\-specialty group practice of more than 500 physicians and 302 advanced practice providers offers 47 specialties through a regional office network providing primary and specialty care in 22 communities. Guthrie Medical Education Programs include General Surgery, Internal Medicine, Emergency Medicine, Family Medicine, Anesthesiology and Orthopedic Surgery Residency, as well as Cardiovascular, Gastroenterology and Pulmonary Critical Care Fellowship programs. Guthrie is also a clinical campus for the Geisinger Commonwealth School of Medicine.

jobs.title: Online Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Purpose:** Online Data Engineer teams at The Home Depot translate business requirements and build the infrastructure needed to capture customer data. They acquire datasets that align with business needs and develop algorithms to transform data into useful, actionable information. Additionally, they build, test, and maintain database pipeline architectures. They create new data validation methods and data analysis tools. Data Engineers develop application programming interfaces (APIs) to retrieve data. Our Data Engineers develop, host, and maintain in\-house enterprise solutions to improve reliability and confidence through monitoring, continually testing, and validating the products we support. These associates use big\-data techniques to cleanse, organize and transform data and to maintain, defend and update data structures and integrity on an automated basis. The Data Engineer position applies data extraction, transformation and loading techniques in order to connect large data sets from a variety of sources. They create data collection frameworks for structured and unstructured data and develops and maintain infrastructure systems (e.g., data warehouses, data lakes) including data access APIs. Data Engineers prepare and manipulate data using Hadoop or equivalent MapReduce platform. **Key Responsibilities:** * 10% \- Business Collaboration \- Incorporate business knowledge into solution approach. Effectively develop trust and collaboration with internal customers and cross\-functional teams; Work with project teams and business partners to determine project goals. * 20% \- Project Management \& Team Support \- Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to both technical and non\-technical leaders and business customers/partners; Present recommendations in a confident manner in order to influence execution of recommendation. Prepare reports, updates and/or presentations related to progress made on a project or solution. Clearly communicate impacts of recommendations to drive alignment and appropriate implementation. * 55% \- Solution Development \- Develops algorithms to transform data into useful, actionable information. Design and develop algorithms and models to use against large datasets to create business insights; Participates in large data analytics project teams by serving as a lead for analytics projects; May lead small projects and work independently on solution development. Execute tasks with high levels of efficiency and quality; Make appropriate selection, utilization and interpretation of advanced analytical methodologies. * 15% \- Technical Exploration \& Development \- Seek further knowledge on key developments within advanced analytics, technical skill sets, and additional data sources. Participate in the continuous improvement of predictive and prescriptive analytics by developing replicable solutions. **Direct Manager/Direct Reports:** * This position reports to the Manager or Above * This position has 0 direct reports **Travel Requirements:** * No travel required. **Physical Requirements:** * Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions, there may be a need to move or lift light articles. **Working Conditions:** * Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Must be 18 years of age or older. * Must be legally permitted to work in the United States. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelors or Masters in a quantitative field (Analytics, Computer Science, Math, Physics, Statistics, etc.) or relevant work experience. * Demonstrated knowledge developing and testing ETL jobs/pipelines, configuring orchestration, automated CI/CD, writing automation scripts, and supporting the pipelines in production. * Experience in high\-level programming languages such as Python * Experience defining and capturing metadata and rules associated with ETL processes * Experience building Batch and Streaming pipelines * Experience writing analytical SQL queries * Ability to stich and maintain data from multiple sources * Ability to use JavaScript, Front\-end development frameworks (React, Nucleus), and QA apps (Retina, KPI Shield, Alert Goose) * Ability to produce tags for site data * Ability to code in Python, Google BigQuery to stitch and enrich the raw data from multiple sources * Ability to use PySpark, AirFlow, and DataProc to engineer and automate data flows pipelines * Ability to optimize the pipelines run time and lower the cost on slots/storage consumption * Ability to prioritize requests and manage a product roadmap * Strong verbal and written communications skills at all levels **Minimum Education:** * The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job. **Preferred Education:** * The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a master's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job. **Minimum Years of Work Experience:** * 2 **Preferred Years of Work Experience:** * 3 **Minimum Leadership Experience:** * No previous leadership experience **Preferred Leadership Experience:** * No previous leadership experience **Certifications:** * None **Competencies:** * Action Oriented * Collaborates * Communicates Effectively * Customer Focus * Drives Results

You will turn approved product requirements, designs and technical direction into secure, accessible, high\-performance software, and you will own day\-to\-day application development, deployment pipelines, environments and headless CMS configuration. You will work as part of an integrated, cross\-functional Agile team, tackling complex functional, technical and architectural challenges while delivering value incrementally. You will also provide hands\-on technical oversight of external implementation partners and mentor a Front End Web Developer. Your work will strengthen JAX's technical capabilities and support both scientific research and operational needs. Fully remote with occasional travel **What you'll do** **Build and maintain full\-stack applications** * Develop, test, deploy and maintain front\-end and back\-end code * Build responsive, accessible interfaces using React, Next.js, HTML, CSS and JavaScript/TypeScript * Maintain reusable components, Storybook libraries, and clean, documented code in Git **Configure and manage our headless CMS** * Configure and maintain Contentstack, including roles, permissions, workflows, content types, references, validation and authoring standards * Implement approved content models, governed page\-builder patterns, locked\-down layouts and localization workflows with Digital Product, UX and Content **Run deployment environments and CI/CD** * Maintain Vercel development, preview/staging and production environments, including edge/serverless functions, routing and redirects * Build and maintain GitHub Actions and Vercel\-integrated CI/CD workflows, automated lint/build/test gates and secure deployment configurations, in partnership with IT **Connect systems and prepare for AI** * Develop and maintain APIs, data models, middleware and integrations across Contentstack, Bynder, Algolia, CRM, analytics, personalization and enterprise systems * Tune search relevance and indexing, improve discoverability, implement event tracking, and support AI\-ready content and search strategies for future generative experiences **Deliver performance, accessibility and reliability** * Optimize SSR, SSG and ISR rendering; implement schema.org structured data, technical SEO and Core Web Vitals improvements * Ensure WCAG 2\.1 AA accessibility * Diagnose performance and integration issues using logs, monitoring and request tracing **Guide technical implementation and external partners** * Translate approved requirements, designs, component inventories and dependencies into implementation tasks and estimates * Identify feasibility and security constraints early, implement approved architecture decisions, and review vendor code against standards and acceptance criteria * Give actionable feedback and verify production readiness **Support developers and mentor your team** * Serve as the first point of contact for engineering, environment and CMS configuration questions * Maintain technical documentation and reusable practices * Assign and prioritize work, conduct code reviews, pair on complex problems, and mentor the Front End Web Developer * Provide strategic leadership and help advance software practices and direction for each platform **What you bring** **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Master’s degree preferred * 10 years of experience in a same or similar role, 15\+ years preferred * Over 10 years of experience in software development and/or application configuration, ideally in an Agile environment * Proficiency in at least 5 of these Agile software development techniques: data analytics, business and system analysis, technical design, automated unit and functional testing, test strategy, user\-centered design, and continuous integration/deployment * Proficiency in at least 5 of these leadership skills: collaboration, product management, facilitation, conflict resolution and mentorship * Strong knowledge of React, Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js * Strong understanding of headless CMS and composable architectures, including structured content modeling, verification, simulation, and debugging, helping semiconductor companies improve engineering efficiency and speed up chip development. * Founded through AI agent research at UC Santa Barbara, brings together experts in AI, semiconductor engineering, and electronic design automation (EDA). * The company works with leading semiconductor companies, hyperscale cloud providers, and startups. **About customer engineering teams at leading semiconductor companies, identifying technical challenges and developing software solutions to solve them. * Partnering with internal R\&D engineers and next\-generation AI tools for chip design and verification.

jobs.title: Research Data Architect/Engineer
jobs.description: **Department** BSD NEU \- HAARC \- Imaging Research **About the Department** The Healthy Aging \& Alzheimer’s Research Care (HAARC) Center, within the Department of Neurology at the University of Chicago, conducts research on healthy aging, SuperAging, and Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD). The HAARC Center operates a coordinating center for multi\-site, multimodal studies, including the SuperAging Research Initiative, that receives continuous streams of data from sites across the country: neuroimaging, cognitive and neuropsychological assessment, blood\-based biomarkers and proteomics, genome and RNA sequencing, wearable and digital\-voice recordings, digital histopathology, microbiome data, and environmental and exposome measures. Each stream must be received, verified, linked, protected, and routed back out to partner laboratories and NIH data repositories. This at\-will position is wholly or partially funded by contractual grant funding which is renewed under provisions set by the grantor of the contract. Employment will be contingent upon the continued receipt of these grant funds and satisfactory job performance. **Job Summary** We are seeking a Research Data Architect/Engineer to join the HAARC Center and work closely with Drs. Adam Martersteck, Ana Capuano, and Emily Rogalski. This position will design and maintain a secure, center\-wide data architecture and multimodal data flows that support HAARC’s research programs and laboratories, including the SuperAging Research Initiative. The architect will create and maintain tools to execute and monitor the receipt, storage, quality control, integration, and sharing of data from neuroimaging; genetics, genomics, and other omics; clinical and cognitive assessments; biospecimens and laboratory assays; digital pathology; wearables and voice; and environmental and exposome measures. The role will build and maintain digital tools and dashboards that integrate data documentation and communicate data metrics and availability internally and externally, as directed by HAARC leadership. The architect will partner with UChicago’s Center for Research Informatics and Research Computing Center and with data teams at collaborating sites. Primary responsibilities include building and operating production data pipelines and reporting; maintaining security, provenance, and data quality, documenting systems and workflows, and defining safe AI\-appropriate practices for the center. We seek an individual who built their fundamentals through years of hands\-on work, writing, debugging, and operating production systems themselves. The ideal candidate is excited to bring that expertise to an academic research environment and knows the fundamentals well enough to build, execute, review, and teach others. Candidates should be proficient in using AI tools for data management, flow, and processing tasks and able to determine which tools are appropriate for which systems and data. They must understand the sensitivity of participant data and maintain security and privacy at all times.**Responsibilities** * Lead the design, documentation, and ongoing improvement of HAARC’s center\-wide data management architecture, setting shared standards for data intake, identifiers, metadata, provenance, quality control, access, storage, and delivery across studies and within laboratories. * Build reproducible workflows that link multimodal research data, including MRI and PET imaging, genetics and sequencing, proteomics and other omics, clinical and cognitive data, specimens and assays, digital pathology, wearables, voice recordings, and environmental measures. * Monitor data flows across HAARC teams, partner sites, university systems, and NIH\-designated repositories; define transfer and validation procedures; and support compliant data sharing and repository submissions. * Building continuous, two\-way transfer workflows that send minimum\-necessary data packages to partner universities and validate and relink the results they return, with SHA\-256 manifests and detailed provenance records for every delivery in or out. * Implementing relational schemas, APIs, and ETL/ELT pipelines that link REDCap and laboratory information management system (LIMS) records to imaging, specimen, assay, device, and exposure data through common participant, visit, and specimen identifiers. * Redesigning study\-specific access controls, encryption, and file permissions, and setting up separate development and production environments so undergraduates, graduate students, and new staff can learn computational research on synthetic data without disrupting running pipelines or touching protected data. * Generating realistic synthetic datasets from protected health and personal information (PHI/PII) so AI\-assisted workflows can be developed without exposing real participant data. * Preparing and creating pipelines that link NIH\-designated repositories. * Provide analysis\-ready tables and data APIs that  tegrity checking (sftp, rsync, checksum manifests). * Virtual server deployment and backup automation. * Familiarity with DICOM networking, BIDS tools, DataLad, REDCap, synthetic data generation, and NIH data\-sharing repositories is a strong plus. * Website management and development, including content management systems, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, accessibility, usability, and web analytics. **Preferred Competencies** * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to translate scientific and operational needs into clear data architecture and deliverables. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with sound judgment about data quality, security, and appropriate access. * Excellent organizational skills, project coordination, and attention to detail across multiple studies and priorities. * Work both independently and collaboratively with investigators and staff across the HAARC Center and external partner teams. * Ability to explain data systems, dashboards, and processes to technical and nontechnical audiences. * Receptive to feedback; willing to learn and committed to continuous improvement. * Mastery of fundamental concepts, practices, and procedures of software development. * Confidentiality and discretion with protected health information, participant data, , unpublished findings, and University information. **Application Documents** * Resume (required) * Cover Letter (required) The University of Chicago uses AI\-assisted tools to streamline and augment some recruitment processes; however, AI is not used to make hiring decisions. When applying, the document(s) **MUST** be uploaded via the **My Experience** page, in the section titled **Application Documents** of the application. **Job Family** Information Technology **Role Impact** Individual Contributor **Scheduled** **Weekly Hours** 40 **Drug Test Required** No **Health Screen Required** No **Motor Vehicle Record Inquiry Required** No **Pay Rate Type** Salary **FLSA Status** Exempt **Pay Range** $100,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 The included pay rate or range represents the University’s good faith estimate of the possible compensation offer for this role at the time of posting. **Benefits Eligible** Yes The University of Chicago offers a wide range of benefits programs and resources for eligible employees, including health, retirement, and paid time off. Information about the benefit offerings can be found in the Benefits Guidebook. **Posting Statement** The University of Chicago is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, or expression, national or ethnic origin, shared ancestry, age, status as an individual with a disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or other protected classes under the law. For additional information please see the University's Notice of Nondiscrimination. Job seekers in need of a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process should call 773\-702\-5800 or submit a request via Applicant Inquiry Form. All offers of employment are contingent upon a background check that includes a review of conviction history. A conviction does not automatically preclude University employment. Rather, the University considers conviction information on a case\-by\-case basis and assesses the nature of the offense, the circumstances surrounding it, the proximity in time of the conviction, and its relevance to the position. The Report can be accessed online at: http://securityreport.uchicago.edu. Paper copies of the Report are available, upon request, from the University of Chicago Police Department, 850 E. 61st Street, Chicago, IL 60637\.

jobs.description: Technology Backend Software Engineer \- Data Lifecycle Management **Location :** San Jose **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A160823 Responsibilities The TikTok Privacy and Security (PnS) R\&D team creates privacy solutions that are intuitive for users, auditable for regulators, and sustainable for the company, making TikTok a platform where people can safely discover, create, and connect. We build user\-facing privacy features, including privacy settings, consent management, data access and export, and age\-appropriate experiences. We protect personal data across its full lifecycle, from collection and transfer through access, storage, retention, and deletion. We develop the platforms, technical controls, and governance tools behind privacy protection and regulatory compliance in global markets, and we bring privacy\-enhancing technologies and research into production at scale. We tackle challenges unique to operating a platform at global scale: translating rapidly evolving laws and policies into reliable technical controls, providing transparency and auditability across highly complex data systems, supporting different regulatory requirements across regions, and making privacy protection work at the quality and speed production systems demand. You will work across product privacy, data lifecycle management, data protection and residency, privacy engineering platforms, AI governance, and privacy\-preserving technologies, using techniques including automated compliance enforcement, data lineage and taxonomy, differential privacy, trusted execution environments, AI fairness, and privacy protection for generative AI. The systems you build will protect hundreds of millions of people, and the privacy decisions you make will reach every one of them. As a part of TikTok Privacy \& Security group, the mission of the Data Lifecycle Management team is to ensure responsible data practices across TikTok and meet privacy commitments made to regulators and end\-users in online system. The team provides solutions for privacy management in data lifecycle, including data collection and sharing, purpose limitation, data understanding etc. We are dealing with an ecosystem that includes tens of thousands of online services and databases in global data centers, managing billions of users' data worldwide. To meet our commitment, we are building a world\-class privacy aware infrastructure that spans all data lifecycle stages across various online environments, including API gateways, micro\-services, storages, and message queues. Furthermore, we are developing data understanding services to support data governance projects in an event\-driven manner. As a software engineer, you will be engaged in designing solutions for protecting TikTok user's sensitive data with cutting\-edge techniques. Your primary focus will be building globalized services and platforms to ensure that user data is well protected while empowering our business. Responsibilities: \- Design and build services to protect user sensitive data with privacy design by default. \- Be responsible for the system design and functionality development of the privacy engineering frameworks and platforms. \- Work on anonymization/pseudonymization/encryption technologies to preserve user privacy in data processing activities. \- Work closely with cross\-functional teams to address technical challenges when applying solutions throughout our product suite. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications \- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, strong internship or project experience will also be considered. \- Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, and common server architectures. \- Proficiency in at least one general\-purpose programming language, such as Java, Go, C\+\+, or Python, and experience building or maintaining backend services. \- Ability to analyze business requirements, break down problems, and deliver reliable, maintainable technical solutions with guidance from senior engineers. \- Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional partners. Preferred Qualifications \- Interest in or exposure to privacy engineering, data protection, security, or data governance. \- Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices, databases, message queues, or cloud\-native infrastructure. \- Hands\-on experience building AI Agent applications, including agent workflow design and tool integration. \- Experience through work, internships, or projects with data protection techniques such as access control, encryption, anonymization, or data classification. \- Demonstrated curiosity, ownership, and eagerness to learn in a fast\-paced global product environment. Job Information 【For Pay Transparency】Compensation Description (Annually) The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $128000 \- $316800 annually. ​ Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units. ​ Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure). ​ The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice. ​ **For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:** ​ Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and ​ 3\. Exercising sound judgment. ​ About TikTok TikTok is the leading destination for short\-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: ### **About the role** As a Forward Deployed Engineer on our Applied AI Inference team, you'll be the hands\-on technical owner for a broad set of fast\-growing customers building products on high\-quality open models at scale. You'll work across several customers and get into the details of how each customer selects and applies models in their workload, from evals and prompts to agents and harness integrations. You'll go deep technically. You'll learn each customer's architecture and use cases well enough to guide their move from closed to open models. That means choosing the right models, benchmarking quality and performance, tuning prompts and pipelines, and integrating models into their systems and workflows. You'll write code most days, alongside customers and in our own tools. You'll own customer outcomes from post\-POC to production. Once a Solutions Architect wins the proof of concept, you take the account into production and help it scale. You drive adoption, remove blockers and proactively make sure the customer gets the value they were promised. You'll bring a product mindset. You'll turn what you learn on each deployment into reusable playbooks, tooling, reference architectures and product feedback so each new deployment is faster and needs less manual work than the last. You'll work across teams constantly. You'll work alongside Solutions Architects, Sales, Engineering, Product, and Research. As one of the early members on this team, you'll also help define how the function runs, including its playbooks, tooling and hiring. Your work will directly affect customer retention, platform adoption and company growth. ### **Responsibilities** * **Opinionated Onboarding:** Plan the path to production with the SA and customer, and make sure the right deployment strategy, model choice, ramp plan and monitoring are in place before the workload goes live. * **Model Selection \& Migration:** Help customers move from closed to open models. Evaluate options on the customer's own data, pick the right model, and handle upgrades and deprecations without regressions. * **Agent Design:** Build and debug agents and multi\-step workflows that hold up in production, including tool calling, planning and retries. * **Harness \& System Integrations:** Get Together working inside the tools customers already use, like coding\-agent harnesses, agent frameworks, OpenAI\-compatible SDKs and data pipelines. Fix what breaks between them: tool\-call formats, streaming, context limits and rate limits. * **Evals \& Prompts:** Build evals that measure what each customer cares about, and use them to tune prompts and catch regressions. * **Customer Touchpoints:** Proactively monitor your accounts, keep a frequent pulse of how things are going, work closely alongside customers to ensure adoption and success. * **Automation \& Tooling:** Write automation, monitoring, scripts and internal tools that turn repeatable work into systems, for customers and for our own team. * **Product Feedback Loop:** Bring what you see in the field to Engineering and Product, contribute product enhancements and documentation, and turn recurring patterns into playbooks the whole team can reuse. ### **Requirements** * **Experience:** 4\+ years in a technical, customer\-facing engineering role such as forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, applied AI engineering or ML infrastructure, ideally at a fast\-growing company. You can own these accounts from day one. * **Agent Design:** You've built agents with tool use and run them in production, and you can tell which harness or framework fits a given workload. * **Model Selection:** You know today's open models well and have compared open and closed models on a real workload. You can explain your pick in terms of quality, latency and cost. * **Automation \& Coding:** Strong Python. You've built tools and automation that other people use, and you lean on AI tools to get your own work done faster. * **Applied AI \& Integrations:** You've shipped LLM features into existing products, ideally coding or agentic use cases, and debugged what broke between the model, the SDK and the app. * **Prompt Engineering:** You've written and evaluated prompts for production LLM applications. * **Ownership \& Judgment:** You can juggle many accounts, turn vague goals into clear plans, and know when to go deep, when to automate and when to bring in a specialist. * **Communication:** You can explain technical tradeoffs clearly to engineers and business stakeholders.Builder Mindset: You're excited to help build a new team from the ground up. ### **About Together AI** Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier\-level specialized models, and pre\-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400\+ trillion tokens a month. ### **Compensation** We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and other benefits, as well as flexibility in terms of remote work. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is: $270,000 \- $300,000 OTE \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. ### **Application Policy** Please read each role carefully and apply to the position best suited to you. Candidates are limited to 6 applications within a 90\-day period, and applications beyond that limit will be automatically rejected. You may apply to additional roles 90 days after your last application. ### **Equal Opportunity** Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more. Please see our Privacy Policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

Fix what breaks between them: tool\-call formats, streaming, context limits and rate limits. * **Evals \& Prompts:** Build evals that measure what each customer cares about, and use them to tune prompts and catch regressions. * **Customer Touchpoints:** Proactively monitor your accounts, keep a frequent pulse of how things are going, work closely alongside customers to ensure adoption and success. * **Automation \& Tooling:** Write automation, monitoring, scripts and internal tools that turn repeatable work into systems, for customers and for our own team. * **Product Feedback Loop:** Bring what you see in the field to Engineering and Product, contribute product enhancements and documentation, and turn recurring patterns into playbooks the whole team can reuse. ### **Requirements** * **Experience:** 4\+ years in a technical, customer\-facing engineering role such as forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, applied AI engineering or ML infrastructure, ideally at a fast\-growing company. You can own these accounts from day one. * **Agent Design:** You’ve built agents with tool use and run them in production, and you can tell which harness or framework fits a given workload. * **Model Selection:** You know today’s open models well and have compared open and closed models on a real workload. You can explain your pick in terms of quality, latency and cost. * **Automation \& Coding:** Strong Python. You’ve built tools and automation that other people use, and you lean on AI tools to get your own work done faster. * **Applied AI \& Integrations:** You’ve shipped LLM features into existing products, ideally coding or agentic use cases, and debugged what broke between the model, the SDK and the app. * **Prompt Engineering:** You’ve written and evaluated prompts for production LLM applications. * **Ownership \& Judgment:** You can juggle many accounts, turn vague goals into clear plans, and know when to go deep, when to automate and when to bring in a specialist. * **Communication:** You can explain technical tradeoffs clearly to engineers and business stakeholders.Builder Mindset: You’re excited to help build a new team from the ground up. ### **About Together AI** Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier\-level specialized models, and pre\-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400\+ trillion tokens a month. ### **Compensation** We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and other benefits, as well as flexibility in terms of remote work. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is: $270,000 \- $300,000 OTE \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. ### **Application Policy** Please read each role carefully and apply to the position best suited to you. Candidates are limited to 6 applications within a 90\-day period, and applications beyond that limit will be automatically rejected. You may apply to additional roles 90 days after your last application. ### **Equal Opportunity** Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more. Please see our Privacy Policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

design, exception strategy, testing, and support planning. * Experience mentoring developers, leading reviews, building reusable components, or contributing to automation standards and governance. * Strong experience integrating automations with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, cloud services, workflow tools, or business applications. * Ability to evaluate opportunities, estimate value and effort, manage delivery risks, and recommend practical, scalable solutions. * Experience with intelligent automation, document understanding, AI\-assisted workflows, process mining, or agentic automation patterns preferred. * Strong communication skills with technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership audiences. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience supporting manufacturing, supply chain, service, engineering, finance, or IT processes in a complex enterprise environment. * UiPath or comparable automation platform certifications. * Experience with Python, SQL, REST APIs, Github, CI/CD practices, structured testing, ERP systems, ITSM platforms, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, databases, or cloud services. * Experience developing machine learning solutions, including supervised or unsupervised models, feature engineering, model validation, deployment support, and integration with business or automation processes. * Interest in emerging automation and AI technologies and a desire to help shape the future of digital ways of working at TEL U.S. **Physical Demands and Work Environment** ----------------------------------------- This role operates primarily in an office setting and routinely uses standard office equipment. The position is largely sedentary but may require occasional lifting of office products or supplies up to 35 pounds and 4 to 6 hours per day at a computer screen/keyboard. **Technology Enabling Life.** Equal Opportunity Employer/Minorities/Females/Disabled/Veterans **Salary Ranges** ================= $122,054\.92 \- $172,499\.28 Individual pay is determined based on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, experience, skills, job\-related knowledge, relevant education, certifications, and/or training. jobs.title: Senior Director, AI Transformation Lead
jobs.description: At TouchTunes, your work matters. As the Senior Director, AI Transformation Lead, you'll own the company's AI strategy, staying ahead of where the technology is headed, and making sure the tools, training, and support we put in front of employees actually change how they work. This role is the Force Multiplier for the entire organization – ever wanted to go into an organization and say “Hey \- you're awesome – but i can make you 10x more awesome”. that's what we want – solve ALL the challenges we can solve with AI so that people can be 10x more effective and we can create 10x more strategic value for our users. You'll lead the AI strategy across the company with the mandate to make AI a genuine competitive advantage for TouchTunes. * Own the AI strategy and roadmap. Lead our Build → Scale → Embed strategy end to end, setting priorities, budget, and governance, and own the TouchTunes AI Lifecycle (AILC). * Stay ahead of the AI landscape. Track emerging tools and capabilities, brief leadership on what matters, and turn what's relevant (not just what's hyped) into action. You don’t wait – you act and roll out. * Burn the ships. Be a Ninja Pirate. Be a pioneer who sets the future without looking back, and build solutions as much as you teach others to build them. And when something has been solved by others, you ‘borrow’ it as quickly as possible. * Own our AI platform. Manage our AI environment (in this case Claude) – access tiers, security, connectors, and admin controls – with hands\-on mastery of Projects, Artifacts, Skills, and agents. Own model routing so every task uses the right model at the right cost, and fine\-tune models with Data and Engineering where the return justifies it. * Connect AI to the business. Bring company systems, including legacy and bespoke ones, into our AI platform, building MCP servers as needed, and select and deploy a company ontology. When a bridge doesn’t exist to a system, you build it. * Own AI governance. Design and implement the permissions model for AI access to company data and systems, and maintain, with Legal, the policy on what AI can and can’t be used for. * Manage AI tools and vendors. Pilot new tools with adoption and ROI metrics defined up front, approve AI features in vendor products, and negotiate our agreements with AI providers. * Drive adoption across the company. Lead and grow the AI Champions Network, maintain the playbook for AI skills and plugins, and partner with department leaders to redesign high\-friction workflows around AI. * Bring AI into our products. Partner with Product and Engineering to build AI features into the service to users. * Build the AI team. Hire and manage forward\-deployed engineers and AI consultants. * Measure and report on impact. Track adoption, fluency, and business impact, identify where to expand AI use, and report to the ELT and AI Steering Committee. **Your profile:** * 8\+ years in technology strategy, digital/AI transformation, learning \& enablement, or a related field, including direct experience leading enterprise AI adoption programs. * Deep, hands\-on fluency with Claude specifically (Projects, Artifacts, Skills, agents, admin/workspace configuration) or an equivalent enterprise AI platform — able to configure it, not just talk about it. * A track record piloting and scaling tools, governance frameworks, and adoption programs across a multi\-functional organization. * Experience building and leading champion or community\-of\-practice networks, train\-the\-trainer models, or similar peer\-led adoption programs. * Strong program and change\-management skills — able to act as the technical SME behind a training program, shaping content and co\-delivering sessions without owning the full curriculum alone. * Excellent executive communication skills; comfortable presenting to ELT/senior leadership and building buy\-in across technical and non\-technical audiences. * A collaborative approach to governance — experience partnering with IT, Legal, and Security on data privacy and responsible\-AI policy is a strong plus. * Genuine curiosity about where AI is headed, with a habit of experimenting with new tools before being asked to. * A bias to action. You don't wait for anything; you’re a shark swimming forward. **What’s in it for you:** At TouchTunes, your work impacts our customers as part of interesting projects that transform the in\-venue entertainment industry. We foster open communication and collaboration across all levels, with approachable leaders that value all voices and empower you to excel and innovate. Our team thrives in an environment where fun meets hard work, and everyone is encouraged to be their authentic selves. **Our Perks and Benefits:** * Hybrid Work Environment: Hybrid schedule with 50% work\-from\-home and in\-office time, with the ability to work anywhere in the world for up to 2 months per year. * Financial Wellness: Annual performance bonus, long\-term company bonus, 401k matching, life insurance. * Comprehensive Benefits: Competitive health insurance and disability coverage, a Lifestyle Spending Account, access to telemedicine, and an unlimited sick days policy. * Professional Development: Continuous hands\-on learning with access to e\-learning platform, tuition reimbursement, and peer mentorship. * Accessibility: An inclusive workplace designed to accommodate people with disabilities. Touchtunes is the world’s largest in\-venue interactive music and entertainment platform, and we’re all about sparking joy and human connection. That moment in a bar where someone at the next table cues the jukebox to play your favorite song? That’s what we do, but we’re also so much more. **Today, our offering goes beyond music:** BullShooter soft\-tip electronic dartboards are now part of the TouchTunes experience, expanding our footprint in social, in\-venue entertainment. We’ve also recently launched a reimagined mobile app, bringing an even more seamless and engaging experience to our users. We’re innovators, strategic thinkers, people making the future possible today, and what a great time to join our team. **Work Requirements:** Must be authorized to work in the United States TouchTunes is an Equal Employment Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. TouchTunes provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. * TouchTunes is a proud ally of QueerTech and DiversityJobs.

jobs.title: Senior Distinguished Engineer, AI Safety & Security
jobs.description: **About Trellix** Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Combining AI\-native security, operational threat intelligence, and automated detection and response, Trellix provides defense\-grade protection at machine speed across on\-premises, air\-gapped, operational technology, hybrid, and cloud environments. Trellix helps customers anticipate threats, scale effective security operations, maintain business continuity, and adapt their security posture for the modern threat landscape. Working with a broad partner ecosystem and global intelligence collaborators, Trellix helps strengthen the collective defense against cybercriminals and state\-sponsored attacks. At Trellix, we empower professionals at all career stages to expand their technical expertise, lead strategic initiatives, and make a tangible global impact. Whether you are an industry pioneer or an emerging specialist, Trellix provides the tools and opportunities to enhance and expand your skill set. Join our mission to scale AI\-driven cyber defense alongside an AI\-accelerated threat landscape, and help build a safer, more resilient future. More at https://trellix.com. ***Role Overview:*** Office of the CTO · Reports to the Chief Technology Officer · US Remote Make AI safe to trust at machine speed AI now writes software, triages alerts, and acts inside networks. Attackers have noticed. They plant instructions in public code to hijack AI coding agents, steal AI credentials at scale, and run agents that move through networks faster than any human team. Governments are planning for superintelligence across their missions. Every company that builds with AI now carries this risk, and a security company must carry it best. Trellix is investing to set that standard. We are looking for the engineer who will define how Trellix builds with AI and how our AI earns customer trust. This is one of the most senior technical roles at Trellix. **Why Trellix** * **AI at the core.** Trellix Wise™, our agentic security platform, went from concept to general availability in about three months, and AI\-assisted engineering now runs across our development teams. You will secure both at scale. * **Trust is the product.** Governments and regulated industries run Trellix on\-prem and air\-gapped. They need AI they can audit, contain, and explain. You will make that possible. * **A front\-row view of the adversary.** Our Advanced Research Center tracks the attackers now turning AI against defenders. Your controls will meet real threats, not hypotheticals. **What you will build** **AI\-native engineering, with evidence** * Set the guardrails for AI coding agents: execution boundaries, repository and credential scope, human approval gates, and complete audit trails. * Require validation before trust: evaluation suites every new model or agent must pass before it touches production code. * Govern our own agentic workforce with identity, least privilege, and spending limits for every AI agent we run. * Prove with data that AI makes us faster and better, and retire what does not. **Secure by default** * Make the safe option the default across our build systems, pipelines, and software supply chain. * Shorten release cycles while lowering defect and vulnerability rates. **AI safety and security in Trellix products** * Set the architecture standard for AI in Trellix products, including Trellix Wise™: data handling, purpose limitation, privacy, model isolation, tool\-use controls, and kill switches. * Red\-team our AI before attackers do: prompt injection, tool abuse, data and model poisoning, credential theft, and agent escape. * Keep models swappable, so customers can choose cloud, on\-prem, or air\-gapped without losing protection. * Shape our products for protecting customers' own AI agents and models. **Frontier questions you will own** * How do you prove an AI agent did only what it was allowed to do? * How do you trust a new model before it touches production? * What does least privilege mean for an agent that writes its own tools? * How do controls hold when adversaries run models as capable as ours? * How do we give customers and regulators audit\-grade evidence for decisions an AI made? **How you will work** * Report to the CTO and work alongside the Chief Architect and Trellix's senior distinguished engineers. * Set standards that every engineering team adopts, and build the shared controls that make them easy to follow. * Align Trellix AI governance with emerging standards such as ISO/IEC 42001, and help shape industry and government standards for AI security. * Explain our controls and their results to executives, boards, customers, and external assessors. Patent and publish where it advances the field. **About you** * 15\+ years of engineering, including principal, fellow, or chief architect roles in security, privacy, or large\-scale infrastructure. * Built enforcement controls at scale, such as privacy, purpose limitation, or access control, and proved they work. * Hands\-on with AI coding agents and LLM pipelines, and clear about how they fail. * Working knowledge of AI threat frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS. * A record of changing how a large engineering organization ships: release cadence, build systems, and secure defaults. * Writes clearly for executives, boards, and assessors. Patents preferred. B.S. in engineering or computer science, or equivalent experience. Base Pay Range: $200K\-250K. Actual base pay within this range will depend on varying circumstances, including the work location, individual qualifications, company budget and other operational business needs. Compensation may also include annual bonuses and long\-term incentives, subject to various metrics and company policy**.** ***Company Benefits and Perks:*** We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family\-friendly benefits to all of our employees. * Retirement Plans * Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage * Paid Time Off * Paid Parental Leave * Support for Community Involvement We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry\-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status. ***Our Commitment to You:*** At Trellix, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications. Trellix conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. We will never request sensitive personal information—such as your date of birth, Social Security number, or national ID number—during the interview process. Trellix also does not require candidates to pay fees, purchase products or services, or process payments of any kind as part of the recruiting or hiring process. And Trellix will never keep any original work authorization documents that we may be required to review during the hiring process. If you have questions or believe you may have encountered fraudulent activity related to Trellix recruiting, please contact us at **ethics@trellix.com**. Apply Now ##### **Share This Job** Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Linkedin Share on Email

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Discovery & Recommendations
jobs.description: ### **About Us** Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day. We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process. ### **About the Team** Twitch is all about community, and our Community team is a core pillar of what makes Twitch, Twitch. Community Discovery \& ML (CDML) helps millions of viewers find the creators and communities they'll love. That covers search, browse, the mobile live and clips feeds, recommended notifications, and the recommendation systems behind them. When a viewer finds a new creator through one of these, it's often the start of a lasting connection. That connection is what keeps viewers, and the creators they watch, coming back. ### **About the Role** We're looking for a data scientist with strong statistics and modeling skills to be the science partner for the machine learning and recommendation systems behind Twitch's discovery products. You will work with product managers, ML engineers and applied scientists to help build what our recommendation systems should optimize for. That means balancing what a viewer does today (a click, a play, minutes watched) against what keeps them coming back: return visits, daily habits, and lasting connections with creators. It also means weighing short\-form clips against long\-form live content, and each surface against the others. This role will draw from a variety of statistical learning techniques, causal inference, optimization and recommender systems evaluation, and it still owns the full path from question to decision. Reporting to the Director of Data Science, you will work from our San Francisco, CA office. ### **You Will:** * Help define the objective functions and success metrics for ranking and recommendations across feeds, search and notifications. Make the trade\-offs explicit between short\-term engagement (clicks, plays, watch time) and long\-term outcomes (return visits, retention, new creator connections), including how short\-form clips and live content add to or take away from each other. * Evaluate ranking, recommendation and feed changes with ML engineers and applied scientists. This covers A/B tests and long\-running holdouts, offline metrics that predict online results, and the cost and value of exploration and cold start. Handle the hard cases: novelty effects, interference between experiments, two\-sided marketplace effects involving creators and viewers, and feedback loops in recommendation data. * Build statistical and ML models that explain viewer behavior and size opportunities, such as propensity, uplift, survival and retention models. Include proxy metrics that predict long\-term retention, so teams can decide in days rather than months. * Turn ambiguous product questions into clear analyses. Quantify the uncertainty, and make recommendations that inform the machine learning and discovery roadmap. * Define the logging and data needed to measure discovery surfaces, and check its quality. * Contribute to the team's standards for experimentation, causal inference and model evaluation, and share what you learn with other data scientists. ### **You Have:** * A BA/BS in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent industry experience. * 3\+ years as a data scientist in a high\-velocity, data\-driven environment, with hands\-on experience applying statistical modeling and machine learning (regression, classification, causal inference, time series), including the assumptions behind each method and when it fails. * Experience designing and analyzing online experiments, including variance reduction, power analysis and the pitfalls of interpreting results. * Expert SQL and proficiency in Python or R. * A track record of using data and models to influence product decisions and leadership. ### **Bonus Points** * An MS or PhD in a quantitative field. * Experience with recommender systems, search ranking or feed ranking, such as offline evaluation (precision and recall, NDCG), exploration versus exploitation, or cold\-start problems. * Experience with multi\-objective optimization or with defining objective functions for ranking systems, including choosing weights between competing goals. * Experience building proxy metrics for long\-term outcomes, or estimating long\-term effects from long\-running holdouts or observational data (e.g., difference\-in\-differences, synthetic control, uplift modeling). * Experience with two\-sided platforms or marketplaces, where changes for viewers also affect creators or supply. * Experience on a consumer content platform: streaming, short\-form video, social or marketplaces. * Familiarity with Twitch, as a viewer or a creator (or both!). ### **Perks** * Medical, Dental, Vision \& Disability Insurance * 401(k) * Maternity \& Parental Leave * Flexible PTO * Amazon Employee Discount *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* Job ID: TWR9333 The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits. The UDP Cybersecurity Cloud Architect is a senior\-level, highly specialized role responsible for the development and governance of the organization's cloud security strategy, standards, and architectural direction. This individual serves as the primary steward of cloud security policies, reference architectures, and design standards, ensuring that cloud initiatives align with organizational objectives, regulatory obligations, and cybersecurity risk management requirements. The role provides strategic oversight of cloud security governance and defines the target\-state architecture necessary to support secure, compliant, and scalable cloud adoption across the enterprise. As the organization pursues an ambitious multi\-cloud strategy \- with Microsoft Azure as the primary cloud platform and Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as secondary environments \- the Cybersecurity Cloud Architect plays a decisive role in establishing unified security controls, governance frameworks, and threat detection capabilities across all cloud surfaces. The architect will lead the design and enforcement of Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), ensure enterprise\-grade Azure Landing Zones, and ensure that all cloud environments maintain measurable, auditable compliance with industry standards including NIST CSF 2\.0, CIS Controls, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and applicable regulatory frameworks such as HIPAA, FedRAMP, and GDPR. jobs.description: About the Role Places\-APIs powers location search, geocoding, and place details for 250\+ services across Uber. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the backend services behind these experiences. You will improve API reliability, latency, and cost while expanding access to Uber’s places data and integrating third\-party providers. You will own projects from architecture through launch and partner with teams across Maps, Mobility, and Delivery. jobs.title: Postdoctoral Scholar: Biochemical Network Simulation Software (libRoadRunner), Bioengineering
jobs.description: **Postdoctoral Scholar: Biochemical Network Simulation Software (libRoadRunner), Bioengineering** ================================================================================================= ### **Position Overview** **School / Campus / College:** School of Medicine **Organization:** Bioengineering (SOM) **Title:** Postdoctoral Scholar: Biochemical Network Simulation Software (libRoadRunner), Bioengineering ### **Position Details** #### **Position Description** The Department of Bioengineering at the University of Washington School of Medicine invites applications for a Postdoctoral Scholar with an anticipated start date of January 2027 (flexible). The successful candidate will join on a full\-time basis for a 12\-month, 2\-year, non\-renewable appointment beginning as soon as possible. This position is being offered at a salary of $5,705 to $6,667 per month ($68,460\-$80,004\) per year), plus University of Washington benefits. Postdoctoral scholars are represented by UAW 4121 and are subject to the collective bargaining agreement, unless agreed exclusion criteria apply. For more information, please visit the University of Washington Labor Relations website. The successful candidate will be expected to harden and extend libRoadRunner, our open\-source, high\-performance SBML simulation engine. Responsibilities include: * Harden the core. Find and fix numerical and software defects; expand regression and SBML Test Suite coverage; improve error reporting so failures are diagnosable. * Improve numerical robustness. Work on integrator and solver behavior (CVODE, KINSOL/NLEQ, Gillespie), event handling, stiff and near\-singular systems, conservation laws, and steady\-state convergence. * Add capabilities. Implement new analysis features such as sensitivities and improved steady\-state and continuation support, guided by user needs. * Modernize the build and release. Maintain CMake builds, LLVM upgrades, continuous integration across Linux, macOS, and Windows, and Python wheel distribution. * Use AI assistance well. Use tools such as Claude Code to accelerate development, test generation, and refactoring, while reviewing and verifying everything that ships. * Support the community. Triage GitHub issues, write documentation and examples, and coordinate with downstream projects including Tellurium and libAntimony. * Investigate alternative approaches to JIT compiling. The code currently uses LLVM, but alternative, more lightweight approaches have recently emerged. The Sauro Lab in the Department of Bioengineering at the University of Washington develops methods and open\-source software for modeling and simulating biochemical networks. This position is funded by a dedicated NIH grant for libRoadRunner development. libRoadRunner (https://github.com/sys\-bio/roadrunner) is an open\-source C\+\+ library with Python bindings that compiles SBML models to native code via LLVM and simulates them with deterministic, stochastic, and steady\-state solvers. It is the engine behind Tellurium and is used by modeling groups, tool developers, and educators worldwide. Applications will only be accepted via Interfolio: https://apply.interfolio.com/198163\. The position will remain open until filled. Applications should include the following materials: 1\. A cover letter of no more than 1 page detailing your interest in the position, relevant qualifications, and experiences 2\. A curriculum vitae 3\. Links to code you have written (GitHub or Similar) 4\. Contact information for at least 2 referees who are prepared to provide letters of recommendation upon request. Note: alternatively, letters of recommendation to be submitted at time of application\* Applicants should articulate how their past experiences and/or future plans in research, teaching, mentoring, patient care, and/or service promote a sense of belonging and foster a welcoming and inclusive environment. Questions about the position may be directed to Herbert Sauro, Professor of Bioengineering, at hsauro@uw.edu. #### **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** **Equal Opportunity** The University of Washington is committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful and welcoming community for all. As an equal opportunity employer, the University considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship, sex, pregnancy, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability, or veteran status consistent with UW Executive Order No. 81\. **Benefits Information** The University is committed to providing excellent benefits to our faculty. jobs.description: **Job no:** 495427 **Work type:** Faculty **Location:** UMBC Campus **Categories:** Computer Engineering **Application Instructions:** Apply via Interfolio at: https://apply.interfolio.com/196803 **Department:** College of Engineering and Information Technology **Anticipated Start Date:** Fall 2027 **About the Position:** **Overview** The University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC) invites applications for a tenure\-track Assistant Professor position in the broad area of Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Mechanical/Chemical/Biochemical/Environmental Engineering Systems. UMBC is a nationally recognized public research university distinguished by inclusive excellence, innovative teaching, a strong commitment to student success, and research that addresses complex societal challenges. The successful candidate will hold a primary appointment in either the Department of Mechanical Engineering (ME) or the Department of Chemical, Biochemical, and Environmental Engineering (CBEE), based on their research and teaching interests and the strategic needs of the departments, and will join the College during a period of strategic planning and growth. They will be expected to establish an externally funded research program, contribute to undergraduate and graduate education, and foster interdisciplinary collaborations that advance engineering research through AI. UMBC seeks candidates committed to interdisciplinary research, effective teaching, mentoring students from diverse backgrounds, and embracing equity and inclusion principles in their research, teaching and service contributions. **Qualifications and Details** ------------------------------ Candidates must hold a PhD in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, biochemical engineering, environmental engineering, or another closely related discipline by the appointment start date. This is a full\-time, nine\-month appointment anticipated to begin in Fall 2027\. The successful candidate’s primary department will be either ME or CBEE. Teaching responsibilities and workload will follow the norms of the home department. Salary Range: $120,000 to $140,000 commensurate with experience. The above salary range represents the University’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. or a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management or closely related degree from an appropriately accredited institution and one year of experience in IT project management or technical project management related work; as an expert in technical field. * Strong reading comprehension and critical thinking skills. * Ability to work constructively in a multidisciplinary team. * Ability to work independently in performing everyday tasks with minimal supervision. #### **Minimum Requirements** * B.S. degree in Petroleum Engineering or related engineering, science, or geoscience field. * Experience in using oil and gas industry simulation and other software packages to determine the long\-term performance of subsurface reservoirs and the fate of produced/injected fluids. * Experience with technical writing, recovery. * Prior experience in successfully launching, planning, and executing data science projects, preferably in the domains of oil and gas, petroleum geology, engineering, or energy. * Applicants relevant experience in the field. * Successful completion of a Criminal History Background Check In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the US and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. ***This position supports visa sponsorship for continued employment.*** #### **Preferred Qualifications** * Advanced degree in petroleum engineering or related engineering, science, or geoscience field. * Two years of experience working in the oil and gas industry or in a research position related to the oil and gas industry. * Experience in conducting reservoir engineering analysis, such as pressure transient analysis, material balance analysis, and decline curve analysis. * engineering data. * Coding proficiency (e.g., Python, R, Matlab). * Experience in designing field or laboratory experiments and/or interpreting results. * Experience in geothermal evaluation and simulation. * Experience in reservoir engineering research and development (R\&D) projects. #### **To Apply** To ensure full consideration, applications must be received by December 9, 2026\.

jobs.title: IT Quality Assurance Tester II

This role develops and performs systematic reviews and testing to ensure the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of datasets, reports, applications, workflows, and other project deliverables. The position works collaboratively with project teams and stakeholders to understand requirements, identify and document discrepancies, verify corrections, and support continuous improvement of quality assurance processes. * Develop and execute quality assurance and quality control plans to evaluate datasets, reports, applications, systems, and other project deliverables against established requirements. * Independently review and validate data, reports, and other outputs for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and adherence to specifications. * Perform systematic testing and QC reviews to identify errors, discrepancies, missing information, unexpected results, and potential issues with data or functionality. * Verify data processing, calculations, business rules, and reporting results against source information, documented requirements, and expected outcomes. * Conduct functional, integration, data validation, and user acceptance testing, as applicable, to ensure systems and deliverables function as intended. * Identify, document, track, and communicate QC findings and defects, including supporting evidence, recommended corrections, and verification of issue documentation, and training materials. * Serve as a QA/QC resource to project teams, providing guidance and support to promote consistent quality practices. * Identify opportunities to improve the
