jobs.title: Data Center & BESS - Reliability & Validation Engineer
jobs.description: Valeo is a tech global company, designing breakthrough solutions to reinvent the mobility. We are an automotive supplier partner to automakers and new mobility actors worldwide. Our vision? Invent a greener and more secured mobility, thanks to solutions focusing on intuitive driving and reducing CO2 emissions. We are leader on our businesses, and recognized as one of the largest global innovative companies. **Ready to tackle the thermal challenges of the future? For over a century, Valeo has been a global pioneer in thermal management, fluid dynamics, and automotive\-grade reliability. Now, we are bringing our world\-class manufacturing scale and thermal expertise to the rapidly expanding Data Center industry!** **What you will win:** As artificial intelligence and high\-performance computing push silicon power limits to unprecedented levels, Valeo is uniquely positioned to solve the industry’s most critical heat dissipation challenges. As part of our new Valeo North America Data Center \& Energy team, you will play a critical role in ensuring the robustness and safety of our product portfolio. Your high\-level scope will be to validate and ensure the long\-term reliability of cutting\-edge cooling and power conversion solutions across both rack\-level data center environments and macro\-level BESS deployments. Our company culture gives all our employees the opportunity every day to \#Dare.Care.Share. You will receive a best\-in\-class total compensation package that provides a comprehensive benefits program with real financial value. **About the Role:** As a Reliability \& Validation Engineer You Will: * **Test Bed Architecture \& Vendor Management:** Design, build, and maintain automated hardware validation test beds simulating extreme data center and BESS operating conditions, including environmental chambers, flow benches, and power load simulators. Partner closely with external equipment vendors to build, validate, and officially certify these specialized test benches prior to deployment. * **Global Standardization \& Collaboration:** Collaborate seamlessly with Valeo’s established global testing and validation teams to co\-develop, deploy, and standardize new testing procedures, methodologies, and cross\-regional validation activities. * **Comprehensive Validation Execution:** Develop and execute rigorous validation test plans covering burst pressure, thermal cycling, acoustic emission, long\-term fluid\-material compatibility (galvanic corrosion prevention), and accelerated life testing (ALT). * **Power Conversion \& BESS Testing:** Evaluate power conversion systems (PCS) and energy storage thermal management systems for efficiency, electrical safety, dielectric strength, and power cycling durability under varying load profiles. * **Failure Analysis \& Risk Mitigation:** Define failure modes and effects analysis (DFMEA) criteria for data center cooling and power conversion systems * **Data\-Driven Engineering Support:** Author detailed validation reports, analyze telemetry data from sensor arrays, and provide corrective mechanical and electrical recommendations to the core R\&D team to drive continuous product improvement. **What You Should Have:** * **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Reliability Engineering, or a related technical field. * **Experience:** 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in hardware reliability testing, validation, or quality engineering, preferably within data centers, BESS, power electronics, or EV thermal systems. * **Testing \& Lab Proficiency:** Strong background in building and programming test rigs using Data Acquisition Systems (DAQ) and automation software (e.g., LabVIEW, Python). * **Thermal \& Fluid Dynamics Knowledge:** Experience testing liquid cooling loops, cold plates, and manifolds, with an understanding of fluid compatibility, corrosion mechanisms, and leak\-testing standards. * **Electrical \& Power Familiarity:** Familiarity with high\-voltage testing protocols, power conversion electronics, and BESS safety standards. * **Quality Methodologies:** Deep expertise in root cause analysis (8D, 5 Whys), Highly Accelerated Life Testing / Highly Accelerated Stress Screening (HALT/HASS), and statistical reliability software/methods (e.g., Weibull analysis). **Join us!** Thanks to its strategy focused on innovation, Valeo aims at reducing CO² emissions and developing intuitive driving to propose greener, safer, and smarter mobility. The fantastic (r)evolution towards the vehicle of the future provides amazing career opportunities and challenging jobs! **Diversity by nature** At Valeo, innovation is driven by the diversity, authenticity and energy of its talent. Are you looking for new technological and human adventures? Join Valeo and its more than 100\.000 employees across the globe! More information about Valeo : https://www.valeo.com **Job:** Customer Applications **Organization:** BG Customer **Schedule:** Full time **Employee Status:** Regular **Job Type:** Permanent contract **Job Posting Date:** 2026\-11\-24 *Join Us !* *Being part of our team, you will join:* * *one of the largest global innovative companies, with more than 20,000 engineers working in Research \& Development* * *a multi\-cultural environment that values diversity and international collaboration* * *more than 100,000 colleagues in 31 countries... which make a lot of opportunity for career growth* * *a business highly committed to limiting the environmental impact if its activities and ranked by Corporate Knights as the number one company in the automotive sector in terms of sustainable development* *More information on Valeo:* *https://www.valeo.com*

jobs.title: Research Computing and AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** The Research Computing and AI Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the strategy, administration, security, reliability, and lifecycle management of the College of Connected Computing’s shared high\-performance computing, GPU, cloud, software, and artificial intelligence resources. Reporting to the Senior Advisor to the Dean, this hands\-on technical staff position ensures that faculty and research groups have reliable, appropriately governed access to computing resources, and establishes the processes the college depends on for resource allocation, software maintenance, utilization tracking, reliability monitoring, capacity planning, availability management, incident mitigation, and cost reporting. Because the college is new, this is a build role. It establishes the technical roadmap, operating standards, and service model for a research\-computing environment that is being stood up alongside the college’s academic and research programs, and operates that environment day to day as it scales. The position works in close partnership with Vanderbilt University Information Technology (VUIT) to manage infrastructure, coordinate software and security updates, monitor service reliability, mitigate operational risks, and respond to incidents. The engineer also collaborates with CCC faculty, the CCC Research Team, the College’s generative AI engineer, the Vanderbilt Office of Cybersecurity, Procurement, and external vendors. **About the Work Unit:** The College of Connected Computing (CCC) is Vanderbilt University’s first new college in more than four decades, dedicated to computer science, artificial intelligence, data science, cybersecurity, robotics, cyber\-physical systems, and computational approaches to policy, law, the humanities, and the social sciences. Built on a “computing for all” philosophy, the college is designed to foster radical collaboration at the intersection of computing and every other discipline across the university. The college’s research enterprise depends on shared high\-performance computing, GPU, cloud, and AI resources that are being acquired and deployed as the college grows. This position anchors the technical and operational function responsible for those resources within the Office of the Senior Advisor to the Dean, working in partnership with VUIT and university offices. **Key Functions and Expected Performance:** **Research Computing and Infrastructure Management** * Establishes the technical roadmap, architecture, operating standards, and service model for CCC high\-performance computing, GPU, storage, cloud, and related research\-computing platforms. * Provides day\-to\-day technical and operational management of CCC\-managed infrastructure and supporting services. * Administers cluster operating systems, schedulers, storage, networks, software environments, container platforms, monitoring systems, backup services, and management tools. * Defines service ownership, operating procedures, escalation paths, maintenance responsibilities, and performance expectations. * Coordinates technical work across CCC staff, VUIT teams, student employees, contractors, vendors, and university partners. * Maintains accurate inventories and configuration records for physical, virtual, cloud, software, subscription, and API resources. * Plans capacity, upgrades, scaling, maintenance windows, and equipment retirement while minimizing disruption to active research. **Software Maintenance and Update Management** * Plans, evaluates, tests, schedules, and deploys software updates in partnership with VUIT and other relevant university teams. * Maintains operating systems, firmware, GPU drivers, accelerator toolkits, cluster schedulers, container runtimes, scientific software, libraries, monitoring agents, and system\-management tools. * Establishes recurring patch and upgrade schedules based on security requirements, vendor support timelines, research dependencies, and operational risk. * Tests updates for compatibility, performance, security, and impact on research workloads before production deployment. * Maintains rollback procedures and recovery plans for significant software, configuration, firmware, and platform changes. * Coordinates change management, maintenance communications, approvals, and implementation activities with VUIT. * Documents software versions, dependencies, configuration changes, known issues, and upgrade decisions. * Tracks vendor security advisories, end\-of\-support dates, and software lifecycle requirements and implements corrective actions. **Reliability Monitoring and Risk Mitigation** * Implements monitoring and alerting for system availability, performance, capacity, job scheduling, GPU and CPU utilization, storage, networks, cloud services, AI APIs, and supporting software. * Establishes reliability indicators, service targets, alert thresholds, and escalation procedures in partnership with VUIT. * Produces dashboards and recurring reports cov  auditable tracking of CPU and GPU consumption, jobs, storage, cloud services, AI APIs, availability, and cost. * Produces reports that support capacity planning, resource allocation, budgeting, and cost recovery. * Performs other duties as assigned. **Supervisory Relationships:** This position does not have direct staff supervisory responsibility, and reports directly to the Senior Advisor to the Dean. The engineer provides functional and technical direction to student employees, contractors, and vendor resources engaged in research\-computing work. **Qualifications:** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in computer science, computer engineering, information systems, or a related technical field. * Minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience administering high\-performance computing, research computing, GPU, or comparable large\-scale Linux\-based infrastructure. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience with cluster operating systems, job schedulers (e.g., Slurm), storage systems, networking, and container platforms. * Demonstrated experience planning and deploying software, firmware, and security updates in a production environment, including testing, change management, and rollback. * Experience implementing monitoring, alerting, and incident response for production systems, including root\-cause analysis and corrective action. * Demonstrated ability to establish new services, processes, and documentation, and to carry technical projects from concept through implementation. * Ability to coordinate work across central IT organizations, security offices, vendors, and research stakeholders. * Excellent communication, project management, organizational, and relationship\-building skills. *Note: Consistent with university practice, an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will be considered in place of the stated degree requirement.* **Preferred** * Master’s degree in a relevant technical field. * Research computing or HPC experience in a higher\-education or research\-institution setting. * Experience with GPU and AI infrastructure, including NVIDIA data\-center platforms, accelerator toolkits, and AI/ML research workloads. * Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation. * Experience with utilization, chargeback, or cost\-reporting models for shared research resources. * Familiarity with security frameworks and requirements applicable to research computing environments. **Key Attributes for Success:** * **Builder.** Prefers a blank page to a maintained process, and brings structure and a service model to infrastructure that does not yet exist. * **Reliability\-minded.** Treats availability, monitoring, and recovery as first\-order design requirements, not afterthoughts. * **Security\-conscious.** Keeps patching, least\-privilege access, and vendor advisories current without disrupting active research. * **Partner.** Works easily with VUIT, Cybersecurity, Procurement, and vendors, and moves shared work forward without formal authority. * **Service\-oriented.** Designs from the researcher’s experience of the systems, and communicates clearly in outages and maintenance windows. * **Steady amid growth.** Holds standards and follows through while equipment, staffing, and priorities are still moving. **Working Conditions:** * Standard office and data\-center environment. Occasional evening and weekend work is required for maintenance windows and incident response; participation in an on\-call rotation may be required. Limited travel may be required. *Job responsibilities listed herein are intended to be a thorough representation of the duties, responsibilities, expectations, and qualifications for this specific role at the time of hire but should not be considered all\-encompassing as actual responsibilities may evolve to include additional duties as assigned based on organizational and operational needs.*

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **Full Stack Developer \- Needed for Reliable, Well\-Crafted Software Development** **Work Type:** **Full\-time, hybrid****Compensation:****$85,000 \- $135,000 base salary plus incentive bonuses, commensurate with experience****Benefits:** **Medical, Vision, Dental, Telemedicine, IRA w/Matching, Corporate Chaplain, Counseling Services, 8 paid holidays, 3 weeks PTO****Location:** **Dallas, TX** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ **Who are we looking for?** The Full Stack Developer we are looking for is an individual dedicated to the perfection of their craft, someone who is consistent and reliable and takes a systematic approach to every schema, migration, and screen they build. If you are the type who knows there is a right way to build software (tested, documented, and built to hold up under real\-world load) and will hunt down the facts before writing a line of code, then you are going to love this role. You take pride in work that is done right the first time, you would rather deliver one feature that never breaks than five that need a hotfix, and you are searching for an organization that will invest in you and give you a well\-defined platform to put your expertise to work. **Interested? Here is what you will be doing:** As a Full Stack Developer, you will help build software that will change the way IT is delivered. You will work alongside our product lead, with clear priorities and a consistent design system to build from. The software you build will be put to work every day, so you will see firsthand the difference that well\-crafted, reliable work makes. Here are some specifics: * Building, maintaining, and optimizing web applications in React and TypeScript, from the Postgres schema to the screen users click through * Designing schemas, writing migrations, and integrating front ends with our databases, APIs, and third\-party systems * Delivering changes that hold up in production, with 10% or fewer of deployments requiring a hotfix or rollback * Getting code right the first time, keeping rework (code rewritten, deleted, or modified within 2 to 3 weeks of commit) under 10% * Contributing to a team average support response time of under 100 minutes on support tickets * Working with stakeholders to understand what users need, then turning that into wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity mockups * Running research and feedback sessions with users, and using what you learn to improve how our systems look and work * Creating and maintaining a design system and style guide so every app looks and behaves the same way * Simplifying navigation and multi\-step processes so the tools feel fast and intuitive * Testing and debugging so features work across devices and browsers, and hold up under real\-world load * Documenting design decisions, workflows, and technical processes so other teams can pick up the work **A little about Velo...** Velo is one of the fastest growing Cybersecurity \& IT service providers in the United States. As an INC 5000, SMU Hot 100, and MSP 501 company, opportunities at Velo abound. Headquartered in Downtown Dallas, with additional offices in Houston, TX, and Lafayette, LA, you will enjoy being a part of this award\-winning team. Velo offers industry\-leading compensation packages for industry\-leading talent. We serve entrepreneurially led companies as their outsourced IT and cybersecurity department. Our rapid growth allows us to consistently bring on new clients and team members, creating a very active and dynamic work environment. Velo understands the nature of our culture, and the servant\-leadership mindset toward every member of Team Velo is our competitive advantage. Our vision is to empower and develop the potential of entrepreneurial teams by serving 100,000 people daily. With this, our leadership team is here to be uniquely human in an increasingly disconnected world; to serve you and your family so you can effectively serve our clients and your peers. **Position Overview:** * **Highlights:** Perfection of Craft, Systematic Approach to Work, Consistent and Reliable, Fact\-Driven Problem Solver, Detail Oriented Execution * **Job Type:** Software Development * **Work Hours:** Full\-time, hybrid * **Annual Compensation:** $85,000 \- $135,000 base salary plus incentive bonuses, commensurate with experience * **Benefits:** Medical, Vision, Dental, Telemedicine, IRA w/Matching, Corporate Chaplain, Counseling Services, 8 paid holidays, 3 weeks PTO * **Location:** Dallas, TX **Required Experience:** * Deep PostgreSQL experience required, including schema design, query optimization, and migrations on live systems with real data * Strong backend skills required in Go, Node.js, Python, Java, or a similar language * Solid front\-end skills required in React or a comparable framework, plus HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript * Sound judgment about correctness required: idempotency, safe retries, failure handling, and the failure modes that only show up under load * A practical eye for UI/UX required, with a portfolio or examples of interfaces you have designed and built * Clear written communication and comfort working with non\-technical stakeholders required **Nice to Have:** * Supabase, row\-level security or other multi\-tenant data models * Experience with MSP, PSA or ITSM tools such as ConnectWise * Integrations with ERP or finance systems like NetSuite If this opportunity is for you – please **Apply Now**!

jobs.title: Software Engineer III, Pre Platform Agents
jobs.description: **About Verily Health Inc.** ============================ At the intersection of technology, data science, and healthcare, Verily Health transforms complex health data into trusted intelligence, enabling health solutions that are more personal, predictive, and precise. Verily’s flagship Governed Health Intelligence platform, Verily Pre, enables healthcare organizations to responsibly govern, model, and securely activate their protected health data at scale, deploying intelligence with the scientific rigor, oversight, and auditability needed for healthcare. **Description** =============== As a Software Engineer at Verily, you will play a pivotal role in developing and enhancing products that are focused on the promise of precision health. Verily Pre is a comprehensive, patient\-centered platform that accelerates evidence generation for safer, more effective treatments and care decisions. Our cloud\-first architecture, advanced analytics, and AI capabilities enable the collection, enrichment, and activation of petabytes of data, tailored to meet the unique needs of our partners. Pre’s Workbench solution provides a secure collaborative environment for data generators, research, and biopharma organizations to govern and analyze their data. Our software powers our customers in genomics research workflows, containerized AI development, and more. The Platform Agents team is focused on delivering end\-to\-end agentic experiences to our Pre platform and Workbench solution users to empower and enable them to move quickly and safely in their healthcare and research work. Platform Agents drives an end to end experience, from the UI to harness to tools and model serving, alongside our other platform and AI squads. **Responsibilities** ==================== * Work closely with the development team to design, develop, and deliver new full\-stack agentic features across Verily Workbench and Pre Platform solutions. * Collaborate cross\-functionally to identify dependencies, coordinate delivery, communicate design decisions and define requirements. * Come up with ideas to technical design problems, compare options, and propose solutions. * Develop using industry\-standard tools including Google Cloud, Langgraph, Go, React, Terraform, and Kubernetes. **Qualifications** ================== Minimum Qualifications * BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience in software development. * 5\+ years of experience as a software developer in an industry setting. * 2\+ years experience building ML or LLM\-powered software. * Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages including but not limited to: Java, C/C\+\+, C\#, Go, or Python. Preferred Qualifications * Demonstrated experience in LLMOps and designing and implementing cloud software built on AI frameworks like Pytorch, Langgraph/Langchain, Google ADK, etc. * Experience building governance, observability, or auditability features into agentic systems. * Education or exposure to healthcare or life sciences, with emphasis on HL7 FHIR or OMOP. * Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively. *Qualified applicants must not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States.* **Compensation Information** The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $156,000 \-$176,000 \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. *Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.* Verily Health Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. For our EEO Policy Statement, please click here. If you'd like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** As a Principal Software Developer at Veson Nautical, you will solve complex, real\-world problems and shape the future of the maritime shipping industry. You will work on the Veson Platform: the TypeScript services, APIs and agentic workflows (CoCaptain) that sit alongside IMOS. This is a hands\-on principal developer role. You will design, code, test, ship and support production software, take end\-to\-end ownership of the design and delivery of major components, influence the structure and direction of the codebase, and lead the way we build with AI coding agents. We expect you to be flexible: the work moves across backend, frontend, data, infrastructure and AI engineering. **Responsibilities** * Own the full software development life cycle for the services you build and the ones you inherit: design, code, tests, review, deployment, observability, maintenance and production support. * Design, build and maintain backend services and APIs in TypeScript (NestJS, GraphQL, MongoDB) and front\-end modules in React/Next.js. Most of our code is TypeScript, but the team also owns C\#, C\+\+ and Go services, and you will maintain and extend those when the work calls for it. * Design and build the core business logic our products depend on: lasting, well\-tested solutions where correctness is proven, with clear boundaries between deterministic code and LLM reasoning. * Build AI\-native product features: LLM orchestration, MCP tool contracts, agent skills and workflows for CoCaptain, with the evals, guardrails and observability needed to run them in production. * Work with AI coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent) as a core part of how you deliver, and raise the bar for the team: author and maintain shared skills, rules, CLIs and harnesses, and improve the review and delivery process so quality keeps up with AI\-assisted throughput. * Write RFCs and design docs for cross\-cutting changes (data models, permissions and security, tenancy, integration patterns), and drive them to a decision with Product, Architecture and partner teams. * Break large projects into shovel\-ready pieces for the team, work with Product and Engineering leadership to drive team decisions and contribute to the roadmap and be comfortable turning an un\-roadmapped idea into a scoped, measurable deliverable as priorities shift. * Mentor and level up teammates through design reviews, code reviews and pairing, and help the Connect, Apps and QA Automation teams share tools and conventions. * Promote teamwork and support a vibrant and innovative work atmosphere. **Qualifications** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including several years as a senior or lead engineer on production systems. * Expert in TypeScript and Node.js, with deep experience designing and operating backend services and APIs (NestJS or similar, GraphQL, REST). * Experience building front\-end modules with React. * Experience with MongoDB or other document databases, and with relational databases (SQL Server, Postgres). * Demonstrated, current fluency with AI coding agents: you can show skills, rules, CLIs, agents or harnesses you have built, and explain how you verify what an agent produces. * Experience shipping LLM\-backed features to production: tool/function calling, MCP, prompt and context design, evaluation, cost and latency management. * Strong testing discipline: unit and integration tests (vitest/jest), end\-to\-end tests (Playwright), fixture\- or property\-based testing of calculation logic. * Comfortable in a polyglot codebase: able to read, debug and change C\#, C\+\+ or Go services when a fix lands outside TypeScript. Expertise in all three is not expected. * Experience with containers and Kubernetes, AWS, and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI preferred). * Experience with observability and production support: error tracking and log analytics (Sentry, Splunk), dashboards, alerting and on\-call, ideally with observability defined as code. * Comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities; able to work in an Agile, entrepreneurial environment and communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills: you can write an RFC that gets a decision, and a review comment that gets acted on. **Nice to Have** * Experience in financial industry or maritime shipping industry * Experience building calculation engines or financial/quantitative libraries where correctness is proven against a reference system. * Deep experience with C\#/.NET and SQL Server (our IMOS core), C\+\+, Go or Python. + Experience with workflow or durable\-execution engines (Inngest, Temporal, Agenda) and event\-driven architectures. * Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS, authorization and permission models, and SOC 2 practices. * Experience with GCP in addition to AWS. * Experience creating and contributing to architecture design and documentation. **About Veson Nautical** We are a team of multi\-cultural, multi\-disciplined professionals that are dedicated to making our clients successful and charting a new, innovative course for the commercial marine industry. Veson Nautical employs a staff of extremely capable creators and innovators all focused on meeting the goals of our clients. We invest extensively in employee development and experience to maintain focus and enthusiasm. The Veson Nautical team is made up of a dynamic blend of engineers, artists, sailors, teachers, brokers, bankers, traders, consultants, and customer service experts. Veson Nautical is a successful, rapidly growing global software company. Our clients are the world’s leading commercial maritime owners, operators and commodity trading companies. Veson’s solutions enable our clients to identify new opportunities and proactively manage their business to make more profitable decisions. With offices in Singapore, Tokyo, London, Houston and headquarters in Boston, USA, Veson Nautical is a dynamic organization with a committed team of professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the highest levels of client satisfaction, Veson Nautical brings decades of experience, technical knowledge, enthusiasm and commitment to clients around the world. The combination of exceptional market growth and leading market position make this a superb opportunity for the right candidate. **\#LI\-Remote** We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City\-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2\.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States. Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace\-delivered retirement plans, employer\-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities. Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third\-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com **Who Are We Looking For?** Vestwell is a fintech company that powers workplace retirement plans, state\-sponsored savings programs, and 529 education and ABLE savings accounts. Our platform is a set of distributed, event\-driven services that handle contributions, investments, and withdrawals, and that integrate with banking, recordkeeping, and payment partners. Because it moves real people's money, correctness, security, and auditability are part of the job. We build with AI agents as a core part of our workflow. Our engineers direct agents to plan, write, test, and refactor code, and they stay accountable for every decision and every line that ships. As a Staff Software Engineer, your impact goes beyond what you deliver yourself. You lead technical outcomes across systems and teams: setting technical direction, refining requirements, breaking down projects, and aligning teams on how to solve hard problems. You are the expert on our products and business logic, and you stay hands\-on every day across a full\-stack .NET and TypeScript codebase with Angular and React frontends. **What Will You Be Doing?** * Lead technical outcomes across systems and teams. Set technical direction, drive architecture decisions, and document the tradeoffs in cost, risk, reversibility, and compliance so others can understand and challenge them. * Be the expert on our products, applications, and business logic, and bring that knowledge to every design and requirements discussion. * Partner with product to refine requirements. Push back when needed, ask why before how, and surface hidden assumptions so we solve the right problem. * Break large projects into well\-scoped, verifiable pieces of work that engineers and agents can deliver, and align with other teams on dependencies and sequencing. * Take on the hardest problems yourself: risky migrations, cross\-system changes, production incidents, and work where the requirements aren't clear yet. * Evaluate the conclusions and decisions AI agents make, and set the standard for how the team does it. Provide oversight to ensure correctness, and steer agents toward good, complete outcomes. * Own and evolve our in\-house AI skills and agent workflows. Write new skills, refine existing ones, and drive adoption so every engineer gets reliable results from agents. * Set and evolve technical standards and practices, including testing, CI/CD, and observability, and help teams apply them consistently. Validate work in code review by running the change, not just reading it. * Mentor engineers on judgment as well as syntax: how to question an agent, how to check its work, and when to slow down. **Requirements** The Necessities * 10\+ years building and operating production software. * Deep expertise in **.NET (C\#)** and **TypeScript**. * Production experience with both **Angular** and **React**. * Experience architecting full\-stack systems: service boundaries and data ownership, event\-driven flows between services, frontend architecture, and large migrations across both the backend and the frontend. * A track record of technical leadership beyond your own code: setting direction, breaking down large projects, and aligning multiple teams. * Strong SQL and relational data modeling (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or similar). * Experience with **AWS** and distributed systems: message queues, event\-driven architecture, and long\-running workflows or sagas. * Strong unit testing skills, and a habit of treating testing and CI/CD as part of the work, not an afterthought. * Hands\-on, daily experience with agentic coding tools (for example Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot agents), including writing reusable instructions, prompts, or skills that make agents more reliable on a codebase. * A track record of critical thinking you can point to: a requirement you challenged that changed the outcome, a flawed design you caught before it shipped, a confidently wrong AI answer you proved wrong. The Extras * Backend TypeScript experience (Node.js). * Experience in fintech, retirement, or other regulated domains (SOC 2, financial data handling) This role will be based in our New York City, Austin, King of Prussia, or Scottsdale office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in\-office operation. For exceptional candidates, we're open to hiring this role fully remote. The expected base salary range for this position is $185K \- $200K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired. **Full\-Time Employee Benefits** We're an innovative, high\-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan. **Interview Process** Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1\-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience\-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in\-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises. For your awareness you will only receive correspondence from recruiting@vestwell.com any other domain not ending in vestwell.com is not our Recruitment team. *Vestwell's* *Privacy Policy.* *Attention California residents: In the course of conducting our business and complying with federal, state, and local government regulations governing such matters as employment, tax, insurance, etc., we must collect Personal Information from you. Should you accept employment with Vestwell you may view our California Privacy Rights Act here:* *Vestwell's California Privacy Rights Policy.*

jobs.title: SR EBS DEVELOPER – Code and Triggers
jobs.description: About us: At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space. We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action. What you'll do: In general, the team will perform an assessment and stabilization\-planning engagement for Viasat’s Oracle EBS environment, e.g., analyze, monitor, and recommend, but will not implement production fixes or changes. They will work directly with the project team, consisting of the EBS business analyst, EBS applications management, and Global IT project manager to establish what processes the environment runs and uses, identify technical risks, profile the systems health, baseline its current operating performance, designing monitoring and operational controls, and ultimately identify what needs to be fixed to develop a stabilization strategy. The day\-to\-day: * Review custom EBS code for risky patterns such as hard\-coding, unhandled exceptions, commits in triggers, direct DML against Oracle\-seeded tables, dynamic SQL, and UTL\_FILE paths. * Analyze database triggers, particularly triggers on Oracle\-seeded tables, and support detailed manual reviews of the highest\-risk code. * Analyze CUSTOM.pll and other invasive customizations to understand their behavior and operational risk. * Identify modified Oracle\-seeded objects, including forms, reports, packages, and workflows that retain Oracle names and therefore may not appear in a prefix\-based CEMLI scan. * Analyze production usage evidence to distinguish actively used custom objects from potentially obsolete ones. * Document code\-quality findings and technical risks so they can feed CEMLI scoring, disposition decisions, and the high\-risk technical items register. * Develop read\-only health\-check scripts supporting monitoring of production risks without modifying EBS. * Contribute to Tier 1 runbooks and the known\-error database for critical objects and recurring issues. What you'll need: * Oracle E\-Business Suite 12\.1\.3 technical development experience, with the ability to analyze custom and modified EBS objects. The environment covered by the SOW is Oracle EBS 12\.1\.3 on Oracle Database 12\.1\.0\.2\. * Strong Oracle PL/SQL and database\-trigger expertise, particularly the ability to review triggers placed on Oracle\-seeded tables and understand how they interact with standard EBS transactions. The SOW specifically requires individual/manual review of every database trigger on a seeded table. * EBS custom\-code review and troubleshooting experience, including identifying risky coding patterns such as: + hard\-coded logic + unhandled exceptions + commits inside triggers + direct DML against seeded tables + dynamic SQL + hard\-coded UTL\_FILE paths + These are specifically called out for automated code scanning. * Experience identifying modified Oracle\-seeded objects, including forms, reports, packages and workflows that retain their standard Oracle names and therefore may not be found by normal prefix\-based CEMLI scans. * Ability to perform detailed manual code reviews, especially of high\-risk objects, seeded\-table triggers and CUSTOM.pll, and document a risk rating for each object. * CEMLI usage and dependency analysis, including determining whether custom objects are actually used in production and supporting code scanning, usage evidence, and manual review activities. * Technical risk analysis of triggers, particularly triggers embedded in standard Oracle transaction paths. The SOW already identifies approximately 20 custom triggers on Oracle\-seeded tables as a high\-risk area because failures can surface as Oracle errors in receiving, shipping, pricing, payroll and invoicing. * Monitoring/runbook development experience. The Senior Developers are expected to support health\-check scripts, runbooks and known\-error documentation in addition to code analysis. What will help you on the job: The candidate who can reverse\-engineer unfamiliar EBS customizations, deeply assess trigger and seeded\-object risk, trace dependencies and real production usage, and convert findings into actionable remediation options without touching the environment would stand out. Salary range: $90,500\.00 \- $143,000\.00 / annually. For specific work locations within San Jose, the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, the base pay range for this role is $112,500\.00\- $168,500\.00/ annually : At Viasat, we consider many factors when it comes to compensation, including the scope of the position as well as your background and experience. Base pay may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. jobs.title: Salesforce Architect
jobs.description: **Position Title: Salesforce Solution Architect** **Department: Vibrant Technology** **Reports to: CRM Director** **Location: Remote** **Schedule: M\-F, 35 hours (Full\-Time)** **Travel: \>5%** **Salary: $80,000 \- $131,000** Formerly the Mental Health Association of New York City (MHA\-NYC), Vibrant Emotional Health’s groundbreaking solutions have delivered high\-quality services and support, when, where, and how people need it for over 50 years. Through our state\-of\-the\-art technology\-enabled services, community wellness programs, and advocacy and education work, we are building a society in which emotional wellness can be a reality for everyone. **Position Overview:** Vibrant is seeking an experienced Salesforce Solution Architect to provide solution architecture leadership across Vibrant’s Salesforce CRM platforms. Reporting directly to the CRM Director, this role translates business and product needs into secure, scalable, maintainable Salesforce solutions while protecting long\-term platform health. The Solution Architect works closely with CRM engineers, CRM administrators, Product, Delivery, Data, Security, DevSecOps, QA, vendors, and systems integrators to guide solution design, identify dependencies and downstream impacts, and establish reusable architecture patterns and standards. This is a senior individual\-contributor role and does not replace hands\-on engineering leadership. The Solution Architect owns solution architecture and major technical design decisions, while CRM engineering leads remain accountable for engineering execution, code quality, mentoring, and implementation. Consistent with an agile delivery model, the architect enables teams to make sound decisions quickly and focuses formal review on changes with meaningful architectural, security, integration, data, or cross\-platform impact. **Duties/Responsibilities:** * Lead Salesforce solution architecture across CRM platforms, including application, data, integration, security, automation, and platform design. * Translate prioritized business requirements and product outcomes into scalable technical solution options, documenting tradeoffs, constraints, assumptions, risks, and recommendations. * Partner with CRM engineers during technical discovery and solutioning so engineering input is incorporated before work is committed to a sprint. * Review proposed Salesforce solutions for scalability, maintainability, reuse, performance, security, data integrity, integration impact, and alignment with platform standards. * Define and maintain reusable Salesforce architecture patterns, design standards, technical guardrails, and reference approaches. * Perform impact and dependency analysis across Salesforce objects, fields, automation, Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations, APIs, reporting, security, identity, and downstream systems. * Architect integration solutions between Salesforce and SaaS, custom, cloud, or on\-premises applications using REST APIs, event\-driven patterns, middleware, custom connectors, and web services. * Partner with Data, Security, Identity, DevSecOps, and other enterprise technology teams when solutions cross CRM boundaries or require specialized review. * Provide architectural direction for new Salesforce capabilities, major platform changes, modernization initiatives, technical debt remediation, and new tools or vendor solutions affecting the CRM ecosystem. * Evaluate when declarative configuration, custom development, integration, or another platform capability is the most appropriate solution; avoid unnecessary customization and duplication. * Support architectural review of major data\-model changes, security\-sensitive designs, cross\-platform integrations, enterprise shared components, and difficult\-to\-reverse technical decisions. * Manage and collaborate with product vendors and systems integrators; review proposed designs and ensure external solutions align with Vibrant’s Salesforce architecture and engineering standards. * Partner with CRM engineering leadership on DevSecOps, source control, CI/CD, testing, deployment, code\-quality, and platform\-reliability standards where architectural direction is required. * Support root cause analysis for significant platform incidents and identify architectural or design changes needed to prevent recurrence. * Maintain state\-of\-the\-art awareness of Salesforce capabilities, releases, architecture guidance, security features, integration patterns, and emerging platform technologies. * Identify opportunities to simplify the Salesforce landscape, retire redundant customization, increase reuse, reduce technical debt, and improve platform sustainability. * Create and maintain solution architecture documentation, architecture decision records, integration diagrams, data\-flow diagrams, design patterns, and technical artifacts for the CRM knowledge base. * Contribute lessons learned and approved architectural patterns to the Salesforce Center of Excellence ides technical direction and architectural guidance to CRM engineers, administrators, vendors, and systems integrators without serving as their day\-to\-day people manager. * Facilitates architecture and design discussions, establishes decision boundaries, and helps teams reach technically sound decisions efficiently. * Mentors engineers and technical leads in solution design, architecture patterns, impact analysis, and technical decision\-making. * Coordinates specialized technical input from Security, Data, DevSecOps, Identity, and other teams when required by the solution. * Manages architecture work and priorities with minimal supervision and balances planned architecture activities with time\-sensitive delivery needs. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree and at least 8 years of experience in Salesforce/CRM engineering, solution architecture, software engineering, or a similar role; additional relevant experience may be substituted in lieu of a degree. * At least 3 years of demonstrated experience designing complex Salesforce solutions or serving in a Salesforce technical/solution architecture capacity. * Experience supporting large\-scale Salesforce implementations, integrations, upgrades, and production environments. * Hands\-on Salesforce implementation, development, administration, maintenance, and optimization experience. * Demonstrated experience with Salesforce integration architecture, security, data modeling, automation, and custom development. * Salesforce Platform Developer I certification required. * Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, Integration Architect, Data Architect, Sharing and Visibility Architect, or comparable advanced Salesforce architecture certification strongly preferred. We determine base pay through a comprehensive review of skills, experience, education, certifications, geographic location, and other relevant factors. The range listed reflects the compensation parameters for the role and does not represent the full compensation package. A complete overview of compensation and benefits will be provided by the Talent Acquisition team during the hiring process. Full time employees will be eligible for excellent comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, supplemental income insurance, employer paid disability insurance, employer paid life insurance, pre\-tax FSA for medical and dependent care, and 401K available. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they are able to perform every task in the job description. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and that candidate may be one who comes from a less traditional background. Vibrant will consider any equivalent combination of knowledge, skills, education and experience to meet minimum qualifications. If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to think broadly about your background and skill set for the role. Vibrant Emotional Health is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants are considered for positions without regard to veteran status, uniformed service member status, race, creed, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, citizenship status, national origin, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, caregiver status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Please be aware that fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers may be circulated on the Internet in an attempt to obtain privileged information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Vibrant does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page and all communications from the Vibrant recruiting team and/or hiring managers will be from an @vibrant.org email address.

jobs.title: Executive Administrative Assistant - Legal
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Executive Administrative Assistant – Legal Department** ========================================================= Easton, PA – Corporate Headquarters Full\-Time Immigration sponsorship: Not available for this position **About Victaulic** ------------------- Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50\+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real\-world challenges across a wide range of industries. Today, our high\-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world’s most critical and prestigious structures. **An Industry Leader With a Heart as Big as Its Ambition and Innovation** ------------------------------------------------------------------------- At Victaulic, we’re committed to constructing a better world for and with our people. **Let’s Build a Better World Together.** Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars: * We build from within. * We stand behind our people. * We foster an environment for constant learning. * We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world. **Your Impact Starts Here** --------------------------- We’re looking for an Executive Administrative Assistant to join our Legal Department at our Corporate Headquarters in Easton, PA. In this role, you’ll be the operational backbone of the Legal Department, keeping its people, matters, records, and systems running smoothly. You’ll report to the Chief Legal \& Administrative Officer and work closely with in\-house attorneys, outside counsel, Accounts Payable, and the Business Development Group to keep legal work organized, compliant, and moving forward. This is an opportunity to take ownership of key legal systems and processes, gain broad exposure to litigation, contracts, real estate, and records management, and make a visible impact across the company. **What You’ll Build \& Own** ---------------------------- * Provide executive\-level administrative support to all members of the Legal Department, including scheduling meetings, coordinating visitors, handling mail and phones, arranging travel (including passports and visas) and conference calls, processing expense reports, and ordering supplies * Support litigation at the direction of Legal Department staff and outside counsel by managing calendaring, litigation holds, document collection, document summaries, and discovery * Serve as the company System Administrator for Legal Tracker, managing matters and invoices, reviewing legal invoices for compliance with the Legal Department Policy for Outside Counsel, ensuring proper coding, running the approval process, supporting outside vendors on the system, and partnering with Accounts Payable to ensure timely payment * Generate reports from Legal Tracker and other sources as directed * Prepare, edit, and deliver correspondence, documents, and contracts for all members of the Legal Department, and maintain archive copies as directed * Prepare outside counsel engagement documents and maintain archived copies * Manage and maintain the contract form repository using disciplined version control protocols * Maintain and organize files, and search for and collect information to respond to requests for assistance, such as contract requests * Coordinate records and document retention, including scheduling purges and litigation holds, and act as the ARC (Assistant Records Custodian) for the Legal Department * Maintain the Real Estate portfolio and respond to requests for information * Assist in preparing presentations and course materials for legal training sessions * Coordinate logistics for new hires and interns, including computer equipment and workspaces * Manage and replenish the Legal Department’s office supply inventory as needed or requested * Provide reports and project support to the Business Development Group as needed * Perform other duties as assigned by members of the Legal Department **What You Bring** ------------------ * 7–10 years of office experience in an upper\-level management environment * Knowledge of legal terminology and legal matters * Comprehensive knowledge of Microsoft Office software, database, document management, e\-billing, and other systems as deployed * Energetic, reliable, competent, personable, well\-spoken, and assertive, with the ability to work with people at all levels * Ability to prioritize and work independently with little supervision * Willingness to attend continuing education in professional or legal training seminars and classes, as directed **What Sets You Apart** ----------------------- * Experience administering a legal matter and e\-billing system such as Legal Tracker * Hands\-on litigation support experience, including discovery, litigation holds, and calendaring * Experience with records retention programs and contract repository management * Paralegal or legal administrative certification **What We Offer** ----------------- ### **Build A Better Career** * Competitive compensation with performance\-based incentives * Career development programs and internal promotion pathways—we build from within * Tuition reimbursement and continuous learning opportunities ### **Build A Better Future** * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Retirement savings plans with company match * Life insurance and disability coverage ### **Build A Better You** * Paid time off, holidays, and flexible work arrangements where applicable * Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and wellness resources * Inclusive, team\-oriented culture where people look out for one another ### **Build A Better World** Join a company whose products contribute to a safer, more sustainable built environment every day. **Immigration Sponsorship** --------------------------- Victaulic does not provide immigration sponsorship (e.g., H\-1B, TN, or other work visa sponsorship) for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the applicable country on a full\-time basis without the need for employer\-sponsored immigration support now or in the future. **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- Victaulic is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EOE/M/F/Vets/Disabled) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, gender, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic data, or other legally protected status. (Background checks may be required as part of our pre\-employment process). **Victaulic Staffing Partner Communication Policy** --------------------------------------------------- All staffing agencies are strictly forbidden from directly contacting any Victaulic employees, except those within the Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. All communications, inquiries and candidate submissions must be routed through Victaulic’s Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. Non\-compliance with this policy may result in the suspension of partnership, cancellation of the current contract, and/or the imposition of a mandatory probation period before any future business can resume. Additionally, non\-compliance may lead to a permanent ban on future business. This policy ensures a streamlined and compliant recruitment process. **Let’s Build a Better World Together.** victaulic.com/careers \#TOP123 \#LI\-JH1 \#LI\-ONSITE

jobs.title: Associate Data Engineer, AI Studio
jobs.description: **About Us** Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. **Job Description** **Company Description** As the world's leader in digital payments technology, Visa's mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable, and secure payments network, enabling individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive. Our advanced global processing network, VisaNet, provides secure and reliable payments around the world, and is capable of handling more than 65,000 transaction messages a second. The company's dedication to innovation drives the rapid growth of connected commerce on any device and fuels the dream of a cashless future for everyone, everywhere. As the world moves from analog to digital, Visa is applying our brand, products, people, network, and scale to reshape the future of commerce. **Job Description** Visa AI Studio is Visa's AI operating system: a single platform for building, deploying, and operating predictive models, foundation models, and AI agents at global scale. It gives every team at Visa a common, self service way to train and experiment, build with generative AI, develop and run production AI agents, manage features and memory, and operate everything with governance and observability built in. Visa AI Studio is the foundation for how AI gets built across the company. This role is for a Data Engineer, with a strong development background, whose primary objective will be to extend our AI as a Service platform to the Public Cloud while enhancing, optimizing our existing codebase and development procedures, as well as developing new solutions. We are seeking for a strong tech leader and architect with a solid background in public cloud and AI/ML production systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong mix of hands\-on technical knowledge and leadership skills, with the ability to contribute technical knowledge and grow leadership skills, supporting the team's progress toward our technical objectives, with guidance from senior engineers. They should be hands\-on, knowledgeable about cloud technologies, business drivers, and emerging AI/ML trends, and experienced with AWS and GCP services. The role demands a proactive learner who can work through ambiguity with support, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and contribute to decisions. The candidate should possess strong interpersonal skills, excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to manage complex projects and deadlines. A problem\-solving mindset and a hands\-on approach are key to succeeding in this role. This role offers ample opportunities for learning and growth, and the chance to be part of delivering the next big thing for our AI as Services team. If you are experienced and passionate about cloud technology, AI, and machine learning, and are excited about making a significant impact, we would love to hear from you. This is a hybrid position based in Austin, TX, allowing alternating between remote and office work. Expectations are to be in\-office at least two days a week, typically Mondays, Tuesdays and alternating Fridays, aiming for a 50% office presence based on business requirements. **Essential Functions** * Design, build, and operate core components of AI Runtime Services: live model and agent serving, the runtime console, release management, and production reliability, so other teams can deploy and operate safely with minimal platform\-team intervention. * Drive development effort end\-to\-end for on\-time delivery of high\-quality solutions that meet requirements, align with the architectural vision, and comply with applicable standards, across all phases from design through production. * Collaborate with Product Managers, Architects, Analysts, Software Engineers, and Project Managers to plan, document, and manage risks and issues to resolution; present technical solutions and status clearly in business terms. * Embed governance, responsible AI, audit, and monitoring directly into the serving path, including drift, hallucination, and anomaly detection for agentic systems in production. * Partner with the AI Engineering Platform, AI Context Platform, and AI Governance Platform teams to deliver a coherent, end\-to\-end platform experience. * Develop and extend the AI agents and agentic workflows that run across AI Runtime Services, from automating platform operations to powering products like Visa Claw, so the platform's own capabilities keep advancing. * Leverage AI coding agents and LLM\-powered developer tools as part of your own workflow, treating AI\-assisted engineering as a core skill to design, build, and ship platform capabilities faster. * Coach and mentor junior team members, growing the team's talent pipeline. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. **Qualifications** **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree, OR 3\+ years of relevant work experience. * 1 or more years of hands\-on experience delivering robust, scalable solutions on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), preferably in an AI/ML production environment. * Expertise in one or more of Golang, Java, Rust, C/C\+\+, or Python, with strong systems and software engineering fundamentals, including distributed systems and API/SDK design. **Preferred Qualifications** * Expertise in Advanced Python; professional cloud certifications. * Basic understanding of core machine learning and deep learning concepts, and the ability to reason about a model or agent across its full lifecycle, from training through production deployment, monitoring, and retirement. * Proven experience designing and developing data\-driven, real\-time and batch systems, with a deep understanding of the trade\-offs across design, architectural, and integration patterns. * Hands\-on fluency with modern AI\-assisted development (coding agents, copilots, LLM\-based tooling) to accelerate day\-to\-day engineering work. * Experience mentoring peers or interns, and contributing to technical design discussions within the team. * Expertise in cloud architecture and service offerings, including core cloud services (compute, storage, databases, networking, AI/ML), AWS EKS, ElastiCache, and CloudWatch. * Rust and/or C\+\+ experience is highly desired for latency\-sensitive serving components. * Experience building internal developer platforms, SDKs, or self\-service tooling used by other engineering or data science teams, such as a runtime console or similar self\-serve capability. **Information for US Applicants** For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $86,500\.00 to $ 134,400\.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job\-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.**Work Hours** Varies upon the needs of the department. **Travel Requirements** This position requires travel 5\-10% of the time. **Mental/Physical Requirements** This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. **Visa is an EEO Employer** Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: INTRODUCTION and WHAT YOU WILL DO (Job Responsibilities) Purpose of Position Are you eager to work on an innovative team focused on new diverse tools and technologies? Are you looking for a stimulating and challenging career where your engineering expertise can be leveraged to create, enhance, and maintain our key product lines? If so, then we have a great opportunity for you! At Gilbarco Veeder\-Root, our purpose is to support the global fueling infrastructure by delivering the best solutions in automatic tank gauging, dispensing, and fuel management systems driven by innovation and break\-through thinking. We are committed to delivering measurable value to our customers and to continually expand that value through improvements to our solutions and processes. We thrive on passion and innovation, and are looking for great people, with great ideas, who want to create the next big thing. We want team members to push limits, look outside the box and think the unthinkable. We have an exciting opportunity for a Software Engineer II on our Automatic Tank Gauge team. We are looking for motivated people to join us on our journey. You need to think big, move fast, and want to make a significant impact. Are you ready? This is a hybrid role located in Simsbury, CT / Hartford, CT / Boston, MA in the US. What you will do * Design, develop, and execute software solutions to address business needs on our Automated Tank Gauge and related platforms * Bring your knowledge of newer technology stacks and frameworks, and identify where they should be applied, helping the rest of the team get up to speed. * Use your experience with Agile methodologies to improve the working of our Agile teams * Collaborate with peers, electrical and mechanical development teams, quality assurance and others as needed to produce game changing solutions * Mentor junior engineers on best practices in design and coding as well as transfer technical knowledge about newer technologies WHO YOU ARE (Qualifications) **Qualifications:** * Bachelors of Science in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Computer Engineering or equivalent experience * 3\-5 Years of experience developing software in object\-oriented programming languages. Ideally C\+\+ or Java. * Project leadership experience is preferred * Experience with continuous integration and automated test technologies is useful * Experience with REST APIs and JSON is useful * Experience with AWS or Azure (and associated services) is useful The base compensation range for this position is $96,800 to $124,600 per annum. Your actual base salary will be determined based upon numerous factors which may include relevant experience, skills, location (labor market data), credentials (education, certifications), and internal equity. Vontier partners with you and your family on your health and wellness journey. Visit VontierBenefits.com to view our benefits. We offer a premium suite of health and wellness programs for you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance. With programs for family planning from Maven Clinic to managing diabetes like Livongo, coverage for women's health, support for adult and elder care, paid parental leave, a generous 401(k) plan with matching company contributions, and more. Vontier is here for all stages of life. We also offer paid time off up to 15 days each year, 13 paid holidays (including 3 floating holidays), and paid sick leave.\* **Disclaimer:** The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Sick leave amount may vary based on state or local laws applicable to the applicant’s geographic location.
