Working closely with Architecture, Information Security, lines of business and business users, this role will provide senior technical advisory, define engineering direction, and establish the shared frameworks, reusable patterns and reference implementations that enable teams across WTW to develop AI solutions safely, consistently and at scale. The role applies deep specialist knowledge of generative AI, agentic systems, enterprise platforms and engineering governance to influence strategic decisions, guide complex technical delivery and solve ambiguous problems across related disciplines. It has end\-to\-end ownership of both build and run activities for central AI engineering capabilities, ensuring solutions are secure, governed, reliable and aligned to measurable business outcomes. We are seeking a proactive and autonomous senior technology leader who combines broad enterprise technology understanding with deep hands\-on expertise in production\-grade generative AI and agentic solutions across enterprise AI platforms, model providers and orchestration frameworks. Relevant experience may include Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Lyzr, Anthropic Claude, Moveworks or similar technologies. **The Role** * Shape the design, build and ongoing support of WTW’s central AI engineering frameworks, providing reusable foundations for lines of business to build upon. * Define technical direction for production\-grade generative AI and agentic solutions across enterprise AI platforms, model providers and orchestration frameworks, including: o Enterprise AI development and orchestration platforms, including agent frameworks, declarative and custom\-engine agents, plugins, skills, connectors and extensions. o Large language models and model\-provider APIs, including tool use, governed integration patterns and protocols such as the Model Context Protocol. o Moveworks and other agentic automation and employee\-support platforms. * Establish shared patterns, reference architectures, SDKs and reusable components, including prompt libraries, retrieval pipelines and tool/connector catalogues, to accelerate safe AI adoption across the business. * Act as a senior expert advisor to lines of business and business stakeholders, assessing workflow fit, validating use cases and translating business needs into secure, scalable AI solution patterns. * Partner with Architecture and Information Security to embed governance, responsible AI and security controls into the AI platform by design, including identity, data protection, content safety and auditability. * Build and operate context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and agent orchestration capabilities, integrating enterprise data sources through secure, governed connectors. * Define and implement large language model operations (LLMOps) practices, including evaluation, testing, prompt and model versioning, monitoring and observability, to ensure quality, reliability and cost efficiency in production. * Serve as a senior technical escalation point for AI services, leading investigation, root cause analysis and remediation of issues impacting production AI solutions. * Influence adoption of new AI capabilities by coordinating technical messaging, implementation guidance and alignment across impacted teams and lines of business. * Create, maintain and govern technical documentation, including design documents, architecture decision records, runbooks and developer guidance for consuming central AI frameworks. * Identify engineering and operational improvement opportunities, articulate recommendations and lead delivery of improvement initiatives across the AI engineering practice. * Guide and mentor AI engineers across WTW by sharing expertise, reviewing solution approaches and setting engineering standards for building on central AI frameworks. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools and platforms, and define adoption strategies and roadmaps for enterprise use. * Maintain a strong information security and responsible AI posture, ensuring risk mitigation and adherence to data protection, model governance and applicable regulatory requirements. * Engage directly with business users and stakeholders to understand workflows, validate AI solutions in real\-world contexts and ensure capabilities deliver tangible business value. **Qualifications** ------------------ **What you'll bring** * Extensive experience of software, platform or AI engineering experience, including significant hands\-on experience building and supporting production generative AI solutions in large enterprise environments. * Deep ent. * Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills, with experience building critical partnerships across technology, business, security, architecture and vendor teams. * Experience working directly with business users or product stakeholders to translate workflow needs into AI solution designs, validate outcomes and ensure solutions deliver practical business value. * Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, advisory, design review and influence across teams, often without direct authority. * Proactive, improvement\-focused mindset, with the ability to operate effectively in evolving environments, shape technical recommendations and drive outcomes with minimal supervision. Preferred Qualifications * Experience in financial services, insurance, consulting or another highly regulated industry. * Experience shaping or supporting enterprise\-wide AI transformation initiatives. * Familiarity with enterprise productivity\-platform extensibility, such as Teams apps, message extensions, Microsoft Graph connectors or comparable collaboration and workflow integrations. * Experience supporting adoption of AI capabilities through user validation, feedback loops, enablement and continuous improvement. * Experience contributing to enterprise technology roadmaps, standards or governance forums. **What we offer** Enjoy a benefits package designed to help you thrive, both professionally and personally. You'll receive 25 days of annual leave plus an extra WTW day to relax and recharge. Our comprehensive health and wellbeing offering includes private healthcare, life insurance, group income protection, and regular health assessments, all giving you peace of mind. Secure your future with our defined contribution pension scheme, featuring matched contributions up to 10% from the company. We support your growth and balance with hybrid working options, access to an employee assistance programme, and a fully paid volunteer day to make a difference in your community. On top of these, you can opt into a variety of additional perks including an electric vehicle car scheme, share scheme, cycle\-to\-work programme, dental and optical cover, critical illness protection, and much more. Start making the most of your career and wellbeing with a range of benefits tailored for you. **Equal Opportunity Employer** We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com **Company Benefits (US locations)** WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply): * **Health and Welfare Benefits:** Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD\&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program) * **Leave Benefits:** Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes paid state/local paid leave where required), Short\-Term Disability, Long\-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave), **Paid Time Off** (*Washington State only*) * **Retirement Benefits:** Contributory Pension Plan and Savings Plan (401k). jobs.title: Data & AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT THIS POSITION** Waystar is seeking a hands\-on Data and Artificial Intelligence Security Engineer to join our Security Operations team. This role will help build and operate the technical controls that protect sensitive enterprise data and enable the secure adoption of artificial intelligence. The ideal candidate will have experience implementing enterprise data protection technologies, including Microsoft Purview and data loss prevention solutions, along with a practical understanding of modern AI systems. This position will work closely with Security Operations, Data and Engineering, IT, Privacy, Legal, Risk, and application teams to translate security requirements into effective and scalable controls.**WHAT YOU'LL DO** Data Protection Engineering Implement and manage Microsoft Purview capabilities, including data discovery, classification, sensitivity labeling, data loss prevention, and other applicable data security controls. Deploy and operate Cyberhaven or similar data security platforms, including policy development, data lineage, sensitive data detection, enforcement, and alert tuning. Develop an integrated control model across Purview, Cyberhaven, cloud platforms, identity, endpoint security, and security monitoring. Identify sensitive data exposure and improve protection across endpoints, Microsoft 365, cloud, SaaS, and AI services. AI Security Engineering Perform security architecture reviews and threat modeling for AI applications, models, data pipelines, agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, model APIs, and Model Context Protocol integrations. Evaluate risks including prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, excessive agency, insecure tool use, unauthorized model access, and third\-party AI dependencies. Define security requirements and guardrails for enterprise AI systems and approved AI services. Develop and perform security testing for AI applications, integrations, and agent workflows. Monitoring and Response Integrate data and AI security telemetry into existing Security Operations monitoring and response processes. Develop alerts, investigation procedures, and response playbooks for data loss and AI\-related security events. Investigate potential data exposure, policy violations, unauthorized AI use, and anomalous data movement. Measure control effectiveness and continuously tune policies to reduce risk without creating unnecessary business disruption. Governance and Enablement Support AI intake, risk assessment, exception, and review processes with technical analysis and control recommendations. Translate regulatory, privacy, and security requirements into enforceable technical controls. Develop standards and guidance for secure data handling and AI adoption. Educate technical and business stakeholders on data protection and AI security practices. **WHAT YOU'LL NEED** Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 4\+ years of experience in security engineering, including hands\-on experience with data security, data loss prevention, or information protection. Experience configuring and managing Microsoft Purview or comparable enterprise data protection technologies. Experience with data classification, sensitivity labeling, data lineage, policy enforcement, and data exposure investigation. Working knowledge of generative AI technologies, including large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, agents, model APIs, and AI integrations. Experience with security architecture reviews, risk assessments, or threat modeling. Ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to engineering teams, business stakeholders, and leadership. Preferred Skills Hands\-on experience with Cyberhaven or a comparable data detection and response platform. Experience with Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention, Information Protection, Insider Risk Management, or Data Security Posture Management. Familiarity with AI security risks and frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and MITRE ATLAS. Experience integrating security telemetry with SIEM and Security Operations workflows. Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform and their native data security capabilities. PowerShell, Python, or other security automation experience. Experience protecting healthcare or other regulated data, including PHI, PII, and PCI data. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, Microsoft security certifications, or equivalent practical experience. **ABOUT WAYSTAR** Through a smart platform and better experience, Waystar helps providers simplify healthcare payments and yield powerful results throughout the complete revenue cycle. Waystar’s healthcare payments platform combines innovative, cloud\-based technology, robust data, and unparalleled client support to streamline workflows and improve financials so providers can focus on what matters most: their patients and communities. Waystar is trusted by 1M\+ providers, 1K\+ hospitals and health systems, and is connected to over 5K commercial and Medicaid/Medicare payers. We are deeply committed to living out our organizational values: honesty; kindness; passion; curiosity; fanatical focus; best work, always; making it happen; and joyful, optimistic \& fun. Waystar products have won multiple Best in KLAS® or Category Leader awards since 2010 and earned multiple \#1 rankings from Black Book™ surveys since 2012\. The Waystar platform supports more than 500,000 providers, 1,000 health systems and hospitals, and 5,000 payers and health plans. For more information, visit waystar.com or follow @Waystar on Twitter. **WAYSTAR PERKS** * Competitive total rewards (base salary \+ bonus, if applicable) * Customizable benefits package (3 medical plans with Health Saving Account company match) * We offer generous paid time off for our non\-exempt team members, starting with 3 weeks \+ 13 paid holidays, including 2 personal floating holidays. We also offer flexible time off for our exempt team members \+ 13 paid holidays * Paid parental leave (including maternity \+ paternity leave) * Education assistance opportunities and free LinkedIn Learning access * Free mental health and family planning programs, including adoption assistance and fertility support * 401(K) program with company match * Pet insurance * Employee resource groups Waystar is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate, value, and support diversity and inclusion. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, marital status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. jobs.title: Front-End Privacy Engineer
jobs.description: **About Local Now** ------------------- Local Now is a free, ad\-supported streaming service delivering local news, weather, sports, and lifestyle programming to viewers across virtually every connected device. As part of Allen Media Group, we operate at meaningful scale across mobile, smart TVs, streaming sticks, set\-top boxes, and the web. We are now investing in a ground\-up rebuild of our streaming platform with a privacy\-first architecture, modern shared\-code strategy, and the engineering rigor needed to grow sustainably. We build for audiences who expect frictionless playback on any device, and for advertisers who depend on us to deliver reliable, high\-quality monetization. As a privacy\-centric platform, our commitment to data protection is a core pillar of our technology and our business. **The Role** ------------ We are hiring a Front\-End Privacy Engineer to help build and maintain the client\-side privacy architecture of Local Now's consumer apps. You will work on a small, senior frontend team building shared, cross\-platform code that powers our experience across iOS, Android, mobile, tablet, and connected TV surfaces. As a key contributor in privacy engineering, you will assist with the technical implementation of Consent Management Platforms (CMPs), privacy SDKs (such as OneTrust or Ethyca), and client\-side tracking governance. This is a greenfield rebuild with a privacy\-first architectural posture, an aggressive but quality\-conscious delivery cadence, and meaningful AI\-assisted developer tooling baked into how we work. You should be passionate about cross\-platform data flow architecture, curious about how third\-party SDKs operate under the hood, and energized by the challenge of enforcing strict privacy controls without compromising a polished streaming experience. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * **Implement and Manage CMPs:** Integrate and maintain Consent Management Platform SDKs (e.g., OneTrust, Ethyca Fides, Ketch) across React Native (iOS/Android) and web environments. * **Govern Consent State:** Develop and maintain centralized state management to ensure user consent and preferences propagate seamlessly to ad insertion (CSAI/SSAI), video players, analytics tools, and third\-party vendors. * **Enforce Data Minimization:** Implement privacy\-first patterns into the client, including data\-minimization at the source and preventing unauthorized data leakage from third\-party tags. * **Automated Privacy Signals:** Implement client\-side support for global privacy signals, including Global Privacy Control (GPC), and ensure compliance with frameworks like the IAB TCF or GPP. * **Audit Tracking \& Network Traffic:** Inspect network traffic using tools like Charles Proxy to audit data flow, verify API compliance, and govern cookies, local storage, and tracking pixels. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with backend, platform, and CMS engineers to integrate privacy\-safe APIs, while collaborating with legal teams to translate privacy policies into strict technical controls. * **Team Collaboration:** Collaborate with peers, uphold privacy\-by\-design principles through code review, and use AI\-assisted development tooling effectively to multiply your output. **What We Are Looking For** --------------------------- * **Experience:** 4\+ years of mobile or front\-end engineering experience, with 2\+ years working in React/React Native production codebases. * **Privacy Expertise:** Experience or strong familiarity with implementing and configuring CMPs (OneTrust, Ethyca, Sourcepoint) and navigating consent orchestration in consumer applications. * **Frontend Fundamentals:** Strong fundamentals in React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern mobile/web architecture patterns. * **Compliance Knowledge:** Familiarity with how global privacy regulations (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, VCDPA) influence front\-end architecture and client\-side tracking mechanisms. * **Platform Familiarity:** Familiarity with native iOS (Swift/Objective\-C) or Android (Kotlin/Java) sufficient to debug and interface with native privacy modules when required. * **Quality \& Delivery:** Comfort with build pipelines, CI, app store submission, and release engineering for mobile. A demonstrated eye for quality—treating performance, polish, and reliability as features. * **Testing \& Tooling:** Experience debugging and testing APIs, writing API smoke tests, and inspecting network traffic (e.g., Charles Proxy). Experience with modern AI tools for test case generation, such as Cursor and Claude Code. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * **Streaming Video Context:** Experience with streaming video ecosystems, including ad insertion (CSAI/SSAI), ExoPlayer, AVPlayer, or commercial player SDKs. * **Connected TV:** Experience targeting connected TV form factors (tvOS, Android TV/Google TV, Fire TV) from a React Native or shared\-code codebase. * **Ad\-Tech Standards:** Familiarity with IAB Tech Lab privacy standards, such as the Global Privacy Platform (GPP) or the US Privacy String. * **Automated UI Testing:** Exposure to automated testing tools like Playwright for automatically testing the UI of web, mobile, and TV platforms. Allen Media Group is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these characteristics. We are dedicated to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination.

jobs.description: **About Wurl, LLC.** At Wurl, our mission is to create innovative technologies and services that help accelerate the shift to streaming. Our technology and data\-driven solutions help companies reach new audiences, engage high\-value viewers, and ultimately increase their revenue. In 2022, Wurl was acquired by AppLovin (Nasdaq: APP), a leading marketing platform, giving our employees the best of both worlds: the dynamic environment of a 150\+ person startup as well as the stability of a high\-growth public tech company. We invest in providing a culture that fosters passion, drives excellence, and encourages collaboration to drive innovation. Wurl is a fully\-remote company that has been globally recognized for our people and technology, having been named a Great Place to Work by Fortune in 2022, 2023, and 2024; an Ad Tech Company of the Year finalist by the UK Business Tech Awards in 2023; a BIG Innovation Awards winner in 2024 and 2025; and the “Innovation in Advertising” winner by the StreamTV Awards in 2024\. ### **The Opportunity** Wurl delivers thousands of FAST channels to more than 50 streaming platforms worldwide with ads inserted in real time. We build the playout platform behind those channels, handling live events, ad signaling, and SSAI integration. Wurl is seeking a Software Engineer I to tackle engineering challenges on systems operating at scale. ### **What you’ll do** * **Build the systems that put channels on air.** Develop features in our playout platform, the software that assembles content and ad breaks into continuous linear streams. * **Investigate across the stack.** When viewership or ad impressions drop on a channel, use metrics and logs to trace the issue through playout, ad insertion, and CDN to its root cause. * **Build tools people rely on daily.** Write the Python services and automation that operations and engineering use to run channels. * **Work AI\-native.** Use AI tools to build faster and learn faster, and hold their output to the same standard as your own code. * **Own what you ship.** Your work goes to production and you stand behind it, including shifts in the on\-call rotation. ### **What you bring** * 2\+ years writing production Python: tested, maintainable code that other people rely on. * Solid grounding in REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, and Git. * Experience taking a well\-scoped problem, working out the approach, and delivering it without step\-by\-step guidance. * Experience diagnosing issues in systems you didn’t build. * Clear communication with both technical and non\-technical teammates. ### **What you’ll learn at Wurl** * **Streaming:** how linear playout systems are built, plus HLS, transcoding, live event switching and recordings. * **Ad tech:** server\-side ad insertion and CTV monetization. * **Cloud:** AWS, serverless, and cloud\-native application development. * **Production engineering:** monitoring, reliability, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation at scale. ### **What We Offer:** * Competitive Salary, Equity (ESPP) and Bonus * Strong Medical, Dental and in place of new development, and requirements analysis and synthesis from system level to individual software components. ### **Signals Software Engineer Level 2 – Required Capabilities** * Analyze * Describe various signal processing techniques. * Identify various digital modulation techniques. * Integrate existing software into new or modified systems or operating environments. * Provide recommendations for improving documentation and software development process standards. * Develop/implement algorithms to meet system performance and functional standards. * Assist with developing and executing test procedures for software components. * Write/review software and system documentation. * Develop software solutions, confer with users or system engineers. * Analyze systems flow, data usage and work processes. * Investigate problem areas. * Serve as team lead at the level appropriate to the software development process being used on any particular project. * Modify existing software to correct errors, to adapt to new hardware, or to improve its performance. * Design, develop and modify software systems, using scientific analysis and mathematical models to predict and measure outcome and consequences of design. * Use signal processing algorithms to convert a signal. * Design signal processing software based on sparse documentation. * Lead one or more software development teams and ensure the work is completed in accordance with the constraints of the software development process being used on any particular project. * Design/implement complex signal processing algorithms requiring adherence to strict timing, system resource, or interface constraints. * Perform quality control on products. * Write software using C\+\+ and Java; suggest languages as needed to solve problems. * Advanced understanding of the Linux operating syst  * Short and Long\-Term Disability * Hospital Indemnity, Accident, and Critical Illness Insurances * Optional Identity Theft and Legal Protection Services * Employee Referral Bonus Eligibility up to $10,000 * Mobility Among Wyetech\-supported Contracts * Various contract and work locations throughout Maryland, Virginia, Colorado, Texas, Utah, Alaska, Hawaii and OCONUS * Various team\-building events throughout the year such as monthly lunches, summer company picnic, and an annual holiday party. * Employees receive two complimentary branded clothing orders annually. **Salary Range** ---------------- **$84\.03–$113\.79 USD Hourly** *Hourly pay rates listed for this position serve as a general guideline jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer & Applied Researcher, Early Stage Projects
jobs.description: Software EngineeringMountain View, CA (HQ) **About the company** X is Alphabet’s moonshot factory where uncomfortably ambitious, world\-changing ideas are developed and taken out into the world. X projects have the potential to transform the lives of billions of people and make the world a radically better place. For X to be successful, we have to repeatedly turn breakthrough technology ideas into products that solve large problems in the world, and create meaningful businesses for Alphabet. **About the team:** You'll join a team at X that provides world\-class computational support to the many different projects, ideas and experiments at the Moonshot Factory. You'll work directly with teams across X to share expert machine learning expertise, advice and hands\-on implementation; from early concept through launch and supporting prototyping, experimentation, technical development and more. **About the role:** Internally, we call this role the "Generally Awesome Engineer" because the problems we tackle at X rarely respect the boundary between a Research Scientist and a Machine Learning Engineer. One month, you might be designing a multi\-agent reasoning harness that critiques early moonshot hypotheses or automates complex engineering workflows across the factory. Next, you might be embedded with a small team of physicists, biologists, or mechanical engineers, adapting foundation models and reinforcement learning to control lab hardware, simulate molecular interactions, or process sparse sensor telemetry. We are looking for someone earlier in their career, ideally coming out of a technical PhD, an early\-stage startup, or preferably both, who lives and breathes modern AI. You don't just follow the state of the art in foundation models and agentic AI; you internalize how the landscape is shifting week by week and immediately translate new capabilities into working systems. Just as importantly, you use AI proactively in your own day\-to\-day workflow: you build with coding agents, automate your own bottlenecks, and prototype at a speed that previously required a five\-person team. **How You'll Make 10x Impact:** * **Architect and ship agentic AI systems:** Design, build, and deploy multi\-agent workflows, tool\-using harnesses, memory/retrieval pipelines, and human\-in\-the\-loop systems that accelerate both individual moonshot projects and factory\-wide discovery. * **Bridge frontier research and real\-world prototyping:** Take newly published papers, open\-weight models, and frontier Alphabet/Google DeepMind capabilities and adapt them via post\-training, fine\-tuning, RL, test\-time compute, or hybrid neuro\-symbolic architectures to messy, non\-obvious real\-world problems. * **De\-risk early moonshot investigations:** Partner with scientists, hardware engineers, and rapid evaluators on 0\-to\-1 investigations to scope technical feasibility, identify the hardest core assumptions, and build fast, scrappy prototypes that deliver clear kill\-or\-continue signals. * **Model AI\-native engineering across the factory:** Push the frontier of AI\-assisted software and research development \- building reusable skills, plugins, and agentic workflows that help engineers and domain scientists across X move 10x faster. * **Own end\-to\-end execution across the stack:** Move fluidly from curating noisy datasets and training models on our on\-prem GPU cluster or cloud infrastructure to building clean backend services, APIs, and interactive prototypes that partners and teammates can use immediately. * **Act as an AI tastemaker for X:** Stay plugged into the bleeding edge across Alphabet, academia, and the startup ecosystem; separate durable technical breakthroughs from passing hype, and bring the best tools and ideas into X. **Minimum Qualifications:** * PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, a quantitative physical/life science, or a related technical field OR a Master's/Bachelor's degree with equivalent high\-velocity experience in an early\-stage startup or applied AI research lab. * Deep theoretical and hands\-on command of modern foundation models (LLMs, multimodal models, diffusion/flow models) and their post\-training/adaptation lifecycle. * Demonstrated experience designing and building agentic AI systems including multi\-agent orchestration, tool use and environment interaction, code execution harnesses, and complex retrieval/memory architectures. * Fluency in AI\-native software development with strong software engineering chops in Python (and modern ML ecosystems such as PyTorch, JAX, or vLLM) paired with daily mastery of AI coding and research agents to build and ship rapidly. * Track record of taking ambiguous, open\-ended real\-world problems from zero to a working prototype with minimal supervision. **Preferred Qualifications:** * The "PhD \+ Startup" combination: Rigorous research training (e.g., publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, CVPR, or domain journals) combined with experience building at an early\-stage startup where you wore multiple hats and shipped under tight constraints. * Experience applying AI/ML to physical, scientific, or hardware\-coupled domains; such as computational chemistry, materials science, synthetic biology, physics simulation, CAD/mechanical design, robotics, or climate/earth systems. * Full\-stack prototyping capability: comfort spinning up cloud infrastructure (GCP, Docker, Kubernetes), GPU cluster workloads, and lightweight web UIs or developer tools when a project needs them. **How You Know You'll Thrive Here:** * **You are unapologetically AI\-fluent—and grounded in reality.** You test new models, agent harnesses, and workflows the day they drop because you genuinely love seeing what's newly possible, but you care about solving real physical and human problems rather than chasing demos. * **You refuse to say "that's not my job description."** Whether a project needs a custom loss function, a data\-cleaning pipeline, an agentic harness, or a script to talk to lab hardware, you jump in and build what the problem requires. * **You have high agency and low ego.** You love working shoulder to shoulder with domain experts who think differently than you do, and you're just as proud of a rigorous experiment that disproves a flawed idea in two weeks as one that launches a multi\-year project. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $147,000 \- $221,000 \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits. **An Equal Opportunity Workplace** ---------------------------------- At X, we don't just accept difference \- we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at x\-accommodation\-request@x.team.

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer (Analytics Engineer)
jobs.description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. We are seeking a Staff Analytics Engineer to join our Data Platform team. Xometry's data ecosystem spans dozens of source systems — transactional databases, marketplace event streams, manufacturing signals, partner integrations, and ML feature pipelines — and your job is to make that complexity legible. You will own the data models, transformation logic, and data flows that turn raw, multi\-system data into the trusted, well\-structured datasets that analytics, ML training, agentic decision systems, and business teams depend on. You work within a complex, multi\-engine architecture that you influence but do not own — your focus is what moves through it, how it's modeled, and whether downstream consumers can trust it. This is a hands\-on, individual contributor role. You will spend most of your time writing SQL and dbt, designing data models, optimizing transformation pipelines, and debugging data quality issues across system boundaries. You influence platform architecture through the modeling patterns you introduce and the performance problems you surface. Your work directly determines whether Xometry's AI products, agentic analytics capabilities, and business intelligence tools have the data foundation they need to be accurate and fast. Everything you build will matter. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Write code and ship data models** — You will spend most of your time writing SQL and dbt, designing transformation logic, and shipping the data models that power analytics, ML, and agentic systems across Xometry. **Own multi\-system data modeling** — Design and maintain performant, well\-documented data models integrating disparate source systems (transactional, event, partner, and ML pipelines). Resolve grain mismatches, handle late data, and balance flexibility, speed, and governance. **Optimize data flows end\-to\-end** — Analyze and optimize transformation pipelines and data flows from ingestion to consumption. Resolve bottlenecks, lower compute costs, improve freshness, and ensure reliable data delivery for dashboards, ML jobs, and downstream consumers. **Build the datasets that power AI** — Design and deliver the curated datasets, feature sets, and analytical tables that directly feed ML training, real\-time inference, and agentic decision systems. Collaborate with ML engineers and data scientists to understand how they consume data and shape models accordingly. **Advance agentic analytics capabilities** — Support automated, intelligent data workflows that deliver insights and drive enterprise actions, ensuring data models and transformations are reliable, well\-tested, and optimized for machine consumption. **Influence platform architecture** — Operating within a complex, multi\-engine data architecture, your modeling, performance analysis, and data quality insights will shape platform evolution, highlight gaps, and guide the platform roadmap. **Champion data quality and trust** — Own data testing, documentation, lineage, and observability for the models you build. **Introduce patterns that stick** — The modeling conventions you establish, the testing practices you enforce, and the documentation standards you set become the templates other engineers follow. **Mentor and elevate** — Raise the engineering bar for senior and mid\-level data engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and pairing. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- ### **Required** * Bachelor's degree in a STEM field (or equivalent experience) plus 5–8 years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a closely related role, with demonstrated ownership of complex data modeling across multiple source systems. * Expert\-level SQL proficiency — you write performant, well\-structured queries and can reason about execution plans, join strategies, and warehouse\-level optimization. * Deep dbt expertise — advanced modeling patterns (dimensional, Data Vault, or similar), testing, documentation, and macro/package development. * Deep expertise with Snowflake or Databricks — performance tuning, query optimization, warehouse configuration, and cost management at scale. * Demonstrated experience modeling data across complex, multi\-system environments — reconciling transactional, event\-driven, partner, and pipeline data with different grains, latencies, and schemas. * Experience building curated datasets, feature sets, or analytical tables that directly feed ML training, inference, or AI application layers. * Strong understanding of data quality practices — testing frameworks, lineage, observability, and root\-cause analysis across system boundaries. * Experience with orchestration tools (Airflow, or similar) and data ingestion frameworks (Airbyte, or similar). * Strong Python proficiency; comfort picking up additional languages as needed. * Deep understanding of CI/CD principles and automated testing in data pipelines. * Strong grasp of the AWS data ecosystem and cloud\-native infrastructure. * Ability to operate independently on ambiguous assignments and communicate effectively across engineering, data science, product, and business audiences. ### **Desired** * Experience with data governance, data quality frameworks, and observability tooling (Monte Carlo, Great Expectations, or similar). * Experience with agentic analytics capabilities or automated, intelligent data workflows. * Exposure to modern lakehouse or data mesh architectural patterns. * Experience with streaming or event\-driven data (Kafka, Kinesis, CDC pipelines). * Familiarity with data visualization tools (Looker, Streamlit, or similar). * Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation). * Background in manufacturing, supply chain, or marketplace environments. The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $180,000\-$200,000\.00 annually \+ bonus depending on factors such as job\-related skills, relevant experience, and location. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including 401(k) match, medical, dental and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays, maternity and bonding leave; EAP, other wellbeing resources; and much more. \#LI\-Hybrid \#Promoted Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. For US based roles: Xometry participates in E\-Verify and after a job offer is accepted, will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We’re not only the largest Mexican\-inspired quick service brand (QSR) in the world, we’re also part of the biggest restaurant group in the world: Yum! Brands. Much of our fan love and authentic connection with our communities are rooted in being rebels with a cause. From ensuring we use high quality, sustainable ingredients to elevating restaurant technology in ways that hasn’t been done before… we will continue to be inclusive, bold, challenge the status quo and push industry boundaries. We’re a company that celebrates and advocates for different, has bold self\-expression, strives for a better future, and brings the fun while we’re at it. jobs.title: Machine Learning Operations Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer\-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives. **Position Summary** We are seeking a Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) Engineer to own the path from a registered model to a production inference workflow, including deployment, scheduled batch scoring, backfills, versioning, and rollback, with near\-real\-time and real\-time scoring to follow. This position plays a key role in supporting the AI/ML Engineering department and reports to the Sr. Manager, AI/ML Engineering, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, operational excellence, and compliance standards. This position has no direct reports. **Key Responsibilities** * Deploy and operate models in production, owning the path from registered model to inference workflow, including scheduled batch scoring, backfills, versioning, and rollback. * Build scoring and data pipelines that are safe to rerun, can be backfilled, and fail loudly instead of quietly producing incomplete output. * Help design, build, and run near\-real\-time and real\-time scoring workflows, an area where our approach is still being defined. * Build monitoring for both the pipeline and the model, including scoring run status, input arrival and freshness, consistency of inputs with training data, and shifts in score distribution. * Set up and tune alerting that identifies when something needs attention, from a failed run to a model that may need retraining, so that issues are found before clinicians are affected. * Write and maintain runbooks, design notes, and clear handoffs so that incident response does not depend on one person. * Contribute to shared defaults that make each new model faster and safer to ship, including automated tests that run on every model or pipeline change and a consistent release process from development to production. * Enable comparison of a new model version against the current version before downstream use cases rely on it. * Provide visibility into the cost of running each model. * Partner with data scientists to move models from development to production, including addressing training/serving skew, drift, and model versioning. * Design for security and access, including secrets management, least\-privilege roles, and logging that never exposes sensitive data. * Work within a Snowflake\-native platform (Snowflake ML Feature Store, Model Registry, and Experiments, dbt, Python, Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript services for online orchestration). **Qualifications** * **Education**: A bachelors degree is preferred. * **Experience**: Typically 5 years of experience in software, data, or ML infrastructure engineering, as a guide rather than a requirement. * **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**: + **Required** - Has put machine learning models, or comparable data products, into production and kept them running, and can describe a failure caught, a failure missed, and what changed afterward. - Has built scheduled scoring or data pipelines that are safe to rerun, can be backfilled, and fail loudly instead of quietly producing a half\-empty table. - Has built monitoring and alerting covering data quality, freshness, and model behavior, and tuned it until people trusted it. - Matches the solution to the need, with experience using managed platforms and building custom components, and can explain when each was the right call. - Strong Python and strong SQL. - Comfortable with Git\-based workflows, automated testing, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform. - Understands machine learning well enough to be a real partner to data scientists, including training/serving skew, drift, model versioning, and why a model that validated well can still fail in production. - Treats security and access as part of the design, including secrets management, least\-privilege roles, and logs that never leak sensitive data. - Documents work, including runbooks, design notes, and clear handoffs. - Uses AI tools effectively, with foundational engineering skills sharp enough to read, audit, and debug every line independently. If an agent writes the code, remains accountable for it and can defend it. + **Preferred** - Experience with Snowflake, especially Snowflake ML (Feature Store, Model Registry, Snowpark), or comparable experience on another ML platform. - Experience deploying and operating services on a cloud provider such as AWS, including containers, APIs, and real\-time model serving. - Experience setting up ML operations at a company or team that did not have them. - Experience in a regulated environment (healthcare, pharmacy, payer, or life sciences is ideal), including PHI under HIPAA and BAAs, access reviews, and audit trails. - Experience with observability for LLM applications. **Work Environment** * **Location**: Columbus, OH or remote (US) * **Schedule**: FT * Small but growing cross\-functional team with high autonomy and minimal ceremony, building new services and practices from the ground up. * Regular collaboration with data scientists and the AI/ML Engineering team to ensure alignment. * Data is PHI. HIPAA, BAAs, masking, and role\-based access are daily working realities. **Key Essential Functions** * Must be able to handle PHI in compliance with HIPAA, BAAs, masking requirements, and role\-based access controls. * Must be able to read, audit, and debug all code, including code produced with AI tools, and be accountable for it. * \[HR to confirm any physical requirements, if applicable] **Employment Classification** **Status:** Full\-time **FLSA:** Exempt **Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement** Gifthealth is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you do not meet every requirement but still feel you would be a great fit for this role, we encourage you to apply! **Disclaimer** This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required of personnel. Gifthealth reserves the right to modify job duties or descriptions at any time.

Forward deployed experience: You’ve worked in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, or similar role at a product\-led technical organization. Product feedback experience: You’ve helped turn customer learnings into clear product feedback, roadmap input, or engineering specifications. Why join us? You’ll join one of Europe’s fastest\-growing startups at a moment of huge momentum, working with a remote\-first team that values autonomy, speed, experimentation, and direct customer impact. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: ### **ABOUT onX** We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further. We’re a high\-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt \- continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver. Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals \- Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish \- is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most. We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact. Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access. ### **ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY** onX is seeking a Senior Data Engineer who will contribute to meaningful, real\-world outcomes that have a lasting impact for customers and the business. The Data Engineer IV is a well\-rounded senior engineer who owns major parts of the onX Lakehouse from design through adoption. This role brings depth in Apache Iceberg, semantic layers and metadata. It adds clear ownership of outcomes: the data products, governance, and platforms they deliver are trusted, used, and maintained over time. A Data Engineer IV understands that data engineering is changing. AI systems are becoming major consumers of data, and AI tools are changing how engineers build. This role prepares onX data for AI use, applies AI to speed up and improve engineering work, and does both with sound governance and security. They lead cross\-team initiatives within Data Engineering's scope and bring stakeholders along from the start. They do all of this while continuing to deliver core data engineering work. This position will report to the Manager of Data Engineering. ### **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ***Essential Job Duties \& Functions*** * **Lakehouse Engineering \& Architecture** + Design and deliver Iceberg\-based data products and pipelines on GCP, across batch and, where it makes sense, streaming. + Own table design, partitioning, schema evolution, and lifecycle automation (compaction, snapshot cleanup, retention) for the domains you lead. + Make clear tradeoffs between cost, performance, and maintainability, and write them down so others can follow your reasoning.**Data Governance \& Metadata** + Turn governance standards into working practice: ownership, stewardship, classification, tiering, and certification applied in the catalog, not just documented. + Automate governance where possible, for example checks that require descriptions and owners, tag\-based classification, and policies driven by metadata. + Partner with Security and Platform to design access controls (table, column, and row level) that use metadata like PII tags to enforce policy. + Maintain lineage from source to consumption, including BI tools, so the impact of changes is visible before they ship.**Data Quality \& Observability** + Define what "healthy" means for the data you own: freshness, completeness, and accuracy, agreed with the people who use it. + Build quality checks into pipelines and connect pipeline health to data quality signals, with alerts that reach the right people. + Set up and track KPIs for the platforms you lead, such as adoption, coverage, and reliability, and act when they drift.**AI\-Ready Data \& AI\-Assisted Engineering** + Prepare data so AI systems can use it safely and correctly: clear definitions, rich metadata, documented lineage, and well\-modeled entities. + Support AI use cases such as feature pipelines, retrieval and embedding data, semantic layers, and agent access to the catalog (for example through MCP), with guardrails on what AI can see and do. + Use AI tools to work faster and better: code generation and review, test creation, documentation, metadata enrichment, and classification. Check AI output with the same rigor as human work. + Stay current on how AI is changing data engineering, and help the team adopt what works and skip what doesn't.**Stakeholder Leadership \& Adoption** + Understand what problem your work solves for each stakeholder group before you build, and shape the work around it. + Keep stakeholders informed with a regular cadence and written updates, so they never have to chase status. + Drive adoption after delivery. Success is measured by use and trust, not by launch. + Lead design reviews with partner teams (BI, Analytics, Data n Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60\-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration. We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members. At this time, we are **NOT** able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia (D.C.), Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming. ### **HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED** onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, we are open to considering candidates ranging in two levels (level II and level III). Spanning these levels, applicants can expect to make between $146,000 to $182,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based on experience, skills, certifications, and education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full\-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and a potential annual bonus of 10% based on company performance. ### **WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU** * Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth * Comprehensive health benefits, including a no\-monthly\-cost medical plan * Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non\-birthing parents * 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3\-5% * Company\-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks * Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle * Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays ### **PERFORMANCE ESSENTIALS** In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem\-solving, essential for our computer\-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at PC@onxmaps.com. **Position open until filled.** **\#LI\-Remote** **At onX, we believe that unique perspectives make us stronger.** By bringing together people with different experiences, ideas, and viewpoints, we fuel innovation and move closer to our mission of awakening the adventurer in everyone. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fairness not only in hiring, but also in development, compensation, and promotion. Our goal is to build an inclusive community where every team member can show up authentically and thrive. Together, we win as one team. Come join us! onX Maps will never ask for credit card or SSN details during the initial application process. For your digital safety, apply only through our legitimate website at onXmaps.com onX does not sell any Personal Information, but we may transfer employment related records to our service providers or third parties that provide business services to onX or as required by law. As part of our interview process, your conversation may be recorded for documentation purposes to allow interviewers to focus fully on the discussion. Recordings are confidential and accessible only to authorized personnel. Please note, onX respects all applicable laws regarding recording consent, and you will have an opportunity to opt\-out if preferred.

jobs.title: Principal Silicon Architect, Product and IP
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** As Principal Silicon Digital Architect, you will shape the architecture of analog and mixed\-signal (AMS) devices, with a strong focus on sensor products and their supporting analog and digital IP. Reporting directly to the Vice President of New Product Development, you will influence current and future product families and translate market needs into clear, implementable chip and IP specifications. * Responsibilities **Primary responsibilities** * You will bring deep semiconductor design experience and sound architectural judgment, including the ability to evaluate complex digital systems and make well\-reasoned design trade\-offs. A strong foundation in digital communications or system architecture, together with experience in analog design or specification, will help you connect system\-level requirements to practical silicon solutions. Additional expertise in FPGA\-based analysis, memory design, design for test (DFT), cybersecurity, or AI acceleration is valuable but not required in every area. Working across product architecture, circuit design, fabrication engineering, and business\-unit and central engineering teams, you will bridge customer and market requirements with product\-family and IP implementation. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role with broad collaboration across disciplines and sensor domains. Define product and IP architectures that balance performance, cost, implementation risk, and reuse. Partner with experts across AMS product families to create differentiated solutions built on a consistent IP strategy. jobs.title: Product Engineer - Onboarding Automation
jobs.description: **About Stuut** =============== Stuut is the AI coworker that runs order\-to\-cash for the world’s leading enterprises. Across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, Stuut does the work end to end and keeps going until the cash hits the bank. Over 150 companies, spanning the mid\-market to the Fortune 50, including Honeywell, ZoomInfo and PerkinElmer, use Stuut to unlock up to 40% more cash flow and cut DSO by 47%. More than $3 billion has moved through the platform to date. Founded in New York by Tarek Alaruri and Ben Winter, Stuut has raised $93 million from Insight Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, M12, Microsoft’s Venture Fund, and others. Learn more at stuut.ai. **The Role** ------------ We're hiring our first Product Engineer dedicated to customer onboarding. Your job is to make bringing a new customer live on Stuut faster and smoother, and to build the tools our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team uses on every implementation. Every new customer brings its own ERP, data, email templates, and collections process. You'll work alongside our FDEs, find the steps that can be automated, and ship the tools that make each onboarding faster than the last: a smarter intake form and the APIs behind it, and agents that turn a customer's existing collateral into a configured account. This work also lays the foundation for channel partners to implement Stuut for their own clients. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Within your first quarter, you've shipped an onboarding automation used on live customers. Within 12 months, customers go live meaningfully faster, your tooling is a core part of every implementation, and it's robust enough for channel partners to use. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build the intake\-to\-configuration path:** Turn our intake form into a full product, with the APIs behind it so customer inputs configure an account end to end. * **Ship agents for onboarding:** Build LLM\-powered tools that turn customer collateral (email templates, collection playbooks, process docs) into working Stuut configuration. * **Make customer data easy:** Make ERP data, flat\-file, and schema mapping fast and reliable, whether that means building or integrating the right tool. * **Improve the onboarding toolkit:** Continuously improve the tools and automation our FDEs use on every implementation. * **Find the bottleneck, ship the simple fix:** Work with FDEs and customers, measure where time goes, and ship the smallest thing that moves it before building the big thing. * **Build for partners:** Design onboarding tooling that channel partners can use too. * **Build with agents:** Use coding agents daily to ship quickly, while owning the testing and debugging of what they produce. **You Might Be a Fit If You…** ------------------------------ * **Ship real LLM features:** You've built agents, tool use, and prompt/eval loops that run in production, not just demos. * **Build APIs and backends:** You're comfortable designing APIs that take structured input and configure a system end to end, in a large existing codebase. * **Handle messy data:** You've worked with ERP data, flat files, schema mapping, validation, and cleaning. ETL experience is a plus. * **Have product sense:** You can talk to internal users and customers, find the biggest bottleneck, and ship the simplest fix first. * **Work autonomously:** You scope your own projects once given priorities, and you're comfortable being the first person in a function that may grow into a team. * **Work agent\-native:** You use coding agents every day and can explain and stand behind their output. **Suggested background:** 5\+ years as a software engineer, with time in backend, full\-stack, or forward deployed roles at a B2B SaaS or fintech company. We weigh shipped work and judgment over any specific title. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * You've worked as a forward deployed, implementation, or solutions engineer. * You've built B2B SaaS onboarding, or worked in fintech, AR/AP, or ERP. * You've built tools that partners or customers use to implement a product themselves. **US Compensation** * Top\-of\-market salary and equity package * Benefits (for U.S.\-based full\-time employees) * Medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you * 401(k) \& Match * Equity * Flexible PTO * Parental Leave **Stuut is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.** We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and interview process. If you need any accommodations, please do not hesitate to reach out. Compensation Range: $190K \- $220K
